name: primorial_lt_four_pow
statement: theorem primorial_lt_four_pow (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) : n# < 4 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with | h n ihn =>
  rcases n with - | n; · grind
  rcases n.even_or_odd with ⟨m, rfl⟩ | ho
  · rcases m.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hm
    · decide
    calc
      (m + m + 1)# = (m + 1 + m)# := by rw [add_right_comm]
      _ ≤ (m + 1)# * choose (m + 1 + m) (m + 1) := primorial_add_le m.le_succ
      _ = (m + 1)# * choose (2 * m + 1) m := by rw [choose_symm_add, two_mul, add_right_comm]
      _ < 4 ^ (m + 1) * 4 ^ m :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_le (ihn _ (by lia) (by lia)) (choose_middle_le_pow _) (by simp)
      _ ≤ 4 ^ (m + m + 1) := by rw [← pow_add, add_right_comm]
  · rcases Decidable.eq_or_ne n 1 with rfl | hn
    · decide
    · calc
        (n + 1)# = n# := primorial_succ hn ho
        _ < 4 ^ n := ihn n n.lt_succ_self (by grind)
        _ ≤ 4 ^ (n + 1) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right four_pos n.le_succ

name: primorial_le_four_pow
statement: theorem primorial_le_four_pow (n : ℕ) : n# ≤ 4 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · decide
  · exact (primorial_lt_four_pow n hn).le

name: squarefree_primorial
statement: lemma squarefree_primorial (n : ℕ) : Squarefree (n#)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primorial_eq_prod_primesLE]
  refine Finset.squarefree_prod_of_pairwise_isCoprime (fun _ hp _ hq hpq ↦ ?_)
    fun _ hp ↦ (prime_of_mem_primesLE hp).squarefree
  simp only [← coprime_iff_isRelPrime]
  exact (coprime_primes (prime_of_mem_primesLE hp) (prime_of_mem_primesLE hq)).mpr hpq

name: quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap_symm_apply
statement:
lemma quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap_symm_apply (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤)
    (hx' : IsIntegral R x) (Q : R[X]) :
    (quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap hx hx').symm (Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) = Q.aeval x
proof:
:= by
  apply (quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap hx hx').injective
  rw [quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap, RingEquiv.symm_trans_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.coe_trans, Function.comp_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    RingEquiv.symm_trans_apply, quotEquivOfEq_symm, quotEquivOfEq_mk]
  congr
  convert! (adjoin.powerBasis' hx').quotientEquivQuotientMinpolyMap_symm_apply_mk I Q
  apply (quotAdjoinEquivQuotMap hx
    (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective ((adjoin R {x})) S)).injective
  simp only [RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, adjoin.powerBasis'_gen, quotAdjoinEquivQuotMap_apply_mk,
    coe_aeval_mk_apply]

name: emultiplicity_factors_map_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_factors_map_eq_emultiplicity
    (hI : IsMaximal I) (hI' : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤) (hx' : IsIntegral R x) {J : Ideal S}
    (hJ : J ∈ normalizedFactors (I.map (algebraMap R S))) :
    emultiplicity J (I.map (algebraMap R S)) =
      emultiplicity (↑(normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx' ⟨J, hJ⟩))
        (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk, Equiv.coe_trans, Function.comp_apply,
    Ideal.emultiplicity_normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors_symm_eq_emultiplicity,
    IsDedekindDomain.normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_emultiplicity_eq_emultiplicity]

name: normalizedFactors_ideal_map_eq_normalizedFactors_min_poly_mk_map
statement:
theorem normalizedFactors_ideal_map_eq_normalizedFactors_min_poly_mk_map (hI : IsMaximal I)
    (hI' : I ≠ ⊥) (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤) (hx' : IsIntegral R x) :
    normalizedFactors (I.map (algebraMap R S)) =
      Multiset.map
        (fun f =>
          ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm f : Ideal S))
        (normalizedFactors (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x))).attach
proof:
:= by
  ext J
  
  by_cases hJ : J ∈ normalizedFactors (I.map (algebraMap R S))
  swap
  · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hJ, eq_comm, Multiset.count_eq_zero, Multiset.mem_map]
    simp only [not_exists]
    rintro J' ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact
      hJ ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm J').prop
  
  have := emultiplicity_factors_map_eq_emultiplicity hI hI' hx hx' hJ
  rw [emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors, emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor _ hJ,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalize_normalized_factor, Nat.cast_inj] at this
  · refine this.trans ?_
    
    generalize hJ' :
      (normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx') ⟨J, hJ⟩ = J'
    have : ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm J' : Ideal S) =
        J := by
      rw [← hJ', Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _, Subtype.coe_mk]
    subst this
    
    rw [Multiset.count_map_eq_count' fun f =>
        ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm f :
          Ideal S),
      Multiset.count_attach]
    · exact Subtype.coe_injective.comp (Equiv.injective _)
  · exact (normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx' _).prop
  · exact irreducible_of_normalized_factor _
        (normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx' _).prop
  · exact Polynomial.map_monic_ne_zero (minpoly.monic hx')
  · exact irreducible_of_normalized_factor _ hJ
  · rwa [← bot_eq_zero, Ne,
      map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S)]

name: Ideal.irreducible_map_of_irreducible_minpoly
statement:
theorem Ideal.irreducible_map_of_irreducible_minpoly (hI : IsMaximal I) (hI' : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤) (hx' : IsIntegral R x)
    (hf : Irreducible (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x))) :
    Irreducible (I.map (algebraMap R S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have mem_norm_factors : normalize (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x)) ∈
      normalizedFactors (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x)) := by
    simp [normalizedFactors_irreducible hf]
  suffices ∃ y, normalizedFactors (I.map (algebraMap R S)) = {y} by
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := this
    have h := prod_normalizedFactors (show I.map (algebraMap R S) ≠ 0 by
          rwa [← bot_eq_zero, Ne,
            map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R S)])
    rw [associated_iff_eq, hy, Multiset.prod_singleton] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact
      irreducible_of_normalized_factor y
        (show y ∈ normalizedFactors (I.map (algebraMap R S)) by simp [hy])
  rw [normalizedFactors_ideal_map_eq_normalizedFactors_min_poly_mk_map hI hI' hx hx']
  use ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm
        ⟨normalize (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x)), mem_norm_factors⟩ :
      Ideal S)
  rw [Multiset.map_eq_singleton]
  use ⟨normalize (Polynomial.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (minpoly R x)), mem_norm_factors⟩
  refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
  apply Multiset.map_injective Subtype.coe_injective
  rw [Multiset.attach_map_val, Multiset.map_singleton, Subtype.coe_mk]
  exact normalizedFactors_irreducible hf

name: normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk_symm_apply_eq_span
statement:
theorem normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk_symm_apply_eq_span
    (hI : I.IsMaximal) {Q : R[X]}
    (hQ : Q.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) ∈ normalizedFactors ((minpoly R x).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)))
    (hI' : I ≠ ⊥) (hx : (conductor R x).comap (algebraMap R S) ⊔ I = ⊤) (hx' : IsIntegral R x) :
    ((normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk hI hI' hx hx').symm ⟨_, hQ⟩).val =
    span (I.map (algebraMap R S) ∪ {Q.aeval x})
proof:
:= by
  unfold normalizedFactorsMapEquivNormalizedFactorsMinPolyMk
    Ideal.normalizedFactorsEquivSpanNormalizedFactors
  rw [Equiv.symm_trans_apply, IsDedekindDomain.normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv_symm]
  unfold IsDedekindDomain.normalizedFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv
  rw [Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.symm_symm, Equiv.ofBijective_apply]
  dsimp only
  unfold IsDedekindDomain.idealFactorsEquivOfQuotEquiv
  rw [OrderIso.ofHomInv_apply]
  erw [IsDedekindDomain.idealFactorsFunOfQuotHom_coe_coe]
  dsimp only
  rw [map_span, image_singleton, map_span, image_singleton, coe_coe,
    quotMapEquivQuotQuotMap_symm_apply, span_union, span_eq, sup_comm,
    ← image_singleton, ← map_span, Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective' _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective,
    Ideal.mk_ker]

name: gaussSum_mulShift
statement:
theorem gaussSum_mulShift (χ : MulChar R R') (ψ : AddChar R R') (a : Rˣ) :
    χ a * gaussSum χ (mulShift ψ a) = gaussSum χ ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussSum, mulShift_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
  exact Fintype.sum_bijective _ a.mulLeft_bijective _ _ fun x ↦ rfl

name: gaussSum_mulShift_eq
statement:
theorem gaussSum_mulShift_eq (χ : MulChar R R') (ψ : AddChar R R') (a : Rˣ) :
    gaussSum χ (ψ.mulShift a) = χ⁻¹ a * gaussSum χ ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← gaussSum_mulShift χ ψ a, inv_apply_eq_inv,
    Ring.inverse_mul_cancel_left _ _ (a.isUnit.map χ)]

name: star_gaussSum_eq
statement:
lemma star_gaussSum_eq (χ : MulChar R ℂ) (ψ : AddChar R ℂ) :
    star (gaussSum χ ψ) = gaussSum χ⁻¹ ψ⁻¹
proof:
:=
  calc
    _ = ∑ x, star (ψ x) * χ⁻¹ x := by simp [gaussSum, star_mul, MulChar.star_apply']
    _ = ∑ x, ψ⁻¹ x * χ⁻¹ x := by simp [← starRingEnd_apply, map_neg_eq_conj]
    _ = _ := by simp [mul_comm, gaussSum]

name: gaussSum_one_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaussSum_one_one : gaussSum (1 : MulChar R R') (1 : AddChar R R') = Nat.card Rˣ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [gaussSum, MulChar.sum_one_eq_card_units]

name: gaussSum_one_right
statement:
theorem gaussSum_one_right [IsDomain R'] {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ ≠ 1) :
    gaussSum χ (1 : AddChar R R') = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [gaussSum] using MulChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hχ

name: gaussSum_one_left
statement:
theorem gaussSum_one_left {ψ : AddChar R R'} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) :
    gaussSum (1 : MulChar R R') ψ = -1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [gaussSum, ← add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg]
  calc ∑ a, (1 : MulChar R R') a * ψ a + 1
  _ = ∑ a ∈ {0}ᶜ, (1 : MulChar R R') a * ψ a + 1 := by
    simp [← ({0} : Finset R).sum_compl_add_sum]
  _ = ∑ a ∈ {0}ᶜ, ψ a + ψ 0 := by
    congr! <;> aesop (add simp MulChar.one_apply)
  _ = 0 := by
    rw [← AddChar.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hψ, ← Finset.sum_compl_add_sum (s := {0})]
    simp

name: gaussSum_mul
statement:
lemma gaussSum_mul {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Fintype R] {R' : Type v} [CommRing R']
    (χ φ : MulChar R R') (ψ : AddChar R R') :
    gaussSum χ ψ * gaussSum φ ψ = ∑ t : R, ∑ x : R, χ x * φ (t - x) * ψ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussSum, gaussSum, sum_mul_sum]
  conv => enter [1, 2, x, 2, x_1]; rw [mul_mul_mul_comm]
  simp only [← ψ.map_add_eq_mul]
  have sum_eq x : ∑ y : R, χ x * φ y * ψ (x + y) = ∑ y : R, χ x * φ (y - x) * ψ y := by
    rw [sum_bij (fun a _ ↦ a + x)]
    · simp only [mem_univ, forall_const]
    · simp only [mem_univ, add_left_inj, imp_self, forall_const]
    · exact fun b _ ↦ ⟨b - x, mem_univ _, by rw [sub_add_cancel]⟩
    · exact fun a _ ↦ by rw [add_sub_cancel_right, add_comm]
  rw [sum_congr rfl fun x _ ↦ sum_eq x, sum_comm]

name: mul_gaussSum_inv_eq_gaussSum
statement:
lemma mul_gaussSum_inv_eq_gaussSum (χ : MulChar R R') (ψ : AddChar R R') :
    χ (-1) * gaussSum χ ψ⁻¹ = gaussSum χ ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [ψ.inv_mulShift, ← Units.coe_neg_one]
  exact gaussSum_mulShift χ ψ (-1)

name: gaussSum_mul_aux
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with hb | hb
  · 
    simp only [hb, inv_zero, mul_zero, MulChar.map_zero, zero_mul,
      Finset.sum_const_zero, map_zero_eq_one, mul_one, χ.sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one hχ]
  · 
    refine (Fintype.sum_bijective _ (mulLeft_bijective₀ b hb) _ _ fun x ↦ ?_).symm
    rw [mul_assoc, mul_comm x, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb, one_mul, mul_sub, mul_one]

name: gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_eq_card
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaussSum, AddChar.inv_apply, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, MulChar.inv_apply']
  conv =>
    enter [1, 2, x, 2, y]
    rw [mul_mul_mul_comm, ← map_mul, ← map_add_eq_mul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

  simp_rw [gaussSum_mul_aux hχ ψ]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  classical 
  simp_rw [← Finset.mul_sum, sum_mulShift _ hψ, sub_eq_zero, apply_ite, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (1 : R)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, map_one, one_mul, ite_true]

name: gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_pow_orderOf_sub_one
proof:
:= by
  have h : χ ^ (orderOf χ - 1) = χ⁻¹ := by
    refine (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right ?_).symm
    rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_one_add_one_eq_of_pos χ.orderOf_pos, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
  rw [h, ← mul_gaussSum_inv_eq_gaussSum χ⁻¹, mul_left_comm, gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_eq_card hχ hψ,
    MulChar.inv_apply', inv_neg_one]

name: gaussSum_ne_zero_of_nontrivial
proof:
:=
  fun H ↦ h.symm <| zero_mul (gaussSum χ⁻¹ _) ▸ H ▸ gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_eq_card hχ hψ

name: gaussSum_sq
statement:
theorem gaussSum_sq {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ₁ : χ ≠ 1) (hχ₂ : IsQuadratic χ)
    {ψ : AddChar R R'} (hψ : IsPrimitive ψ) :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ (-1) * Fintype.card R
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_two, ← gaussSum_mul_gaussSum_eq_card hχ₁ hψ, hχ₂.inv, mul_rotate']
  congr
  rw [mul_comm, ← gaussSum_mulShift _ _ (-1 : Rˣ), inv_mulShift]
  rfl

name: gaussSum_frob
statement:
theorem gaussSum_frob (χ : MulChar R R') (ψ : AddChar R R') :
    gaussSum χ ψ ^ p = gaussSum (χ ^ p) (ψ ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← frobenius_def, gaussSum, gaussSum, map_sum]
  simp_rw [pow_apply' χ fp.1.ne_zero, map_mul, frobenius_def]
  rfl

name: MulChar.IsQuadratic.gaussSum_frob
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.gaussSum_frob, pow_mulShift, hχ.pow_char p, ← gaussSum_mulShift χ ψ hp.unit,
    ← mul_assoc, hp.unit_spec, ← pow_two, ← pow_apply' _ two_ne_zero, hχ.sq_eq_one, ← hp.unit_spec,
    one_apply_coe, one_mul]

name: MulChar.IsQuadratic.gaussSum_frob_iter
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_one, pow_zero, MulChar.map_one, one_mul]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, ih, mul_pow, hχ.gaussSum_frob _ hp, ← mul_assoc, pow_succ, map_mul,
      ← pow_apply' χ fp.1.ne_zero ((p : R) ^ n), hχ.pow_char p]

name: Char.card_pow_char_pow
statement:
theorem Char.card_pow_char_pow {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : IsQuadratic χ) (ψ : AddChar R R') (p n : ℕ)
    [fp : Fact p.Prime] [hch : CharP R' p] (hp : IsUnit (p : R)) (hp' : p ≠ 2)
    (hg : gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ (-1) * Fintype.card R) :
    (χ (-1) * Fintype.card R) ^ (p ^ n / 2) = χ ((p : R) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  have : gaussSum χ ψ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    rw [hf, zero_pow two_ne_zero, eq_comm, mul_eq_zero] at hg
    exact not_isUnit_prime_of_dvd_card
        ((CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff R' p _).mp <| hg.resolve_left (isUnit_one.neg.map χ).ne_zero) hp
  rw [← hg]
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ this
  rw [← hχ.gaussSum_frob_iter p n hp ψ, ← pow_mul, ← pow_succ,
    Nat.two_mul_div_two_add_one_of_odd (fp.1.eq_two_or_odd'.resolve_left hp').pow]

name: Char.card_pow_card
statement:
theorem Char.card_pow_card {F : Type*} [Field F] [Fintype F] {F' : Type*} [Field F'] [Fintype F']
    {χ : MulChar F F'} (hχ₁ : χ ≠ 1) (hχ₂ : IsQuadratic χ)
    (hch₁ : ringChar F' ≠ ringChar F) (hch₂ : ringChar F' ≠ 2) :
    (χ (-1) * Fintype.card F) ^ (Fintype.card F' / 2) = χ (Fintype.card F')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hp, hc⟩ := FiniteField.card F (ringChar F)
  obtain ⟨n', hp', hc'⟩ := FiniteField.card F' (ringChar F')
  let ψ := FiniteField.primitiveChar F F' hch₁
  let FF' := CyclotomicField ψ.n F'
  have hchar := Algebra.ringChar_eq F' FF'
  apply (algebraMap F' FF').injective
  rw [map_pow, map_mul, map_natCast, hc', hchar, Nat.cast_pow]
  simp only [← MulChar.ringHomComp_apply]
  have := Fact.mk hp'
  have := Fact.mk (hchar.subst hp')
  rw [Ne, ← Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hp' hp, ← isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char, hchar] at hch₁
  exact Char.card_pow_char_pow (hχ₂.comp _) ψ.char (ringChar FF') n' hch₁ (hchar ▸ hch₂)
       (gaussSum_sq ((ringHomComp_ne_one_iff (RingHom.injective _)).mpr hχ₁) (hχ₂.comp _) ψ.prim)

name: FiniteField.two_pow_card
statement:
theorem FiniteField.two_pow_card {F : Type*} [Fintype F] [Field F] (hF : ringChar F ≠ 2) :
    (2 : F) ^ (Fintype.card F / 2) = χ₈ (Fintype.card F)
proof:
:= by
  have hp2 (n : ℕ) : (2 ^ n : F) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero n (Ring.two_ne_zero hF)
  obtain ⟨n, hp, hc⟩ := FiniteField.card F (ringChar F)
  
  let FF := CyclotomicField 8 F
  have hchar := Algebra.ringChar_eq F FF
  have FFp := hchar.subst hp
  have := Fact.mk FFp
  have hFF := hchar ▸ hF 
  have hu : IsUnit (ringChar FF : ZMod 8) := by
    rw [isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char, ringChar_zmod_n]
    rw [Ne, ← Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq FFp Nat.prime_two] at hFF
    change ¬_ ∣ 2 ^ 3
    exact mt FFp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hFF
  
  
  let ψ₈ := primitiveZModChar 8 F (by convert! hp2 3 using 1; norm_cast)
  
  
  let ψ₈char : AddChar (ZMod 8) FF := ψ₈.char
  let τ : FF := ψ₈char 1
  have τ_spec : τ ^ 4 = -1 := by
    rw [show τ = ψ₈.char 1 from rfl] 
    refine (sq_eq_one_iff.1 ?_).resolve_left ?_
    · rw [← pow_mul, ← map_nsmul_eq_pow ψ₈.char, ψ₈.prim.zmod_char_eq_one_iff]
      decide
    · rw [← map_nsmul_eq_pow ψ₈.char, ψ₈.prim.zmod_char_eq_one_iff]
      decide
  
  let χ := χ₈.ringHomComp (Int.castRingHom FF)
  have hχ : χ (-1) = 1 := Int.cast_one
  have hq : IsQuadratic χ := isQuadratic_χ₈.comp _
  
  have h₁ : (fun (a : Fin 8) ↦ ↑(χ₈ a) * τ ^ (a : ℕ)) = fun a ↦ χ a * ↑(ψ₈char a) := by
    ext1; congr; apply pow_one
  have hg₁ : gaussSum χ ψ₈char = 2 * (τ - τ ^ 3) := by
    rw [gaussSum, ← h₁, Fin.sum_univ_eight,
      
      show χ₈ 0 = 0 from rfl, show χ₈ 1 = 1 from rfl, show χ₈ 2 = 0 from rfl,
      show χ₈ 3 = -1 from rfl, show χ₈ 4 = 0 from rfl, show χ₈ 5 = -1 from rfl,
      show χ₈ 6 = 0 from rfl, show χ₈ 7 = 1 from rfl,
      
      show ((3 : Fin 8) : ℕ) = 3 from rfl, show ((5 : Fin 8) : ℕ) = 5 from rfl,
      show ((7 : Fin 8) : ℕ) = 7 from rfl]
    simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, Int.cast_one, Fin.val_one, pow_one, one_mul, zero_add,
      Fin.val_two, add_zero, Int.reduceNeg, Int.cast_neg]
    linear_combination (τ ^ 3 - τ) * τ_spec
  have hg : gaussSum χ ψ₈char ^ 2 = χ (-1) * Fintype.card (ZMod 8) := by
    rw [hχ, one_mul, ZMod.card, Nat.cast_ofNat, hg₁]
    linear_combination (4 * τ ^ 2 - 8) * τ_spec
  
  have h := Char.card_pow_char_pow (R := ZMod 8) hq ψ₈char (ringChar FF) n hu hFF hg
  rw [ZMod.card, ← hchar, hχ, one_mul, ← hc, ← Nat.cast_pow (ringChar F), ← hc] at h
  
  convert_to (8 : F) ^ (Fintype.card F / 2) = _
  · rw [(by norm_num : (8 : F) = 2 ^ 2 * 2), mul_pow,
      (FiniteField.isSquare_iff hF <| hp2 2).mp ⟨2, pow_two 2⟩, one_mul]
  apply (algebraMap F FF).injective
  simpa only [map_pow, map_ofNat, map_intCast, Nat.cast_ofNat] using! h

name: pow_totient_mod_eq_one
statement:
lemma pow_totient_mod_eq_one {x n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (h : x.Coprime n) :
    (x ^ φ n) % n = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact mod_eq_of_modEq (ModEq.pow_totient h) hn

name: pow_add_totient_mod_eq
statement:
lemma pow_add_totient_mod_eq {x k n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (h : x.Coprime n) :
    (x ^ (k + φ n)) % n = (x ^ k) % n
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add, mul_mod, pow_totient_mod_eq_one hn h]
  simp only [mul_one, dvd_refl, mod_mod_of_dvd]

name: pow_add_mul_totient_mod_eq
statement:
lemma pow_add_mul_totient_mod_eq {x k l n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (h : x.Coprime n) :
    (x ^ (k + l * φ n)) % n = (x ^ k) % n
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | zero => simp
  | succ l ih =>
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, ← add_assoc, pow_add_totient_mod_eq hn h, ih]

name: pow_totient_mod
statement:
lemma pow_totient_mod {x k n : ℕ} (hn : 1 < n) (h : x.Coprime n) :
    x ^ k % n = x ^ (k % φ n) % n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← div_add_mod' k (φ n), add_comm, pow_add_mul_totient_mod_eq hn h, add_mul_mod_self_right,
    mod_mod k (φ n)]

name: dvd_sub_pow_of_dvd_sub
statement:
theorem dvd_sub_pow_of_dvd_sub {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {p : ℕ} {a b : R} (h : (p : R) ∣ a - b)
    (k : ℕ) : (p ^ (k + 1) : R) ∣ a ^ p ^ k - b ^ p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rwa [pow_one, pow_zero, pow_one, pow_one]
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [pow_succ p k, pow_mul, pow_mul, ← geom_sum₂_mul, pow_succ']
    refine mul_dvd_mul ?_ ih
    let f : R →+* R ⧸ span {(p : R)} := mk (span {(p : R)})
    have hf : ∀ r : R, (p : R) ∣ r ↔ f r = 0 := fun r ↦ by rw [eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_span_singleton]
    rw [hf, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
    rw [hf, RingHom.map_geom_sum₂, map_pow, map_pow, h, geom_sum₂_self, mul_eq_zero_of_left]
    rw [← map_natCast f, eq_zero_iff_mem, mem_span_singleton]

name: filter_dvd_eq_divisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_dvd_eq_divisors (h : n ≠ 0) : {d ∈ range n.succ | d ∣ n} = n.divisors
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [divisors, mem_filter, mem_range, mem_Ico, and_congr_left_iff, iff_and_self]
  exact fun ha _ => succ_le_iff.mpr (pos_of_dvd_of_pos ha h.bot_lt)

name: filter_dvd_eq_properDivisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem filter_dvd_eq_properDivisors (h : n ≠ 0) : {d ∈ range n | d ∣ n} = n.properDivisors
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [properDivisors, mem_filter, mem_range, mem_Ico, and_congr_left_iff, iff_and_self]
  exact fun ha _ => succ_le_iff.mpr (pos_of_dvd_of_pos ha h.bot_lt)

name: self_notMem_properDivisors
statement: theorem self_notMem_properDivisors : n ∉ properDivisors n
proof: := by simp [properDivisors]

name: mem_properDivisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_properDivisors {m : ℕ} : n ∈ properDivisors m ↔ n ∣ m ∧ n < m
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm); · simp [properDivisors]
  simp only [and_comm, ← filter_dvd_eq_properDivisors hm, mem_filter, mem_range]

name: insert_self_properDivisors
statement: theorem insert_self_properDivisors (h : n ≠ 0) : insert n (properDivisors n) = divisors n
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisors, properDivisors,
    ← Finset.insert_Ico_right_eq_Ico_add_one (one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 h),
    Finset.filter_insert, ite_eq_left (dvd_refl n)]

name: cons_self_properDivisors
statement:
theorem cons_self_properDivisors (h : n ≠ 0) :
    cons n (properDivisors n) self_notMem_properDivisors = divisors n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cons_eq_insert, insert_self_properDivisors h]

name: mem_divisors
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_divisors {m : ℕ} : n ∈ divisors m ↔ n ∣ m ∧ m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm); · simp [divisors]
  simp only [hm, Ne, not_false_iff, and_true, ← filter_dvd_eq_divisors hm, mem_filter,
    mem_range, and_iff_right_iff_imp, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
  exact le_of_dvd hm.bot_lt

name: dvd_of_mem_divisors
statement: theorem dvd_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : n ∈ divisors m) : n ∣ m
proof: := (mem_divisors.mp h).1

name: ne_zero_of_mem_divisors
statement: theorem ne_zero_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : n ∈ divisors m) : m ≠ 0
proof: := (mem_divisors.mp h).2

name: one_mem_divisors
statement: theorem one_mem_divisors : 1 ∈ divisors n ↔ n ≠ 0
proof: := by simp

name: mem_divisors_self
statement: theorem mem_divisors_self (n : ℕ) (h : n ≠ 0) : n ∈ n.divisors
proof:
:=
  mem_divisors.2 ⟨dvd_rfl, h⟩

name: mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n ↔ x.fst * x.snd = n ∧ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := x
  simp only [divisorsAntidiagonal, mul_div_eq_iff_dvd, mem_filterMap, mem_Icc, one_le_iff_ne_zero,
    Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, Option.some.injEq, Prod.ext_iff, and_left_comm, exists_eq_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨han, ⟨ha, han'⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [Nat.mul_div_eq_iff_dvd, han]
    lia
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hab⟩
    rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at hab
    simpa [hab.1, hab.2] using Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ hab.2.bot_lt

name: divisorsAntidiagonalList_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma divisorsAntidiagonalList_zero : divisorsAntidiagonalList 0 = []
proof: := rfl

name: divisorsAntidiagonalList_one
statement: @[simp] lemma divisorsAntidiagonalList_one : divisorsAntidiagonalList 1 = [(1, 1)]
proof: := rfl

name: toFinset_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
@[simp]
lemma toFinset_divisorsAntidiagonalList {n : ℕ} :
    n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.toFinset = n.divisorsAntidiagonal
proof:
:= by
  rw [divisorsAntidiagonalList, divisorsAntidiagonal, List.toFinset_filterMap
    (f_inj := by simp_all), List.toFinset_range'_1_1]

name: pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_fst
statement:
lemma pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_fst {n : ℕ} :
    n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.Pairwise (·.fst < ·.fst)
proof:
:= by
  refine (List.sortedLT_range' _ _ Nat.one_ne_zero).pairwise.filterMap _ fun a b c d h ha h' => ?_
  rw [Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, Option.some.injEq] at h h'
  simpa [← h.right, ← h'.right]

name: pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_snd
statement:
lemma pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_snd {n : ℕ} :
    n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.Pairwise (·.snd > ·.snd)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  refine (List.sortedLT_range' _ _ Nat.one_ne_zero).pairwise.filterMap _ ?_
  simp only [Option.ite_none_right_eq_some, Option.some.injEq, gt_iff_lt,
    and_imp, Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq]
  rintro a b hab _ _ ha rfl rfl _ _ hb rfl rfl
  rwa [Nat.div_lt_div_left hn ⟨_, hb.symm⟩ ⟨_, ha.symm⟩]

name: sortedLT_map_fst_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
lemma sortedLT_map_fst_divisorsAntidiagonalList {n : ℕ} :
    (n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.map Prod.fst).SortedLT
proof:
:=
  (List.pairwise_map.mpr <| pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_fst).sortedLT

name: sortedGT_map_snd_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
lemma sortedGT_map_snd_divisorsAntidiagonalList {n : ℕ} :
    (n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.map Prod.snd).SortedGT
proof:
:=
  (List.pairwise_map.mpr <| pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_snd).sortedGT

name: nodup_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement: lemma nodup_divisorsAntidiagonalList {n : ℕ} : n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.Nodup
proof:
:=
  have : @Std.Irrefl (ℕ × ℕ) (·.fst < ·.fst) := ⟨by simp⟩
  pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_fst.nodup

name: val_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem val_divisorsAntidiagonal (n : ℕ) :
    (divisorsAntidiagonal n).val = divisorsAntidiagonalList n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: mem_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_divisorsAntidiagonalList {n : ℕ} {a : ℕ × ℕ} :
    a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonalList ↔ a.1 * a.2 = n ∧ n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← List.mem_toFinset, toFinset_divisorsAntidiagonalList, mem_divisorsAntidiagonal]

name: swap_mem_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
@[simp high]
lemma swap_mem_divisorsAntidiagonalList {a : ℕ × ℕ} :
    a.swap ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonalList ↔ a ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonalList
proof: := by simp [mul_comm]

name: reverse_divisorsAntidiagonalList
statement:
lemma reverse_divisorsAntidiagonalList (n : ℕ) :
    n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.reverse = n.divisorsAntidiagonalList.map .swap
proof:
:= by
  have : Std.Asymm (α := ℕ × ℕ) (·.snd < ·.snd) := ⟨fun _ _ ↦ lt_asymm⟩
  refine List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_snd.reverse
    (pairwise_divisorsAntidiagonalList_fst.map _ fun _ _ ↦ id) ?_
  simp [List.reverse_perm', List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup nodup_divisorsAntidiagonalList
    (nodup_divisorsAntidiagonalList.map Prod.swap_injective), mul_comm]

name: ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
lemma ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal) :
    p.1 ≠ 0 ∧ p.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ := Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mp hp
  exact mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hp₁.symm ▸ hp₂)

name: left_ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
lemma left_ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal) :
    p.1 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal hp).1

name: right_ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
lemma right_ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal) :
    p.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal hp).2

name: divisor_le
statement: theorem divisor_le {m : ℕ} : n ∈ divisors m → n ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with - | m
  · simp
  · simp only [mem_divisors, Nat.succ_ne_zero m, and_true, Ne, not_false_iff]
    exact Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos m)

name: divisors_subset_of_dvd
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem divisors_subset_of_dvd {m : ℕ} (hzero : n ≠ 0) (h : m ∣ n) : divisors m ⊆ divisors n
proof:
:=
  Finset.subset_iff.2 fun _x hx => Nat.mem_divisors.mpr ⟨(Nat.mem_divisors.mp hx).1.trans h, hzero⟩

name: card_divisors_le_self
statement: theorem card_divisors_le_self (n : ℕ) : #n.divisors ≤ n
proof:
:= calc
  _ ≤ #(Ico 1 (n + 1)) := by
    apply card_le_card
    simp only [divisors, filter_subset]
  _ = n := by rw [card_Ico, add_tsub_cancel_right]

name: divisors_subset_properDivisors
statement:
theorem divisors_subset_properDivisors {m : ℕ} (hzero : n ≠ 0) (h : m ∣ n) (hdiff : m ≠ n) :
    divisors m ⊆ properDivisors n
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.subset_iff.2
  intro x hx
  exact
    Nat.mem_properDivisors.2
      ⟨(Nat.mem_divisors.1 hx).1.trans h,
        lt_of_le_of_lt (divisor_le hx)
          (lt_of_le_of_ne (divisor_le (Nat.mem_divisors.2 ⟨h, hzero⟩)) hdiff)⟩

name: divisors_filter_dvd_of_dvd
statement:
lemma divisors_filter_dvd_of_dvd {n m : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hm : m ∣ n) :
    {d ∈ n.divisors | d ∣ m} = m.divisors
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  simp_rw [mem_filter, mem_divisors]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, hkm⟩ ↦ ⟨hkm, ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero hn hm⟩, fun ⟨hk, _⟩ ↦ ⟨⟨hk.trans hm, hn⟩, hk⟩⟩

name: divisors_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisors_zero : divisors 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: properDivisors_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properDivisors_zero : properDivisors 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: nonempty_divisors
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nonempty_divisors : (divisors n).Nonempty ↔ n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨m, hm⟩ hn ↦ by simp [hn] at hm, fun hn ↦ ⟨1, one_mem_divisors.2 hn⟩⟩

name: divisors_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma divisors_eq_empty : divisors n = ∅ ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  exact nonempty_divisors

name: properDivisors_subset_divisors
statement: theorem properDivisors_subset_divisors : properDivisors n ⊆ divisors n
proof:
:=
  filter_subset_filter _ <| Ico_subset_Ico_right n.le_succ

name: divisors_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisors_one : divisors 1 = {1}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: properDivisors_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem properDivisors_one : properDivisors 1 = ∅
proof: := by rw [properDivisors, Ico_self, filter_empty]

name: pos_of_mem_divisors
statement: theorem pos_of_mem_divisors {m : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.divisors) : 0 < m
proof:
:= by
  cases m
  · rw [mem_divisors, zero_dvd_iff (a := n)] at h
    cases h.2 h.1
  apply Nat.succ_pos

name: pos_of_mem_properDivisors
statement: theorem pos_of_mem_properDivisors {m : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.properDivisors) : 0 < m
proof:
:=
  pos_of_mem_divisors (properDivisors_subset_divisors h)

name: one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt
statement: theorem one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt : 1 ∈ n.properDivisors ↔ 1 < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_properDivisors, and_iff_right (one_dvd _)]

name: sup_divisors_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma sup_divisors_id (n : ℕ) : n.divisors.sup id = n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le fun _ ↦ divisor_le) ?_
  rcases Decidable.eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · apply zero_le
  · exact Finset.le_sup (f := id) <| mem_divisors_self n hn

name: one_lt_of_mem_properDivisors
statement: lemma one_lt_of_mem_properDivisors {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.properDivisors) : 1 < n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (pos_of_mem_properDivisors h) (mem_properDivisors.1 h).2

name: one_lt_div_of_mem_properDivisors
statement:
lemma one_lt_div_of_mem_properDivisors {m n : ℕ} (h : m ∈ n.properDivisors) :
    1 < n / m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h_dvd, h_lt⟩ := mem_properDivisors.mp h
  rwa [Nat.lt_div_iff_mul_lt' h_dvd, mul_one]

name: mem_properDivisors_iff_exists
statement:
lemma mem_properDivisors_iff_exists {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    m ∈ n.properDivisors ↔ ∃ k > 1, n = m * k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ⟨n / m, one_lt_div_of_mem_properDivisors h, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact (Nat.mul_div_cancel' (mem_properDivisors.mp h).1).symm
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩
    rw [mul_ne_zero_iff] at hn
    exact mem_properDivisors.mpr ⟨⟨k, rfl⟩, lt_mul_of_one_lt_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn.1) hk⟩

name: nonempty_properDivisors
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nonempty_properDivisors : n.properDivisors.Nonempty ↔ 1 < n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨_m, hm⟩ ↦ one_lt_of_mem_properDivisors hm, fun hn ↦
    ⟨1, one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt.2 hn⟩⟩

name: properDivisors_eq_empty
statement:
@[simp]
lemma properDivisors_eq_empty : n.properDivisors = ∅ ↔ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  contrapose!
  exact nonempty_properDivisors

name: divisorsAntidiagonal_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorsAntidiagonal_zero : divisorsAntidiagonal 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp

name: divisorsAntidiagonal_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisorsAntidiagonal_one : divisorsAntidiagonal 1 = {(1, 1)}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [mul_eq_one, Prod.ext_iff]

name: swap_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem swap_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} :
    x.swap ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n ↔ x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mul_comm, Prod.swap]

name: prodMk_mem_divisorsAntidiag
statement:
lemma prodMk_mem_divisorsAntidiag {x y : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (x, y) ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal ↔ x * y = n
proof: := by simp [hn]

name: fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} (h : x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n) :
    x.fst ∈ divisors n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal] at h
  simp [Dvd.intro _ h.1, h.2]

name: snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal
statement:
theorem snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal {x : ℕ × ℕ} (h : x ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal n) :
    x.snd ∈ divisors n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal] at h
  simp [Dvd.intro_left _ h.1, h.2]

name: map_swap_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_swap_divisorsAntidiagonal :
    (divisorsAntidiagonal n).map (Equiv.prodComm _ _).toEmbedding = divisorsAntidiagonal n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_inj, coe_map, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, Equiv.coe_prodComm,
    Set.image_swap_eq_preimage_swap]
  ext
  exact swap_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal

name: image_fst_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_fst_divisorsAntidiagonal : (divisorsAntidiagonal n).image Prod.fst = divisors n
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [Dvd.dvd, @eq_comm _ n (_ * _)]

name: image_snd_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_snd_divisorsAntidiagonal : (divisorsAntidiagonal n).image Prod.snd = divisors n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_swap_divisorsAntidiagonal, map_eq_image, image_image]
  exact image_fst_divisorsAntidiagonal

name: map_div_right_divisors
statement:
theorem map_div_right_divisors :
    n.divisors.map ⟨fun d => (d, n / d), fun _ _ => congr_arg Prod.fst⟩ =
      n.divisorsAntidiagonal
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨d, nd⟩
  simp only [mem_map, mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, mem_divisors,
    Prod.ext_iff, and_left_comm, exists_eq_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨k, rfl⟩, hn⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hn).bot_lt]
    exact ⟨rfl, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, hn⟩
    exact ⟨⟨dvd_mul_right _ _, hn⟩, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (left_ne_zero_of_mul hn).bot_lt⟩

name: map_div_left_divisors
statement:
theorem map_div_left_divisors :
    n.divisors.map ⟨fun d => (n / d, d), fun _ _ => congr_arg Prod.snd⟩ =
      n.divisorsAntidiagonal
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.map_injective (Equiv.prodComm _ _).toEmbedding
  ext
  rw [map_swap_divisorsAntidiagonal, ← map_div_right_divisors, Finset.map_map]
  simp

name: sum_divisors_eq_sum_properDivisors_add_self
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_eq_sum_properDivisors_add_self :
    ∑ i ∈ divisors n, i = (∑ i ∈ properDivisors n, i) + n
proof:
:= by
  rcases Decidable.eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  · rw [← cons_self_properDivisors hn, Finset.sum_cons, add_comm]

name: perfect_iff_sum_properDivisors
statement: theorem perfect_iff_sum_properDivisors (h : 0 < n) : Perfect n ↔ ∑ i ∈ properDivisors n, i = n
proof:
:=
  and_iff_left h

name: perfect_iff_sum_divisors_eq_two_mul
statement:
theorem perfect_iff_sum_divisors_eq_two_mul (h : 0 < n) :
    Perfect n ↔ ∑ i ∈ divisors n, i = 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  rw [perfect_iff_sum_properDivisors h, sum_divisors_eq_sum_properDivisors_add_self, two_mul]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [h]
  · apply add_right_cancel h

name: mem_divisors_prime_pow
statement:
theorem mem_divisors_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) {x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ divisors (p ^ k) ↔ ∃ j ≤ k, x = p ^ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_divisors, Nat.dvd_prime_pow pp, and_iff_left (ne_of_gt (pow_pos pp.pos k))]

name: Prime.divisors
statement: theorem Prime.divisors {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) : divisors p = {1, p}
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [mem_divisors, dvd_prime pp, and_iff_left pp.ne_zero, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]

name: Prime.properDivisors
statement: theorem Prime.properDivisors {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) : properDivisors p = {1}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← erase_insert self_notMem_properDivisors, insert_self_properDivisors pp.ne_zero,
    pp.divisors, pair_comm, erase_insert fun con => pp.ne_one (mem_singleton.1 con)]

name: divisors_prime_pow
statement:
theorem divisors_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) :
    divisors (p ^ k) = (Finset.range (k + 1)).map ⟨(p ^ ·), Nat.pow_right_injective pp.two_le⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [mem_divisors_prime_pow pp]
  simp [eq_comm]

name: divisors_injective
statement: theorem divisors_injective : Function.Injective divisors
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective sup_divisors_id

name: divisors_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem divisors_inj {a b : ℕ} : a.divisors = b.divisors ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  divisors_injective.eq_iff

name: eq_properDivisors_of_subset_of_sum_eq_sum
statement:
theorem eq_properDivisors_of_subset_of_sum_eq_sum {s : Finset ℕ} (hsub : s ⊆ n.properDivisors) :
    ((∑ x ∈ s, x) = ∑ x ∈ n.properDivisors, x) → s = n.properDivisors
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · rw [properDivisors_zero, subset_empty] at hsub
    simp [hsub]
  classical
    rw [← sum_sdiff hsub]
    intro h
    apply Subset.antisymm hsub
    rw [← sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset]
    contrapose! h
    apply ne_of_lt
    rw [← zero_add (∑ x ∈ s, x), ← add_assoc, add_zero]
    gcongr
    have hlt :=
      sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty h fun x hx => pos_of_mem_properDivisors (sdiff_subset hx)
    simp only [sum_const_zero] at hlt
    apply hlt

name: sum_properDivisors_dvd
statement:
theorem sum_properDivisors_dvd (h : (∑ x ∈ n.properDivisors, x) ∣ n) :
    ∑ x ∈ n.properDivisors, x = 1 ∨ ∑ x ∈ n.properDivisors, x = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp
  · rcases n with - | n
    · simp at h
    · rw [or_iff_not_imp_right]
      intro ne_n
      have hlt : ∑ x ∈ n.succ.succ.properDivisors, x < n.succ.succ :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.succ_pos _) h) ne_n
      symm
      rw [← mem_singleton, eq_properDivisors_of_subset_of_sum_eq_sum (singleton_subset_iff.2
        (mem_properDivisors.2 ⟨h, hlt⟩)) (sum_singleton _ _), mem_properDivisors]
      exact ⟨one_dvd _, Nat.succ_lt_succ (Nat.succ_pos _)⟩

name: Prime.prod_properDivisors
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem Prime.prod_properDivisors {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] {p : ℕ} {f : ℕ → α} (h : p.Prime) :
    ∏ x ∈ p.properDivisors, f x = f 1
proof: := by simp [h.properDivisors]

name: Prime.prod_divisors
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp)]
theorem Prime.prod_divisors {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] {p : ℕ} {f : ℕ → α} (h : p.Prime) :
    ∏ x ∈ p.divisors, f x = f p * f 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← cons_self_properDivisors h.ne_zero, prod_cons, h.prod_properDivisors]

name: properDivisors_eq_singleton_one_iff_prime
statement: theorem properDivisors_eq_singleton_one_iff_prime : n.properDivisors = {1} ↔ n.Prime
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, Prime.properDivisors⟩
  rw [Nat.prime_def_lt]
  refine ⟨Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr <| one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt.mp (by simp [h]), ?_⟩
  intro m hm hdvd
  simpa [h] using mem_properDivisors.mpr ⟨hdvd, hm⟩

name: sum_properDivisors_eq_one_iff_prime
statement: theorem sum_properDivisors_eq_one_iff_prime : ∑ x ∈ n.properDivisors, x = 1 ↔ n.Prime
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp [Nat.not_prime_zero]
  · cases n
    · simp [Nat.not_prime_one]
    · rw [← properDivisors_eq_singleton_one_iff_prime]
      refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.symm ▸ sum_singleton _ _⟩
      rw [@eq_comm (Finset ℕ) _ _]
      apply
        eq_properDivisors_of_subset_of_sum_eq_sum
          (singleton_subset_iff.2
            (one_mem_properDivisors_iff_one_lt.2 (succ_lt_succ (Nat.succ_pos _))))
          ((sum_singleton _ _).trans h.symm)

name: mem_properDivisors_prime_pow
statement:
theorem mem_properDivisors_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) {x : ℕ} :
    x ∈ properDivisors (p ^ k) ↔ ∃ (j : ℕ) (_ : j < k), x = p ^ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_properDivisors, Nat.dvd_prime_pow pp]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨j, hjk, rfl⟩, hlt⟩
    exact ⟨j, (Nat.pow_lt_pow_iff_right pp.one_lt).mp hlt, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hjk, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨⟨j, le_of_lt hjk, rfl⟩, Nat.pow_lt_pow_of_lt pp.one_lt hjk⟩

name: properDivisors_prime_pow
statement:
theorem properDivisors_prime_pow {p : ℕ} (pp : p.Prime) (k : ℕ) :
    properDivisors (p ^ k) = (Finset.range k).map ⟨(p ^ ·), Nat.pow_right_injective pp.two_le⟩
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp [mem_properDivisors_prime_pow pp, eq_comm]

name: prod_properDivisors_prime_pow
proof:
:= by
  simp [h, properDivisors_prime_pow]

name: prod_divisors_prime_pow
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) sum_divisors_prime_pow]
theorem prod_divisors_prime_pow {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] {k p : ℕ} {f : ℕ → α} (h : p.Prime) :
    (∏ x ∈ (p ^ k).divisors, f x) = ∏ x ∈ range (k + 1), f (p ^ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [h, divisors_prime_pow]

name: prod_divisorsAntidiagonal
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_divisorsAntidiagonal {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) {n : ℕ} :
    ∏ i ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, f i.1 i.2 = ∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f i (n / i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_div_right_divisors, Finset.prod_map]
  rfl

name: prod_divisorsAntidiagonal'
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_divisorsAntidiagonal' {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → ℕ → M) {n : ℕ} :
    ∏ i ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, f i.1 i.2 = ∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f (n / i) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_swap_divisorsAntidiagonal, Finset.prod_map]
  exact prod_divisorsAntidiagonal fun i j => f j i

name: primeFactors_eq_to_filter_divisors_prime

theorem primeFactors_eq_to_filter_divisors_prime (n : ℕ) :

name: primeFactors_filter_dvd_of_dvd
statement:
lemma primeFactors_filter_dvd_of_dvd {m n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (hmn : m ∣ n) :
    {p ∈ n.primeFactors | p ∣ m} = m.primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [primeFactors_eq_to_filter_divisors_prime, filter_comm,
    divisors_filter_dvd_of_dvd hn hmn]

name: image_div_divisors_eq_divisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_div_divisors_eq_divisors (n : ℕ) :
    image (fun x : ℕ => n / x) n.divisors = n.divisors
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← image_fst_divisorsAntidiagonal, ← map_div_left_divisors, map_eq_image, image_image]
  rfl

name: prod_div_divisors
statement:
@[to_additive (attr := simp) sum_div_divisors]
theorem prod_div_divisors {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) :
    (∏ d ∈ n.divisors, f (n / d)) = n.divisors.prod f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0; · simp [hn]
  rw [← prod_image]
  · exact prod_congr (image_div_divisors_eq_divisors n) (by simp)
  · intro x hx y hy h
    rw [mem_coe, mem_divisors] at hx hy
    exact (div_eq_iff_eq_of_dvd_dvd hn hx.1 hy.1).mp h

name: disjoint_divisors_filter_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem disjoint_divisors_filter_isPrimePow {a b : ℕ} (hab : a.Coprime b) :
    Disjoint (a.divisors.filter IsPrimePow) (b.divisors.filter IsPrimePow)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.disjoint_left, Finset.mem_filter, and_imp, Nat.mem_divisors, not_and]
  rintro n han _ha hn hbn _hb -
  exact hn.ne_one (Nat.eq_one_of_dvd_coprimes hab han hbn)

name: divisorsAntidiagonal_eq_prod_filter_of_le
statement:
lemma divisorsAntidiagonal_eq_prod_filter_of_le {n N : ℕ} (n_ne_zero : n ≠ 0) (hn : n ≤ N) :
    n.divisorsAntidiagonal = (Ioc 0 N ×ˢ Ioc 0 N).filter (fun x ↦ x.1 * x.2 = n)
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨n1, n2⟩
  rw [Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal]
  simp only [ne_eq, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_Ioc]
  constructor
  · intro ⟨rfl, hn2⟩
    grw [← hn]
    simp (disch := lia) only [le_mul_iff_one_le_right, le_mul_iff_one_le_left, and_true]
    lia
  · intro ⟨⟨hn1, hn2⟩, hn3⟩
    exact ⟨hn3, n_ne_zero⟩

name: antidiagonal_map_subset_divisorsAntidiagonal_pow
statement:
theorem antidiagonal_map_subset_divisorsAntidiagonal_pow {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (k : ℕ) :
    letI ι : ℕ ↪ ℕ
proof:
:= ⟨fun k ↦ q ^ k, Nat.pow_right_injective hq⟩
    (Finset.antidiagonal k).map (.prodMap ι ι) ⊆ (q ^ k).divisorsAntidiagonal := by
  intro k hk
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hk
  simp [Nat.mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, ← Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hi, pow_add, ne_zero_of_lt hq]

name: mem_divisors_iff_natAbs_mem_divisors_natAbs
statement:
theorem mem_divisors_iff_natAbs_mem_divisors_natAbs :
    x ∈ z.divisors ↔ x.natAbs ∈ z.natAbs.divisors
proof:
:= calc
  _ ↔ ∃ y ∈ z.natAbs.divisors, ↑y = x ∨ -↑y = x := by
    simp [← exists_or, ← and_or_left, divisors]
  _ ↔ ∃ y ∈ z.natAbs.divisors, y = x.natAbs := congr(∃ y ∈ _, $(by grind))
  _ ↔ x.natAbs ∈ z.natAbs.divisors := exists_eq_right

name: mem_divisors
statement:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem mem_divisors : x ∈ divisors z ↔ x ∣ z ∧ z ≠ 0
