name: coe_zero
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_zero : ((0 : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: coe_eq_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma coe_eq_zero : (x : ℚ_[p]) = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof: := by rw [← coe_zero, Subtype.coe_inj]

name: coe_ne_zero
statement: lemma coe_ne_zero : (x : ℚ_[p]) ≠ 0 ↔ x ≠ 0
proof: := coe_eq_zero.not

name: coe_natCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_natCast (n : ℕ) : ((n : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = n
proof: := rfl

name: coe_intCast
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_intCast (z : ℤ) : ((z : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = z
proof: := rfl

name: coe_pow
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_pow (x : ℤ_[p]) (n : ℕ) : (↑(x ^ n) : ℚ_[p]) = (↑x : ℚ_[p]) ^ n
proof: := rfl

name: mk_coe
statement: theorem mk_coe (k : ℤ_[p]) : (⟨k, k.2⟩ : ℤ_[p]) = k
proof: := by simp

name: coe_sum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_sum {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℤ_[p]) :
    (((∑ z ∈ s, f z) : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = ∑ z ∈ s, (f z : ℚ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  simp [← Coe.ringHom_apply, map_sum PadicInt.Coe.ringHom f s]

name: isOpenEmbedding_coe
statement: lemma isOpenEmbedding_coe : IsOpenEmbedding ((↑) : ℤ_[p] → ℚ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  refine (?_ : IsOpen {y : ℚ_[p] | ‖y‖ ≤ 1}).isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal
  simpa only [Metric.closedBall, dist_eq_norm_sub, sub_zero] using
    IsUltrametricDist.isOpen_closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) one_ne_zero

name: intCast_eq
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem intCast_eq (z1 z2 : ℤ) : (z1 : ℤ_[p]) = z2 ↔ z1 = z2
proof: := by simp

name: norm_def
statement: theorem norm_def {z : ℤ_[p]} : ‖z‖ = ‖(z : ℚ_[p])‖
proof: := rfl

name: norm_le_one
statement:
@[bound]
theorem norm_le_one (z : ℤ_[p]) : ‖z‖ ≤ 1

name: nonarchimedean
statement: theorem nonarchimedean (q r : ℤ_[p]) : ‖q + r‖ ≤ max ‖q‖ ‖r‖
proof: := Padic.nonarchimedean _ _

name: norm_add_eq_max_of_ne
statement: theorem norm_add_eq_max_of_ne {q r : ℤ_[p]} : ‖q‖ ≠ ‖r‖ → ‖q + r‖ = max ‖q‖ ‖r‖
proof:
:=
  Padic.add_eq_max_of_ne

name: norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right {z1 z2 : ℤ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 + z2‖ < ‖z2‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:=
  by_contra fun hne =>
    not_lt_of_ge (by rw [norm_add_eq_max_of_ne hne]; apply le_max_right) h

name: norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_left
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_left {z1 z2 : ℤ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 + z2‖ < ‖z1‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:=
  by_contra fun hne =>
    not_lt_of_ge (by rw [norm_add_eq_max_of_ne hne]; apply le_max_left) h

name: padic_norm_e_of_padicInt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padic_norm_e_of_padicInt (z : ℤ_[p]) : ‖(z : ℚ_[p])‖ = ‖z‖
proof: := by simp [norm_def]

name: norm_intCast_eq_padic_norm
statement: theorem norm_intCast_eq_padic_norm (z : ℤ) : ‖(z : ℤ_[p])‖ = ‖(z : ℚ_[p])‖
proof: := by simp [norm_def]

name: norm_eq_padic_norm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_eq_padic_norm {q : ℚ_[p]} (hq : ‖q‖ ≤ 1) : @norm ℤ_[p] _ ⟨q, hq⟩ = ‖q‖
proof: := rfl

name: norm_p
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_p : ‖(p : ℤ_[p])‖ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹
proof: := Padic.norm_p

name: norm_p_pow
statement: theorem norm_p_pow (n : ℕ) : ‖(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n‖ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ)
proof: := by simp

name: one_le_norm_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma one_le_norm_iff {x : ℤ_[p]} :
    1 ≤ ‖x‖ ↔ ‖x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [le_antisymm_iff, ← padic_norm_e_of_padicInt, x.prop]

name: norm_natCast_p_sub_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_p_sub_one :
    ‖((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ_[p])‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [norm_def]

name: exists_pow_neg_lt
statement: theorem exists_pow_neg_lt {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ k : ℕ, (p : ℝ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_nat_gt ε⁻¹
  use k
  rw [← inv_lt_inv₀ hε (zpow_pos _ _)]
  · rw [zpow_neg, inv_inv, zpow_natCast]
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le hk
    norm_cast
    apply le_of_lt
    convert! Nat.lt_pow_self _ using 1
    exact hp.1.one_lt
  · exact mod_cast hp.1.pos

name: exists_pow_neg_lt_rat
statement: theorem exists_pow_neg_lt_rat {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ k : ℕ, (p : ℚ) ^ (-(k : ℤ)) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := @exists_pow_neg_lt p _ ε (mod_cast hε)
  use k
  rw [show (p : ℝ) = (p : ℚ) by simp] at hk
  exact mod_cast hk

name: norm_int_lt_one_iff_dvd
statement: theorem norm_int_lt_one_iff_dvd (k : ℤ) : ‖(k : ℤ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ k
proof:
:=
  suffices ‖(k : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ ↑p ∣ k by rwa [norm_intCast_eq_padic_norm]
  Padic.norm_intCast_lt_one_iff

name: norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd {k : ℤ} {n : ℕ} :
    ‖(k : ℤ_[p])‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) ↔ (p ^ n : ℤ) ∣ k
proof:
:=
  suffices ‖(k : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) ↔ (p ^ n : ℤ) ∣ k by
    simpa [norm_intCast_eq_padic_norm]
  Padic.norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd _ _

name: norm_natCast_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} :
    ‖(n : ℤ_[p])‖ = 1 ↔ p.Coprime n
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_def, coe_natCast, Padic.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff]

name: norm_natCast_lt_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_lt_one_iff {n : ℕ} :
    ‖(n : ℤ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_def, coe_natCast, Padic.norm_natCast_lt_one_iff]

name: norm_intCast_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_intCast_eq_one_iff {z : ℤ} :
    ‖(z : ℤ_[p])‖ = 1 ↔ IsCoprime z p
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_def, coe_intCast, Padic.norm_intCast_eq_one_iff]

name: norm_intCast_lt_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_intCast_lt_one_iff {z : ℤ} :
    ‖(z : ℤ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_def, coe_intCast, Padic.norm_intCast_lt_one_iff]

name: valuation_coe_nonneg
statement: lemma valuation_coe_nonneg : 0 ≤ (x : ℚ_[p]).valuation
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp
  have := x.2
  rwa [Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation <| coe_ne_zero.2 hx, zpow_le_one_iff_right₀, neg_nonpos]
    at this
  exact mod_cast hp.out.one_lt

name: valuation_coe
statement: @[simp, norm_cast] lemma valuation_coe (x : ℤ_[p]) : (x : ℚ_[p]).valuation = x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  simp [valuation, valuation_coe_nonneg]

name: valuation_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma valuation_zero : valuation (0 : ℤ_[p]) = 0
proof: := by simp [valuation]

name: valuation_one
statement: @[simp] lemma valuation_one : valuation (1 : ℤ_[p]) = 0
proof: := by simp [valuation]

name: valuation_p
statement: @[simp] lemma valuation_p : valuation (p : ℤ_[p]) = 1
proof: := by simp [valuation]

name: le_valuation_add
statement: lemma le_valuation_add (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) : min x.valuation y.valuation ≤ (x + y).valuation
proof:
:= by
  zify; simpa [← valuation_coe] using Padic.le_valuation_add <| coe_ne_zero.2 hxy

name: valuation_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma valuation_mul (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (x * y).valuation = x.valuation + y.valuation
proof:
:= by
  zify; simp [← valuation_coe, Padic.valuation_mul (coe_ne_zero.2 hx) (coe_ne_zero.2 hy)]

name: valuation_pow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_pow (x : ℤ_[p]) (n : ℕ) : (x ^ n).valuation = n * x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  zify; simp [← valuation_coe]

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation
statement: lemma norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation {x : ℤ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) : ‖x‖ = p ^ (-x.valuation : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [norm_def, Padic.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation <| coe_ne_zero.2 hx]

name: valuation_p_pow_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem valuation_p_pow_mul (n : ℕ) (c : ℤ_[p]) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ((p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n * c).valuation = n + c.valuation
proof:
:= by
  rw [valuation_mul (NeZero.ne _) hc, valuation_pow, valuation_p, mul_one]

name: mul_inv
statement:
theorem mul_inv : ∀ {z : ℤ_[p]}, ‖z‖ = 1 → z * z.inv = 1
  | ⟨k, _⟩, h => by
    have hk : k ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h' => zero_ne_one' ℚ_[p] (by simp [h'] at h)
    unfold PadicInt.inv
    rw [norm_eq_padic_norm] at h
    dsimp only
    rw [dite_eq_left h]
    apply Subtype.ext_iff.2
    simp [mul_inv_cancel₀ hk]

name: inv_mul
statement: theorem inv_mul {z : ℤ_[p]} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) : z.inv * z = 1
proof: := by rw [mul_comm, mul_inv hz]

name: isUnit_iff
statement: theorem isUnit_iff {z : ℤ_[p]} : IsUnit z ↔ ‖z‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rcases isUnit_iff_dvd_one.1 h with ⟨w, eq⟩
    refine le_antisymm (norm_le_one _) ?_
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_le_one w) (norm_nonneg z)
    rwa [mul_one, ← norm_mul, ← eq, norm_one] at this, fun h =>
    ⟨⟨z, z.inv, mul_inv h, inv_mul h⟩, rfl⟩⟩

name: norm_lt_one_add
statement: theorem norm_lt_one_add {z1 z2 : ℤ_[p]} (hz1 : ‖z1‖ < 1) (hz2 : ‖z2‖ < 1) : ‖z1 + z2‖ < 1
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (nonarchimedean _ _) (max_lt hz1 hz2)

name: norm_lt_one_mul
statement: theorem norm_lt_one_mul {z1 z2 : ℤ_[p]} (hz2 : ‖z2‖ < 1) : ‖z1 * z2‖ < 1
proof:
:=
  calc
    ‖z1 * z2‖ = ‖z1‖ * ‖z2‖ := by simp
    _ < 1 := (mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (norm_le_one _)).trans_lt hz2

name: mem_nonunits
statement: theorem mem_nonunits {z : ℤ_[p]} : z ∈ nonunits ℤ_[p] ↔ ‖z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [norm_le_one z, nonunits, isUnit_iff]

name: not_isUnit_iff
statement: theorem not_isUnit_iff {z : ℤ_[p]} : ¬IsUnit z ↔ ‖z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mem_nonunits

name: val_mkUnits
statement:
@[simp]
lemma val_mkUnits {u : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖u‖ = 1) : (mkUnits h).val = ⟨u, h.le⟩
proof: := rfl

name: mkUnits_eq
statement: theorem mkUnits_eq {u : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖u‖ = 1) : ((mkUnits h : ℤ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) = u
proof: := rfl

name: norm_units
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_units (u : ℤ_[p]ˣ) : ‖(u : ℤ_[p])‖ = 1
proof: := isUnit_iff.mp <| by simp

name: unitCoeff_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitCoeff_coe {x : ℤ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (unitCoeff hx : ℚ_[p]) = x * (p : ℚ_[p]) ^ (-x.valuation : ℤ)
proof: := rfl

name: unitCoeff_spec
statement:
theorem unitCoeff_spec {x : ℤ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    x = (unitCoeff hx : ℤ_[p]) * (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.coe_injective
  push_cast
  rw [unitCoeff_coe, mul_assoc, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀]
  · simp
  · exact NeZero.ne _

name: isUnit_den
statement:
theorem isUnit_den {p : ℕ} [hp_prime : Fact p.Prime] (r : ℚ) (h : ‖(r : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1) :
    IsUnit (r.den : ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnit_iff]
  apply le_antisymm (r.den : ℤ_[p]).2
  rw [← not_lt, coe_natCast]
  intro norm_denom_lt
  have hr : ‖(r * r.den : ℚ_[p])‖ = ‖(r.num : ℚ_[p])‖ := by
    congr
    rw_mod_cast [@Rat.mul_den_eq_num r]
  rw [padicNormE.mul] at hr
  have key : ‖(r.num : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 := by
    calc
      _ = _ := hr.symm
      _ < 1 * 1 := mul_lt_mul' h norm_denom_lt (norm_nonneg _) zero_lt_one
      _ = 1 := mul_one 1
  have : ↑p ∣ r.num ∧ (p : ℤ) ∣ r.den := by
    simp only [← norm_int_lt_one_iff_dvd, ← padic_norm_e_of_padicInt]
    exact ⟨key, norm_denom_lt⟩
  apply hp_prime.1.not_dvd_one
  rwa [← r.reduced.gcd_eq_one, Nat.dvd_gcd_iff, ← Int.natCast_dvd, ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast]

name: norm_le_pow_iff_le_valuation
statement:
theorem norm_le_pow_iff_le_valuation (x : ℤ_[p]) (hx : x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) ↔ n ≤ x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀, neg_le_neg_iff, Nat.cast_le]
  exact mod_cast hp.out.one_lt

name: mem_span_pow_iff_le_valuation
statement:
theorem mem_span_pow_iff_le_valuation (x : ℤ_[p]) (hx : x ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    x ∈ (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n} : Ideal ℤ_[p]) ↔ n ≤ x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    suffices c ≠ 0 by
      rw [valuation_p_pow_mul _ _ this]
      exact le_self_add
    contrapose hx
    rw [hx, mul_zero]
  · nth_rewrite 2 [unitCoeff_spec hx]
    simpa [Units.isUnit, IsUnit.dvd_mul_left] using pow_dvd_pow _

name: norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow
statement:
theorem norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow (x : ℤ_[p]) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) ↔ x ∈ (Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n} : Ideal ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · subst hx
    simp only [norm_zero, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, inv_nonneg, iff_true, Submodule.zero_mem]
    exact mod_cast Nat.zero_le _
  rw [norm_le_pow_iff_le_valuation x hx, mem_span_pow_iff_le_valuation x hx]

name: norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one
statement:
theorem norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one (x : ℤ_[p]) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ n ↔ ‖x‖ < (p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_def]; exact Padic.norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one _ _

name: norm_lt_pow_iff_norm_le_pow_sub_one
statement:
theorem norm_lt_pow_iff_norm_le_pow_sub_one (x : ℤ_[p]) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖x‖ < (p : ℝ) ^ n ↔ ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one, sub_add_cancel]

name: norm_lt_one_iff_dvd
statement: theorem norm_lt_one_iff_dvd (x : ℤ_[p]) : ‖x‖ < 1 ↔ ↑p ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  have := norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow x 1
  rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, pow_one] at this
  rw [← this, norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one]
  simp only [zpow_zero, Int.ofNat_zero, Int.natCast_succ, neg_add_cancel, zero_add]

name: pow_p_dvd_int_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_p_dvd_int_iff (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) : (p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n ∣ a ↔ (p ^ n : ℤ) ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd, norm_le_pow_iff_mem_span_pow,
    Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Nat.cast_pow]

name: p_nonunit
statement: theorem p_nonunit : (p : ℤ_[p]) ∈ nonunits ℤ_[p]
proof:
:= by
  have : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ <| mod_cast hp.out.one_lt
  rwa [← norm_p, ← mem_nonunits] at this

name: maximalIdeal_eq_span_p
statement: theorem maximalIdeal_eq_span_p : maximalIdeal ℤ_[p] = Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p])}
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    simp only [IsLocalRing.mem_maximalIdeal, mem_nonunits] at hx
    rwa [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, ← norm_lt_one_iff_dvd]
  · rw [Ideal.span_le, Set.singleton_subset_iff]
    exact p_nonunit

name: prime_p
statement: theorem prime_p : Prime (p : ℤ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Ideal.span_singleton_prime, ← maximalIdeal_eq_span_p]
  · infer_instance
  · exact NeZero.ne _

name: irreducible_p
statement: theorem irreducible_p : Irreducible (p : ℤ_[p])
proof: := Prime.irreducible prime_p

name: ideal_eq_span_pow_p
statement:
theorem ideal_eq_span_pow_p {s : Ideal ℤ_[p]} (hs : s ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, s = Ideal.span {(p : ℤ_[p]) ^ n}
proof:
:=
  IsDiscreteValuationRing.ideal_eq_span_pow_irreducible hs irreducible_p

name: algebraMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_apply (x : ℤ_[p]) : algebraMap ℤ_[p] ℚ_[p] x = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: eq_zpow_of_nonzero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem eq_zpow_of_nonzero {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) :
    padicNorm p q = (p : ℚ) ^ (-padicValRat p q)
proof: := by simp [hq, padicNorm]

name: nonneg
statement: protected theorem nonneg (q : ℚ) : 0 ≤ padicNorm p q
proof:
:=
  if hq : q = 0 then by simp [hq, padicNorm]
  else by
    unfold padicNorm
    split_ifs
    apply zpow_nonneg
    exact mod_cast Nat.zero_le _

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zero : padicNorm p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [padicNorm]

name: one
statement: protected theorem one : padicNorm p 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [padicNorm]

name: padicNorm_p
statement: theorem padicNorm_p (hp : 1 < p) : padicNorm p p = (p : ℚ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [padicNorm, (pos_of_gt hp).ne', padicValNat.self hp]

name: padicNorm_p_of_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padicNorm_p_of_prime [Fact p.Prime] : padicNorm p p = (p : ℚ)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  padicNorm_p <| Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out

name: padicNorm_of_prime_of_ne
statement:
theorem padicNorm_of_prime_of_ne {q : ℕ} [p_prime : Fact p.Prime] [q_prime : Fact q.Prime]
    (ne : p ≠ q) : padicNorm p q = 1
proof:
:= by
  have p : padicValRat p q = 0 := mod_cast padicValNat_primes ne
  rw [padicNorm, p]
  simp [q_prime.1.ne_zero]

name: padicNorm_p_lt_one
statement: theorem padicNorm_p_lt_one (hp : 1 < p) : padicNorm p p < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicNorm_p hp, inv_lt_one_iff₀]
  exact mod_cast Or.inr hp

name: padicNorm_p_lt_one_of_prime
statement: theorem padicNorm_p_lt_one_of_prime [Fact p.Prime] : padicNorm p p < 1
proof:
:=
  padicNorm_p_lt_one <| Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out

name: values_discrete
statement: protected theorem values_discrete {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : ∃ z : ℤ, padicNorm p q = (p : ℚ) ^ (-z)
proof:
:=
  ⟨padicValRat p q, by simp [padicNorm, hq]⟩

name: neg
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem neg (q : ℚ) : padicNorm p (-q) = padicNorm p q
proof:
:=
  if hq : q = 0 then by simp [hq] else by simp [padicNorm, hq]

name: nonzero
statement: protected theorem nonzero {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : padicNorm p q ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicNorm.eq_zpow_of_nonzero hq]
  apply zpow_ne_zero
  exact mod_cast ne_of_gt hp.1.pos

name: zero_of_padicNorm_eq_zero
statement: theorem zero_of_padicNorm_eq_zero {q : ℚ} (h : padicNorm p q = 0) : q = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply by_contradiction; intro hq
  unfold padicNorm at h; rw [ite_eq_right hq] at h
  apply absurd h
  apply zpow_ne_zero
  exact mod_cast hp.1.ne_zero

name: mul
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem mul (q r : ℚ) : padicNorm p (q * r) = padicNorm p q * padicNorm p r
proof:
:=
  if hq : q = 0 then by simp [hq]
  else
    if hr : r = 0 then by simp [hr]
    else by
      have : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by simp [hp.1.ne_zero]
      simp [padicNorm, *, padicValRat.mul, zpow_add₀ this, mul_comm]

name: div
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem div (q r : ℚ) : padicNorm p (q / r) = padicNorm p q / padicNorm p r

name: of_int
statement: protected theorem of_int (z : ℤ) : padicNorm p z ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hz := eq_or_ne z 0
  · simp
  · rw [padicNorm, ite_eq_right (mod_cast hz)]
    exact zpow_le_one_of_nonpos₀ (mod_cast hp.1.one_le) (by simp)

name: nonarchimedean_aux
statement:
private theorem nonarchimedean_aux {q r : ℚ} (h : padicValRat p q ≤ padicValRat p r) :
    padicNorm p (q + r) ≤ max (padicNorm p q) (padicNorm p r)
proof:
:=
  have hnqp : padicNorm p q ≥ 0 := padicNorm.nonneg _
  have hnrp : padicNorm p r ≥ 0 := padicNorm.nonneg _
  if hq : q = 0 then by simp [hq, max_eq_right hnrp]
  else
    if hr : r = 0 then by simp [hr, max_eq_left hnqp]
    else
      if hqr : q + r = 0 then le_trans (by simpa [hqr] using hnqp) (le_max_left _ _)
      else by
        unfold padicNorm; split_ifs
        apply le_max_iff.2
        left
        apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀
        · exact mod_cast le_of_lt hp.1.one_lt
        · apply neg_le_neg
          have : padicValRat p q = min (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r) := (min_eq_left h).symm
          rw [this]
          exact min_le_padicValRat_add hqr

name: nonarchimedean
statement:
protected theorem nonarchimedean {q r : ℚ} :
    padicNorm p (q + r) ≤ max (padicNorm p q) (padicNorm p r)
proof:
:= by
  wlog hle : padicValRat p q ≤ padicValRat p r generalizing q r
  · rw [add_comm, max_comm]
    exact this (le_of_not_ge hle)
  exact nonarchimedean_aux hle

name: triangle_ineq
statement: theorem triangle_ineq (q r : ℚ) : padicNorm p (q + r) ≤ padicNorm p q + padicNorm p r
proof:
:=
  calc
    padicNorm p (q + r) ≤ max (padicNorm p q) (padicNorm p r) := padicNorm.nonarchimedean
    _ ≤ padicNorm p q + padicNorm p r :=
      max_le_add_of_nonneg (padicNorm.nonneg _) (padicNorm.nonneg _)

name: sub
statement: protected theorem sub {q r : ℚ} : padicNorm p (q - r) ≤ max (padicNorm p q) (padicNorm p r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← padicNorm.neg r]
  exact padicNorm.nonarchimedean

name: add_eq_max_of_ne
statement:
theorem add_eq_max_of_ne {q r : ℚ} (hne : padicNorm p q ≠ padicNorm p r) :
    padicNorm p (q + r) = max (padicNorm p q) (padicNorm p r)
proof:
:=
  IsNonarchimedean.add_eq_max_of_ne (fun a ↦ by simp) (fun _ _ ↦ padicNorm.nonarchimedean) hne

name: dvd_iff_norm_le
statement: theorem dvd_iff_norm_le {n : ℕ} {z : ℤ} : ↑(p ^ n) ∣ z ↔ padicNorm p z ≤ (p : ℚ) ^ (-n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold padicNorm; split_ifs with hz
  · norm_cast at hz
    simp [hz]
  · rw [zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀, neg_le_neg_iff, padicValRat.of_int,
      padicValInt.of_ne_one_ne_zero]
    · norm_cast
      rw [← FiniteMultiplicity.pow_dvd_iff_le_multiplicity]
      · norm_cast
      · apply Int.finiteMultiplicity_iff.2 ⟨by simp [hp.out.ne_one], mod_cast hz⟩
    · exact_mod_cast hp.out.one_lt

name: int_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem int_eq_one_iff (m : ℤ) : padicNorm p m = 1 ↔ ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← pow_one p]
  simp only [dvd_iff_norm_le, Nat.cast_one, zpow_neg, zpow_one, not_le]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h, inv_lt_one₀] <;> norm_cast
    · exact Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out
    · exact Nat.Prime.pos Fact.out
  · simp only [padicNorm]
    split_ifs
    · rw [inv_lt_zero, ← Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_lt]
      intro h
      exact (Nat.not_lt_zero p h).elim
    · have : 1 < (p : ℚ) := by norm_cast; exact Nat.Prime.one_lt (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p)
      rw [← zpow_neg_one, zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ this]
      have : 0 ≤ padicValRat p m := by simp only [of_int, Nat.cast_nonneg]
      intro h
      rw [← zpow_zero (p : ℚ), zpow_right_inj₀] <;> linarith

name: int_lt_one_iff
statement: theorem int_lt_one_iff (m : ℤ) : padicNorm p m < 1 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, ← int_eq_one_iff, eq_iff_le_not_lt]
  simp only [padicNorm.of_int, true_and]

name: of_nat
statement: theorem of_nat (m : ℕ) : padicNorm p m ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  padicNorm.of_int (m : ℤ)

name: nat_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem nat_eq_one_iff (m : ℕ) : padicNorm p m = 1 ↔ ¬p ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, ← int_eq_one_iff, Int.cast_natCast]

name: nat_lt_one_iff
statement: theorem nat_lt_one_iff (m : ℕ) : padicNorm p m < 1 ↔ p ∣ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, ← int_lt_one_iff, Int.cast_natCast]

name: not_int_of_not_padic_int
statement:
theorem not_int_of_not_padic_int (p : ℕ) {a : ℚ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
    (H : 1 < padicNorm p a) : ¬ a.isInt
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! H
  rw [Rat.eq_num_of_isInt H]
  apply padicNorm.of_int

name: sum_lt
statement:
theorem sum_lt {α : Type*} {F : α → ℚ} {t : ℚ} {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, padicNorm p (F i) < t) : padicNorm p (∑ i ∈ s, F i) < t
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (IsNonarchimedean.apply_sum_le_sup (fun _ _ ↦ padicNorm.nonarchimedean) hs) <|
    (Finset.sup'_lt_iff hs).2 hF

name: sum_le
statement:
theorem sum_le {α : Type*} {F : α → ℚ} {t : ℚ} {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, padicNorm p (F i) ≤ t) : padicNorm p (∑ i ∈ s, F i) ≤ t
proof:
:=
  (IsNonarchimedean.apply_sum_le_sup (fun _ _ ↦ padicNorm.nonarchimedean) hs).trans <|
    (Finset.sup'_le_iff hs (fun i ↦ padicNorm p (F i))).2 hF

name: sum_lt'
statement:
theorem sum_lt' {α : Type*} {F : α → ℚ} {t : ℚ} {s : Finset α}
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, padicNorm p (F i) < t) (ht : 0 < t) : padicNorm p (∑ i ∈ s, F i) < t
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hs := Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty s
  · simp [ht]
  · exact sum_lt hs hF

name: sum_le'
statement:
theorem sum_le' {α : Type*} {F : α → ℚ} {t : ℚ} {s : Finset α}
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, padicNorm p (F i) ≤ t) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : padicNorm p (∑ i ∈ s, F i) ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hs := Finset.eq_empty_or_nonempty s
  · simp [ht]
  · exact sum_le hs hF

name: norm_ascPochhammer_le
statement:
lemma norm_ascPochhammer_le (k : ℕ) (x : ℤ_[p]) :
    ‖(ascPochhammer ℤ_[p] k).eval x‖ ≤ ‖(k.factorial : ℤ_[p])‖
proof:
:= by
  let f := (ascPochhammer ℤ_[p] k).eval
  change ‖f x‖ ≤ ‖_‖
  have hC : (k.factorial : ℤ_[p]) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr k.factorial_ne_zero
  have hf : ContinuousAt f x := Polynomial.continuousAt _
  
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, ‖f x - f n‖ ≤ ‖(k.factorial : ℤ_[p])‖ := by
    obtain ⟨δ, hδp, hδ⟩ := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hf _ (norm_pos_iff.mpr hC)
    obtain ⟨n, hn'⟩ := PadicInt.denseRange_natCast.exists_dist_lt x hδp
    simpa only [← dist_eq_norm_sub'] using ⟨n, (hδ (dist_comm x n ▸ hn')).le⟩
  
  refine sub_add_cancel (f x) _ ▸ (IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max _ (f n)).trans (max_le hn ?_)
  
  simp_rw [f, ← ascPochhammer_eval_cast, Polynomial.eval_eq_smeval,
    ← Ring.factorial_nsmul_multichoose_eq_ascPochhammer, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul, norm_mul]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (norm_nonneg _) (norm_le_one _)

name: continuous_multichoose
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_multichoose (k : ℕ) : Continuous (fun x : ℤ_[p] ↦ Ring.multichoose x k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ring.multichoose, BinomialRing.multichoose]
  fun_prop

name: continuous_choose
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_choose (k : ℕ) : Continuous (fun x : ℤ_[p] ↦ Ring.choose x k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ring.choose]
  fun_prop

name: mahler_apply
statement: lemma mahler_apply (k : ℕ) (x : ℤ_[p]) : mahler k x = Ring.choose x k
proof: := rfl

name: mahler_natCast_eq
statement: lemma mahler_natCast_eq (k n : ℕ) : mahler k (n : ℤ_[p]) = n.choose k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mahler_apply, Ring.choose_natCast]

name: IsUltrametricDist.norm_fwdDiff_iter_apply_le
statement:
lemma IsUltrametricDist.norm_fwdDiff_iter_apply_le [TopologicalSpace M] [CompactSpace M]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [SeminormedAddCommGroup G] [IsUltrametricDist G]
    (h : M) (f : C(M, G)) (m : M) (n : ℕ) : ‖Δ_[h]^[n] f m‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  
  
  
  rw [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift]
  refine norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg f) fun i _ ↦ ?_
  exact (norm_zsmul_le _ _).trans (f.norm_coe_le_norm _)

name: bojanic_mahler_step1
statement:
private lemma bojanic_mahler_step1 [AddCommMonoidWithOne M] [AddCommGroup G] (f : M → G)
    (n : ℕ) {R : ℕ} (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    Δ_[1]^[n + R] f 0 = -∑ j ∈ range (R - 1), R.choose (j + 1) • Δ_[1]^[n + (j + 1)] f 0 +
      ∑ k ∈ range (n + 1), ((-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - k) * n.choose k) • (f (k + R) - f k)
proof:
:= by
  have aux : Δ_[1]^[n + R] f 0 = R.choose (R - 1 + 1) • Δ_[1]^[n + R] f 0 := by
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hR, Nat.choose_self, one_smul]
  rw [neg_add_eq_sub, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, add_comm, aux, (by lia : n + R = (n + ((R - 1) + 1))),
    ← sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hR,
    ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr (sum_range_succ' (fun x ↦ R.choose x • Δ_[1]^[n + x] f 0) R), add_zero,
    Nat.choose_zero_right, one_smul]
  have : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (R + 1), R.choose k • Δ_[1]^[n + k] f 0 = Δ_[1]^[n] f R := by
    simpa only [← Function.iterate_add_apply, add_comm, nsmul_one, add_zero] using
      (shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter 1 (Δ_[1]^[n] f) R 0).symm
  simp only [this, fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift (1 : M) f n, mul_comm, nsmul_one, mul_smul, add_comm,
    add_zero, smul_sub, sum_sub_distrib]

name: bojanic_mahler_step2
statement:
private lemma bojanic_mahler_step2 {f : C(ℤ_[p], E)} {s t : ℕ}
    (hst : ∀ x y : ℤ_[p], ‖x - y‖ ≤ p ^ (-t : ℤ) → ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ ‖f‖ / p ^ s) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖Δ_[1]^[n + p ^ t] f 0‖ ≤ max ↑((Finset.range (p ^ t - 1)).sup
      fun j ↦ ‖Δ_[1]^[n + (j + 1)] f 0‖₊ / p) (‖f‖ / p ^ s)
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [bojanic_mahler_step1 _ _ (one_le_pow₀ hp.out.one_le)]
  
  refine (norm_add_le_max _ _).trans (max_le_max ?_ ?_)
  · 
    
    rw [norm_neg, ← coe_nnnorm, coe_le_coe]
    refine nnnorm_sum_le_of_forall_le (fun i hi ↦ Finset.le_sup_of_le hi ?_)
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℤ_[p], div_eq_inv_mul]
    refine (nnnorm_smul_le _ _).trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ?_ (by simp only [zero_le])
    
    rw [mem_range] at hi
    have : 0 < (p ^ t).choose (i + 1) := Nat.choose_pos (by omega)
    rw [← zpow_neg_one, ← coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, PadicInt.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation
      (mod_cast this.ne'), coe_zpow, NNReal.coe_natCast,
      zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ (mod_cast hp.out.one_lt), neg_le_neg_iff,
      ← PadicInt.valuation_coe, PadicInt.coe_natCast, Padic.valuation_natCast, Nat.one_le_cast]
    exact one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd this.ne' <| hp.out.dvd_choose_pow (by lia) (by omega)
  · 
    refine norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonempty nonempty_range_add_one (fun i _ ↦ ?_)
    calc ‖((-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - i) * n.choose i) • (f (i + ↑(p ^ t)) - f i)‖
    _ ≤ ‖((-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - i) * n.choose i : ℤ_[p])‖ * ‖(f (i + ↑(p ^ t)) - f i)‖ := by
      rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul ℤ_[p]]
      exact (norm_smul_le ..).trans (by norm_cast)
    _ ≤ ‖f (i + ↑(p ^ t)) - f i‖ := by
      apply mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _)
      simpa only [← coe_intCast] using norm_le_one _
    _ ≤ ‖f‖ / p ^ s := by
      apply hst
      rw [Nat.cast_pow, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_pow, norm_p, inv_pow, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]

name: fwdDiff_iter_le_of_forall_le
proof:
:= by
  
  suffices ∀ {k : ℕ}, k ≤ s → ‖Δ_[1]^[n + k * p ^ t] f 0‖ ≤ ‖f‖ / p ^ k from this le_rfl
  intro k hk
  induction k generalizing n with
  | zero => 
    simpa only [zero_mul, pow_zero, add_zero, div_one] using norm_fwdDiff_iter_apply_le 1 f 0 n
  | succ k IH => 
    rw [add_mul, one_mul, ← add_assoc]
    refine (bojanic_mahler_step2 hst (n + k * p ^ t)).trans (max_le ?_ ?_)
    · rw [← coe_nnnorm, ← NNReal.coe_natCast, ← NNReal.coe_pow, ← NNReal.coe_div, NNReal.coe_le_coe]
      refine Finset.sup_le fun j _ ↦ ?_
      rw [pow_succ, ← div_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (mod_cast hp.out.pos), add_right_comm]
      exact_mod_cast IH (n + (j + 1)) (by lia)
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (norm_nonneg _)
        (mod_cast pow_pos hp.out.pos _) (mod_cast pow_le_pow_right₀ hp.out.one_le hk)

name: fwdDiff_tendsto_zero
statement: lemma fwdDiff_tendsto_zero (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : Tendsto (Δ_[1]^[·] f 0) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  
  refine NormedAddGroup.tendsto_nhds_zero.mpr (fun ε hε ↦ ?_)
  have : Tendsto (fun s ↦ ‖f‖ / p ^ s) _ _ := tendsto_const_nhds.div_atTop
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (mod_cast hp.out.one_lt))
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (this.eventually_lt_const hε).exists
  refine .mp ?_ (.of_forall fun x hx ↦ lt_of_le_of_lt hx hs)
  
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℕ, ∀ x y, ‖x - y‖ ≤ p ^ (-t : ℤ) → ‖f x - f y‖ ≤ ‖f‖ / p ^ s := by
    rcases eq_or_ne f 0 with rfl | hf
    · 
      simp
    have : 0 < ‖f‖ / p ^ s := div_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hf) (mod_cast pow_pos hp.out.pos _)
    obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδf⟩ := f.uniform_continuity _ this
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := PadicInt.exists_pow_neg_lt p hδpos
    exact ⟨t, fun x y hxy ↦  by simpa only [dist_eq_norm_sub] using (hδf (hxy.trans_lt ht)).le⟩
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (s * p ^ t)] with m hm
  simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm] using fwdDiff_iter_le_of_forall_le ht (m - s * p ^ t)

name: mahlerTerm_apply
statement: lemma mahlerTerm_apply : mahlerTerm a n x = mahler n x • a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mahlerTerm, ContinuousMap.smul_apply', ContinuousMap.const_apply]

name: norm_mahlerTerm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_mahlerTerm : ‖(mahlerTerm a n : C(ℤ_[p], E))‖ = ‖a‖
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    rw [ContinuousMap.norm_le_of_nonempty]
    refine fun _ ↦ (norm_smul_le _ _).trans <| mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (norm_le_one _)
  · 
    refine le_trans ?_ <| (mahlerTerm a n).norm_coe_le_norm n
    simp [mahlerTerm_apply, mahler_natCast_eq]

name: mahlerTerm_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mahlerTerm_one : (mahlerTerm 1 n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) = mahler n
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [mahlerTerm_apply]

name: norm_mahler_eq
statement: @[simp] lemma norm_mahler_eq (k : ℕ) : ‖(mahler k : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p]))‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [← mahlerTerm_one]

name: hasSum_mahlerSeries
statement:
lemma hasSum_mahlerSeries (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ mahlerTerm (a n) n) (mahlerSeries a : C(ℤ_[p], E))
proof:
:= by
  refine (NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero ?_).hasSum
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero] at ha ⊢
  simpa only [norm_mahlerTerm, Nat.cofinite_eq_atTop] using ha

name: mahlerSeries_apply
statement:
lemma mahlerSeries_apply (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)) (x : ℤ_[p]) :
    mahlerSeries a x = ∑' n, mahler n x • a n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mahlerSeries, ← ContinuousMap.tsum_apply (hasSum_mahlerSeries ha).summable,
    mahlerTerm_apply]

name: mahlerSeries_apply_nat
statement:
lemma mahlerSeries_apply_nat (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    mahlerSeries a (m : ℤ_[p]) = ∑ i ∈ range (n + 1), m.choose i • a i
proof:
:= by
  have h_van (i) : m.choose (i + (n + 1)) = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by lia)
  have aux : Summable fun i ↦ m.choose (i + (n + 1)) • a (i + (n + 1)) := by
    simpa only [h_van, zero_smul] using summable_zero
  simp only [mahlerSeries_apply ha, mahler_natCast_eq, Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, add_zero,
    ← aux.sum_add_tsum_nat_add' (f := fun i ↦ m.choose i • a i), h_van, zero_smul, tsum_zero]

name: fwdDiff_mahlerSeries
statement:
lemma fwdDiff_mahlerSeries (ha : Tendsto a atTop (𝓝 0)) (n) :
    Δ_[1]^[n] (mahlerSeries a) (0 : ℤ_[p]) = a n
proof:
:=
  calc Δ_[1]^[n] (mahlerSeries a) 0
  
  _ = Δ_[1]^[n] (fun k ↦ ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), k.choose j • (a j)) 0 := by
    simp only [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, zero_add]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
    rw [nsmul_one, nsmul_one,
      mahlerSeries_apply_nat ha (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp <| Finset.mem_range.mp hj), Nat.cast_id]
  
  _ = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), Δ_[1]^[n] (fun k ↦ k.choose j • (a j)) 0 := by
    simp only [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, smul_sum]
    rw [sum_comm]
  
  _ = ∑ j ∈ range (n + 1), (Δ_[1]^[n] (fun k ↦ k.choose j : ℕ → ℤ) 0) • (a j) := by
    simp only [fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, zero_add, sum_smul, smul_assoc,
      natCast_zsmul]
  
  _ = a n := by
    simp only [fwdDiff_iter_choose_zero, ite_smul, one_smul, zero_smul, sum_ite_eq,
      Finset.mem_range, lt_add_iff_pos_right, zero_lt_one, ↓reduceIte]

name: hasSum_mahler
statement: lemma hasSum_mahler (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : HasSum (fun n ↦ mahlerTerm (Δ_[1]^[n] f 0) n) f
proof:
:= by
  
  have : HasSum (fun n ↦ mahlerTerm (Δ_[1]^[n] f 0) n)
      (mahlerSeries (Δ_[1]^[·] f 0) : C(ℤ_[p], E)) :=
    hasSum_mahlerSeries (fwdDiff_tendsto_zero f)
  
  convert! this using 1
  refine ContinuousMap.coe_injective (denseRange_natCast.equalizer
    (map_continuous f) (map_continuous _) (funext fun n ↦ ?_))
  simpa [mahlerSeries_apply_nat (fwdDiff_tendsto_zero f) le_rfl]
    using shift_eq_sum_fwdDiff_iter 1 f n 0

name: mahlerEquiv_apply
statement: lemma mahlerEquiv_apply (f : C(ℤ_[p], E)) : mahlerEquiv E f = fun n ↦ Δ_[1]^[n] f 0
proof: := rfl

name: mahlerEquiv_symm_apply
statement: lemma mahlerEquiv_symm_apply (a : C₀(ℕ, E)) : (mahlerEquiv E).symm a = (mahlerSeries (p := p) a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: dense_span_mahler
statement:
theorem dense_span_mahler : Dense (span R
      (.range fun n ↦ (mahler n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) • (1 : C(ℤ_[p], R))) : Set C(ℤ_[p], R))
proof:
:= by
  refine fun f ↦ mem_closure_of_tendsto (PadicInt.hasSum_mahler _) ?_
  refine .of_forall fun s ↦ Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ ↦ ?_
  simp only [span_range_eq_iSup]
  apply mem_iSup_of_mem (i := c)
  rw [mem_span_singleton]
  use (fwdDiff 1)^[c] f 0
  ext x
  simp [PadicInt.mahlerTerm]

name: ext_mahler
statement:
lemma ext_mahler {μ : C(ℤ_[p], R) →L[R] R}
    (hμ : ∀ n, μ ((mahler n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) • 1) = 0) : μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext_on dense_span_mahler
  rintro _ ⟨n, rfl⟩
  simpa using hμ n

name: isUniformInducing_cast_withVal
statement:
lemma isUniformInducing_cast_withVal : IsUniformInducing ((Rat.castHom ℚ_[p]).comp
    (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0' : 0 < (p : ℚ) := by simp [Nat.Prime.pos Fact.out]
  have hp0 : 0 < (p : ℝ)⁻¹ := by simp [Nat.Prime.pos Fact.out]
  have hp1' : 1 < (p : ℚ) := by simp [Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out]
  have hp1 : (p : ℝ)⁻¹ < 1 := by simp [inv_lt_one_iff₀, Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out]
  rw [Filter.HasBasis.isUniformInducing_iff (Valued.hasBasis_uniformity _ _)
    (Metric.uniformity_basis_dist_le_pow hp0 hp1)]
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, dist_eq_norm_sub, inv_pow, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingHom.coe_comp, Rat.coe_castHom, RingHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, ← Rat.cast_sub,
    ← map_sub, Padic.eq_padicNorm, true_and, forall_const]
  constructor
  · intro n
    have hn : Valued.v (R := (WithVal (Rat.padicValuation p))) (p ^ n) =
      exp (-n : ℤ) := by
      simp only [← WithVal.val_apply_equiv, map_pow, map_natCast, Rat.padicValuation_self,
        Int.reduceNeg, exp_neg, inv_pow, ← exp_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    use Units.mk0 (Valued.v.restrict (p ^ n)) (by
      simp [Valuation.restrict_def, Nat.Prime.ne_zero Fact.out])
    intro x y h
    set x' := (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)) x with hx
    set y' := (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)) y with hy
    rw [Valuation.map_sub_swap, Units.val_mk0, Valuation.restrict_lt_iff, hn] at h
    change Rat.padicValuation p (x' - y') < exp _ at h
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← Rat.cast_natCast, ← Rat.cast_inv_of_ne_zero, Rat.cast_le]
    · rw [map_sub, ← hx, ← hy]
      simp only [Rat.padicValuation, Valuation.coe_mk, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
        padicNorm, zpow_neg, Nat.cast_pow] at h ⊢
      split_ifs with H
      · simp
      · simp only [H, ↓reduceIte, exp_lt_exp, neg_lt_neg_iff] at h
        simpa [hp0', zpow_pos, pow_pos, inv_le_inv₀] using
          zpow_right_mono₀ (by exact_mod_cast (Nat.Prime.one_le Fact.out)) h.le
    · simp [Nat.Prime.ne_zero Fact.out]
  · intro γ
    use (log ((embedding γ.val) * exp (-1))).natAbs
    intro x y h
    set x' := (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)) x with hx
    set y' := (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)) y with hy
    rw [Valuation.map_sub_swap, Valuation.restrict_lt_iff_lt_embedding]
    change Rat.padicValuation p (x' - y') < embedding γ.1
    rw [← Nat.cast_pow, ← Rat.cast_natCast, ← Rat.cast_inv_of_ne_zero, Rat.cast_le] at h
    · change padicNorm p (x' - y') ≤ _ at h
      simp only [Rat.padicValuation, Valuation.coe_mk, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
        padicNorm, zpow_neg, Nat.cast_pow] at h ⊢
      split_ifs with H
      · simp only [exp_neg]
        exact embedding_unit_pos _
      · rw [← lt_log_iff_exp_lt (embedding_unit_ne_zero _)]
        simp_all [← zpow_natCast, zpow_pos, inv_le_inv₀, zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ hp1', abs_le,
          Int.lt_iff_add_one_le]
    · simp [Nat.Prime.ne_zero Fact.out]

name: isDenseInducing_cast_withVal
statement:
lemma isDenseInducing_cast_withVal : IsDenseInducing ((Rat.castHom ℚ_[p]).comp
    (WithVal.equiv (Rat.padicValuation p)).toRingHom)
proof:
:= by
  refine Padic.isUniformInducing_cast_withVal.isDenseInducing ?_
  intro
  
  simpa [-nhds_discrete] using Padic.denseRange_ratCast p _

name: norm_rat_le_one_iff_padicValuation_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_rat_le_one_iff_padicValuation_le_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {x : ℚ} :
    ‖(x : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 ↔ Rat.padicValuation p x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rat.padicValuation_le_one_iff]
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ Padic.norm_rat_le_one h⟩
  simpa [Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd Fact.out] using isUnit_iff.1 <| isUnit_den _ h

name: withValUniformEquiv_norm_le_one_iff
statement:
theorem withValUniformEquiv_norm_le_one_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime]
    (x : (Rat.padicValuation p).Completion) :
    ‖Padic.withValUniformEquiv x‖ ≤ 1 ↔ Valued.v x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction x using UniformSpace.Completion.induction_on with
  | hp =>
    rw [Set.ext fun _ ↦ Iff.comm]
    simp_rw [← Valuation.restrict_le_one_iff Valued.v]
    apply withValUniformEquiv.toHomeomorph.isClosed_setOfPred_iff (q := fun x ↦ ‖x‖ ≤ 1)
      (Valued.isClopen_closedBall _ one_ne_zero)
    simpa [Metric.closedBall] using IsUltrametricDist.isClopen_closedBall (0 : ℚ_[p]) one_ne_zero
  | ih a =>
    rw [Valued.valuedCompletion_apply, ← WithVal.apply_ofVal, withValUniformEquiv_cast_apply]
    exact (norm_rat_le_one_iff_padicValuation_le_one p)

name: Int.padicValuation_le_one
statement:
lemma Int.padicValuation_le_one (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (x : ℤ) :
    Int.padicValuation p x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Rat.padicValuation_cast, Rat.padicValuation, Valuation.coe_mk,
    MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, Rat.intCast_eq_zero_iff, padicValRat.of_int]
  split_ifs
  · simp
  · rw [← le_log_iff_exp_le] <;>
    simp_all

name: Int.padicValuation_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma Int.padicValuation_eq_one_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {x : ℤ} :
    Int.padicValuation p x = 1 ↔ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Rat.padicValuation_cast, Rat.padicValuation, Valuation.coe_mk,
    MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, Rat.intCast_eq_zero_iff, padicValRat.of_int]
  split_ifs
  · simp_all
  · rw [← exp_zero, exp_injective.eq_iff]
    simp_all [Nat.Prime.ne_one Fact.out]

name: Int.padicValuation_lt_one_iff
statement:
lemma Int.padicValuation_lt_one_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {x : ℤ} :
    Int.padicValuation p x < 1 ↔ (p : ℤ) ∣ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [lt_iff_le_and_ne, padicValuation_eq_one_iff, Int.padicValuation_le_one]

name: Rat.padicValuation_le_one_iff
statement:
lemma Rat.padicValuation_le_one_iff {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {x : ℚ} :
    Rat.padicValuation p x ≤ 1 ↔ ¬ p ∣ x.den
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← x.num_div_den, map_div₀, ← Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, ← Int.padicValuation_eq_one_iff,
    Rat.padicValuation_cast, ← Int.cast_natCast, Rat.padicValuation_cast, div_le_one₀]
  · rcases (Int.padicValuation_le_one p x.den).eq_or_lt with h | h
    · simp [h, Int.padicValuation_le_one]
    · simp only [h.ne, iff_false, not_le]
      rcases (Int.padicValuation_le_one p x.num).eq_or_lt with h' | h'
      · simp [h, h']
      · rw [Int.padicValuation_lt_one_iff] at h h'
        exfalso
        rw [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast] at h
        rw [Int.natCast_dvd] at h'
        exact Nat.not_coprime_of_dvd_of_dvd (Nat.Prime.one_lt Fact.out) h h' x.reduced.symm
  · simp [zero_lt_iff]

name: Rat.surjective_padicValuation
statement:
theorem Rat.surjective_padicValuation (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact (p.Prime)] :
    Function.Surjective (Rat.padicValuation p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | zero => simp
  | coe x =>
    induction x with | ofAdd x
    simp_rw [Rat.padicValuation, WithZero.exp, Valuation.coe_mk, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk]
    rcases le_or_gt 0 x with (hx | hx)
    · exact ⟨(p ^ x.natAbs)⁻¹, by simp [hp.out.ne_zero, hx]⟩
    · exact ⟨p ^ x.natAbs, by simp [hp.out.ne_zero, padicValRat.pow, abs_eq_neg_self.2 hx.le]⟩

name: stationary
statement:
theorem stationary {f : CauSeq ℚ (padicNorm p)} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) :
    ∃ N, ∀ m n, N ≤ m → N ≤ n → padicNorm p (f n) = padicNorm p (f m)
proof:
:=
  have : ∃ ε > 0, ∃ N1, ∀ j ≥ N1, ε ≤ padicNorm p (f j) :=
    CauSeq.abv_pos_of_not_limZero <| not_limZero_of_not_congr_zero hf
  let ⟨ε, hε, N1, hN1⟩ := this
  let ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := CauSeq.cauchy₂ f hε
  ⟨max N1 N2, fun n m hn hm ↦ by
    have : padicNorm p (f n - f m) < ε := hN2 _ (max_le_iff.1 hn).2 _ (max_le_iff.1 hm).2
    have : padicNorm p (f n - f m) < padicNorm p (f n) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le this <| hN1 _ (max_le_iff.1 hn).1
    have : padicNorm p (f n - f m) < max (padicNorm p (f n)) (padicNorm p (f m)) :=
      lt_max_iff.2 (Or.inl this)
    by_contra hne
    rw [← padicNorm.neg (f m)] at hne
    have hnam := add_eq_max_of_ne hne
    rw [padicNorm.neg, max_comm] at hnam
    rw [← hnam, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm] at this
    apply _root_.lt_irrefl _ this⟩

name: stationaryPoint_spec
statement:
theorem stationaryPoint_spec {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) :
    ∀ {m n},
      stationaryPoint hf ≤ m → stationaryPoint hf ≤ n → padicNorm p (f n) = padicNorm p (f m)
proof:
:=
  @(Classical.choose_spec <| stationary hf)

name: norm_zero_iff
statement: theorem norm_zero_iff (f : PadicSeq p) : f.norm = 0 ↔ f ≈ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hf
    unfold norm at h
    split_ifs at h
    apply hf
    intro ε hε
    exists stationaryPoint hf
    intro j hj
    have heq := stationaryPoint_spec hf le_rfl hj
    simpa [h, heq]
  · intro h
    simp [norm, h]

name: equiv_zero_of_val_eq_of_equiv_zero
statement:
theorem equiv_zero_of_val_eq_of_equiv_zero {f g : PadicSeq p}
    (h : ∀ k, padicNorm p (f k) = padicNorm p (g k)) (hf : f ≈ 0) : g ≈ 0
proof:
:= fun ε hε ↦
  let ⟨i, hi⟩ := hf _ hε
  ⟨i, fun j hj ↦ by simpa [h] using hi _ hj⟩

name: norm_nonzero_of_not_equiv_zero
statement: theorem norm_nonzero_of_not_equiv_zero {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) : f.norm ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  hf ∘ f.norm_zero_iff.1

name: norm_eq_norm_app_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem norm_eq_norm_app_of_nonzero {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) :
    ∃ k, f.norm = padicNorm p k ∧ k ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  have heq : f.norm = padicNorm p (f <| stationaryPoint hf) := by simp [norm, hf]
  ⟨f <| stationaryPoint hf, heq, fun h ↦
    norm_nonzero_of_not_equiv_zero hf (by simpa [h] using heq)⟩

name: not_limZero_const_of_nonzero
statement: theorem not_limZero_const_of_nonzero {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : ¬LimZero (const (padicNorm p) q)
proof:
:=
  fun h' ↦ hq <| const_limZero.1 h'

name: not_equiv_zero_const_of_nonzero
statement: theorem not_equiv_zero_const_of_nonzero {q : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) : ¬const (padicNorm p) q ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h : LimZero (const (padicNorm p) q - 0) ↦
    not_limZero_const_of_nonzero (p := p) hq <| by simpa using h

name: norm_nonneg
statement: theorem norm_nonneg (f : PadicSeq p) : 0 ≤ f.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical exact if hf : f ≈ 0 then by simp [hf, norm] else by simp [norm, hf, padicNorm.nonneg]

name: lift_index_left_left
statement:
theorem lift_index_left_left {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (v2 v3 : ℕ) :
    padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) =
    padicNorm p (f (max (stationaryPoint hf) (max v2 v3)))
proof:
:= by
  apply stationaryPoint_spec hf
  · apply le_max_left
  · exact le_rfl

name: lift_index_left
statement:
theorem lift_index_left {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (v1 v3 : ℕ) :
    padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) =
    padicNorm p (f (max v1 (max (stationaryPoint hf) v3)))
proof:
:= by
  apply stationaryPoint_spec hf
  · apply le_trans
    · apply le_max_left _ v3
    · apply le_max_right
  · exact le_rfl

name: lift_index_right
statement:
theorem lift_index_right {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (v1 v2 : ℕ) :
    padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) =
    padicNorm p (f (max v1 (max v2 (stationaryPoint hf))))
proof:
:= by
  apply stationaryPoint_spec hf
  · apply le_trans
    · apply le_max_right v2
    · apply le_max_right
  · exact le_rfl

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation
statement:
theorem norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation {f : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) :
    f.norm = (p : ℚ) ^ (-f.valuation : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm, valuation, dite_eq_right hf, dite_eq_right hf, padicNorm, ite_eq_right]
  intro H
  apply CauSeq.not_limZero_of_not_congr_zero hf
  intro ε hε
  use stationaryPoint hf
  intro n hn
  rw [stationaryPoint_spec hf le_rfl hn]
  simpa [H] using hε

name: val_eq_iff_norm_eq
statement:
theorem val_eq_iff_norm_eq {f g : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (hg : ¬g ≈ 0) :
    f.valuation = g.valuation ↔ f.norm = g.norm
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hf, norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hg, ← neg_inj, zpow_right_inj₀]
  · exact mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).pos
  · exact mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one

name: norm_mul
statement: theorem norm_mul (f g : PadicSeq p) : (f * g).norm = f.norm * g.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if hf : f ≈ 0 then by
    have hg : f * g ≈ 0 := mul_equiv_zero' _ hf
    simp only [hf, hg, norm, dite_eq_left, zero_mul]
  else
    if hg : g ≈ 0 then by
      have hf : f * g ≈ 0 := mul_equiv_zero _ hg
      simp only [hf, hg, norm, dite_eq_left, mul_zero]
    else by
      unfold norm
      have hfg := mul_not_equiv_zero hf hg
      simp only [hfg, hf, hg, dite_false]
      
      rw [lift_index_left_left hfg, lift_index_left hf, lift_index_right hg]
      apply padicNorm.mul

name: eq_zero_iff_equiv_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff_equiv_zero (f : PadicSeq p) : mk f = 0 ↔ f ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  mk_eq

name: ne_zero_iff_nequiv_zero
statement: theorem ne_zero_iff_nequiv_zero (f : PadicSeq p) : mk f ≠ 0 ↔ ¬f ≈ 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_iff_equiv_zero _ |>.not

name: norm_const
statement: theorem norm_const (q : ℚ) : norm (const (padicNorm p) q) = padicNorm p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hq := eq_or_ne q 0
  · simp [norm]
  · simp [norm, not_equiv_zero_const_of_nonzero hq]

name: norm_values_discrete
statement: theorem norm_values_discrete (a : PadicSeq p) (ha : ¬a ≈ 0) : ∃ z : ℤ, a.norm = (p : ℚ) ^ (-z)
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := norm_eq_norm_app_of_nonzero ha
  simpa [hk] using padicNorm.values_discrete hk'

name: norm_one
statement: theorem norm_one : norm (1 : PadicSeq p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ¬(1 : PadicSeq p) ≈ 0 := one_not_equiv_zero _
  simp [h1, norm]

name: norm_eq_of_equiv_aux
statement:
private theorem norm_eq_of_equiv_aux {f g : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (hg : ¬g ≈ 0) (hfg : f ≈ g)
    (h : padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) ≠ padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg)))
    (hlt : padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg)) < padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf))) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have hpn : 0 < padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) - padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg)) :=
    sub_pos_of_lt hlt
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hfg _ hpn
  let i := max N (max (stationaryPoint hf) (stationaryPoint hg))
  have hi : N ≤ i := le_max_left _ _
  have hN' := hN _ hi
  
  rw [lift_index_left hf N (stationaryPoint hg), lift_index_right hg N (stationaryPoint hf)]
    at hN' h hlt
  have hpne : padicNorm p (f i) ≠ padicNorm p (-g i) := by rwa [← padicNorm.neg (g i)] at h
  rw [CauSeq.sub_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, add_eq_max_of_ne hpne, padicNorm.neg, max_eq_left_of_lt hlt]
    at hN'
  have : padicNorm p (f i) < padicNorm p (f i) := by
    apply lt_of_lt_of_le hN'
    apply sub_le_self
    apply padicNorm.nonneg
  exact lt_irrefl _ this

name: norm_eq_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem norm_eq_of_equiv {f g : PadicSeq p} (hf : ¬f ≈ 0) (hg : ¬g ≈ 0) (hfg : f ≈ g) :
    padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) = padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  cases lt_or_ge (padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg))) (padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf))) with
  | inl hlt =>
    exact norm_eq_of_equiv_aux hf hg hfg h hlt
  | inr hle =>
    apply norm_eq_of_equiv_aux hg hf (Setoid.symm hfg) (Ne.symm h)
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle h

name: norm_equiv
statement: theorem norm_equiv {f g : PadicSeq p} (hfg : f ≈ g) : f.norm = g.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if hf : f ≈ 0 then by
    have hg : g ≈ 0 := Setoid.trans (Setoid.symm hfg) hf
    simp [norm, hf, hg]
  else by
    have hg : ¬g ≈ 0 := hf ∘ Setoid.trans hfg
    unfold norm; split_ifs; exact norm_eq_of_equiv hf hg hfg

name: norm_nonarchimedean_aux
statement:
private theorem norm_nonarchimedean_aux {f g : PadicSeq p} (hfg : ¬f + g ≈ 0) (hf : ¬f ≈ 0)
    (hg : ¬g ≈ 0) : (f + g).norm ≤ max f.norm g.norm
proof:
:= by
  unfold norm; split_ifs
  
  rw [lift_index_left_left hfg, lift_index_left hf, lift_index_right hg]
  apply padicNorm.nonarchimedean

name: norm_nonarchimedean
statement: theorem norm_nonarchimedean (f g : PadicSeq p) : (f + g).norm ≤ max f.norm g.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if hfg : f + g ≈ 0 then by
    have : 0 ≤ max f.norm g.norm := le_max_of_le_left (norm_nonneg _)
    simpa only [hfg, norm]
  else
    if hf : f ≈ 0 then by
      have hfg' : f + g ≈ g := by
        change LimZero (f - 0) at hf
        change LimZero (f + g - g); · simpa only [sub_zero, add_sub_cancel_right] using hf
      have hcfg : (f + g).norm = g.norm := norm_equiv hfg'
      have hcl : f.norm = 0 := (norm_zero_iff f).2 hf
      have : max f.norm g.norm = g.norm := by rw [hcl]; exact max_eq_right (norm_nonneg _)
      rw [this, hcfg]
    else
      if hg : g ≈ 0 then by
        have hfg' : f + g ≈ f := by
          change LimZero (g - 0) at hg
          change LimZero (f + g - f); · simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, sub_zero] using hg
        have hcfg : (f + g).norm = f.norm := norm_equiv hfg'
        have hcl : g.norm = 0 := (norm_zero_iff g).2 hg
        have : max f.norm g.norm = f.norm := by rw [hcl]; exact max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)
        rw [this, hcfg]
      else norm_nonarchimedean_aux hfg hf hg

name: norm_eq
statement:
theorem norm_eq {f g : PadicSeq p} (h : ∀ k, padicNorm p (f k) = padicNorm p (g k)) :
    f.norm = g.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if hf : f ≈ 0 then by
    have hg : g ≈ 0 := equiv_zero_of_val_eq_of_equiv_zero h hf
    simp only [hf, hg, norm, dite_eq_left]
  else by
    have hg : ¬g ≈ 0 := fun hg ↦
      hf <| equiv_zero_of_val_eq_of_equiv_zero (by simp only [h, forall_const]) hg
    simp only [hg, hf, norm, dite_eq_right, not_false_iff]
    let i := max (stationaryPoint hf) (stationaryPoint hg)
    have hpf : padicNorm p (f (stationaryPoint hf)) = padicNorm p (f i) := by
      apply stationaryPoint_spec
      · apply le_max_left
      · exact le_rfl
    have hpg : padicNorm p (g (stationaryPoint hg)) = padicNorm p (g i) := by
      apply stationaryPoint_spec
      · apply le_max_right
      · exact le_rfl
    rw [hpf, hpg, h]

name: norm_neg
statement: theorem norm_neg (a : PadicSeq p) : (-a).norm = a.norm
proof:
:=
  norm_eq <| by simp

name: norm_eq_of_add_equiv_zero
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_add_equiv_zero {f g : PadicSeq p} (h : f + g ≈ 0) : f.norm = g.norm
proof:
:= by
  have : LimZero (f + g - 0) := h
  have : f ≈ -g := show LimZero (f - -g) by simpa only [sub_zero, sub_neg_eq_add]
  have : f.norm = (-g).norm := norm_equiv this
  simpa only [norm_neg] using this

name: add_eq_max_of_ne
statement:
theorem add_eq_max_of_ne {f g : PadicSeq p} (hfgne : f.norm ≠ g.norm) :
    (f + g).norm = max f.norm g.norm
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfg : ¬f + g ≈ 0 := mt norm_eq_of_add_equiv_zero hfgne
  exact if hf : f ≈ 0 then by
    have : LimZero (f - 0) := hf
    have : f + g ≈ g := show LimZero (f + g - g) by simpa only [sub_zero, add_sub_cancel_right]
    have h1 : (f + g).norm = g.norm := norm_equiv this
    have h2 : f.norm = 0 := (norm_zero_iff _).2 hf
    rw [h1, h2, max_eq_right (norm_nonneg _)]
  else
    if hg : g ≈ 0 then by
      have : LimZero (g - 0) := hg
      have : f + g ≈ f := show LimZero (f + g - f) by simpa only [add_sub_cancel_left, sub_zero]
      have h1 : (f + g).norm = f.norm := norm_equiv this
      have h2 : g.norm = 0 := (norm_zero_iff _).2 hg
      rw [h1, h2, max_eq_left (norm_nonneg _)]
    else by
      unfold norm at hfgne ⊢; split_ifs at hfgne ⊢
      
      rw [lift_index_left hf, lift_index_right hg] at hfgne
      · rw [lift_index_left_left hfg, lift_index_left hf, lift_index_right hg]
        exact padicNorm.add_eq_max_of_ne hfgne

statement: theorem zero_def : (0 : ℚ_[p]) = ⟦0⟧

name: defn
statement:
theorem defn (f : PadicSeq p) {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, padicNormE (Padic.mk f - f i : ℚ_[p]) < ε
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [padicNormE]
  
  suffices hyp : ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, (f - const _ (f i)).norm < ε by convert hyp; rfl
  by_contra! h
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := cauchy₂ f hε
  rcases h N with ⟨i, hi, hge⟩
  have hne : ¬f - const (padicNorm p) (f i) ≈ 0 := fun h ↦ by
    rw [PadicSeq.norm, dite_eq_left h] at hge
    exact not_lt_of_ge hge hε
  unfold PadicSeq.norm at hge; split_ifs at hge
  apply not_le_of_gt _ hge
  cases _root_.le_total N (stationaryPoint hne) with
  | inl hgen =>
    exact hN _ hgen _ hi
  | inr hngen =>
    have := stationaryPoint_spec hne le_rfl hngen
    rw [← this]
    exact hN _ le_rfl _ hi

name: nonarchimedean'
statement:
theorem nonarchimedean' (q r : ℚ_[p]) :
    padicNormE (q + r : ℚ_[p]) ≤ max (padicNormE q) (padicNormE r)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ q r <| norm_nonarchimedean

name: add_eq_max_of_ne'
statement:
theorem add_eq_max_of_ne' {q r : ℚ_[p]} :
    padicNormE q ≠ padicNormE r → padicNormE (q + r : ℚ_[p]) = max (padicNormE q) (padicNormE r)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn₂ q r fun _ _ ↦ PadicSeq.add_eq_max_of_ne

name: eq_padic_norm'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eq_padic_norm' (q : ℚ) : padicNormE (q : ℚ_[p]) = padicNorm p q
proof:
:=
  norm_const _

name: image'
statement: protected theorem image' {q : ℚ_[p]} : q ≠ 0 → ∃ n : ℤ, padicNormE q = (p : ℚ) ^ (-n)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn q fun f hf ↦
    have : ¬f ≈ 0 := (ne_zero_iff_nequiv_zero f).1 hf
    norm_values_discrete f this

name: rat_dense'
statement: theorem rat_dense' (q : ℚ_[p]) {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ r : ℚ, padicNormE (q - r : ℚ_[p]) < ε
proof:
:=
  Quotient.inductionOn q fun q' ↦
    have : ∃ N, ∀ m ≥ N, ∀ n ≥ N, padicNorm p (q' m - q' n) < ε := cauchy₂ _ hε
    let ⟨N, hN⟩ := this
    ⟨q' N, by
      classical
      dsimp [padicNormE]
      convert_to! PadicSeq.norm (q' - const _ (q' N)) < ε 
      rcases Decidable.em (q' - const (padicNorm p) (q' N) ≈ 0) with heq | hne'
      · simpa only [heq, PadicSeq.norm, dite_eq_left]
      · simp only [PadicSeq.norm, dite_eq_right hne']
        change padicNorm p (q' _ - q' _) < ε
        rcases Decidable.em (stationaryPoint hne' ≤ N) with hle | hle
        · have := (stationaryPoint_spec hne' le_rfl hle).symm
          simp only [const_apply, CauSeq.sub_apply, padicNorm.zero, sub_self] at this
          simpa only [this]
        · exact hN _ (lt_of_not_ge hle).le _ le_rfl⟩

name: div_nat_pos
statement: private theorem div_nat_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < 1 / (n + 1 : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  div_pos zero_lt_one (mod_cast succ_pos _)

name: exi_rat_seq_conv
statement:
theorem exi_rat_seq_conv {ε : ℚ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, padicNormE (f i - (limSeq f i : ℚ_[p]) : ℚ_[p]) < ε
proof:
:= by
  refine (exists_nat_gt (1 / ε)).imp fun N hN i hi ↦ ?_
  have h := Classical.choose_spec (rat_dense' (f i) (div_nat_pos i))
  refine lt_of_lt_of_le h ((div_le_iff₀' <| mod_cast succ_pos _).mpr ?_)
  rw [right_distrib]
  apply le_add_of_le_of_nonneg
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hε).mp (le_trans (le_of_lt hN) (mod_cast hi))
  · apply le_of_lt
    simpa

name: exi_rat_seq_conv_cauchy
statement: theorem exi_rat_seq_conv_cauchy : IsCauSeq (padicNorm p) (limSeq f)
proof:
:= fun ε hε ↦ by
  have hε3 : 0 < ε / 3 := div_pos hε (by simp)
  let ⟨N, hN⟩ := exi_rat_seq_conv f hε3
  let ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := f.cauchy₂ hε3
  exists max N N2
  intro j hj
  suffices
    padicNormE (limSeq f j - f (max N N2) + (f (max N N2) - limSeq f (max N N2)) : ℚ_[p]) < ε by
    ring_nf at this
    rw [← padicNormE.eq_padic_norm']
    exact mod_cast this
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt
  · apply padicNormE.add_le
  · rw [← add_thirds ε]
    apply _root_.add_lt_add
    · suffices padicNormE (limSeq f j - f j + (f j - f (max N N2)) : ℚ_[p]) < ε / 3 + ε / 3 by
        simpa only [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      apply lt_of_le_of_lt
      · apply padicNormE.add_le
      · apply _root_.add_lt_add
        · rw [padicNormE.map_sub]
          apply mod_cast hN j
          exact le_of_max_le_left hj
        · exact hN2 _ (le_of_max_le_right hj) _ (le_max_right _ _)
    · apply mod_cast hN (max N N2)
      apply le_max_left

name: complete'
statement: theorem complete' : ∃ q : ℚ_[p], ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, padicNormE (q - f i : ℚ_[p]) < ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨lim f, fun ε hε ↦ by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exi_rat_seq_conv f (half_pos hε)
    obtain ⟨N2, hN2⟩ := padicNormE.defn (lim' f) (half_pos hε)
    refine ⟨max N N2, fun i hi ↦ ?_⟩
    rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel _ (lim' f i : ℚ_[p]) _]
    refine (padicNormE.add_le _ _).trans_lt ?_
    rw [← add_halves ε]
    apply _root_.add_lt_add
    · apply hN2 _ (le_of_max_le_right hi)
    · rw [padicNormE.map_sub]
      exact hN _ (le_of_max_le_left hi)⟩

name: complete''
statement: theorem complete'' : ∃ q : ℚ_[p], ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N, ∀ i ≥ N, padicNormE (f i - q : ℚ_[p]) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := complete' f
  refine ⟨x, fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := hx ε hε
  refine ⟨N, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  rw [padicNormE.map_sub]
  exact hN i hi

name: rat_dense
statement: theorem rat_dense (q : ℚ_[p]) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ r : ℚ, ‖q - r‖ < ε
proof:
:=
  let ⟨ε', hε'l, hε'r⟩ := exists_rat_btwn hε
  let ⟨r, hr⟩ := rat_dense' q (ε := ε') (by simpa using hε'l)
  ⟨r, lt_trans (by simpa [Norm.norm] using hr) hε'r⟩

name: add_eq_max_of_ne

theorem eq_padicNorm (q : ℚ) : ‖(q : ℚ_[p])‖ = padicNorm p q

name: norm_p
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_p : ‖(p : ℚ_[p])‖ = (p : ℝ)⁻¹

  rw [← @Rat.cast_natCast ℚ_[p] _ p]

    -Rat.cast_natCast]

  Quotient.inductionOn q fun f hf ↦

  exact if h : q = 0 then ⟨0, by simp [h]⟩

    let ⟨n, hn⟩ := padicNormE.image h

name: eq_ratNorm
statement: theorem eq_ratNorm (q : ℚ_[p]) : ‖q‖ = ratNorm q

  Classical.choose_spec (padicNormE.is_rat q)

name: norm_rat_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_rat_le_one : ∀ {q : ℚ} (_ : ¬p ∣ q.den), ‖(q : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1
  | ⟨n, d, hn, hd⟩ => fun hq : ¬p ∣ d ↦
    if hnz : n = 0 then by
      have : (⟨n, d, hn, hd⟩ : ℚ) = 0
proof:
:= Rat.zero_iff_num_zero.mpr hnz
      norm_num [this]
    else by
      have hnz' : (⟨n, d, hn, hd⟩ : ℚ) ≠ 0 := mt Rat.zero_iff_num_zero.1 hnz
      rw [eq_padicNorm]
      norm_cast
      
      rw [padicNorm.eq_zpow_of_nonzero hnz', padicValRat, neg_sub,
        padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd hq, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast]
      apply inv_le_one_of_one_le₀
      norm_cast
      apply one_le_pow
      exact hp.1.pos

name: norm_int_le_one
statement: theorem norm_int_le_one (z : ℤ) : ‖(z : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  suffices ‖((z : ℚ) : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ 1 by simpa
  norm_rat_le_one <| by simp [hp.1.ne_one]

name: norm_intCast_lt_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_intCast_lt_one_iff {k : ℤ} : ‖(k : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ ↑p ∣ k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    contrapose! h
    apply le_of_eq
    rw [eq_comm]
    calc
      ‖(k : ℚ_[p])‖ = ‖((k : ℚ) : ℚ_[p])‖ := by norm_cast
      _ = padicNorm p k := eq_padicNorm _
      _ = 1 := mod_cast (int_eq_one_iff k).mpr h
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    push_cast
    rw [padicNormE.mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖(p : ℚ_[p])‖ * 1 :=
        mul_le_mul le_rfl (by simpa using norm_int_le_one _) (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ < 1 := by
        rw [mul_one, norm_p]
        exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ <| mod_cast hp.1.one_lt

name: norm_natCast_lt_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_lt_one_iff {n : ℕ} :
    ‖(n : ℚ_[p])‖ < 1 ↔ p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Int.natCast_dvd_natCast] using norm_intCast_lt_one_iff (p := p) (k := n)

name: norm_intCast_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_intCast_eq_one_iff {z : ℤ} :
    ‖(z : ℚ_[p])‖ = 1 ↔ IsCoprime z p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not]
  simp [Nat.coprime_comm, ← norm_natCast_lt_one_iff, -norm_intCast_lt_one_iff,
    Int.isCoprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one, Int.gcd,
    ← hp.out.dvd_iff_not_coprime, norm_natAbs, -cast_natAbs, norm_int_le_one]

name: norm_natCast_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} :
    ‖(n : ℚ_[p])‖ = 1 ↔ p.Coprime n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [p.coprime_comm] using norm_intCast_eq_one_iff (p := p) (z := n)

name: norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd
statement:
theorem norm_int_le_pow_iff_dvd (k : ℤ) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖(k : ℚ_[p])‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) ↔ (p ^ n : ℤ) ∣ k
proof:
:= by
  have : (p : ℝ) ^ (-n : ℤ) = (p : ℚ) ^ (-n : ℤ) := by simp
  rw [show (k : ℚ_[p]) = ((k : ℚ) : ℚ_[p]) by norm_cast, eq_padicNorm, this]
  norm_cast
  rw [← padicNorm.dvd_iff_norm_le]

name: norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right {z1 z2 : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 + z2‖ < ‖z2‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:=
  _root_.by_contradiction fun hne ↦
    not_lt_of_ge (by rw [add_eq_max_of_ne hne]; apply le_max_right) h

name: norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_left
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_left {z1 z2 : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 + z2‖ < ‖z1‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:=
  _root_.by_contradiction fun hne ↦
    not_lt_of_ge (by rw [add_eq_max_of_ne hne]; apply le_max_left) h

name: norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_right
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_right {z1 z2 : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 - z2‖ < ‖z2‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_neg z2]
  apply norm_eq_of_norm_add_lt_right
  simp [← sub_eq_add_neg, h]

name: norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_left
statement: theorem norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_left {z1 z2 : ℚ_[p]} (h : ‖z1 - z2‖ < ‖z1‖) : ‖z1‖ = ‖z2‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm]
  apply norm_eq_of_norm_sub_lt_right
  simpa [← norm_neg (z1 - _)] using h

name: norm_natCast_p_sub_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma norm_natCast_p_sub_one :
    ‖((p - 1 : ℕ) : ℚ_[p])‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_natCast_eq_one_iff]
  exact (coprime_self_sub_right hp.out.one_le).mpr p.coprime_one_right

name: padicNormE_lim_le
statement:
theorem padicNormE_lim_le {f : CauSeq ℚ_[p] norm} {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hf : ∀ i, ‖f i‖ ≤ a) :
    ‖f.lim‖ ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Setoid.symm (CauSeq.equiv_lim f) _ ha
  calc
    ‖f.lim‖ = ‖f.lim - f N + f N‖ := by simp
    _ ≤ max ‖f.lim - f N‖ ‖f N‖ := nonarchimedean _ _
    _ ≤ a := max_le (le_of_lt (hN _ le_rfl)) (hf _)

name: valuation_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem valuation_zero : valuation (0 : ℚ_[p]) = 0
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_left ((const_equiv p).2 rfl)

name: norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation
statement: theorem norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation {x : ℚ_[p]} : x ≠ 0 → ‖x‖ = (p : ℝ) ^ (-x.valuation)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with | _ f
  intro hf
  change (PadicSeq.norm _ : ℝ) = (p : ℝ) ^ (-PadicSeq.valuation _)
  rw [PadicSeq.norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation]
  · rw [Rat.cast_zpow, Rat.cast_natCast]
  · apply CauSeq.not_limZero_of_not_congr_zero
    contrapose hf
    apply Quotient.sound
    simpa using hf

name: valuation_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_ratCast (q : ℚ) : valuation (q : ℚ_[p]) = padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with rfl | hq
  · simp only [Rat.cast_zero, valuation_zero, padicValRat.zero]
  refine neg_injective ((zpow_right_strictMono₀ (mod_cast hp.out.one_lt)).injective
    <| (norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation (mod_cast hq)).symm.trans ?_)
  rw [eq_padicNorm, ← Rat.cast_natCast, ← Rat.cast_zpow, Rat.cast_inj]
  exact padicNorm.eq_zpow_of_nonzero hq

name: valuation_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_intCast (n : ℤ) : valuation (n : ℚ_[p]) = padicValInt p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Rat.cast_intCast, valuation_ratCast, padicValRat.of_int]

name: valuation_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_natCast (n : ℕ) : valuation (n : ℚ_[p]) = padicValNat p n
proof:

name: valuation_ofNat

name: valuation_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_one : valuation (1 : ℚ_[p]) = 0
proof:

name: valuation_p
statement: lemma valuation_p : valuation (p : ℚ_[p]) = 1
proof:

name: le_valuation_add
statement:
theorem le_valuation_add {x y : ℚ_[p]} (hxy : x + y ≠ 0) :
    min x.valuation y.valuation ≤ (x + y).valuation
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simpa only [hx, zero_add] using min_le_right _ _
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simpa only [hy, add_zero] using min_le_left _ _
  have : ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖ := nonarchimedean x y
  simpa only [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hxy, norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx,
    norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hy, le_max_iff,
    zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀ (mod_cast hp.out.one_lt : 1 < (p : ℝ)), neg_le_neg_iff, ← min_le_iff]

name: valuation_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_mul {x y : ℚ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    (x * y).valuation = x.valuation + y.valuation
proof:
:= by
  have h_norm : ‖x * y‖ = ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := norm_mul x y
  have hp_ne_one : (p : ℝ) ≠ 1 := mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < p := mod_cast NeZero.pos _
  rwa [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hy,
    norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation (mul_ne_zero hx hy), ← zpow_add₀ hp_pos.ne',
    zpow_right_inj₀ hp_pos hp_ne_one, ← neg_add, neg_inj] at h_norm

name: valuation_inv
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_inv (x : ℚ_[p]) : x⁻¹.valuation = -x.valuation
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hx := eq_or_ne x 0
  · simp
  have h_norm : ‖x⁻¹‖ = ‖x‖⁻¹ := norm_inv x
  have hp_ne_one : (p : ℝ) ≠ 1 := mod_cast (Fact.out : p.Prime).ne_one
  have hp_pos : (0 : ℝ) < p := mod_cast NeZero.pos _
  rwa [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation <| inv_ne_zero hx,
    ← zpow_neg, zpow_right_inj₀ hp_pos hp_ne_one, neg_inj] at h_norm

name: valuation_pow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_pow (x : ℚ_[p]) : ∀ n : ℕ, (x ^ n).valuation = n * x.valuation
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    obtain rfl | hx
proof:
:= eq_or_ne x 0
    · simp
    · simp [pow_succ, hx, valuation_mul, valuation_pow, _root_.add_one_mul]

name: valuation_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
lemma valuation_zpow (x : ℚ_[p]) : ∀ n : ℤ, (x ^ n).valuation = n * x.valuation
  | (n : ℕ) => by simp
  | .negSucc n => by simp [← neg_mul]; simp [Int.negSucc_eq]

open scoped Classical in
/
def addValuationDef : ℚ_[p] → WithTop ℤ
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ if x = 0 then ⊤ else x.valuation

name: AddValuation.map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AddValuation.map_zero : addValuationDef (0 : ℚ_[p]) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [addValuationDef, ite_eq_left rfl]

name: AddValuation.map_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AddValuation.map_one : addValuationDef (1 : ℚ_[p]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [addValuationDef, ite_eq_right one_ne_zero, valuation_one, WithTop.coe_zero]

name: AddValuation.map_mul
statement:
theorem AddValuation.map_mul (x y : ℚ_[p]) :
    addValuationDef (x * y : ℚ_[p]) = addValuationDef x + addValuationDef y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addValuationDef]
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, ite_eq_left rfl, zero_mul, ite_eq_left rfl, WithTop.top_add]
  · by_cases hy : y = 0
    · rw [hy, ite_eq_left rfl, mul_zero, ite_eq_left rfl, WithTop.add_top]
    · rw [ite_eq_right hx, ite_eq_right hy, ite_eq_right (mul_ne_zero hx hy), ← WithTop.coe_add,
        WithTop.coe_eq_coe, valuation_mul hx hy]

name: AddValuation.map_add
statement:
theorem AddValuation.map_add (x y : ℚ_[p]) :
    min (addValuationDef x) (addValuationDef y) ≤ addValuationDef (x + y : ℚ_[p])
proof:
:= by
  simp only [addValuationDef]
  by_cases hxy : x + y = 0
  · rw [hxy, ite_eq_left rfl]
    exact le_top
  · by_cases hx : x = 0
    · rw [hx, ite_eq_left rfl, min_eq_right, zero_add]
      exact le_top
    · by_cases hy : y = 0
      · rw [hy, ite_eq_left rfl, min_eq_left, add_zero]
        exact le_top
      · rw [ite_eq_right hx, ite_eq_right hy, ite_eq_right hxy, ← WithTop.coe_min,
          WithTop.coe_le_coe]
        exact le_valuation_add hxy

name: norm_eq_zpow_log_mulValuation
statement:
lemma norm_eq_zpow_log_mulValuation {x : ℚ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) :

proof:

name: norm_lt_zpow_iff_mulValuation_lt_exp
statement:
lemma norm_lt_zpow_iff_mulValuation_lt_exp {x : ℚ_[p]} {m : ℤ} :
    ‖x‖ < (p : ℝ) ^ m ↔ mulValuation x < exp m
proof:
:= by
  have h1p : (1 : ℝ) < p := mod_cast hp.out.one_lt
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simpa [hx] using zpow_pos (by positivity) m
  · rw [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, zpow_lt_zpow_iff_right₀ h1p, mulValuation_toFun,
      ite_eq_right hx, exp_lt_exp]

name: norm_lt_norm_iff_mulValuation_lt
statement:
lemma norm_lt_norm_iff_mulValuation_lt {x y : ℚ_[p]} :
    ‖x‖ < ‖y‖ ↔ mulValuation x < mulValuation y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simp [hy]
  rw [norm_eq_zpow_log_mulValuation hy, norm_lt_zpow_iff_mulValuation_lt_exp,
    exp_log (mulValuation.ne_zero_iff.mpr hy)]

name: addValuation.apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem addValuation.apply {x : ℚ_[p]} (hx : x ≠ 0) :

name: norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one
statement:
theorem norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one (x : ℚ_[p]) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖x‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ n ↔ ‖x‖ < (p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have aux (n : ℤ) : 0 < ((p : ℝ) ^ n) := zpow_pos (mod_cast hp.1.pos) _
  by_cases hx0 : x = 0
  · simp [hx0, norm_zero, aux, le_of_lt (aux _)]
  rw [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx0]
  have h1p : 1 < (p : ℝ) := mod_cast hp.1.one_lt
  have H := zpow_right_strictMono₀ h1p
  rw [H.le_iff_le, H.lt_iff_lt, Int.lt_add_one_iff]

name: norm_lt_pow_iff_norm_le_pow_sub_one

theorem norm_lt_pow_iff_norm_le_pow_sub_one (x : ℚ_[p]) (n : ℤ) :

proof:

  rw [norm_le_pow_iff_norm_lt_pow_add_one, sub_add_cancel]

name: norm_le_one_iff_val_nonneg
statement: theorem norm_le_one_iff_val_nonneg (x : ℚ_[p]) : ‖x‖ ≤ 1 ↔ 0 ≤ x.valuation

  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp only [hx, norm_zero, valuation_zero, zero_le_one, le_refl]
  · rw [norm_eq_zpow_neg_valuation hx, ← zpow_zero (p : ℝ), zpow_le_zpow_iff_right₀, neg_nonpos]
    exact Nat.one_lt_cast.2 (Nat.Prime.one_lt' p).1

name: prime_natGenerator
