proof:
:=
  Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.1 <| Submodule.IsPrincipal.prime_generator_of_isPrime _
    ((Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective (IsIntegralClosure.intEquiv R).injective).not.2 v.ne_bot)

name: valuation_equiv_padicValuation
statement:
theorem valuation_equiv_padicValuation (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    (v.valuation ℚ).IsEquiv (padicValuation (primesEquiv v))
proof:
:= by
  simp [primesEquiv, Valuation.isEquiv_iff_val_le_one, valuation_le_one_iff_den,
    padicValuation_le_one_iff, natGenerator_dvd_iff,
    map_natCast (IsIntegralClosure.intEquiv R) _ ▸ Ideal.apply_mem_of_equiv_iff]

name: adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum R)
    (x : v.adicCompletionIntegers ℚ) : padicIntEquiv v x = adicCompletion.padicEquiv v x
proof: := rfl

name: adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_symm_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum R)
    (x : ℤ_[primesEquiv v]) : (adicCompletionIntegers.padicIntEquiv v).symm x =
      (adicCompletion.padicEquiv v).symm x
proof: := rfl

name: adicCompletion.padicEquiv_bijOn
statement:
theorem adicCompletion.padicEquiv_bijOn (v : HeightOneSpectrum R) :
    Set.BijOn (padicEquiv v) (v.adicCompletionIntegers ℚ) (subring (primesEquiv v))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x hx ↦ ?_, (padicEquiv v).injective.injOn, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [← adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_apply v ⟨x, hx⟩]
    exact norm_le_one ((adicCompletionIntegers.padicIntEquiv v) ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (adicCompletionIntegers.padicIntEquiv v).surjective ⟨y, hy⟩
    refine ⟨x, x.2, by rw [← adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_apply, hx]⟩

name: coe_adicCompletionIntegersEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coe_adicCompletionIntegersEquiv_apply (p : Nat.Primes) (x : ℤ_[p]) :
    (adicCompletionIntegersEquiv R p x) = adicCompletionEquiv R p x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [adicCompletionIntegersEquiv, ContinuousAlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_symm_apply,
    adicCompletionEquiv, ContinuousAlgEquiv.trans_apply, ContinuousAlgEquiv.cast_apply,
    EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, Equiv.cast_apply, eq_cast_iff_heq]
  rw [← Subtype.heq_iff_coe_heq (by rw [primesEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
    (by rw [primesEquiv.apply_symm_apply])]
  exact cast_heq _ _

name: coe_adicCompletionIntegersEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem coe_adicCompletionIntegersEquiv_symm_apply (p : Nat.Primes)
    (x : (primesEquiv.symm p).adicCompletionIntegers ℚ) :
    (adicCompletionIntegersEquiv R p).symm x = (adicCompletionEquiv R p).symm x
proof:
:= by
  simp -implicitDefEqProofs only [adicCompletionIntegersEquiv, ContinuousAlgEquiv.symm_trans_apply,
    ContinuousAlgEquiv.symm_symm, adicCompletionEquiv, Equiv.cast_apply, eq_cast_iff_heq,
    ← adicCompletionIntegers.coe_padicIntEquiv_apply, ContinuousAlgEquiv.cast_symm_apply]
  rw [← Subtype.heq_iff_coe_heq (by rw [primesEquiv.apply_symm_apply])
    (by rw [primesEquiv.apply_symm_apply])]
  exact cast_heq _ _

name: AddChar.tendsto_eval_one_sub_pow
statement:
lemma AddChar.tendsto_eval_one_sub_pow {κ : AddChar ℤ_[p] R} (hκ : Continuous κ) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ (κ 1 - 1) ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine (PadicInt.fwdDiff_tendsto_zero ⟨κ, hκ⟩).congr fun n ↦ ?_
  simpa only [AddChar.map_zero_eq_one, mul_one] using! fwdDiff_addChar_eq κ 0 1 n

name: continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma continuous_addChar_of_value_at_one {r : R} (hr : Tendsto (r ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Continuous (addChar_of_value_at_one r hr : ℤ_[p] → R)
proof:
:=
  map_continuous (mahlerSeries (r ^ ·))

name: coe_addChar_of_value_at_one
statement:
lemma coe_addChar_of_value_at_one {r : R} (hr : Tendsto (r ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (addChar_of_value_at_one r hr : ℤ_[p] → R) = mahlerSeries (r ^ ·)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: addChar_of_value_at_one_def
statement:
@[simp]
lemma addChar_of_value_at_one_def {r : R} (hr : Tendsto (r ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    addChar_of_value_at_one r hr (1 : ℤ_[p]) = 1 + r
proof:
:= by
  change mahlerSeries (r ^ ·) ↑(1 : ℕ) = _
  rw [mahlerSeries_apply_nat hr le_rfl, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_one,
    Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.choose_self, one_smul, one_smul, pow_zero, pow_one]

name: eq_addChar_of_value_at_one
statement:
lemma eq_addChar_of_value_at_one {r : R} (hr : Tendsto (r ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0))
    {κ : AddChar ℤ_[p] R} (hκ : Continuous κ) (hκ' : κ 1 = 1 + r) :
    κ = addChar_of_value_at_one r hr
proof:
:=
  denseRange_natCast.addChar_eq_of_eval_one_eq hκ (by fun_prop) (by simp [hκ'])

name: continuousAddCharEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma continuousAddCharEquiv_apply {κ : AddChar ℤ_[p] R} (hκ : Continuous κ) :
    continuousAddCharEquiv p R ⟨κ, hκ⟩ = κ 1 - 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: continuousAddCharEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma continuousAddCharEquiv_symm_apply {r : R} (hr : Tendsto (r ^ ·) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    (continuousAddCharEquiv p R).symm ⟨r, hr⟩ =
    (addChar_of_value_at_one r hr : AddChar ℤ_[p] R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul_apply {κ : AddChar ℤ_[p] R} (hκ : Continuous κ) :
    continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul p R ⟨κ, hκ⟩ = κ 1 - 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul_symm_apply {r : R} (hr : ‖r‖ < 1) :
    (continuousAddCharEquiv_of_norm_mul p R).symm ⟨r, hr⟩ = (addChar_of_value_at_one r
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_iff_norm_lt_one.mpr hr) : AddChar ℤ_[p] R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: padic_polynomial_dist
statement:
theorem padic_polynomial_dist {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Algebra R ℤ_[p]]
    (F : Polynomial R) (x y : ℤ_[p]) :
    ‖F.aeval x - F.aeval y‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
proof:
:= by
  let ⟨z, hz⟩ := (F.map (algebraMap R ℤ_[p])).evalSubFactor x y
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap] at hz
  calc
    ‖F.aeval x - F.aeval y‖ = ‖z‖ * ‖x - y‖ := by simp [hz]
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖x - y‖ := by gcongr; apply PadicInt.norm_le_one
    _ = ‖x - y‖ := by simp

name: comp_tendsto_lim
statement:
private theorem comp_tendsto_lim {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {F : Polynomial ℤ_[p]}
    (ncs : CauSeq ℤ_[p] norm) : Tendsto (fun i => F.eval (ncs i)) atTop (𝓝 (F.eval ncs.lim))
proof:
:=
  Filter.Tendsto.comp (@Polynomial.continuousAt _ _ _ _ F _) ncs.tendsto_limit

name: ncs_tendsto_lim
statement:
private theorem ncs_tendsto_lim :
    Tendsto (fun i => ‖F.derivative.aeval (ncs i)‖) atTop (𝓝 ‖F.derivative.aeval ncs.lim‖)
proof:
:= by
  refine Tendsto.comp (continuous_iff_continuousAt.1 continuous_norm _) ?_
  rw [← Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap]
  refine (comp_tendsto_lim ncs).congr ?_
  simp

name: ncs_tendsto_const
statement:
private theorem ncs_tendsto_const :
    Tendsto (fun i => ‖F.derivative.aeval (ncs i)‖) atTop (𝓝 ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖)
proof:
:= by
  convert! @tendsto_const_nhds ℝ _ ℕ _ _; rw [ncs_der_val]

name: norm_deriv_eq
statement: private theorem norm_deriv_eq : ‖F.derivative.aeval ncs.lim‖ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  tendsto_nhds_unique ncs_tendsto_lim (ncs_tendsto_const ncs_der_val)

name: tendsto_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem tendsto_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun i => F.aeval (ncs i)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero.2 (by simpa using hnorm)

name: limit_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero
statement: theorem limit_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero : F.aeval ncs.lim = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_nhds_unique ?_ (tendsto_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero hnorm)
  rw [← Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap]
  refine (comp_tendsto_lim ncs).congr ?_
  simp

name: a_soln_is_unique
statement:
private theorem a_soln_is_unique {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
    [Algebra R ℤ_[p]] {F : Polynomial R} {a : ℤ_[p]} (ha : F.aeval a = 0) (z' : ℤ_[p])
    (hz' : F.aeval z' = 0) (hnormz' : ‖z' - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖) : z' = a
proof:
:= by
  let h := z' - a
  let ⟨q, hq⟩ := (F.map (algebraMap R ℤ_[p])).binomExpansion a h
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap, Polynomial.derivative_map] at hq
  have : (F.derivative.aeval a + q * h) * h = 0 := by calc
    _ = F.aeval (a + h) := by rw [hq, ha, zero_add, sq, right_distrib, mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := show F.aeval (a + (z' - a)) = 0 by simp [hz']
  have : h = 0 := by_contra fun hne ↦
    have : F.derivative.aeval a + q * h = 0 :=
      (eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero this).resolve_right hne
    have : F.derivative.aeval a = -q * h := by simpa using eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left this
    lt_irrefl ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
      (calc
        ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ = ‖q‖ * ‖h‖ := by simp [this]
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖h‖ := by gcongr; apply PadicInt.norm_le_one
        _ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by simpa)
  exact eq_of_sub_eq_zero (by rw [← this])

name: T_def
statement: private theorem T_def : T = ‖F.aeval a‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [T_gen]

name: T_nonneg
statement: private theorem T_nonneg : 0 ≤ T
proof: := norm_nonneg _

name: T_pow_nonneg
statement: private theorem T_pow_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ T ^ n
proof: := pow_nonneg T_nonneg _

name: deriv_sq_norm_pos
statement: private theorem deriv_sq_norm_pos : 0 < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) hnorm

name: deriv_sq_norm_ne_zero
statement: private theorem deriv_sq_norm_ne_zero : ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_of_gt (deriv_sq_norm_pos hnorm)

name: deriv_norm_ne_zero
statement: private theorem deriv_norm_ne_zero : ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h =>
  deriv_sq_norm_ne_zero hnorm (by simp [*, sq])

name: deriv_norm_pos
statement: private theorem deriv_norm_pos : 0 < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm (deriv_norm_ne_zero hnorm))

name: deriv_ne_zero
statement: private theorem deriv_ne_zero : F.derivative.aeval a ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mt norm_eq_zero.2 (deriv_norm_ne_zero hnorm)

name: T_lt_one
statement: private theorem T_lt_one : T < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := (div_lt_one (deriv_sq_norm_pos hnorm)).2 hnorm
  rw [T_def]; exact h

name: T_pow
statement: private theorem T_pow {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : T ^ n < 1
proof: := pow_lt_one₀ T_nonneg (T_lt_one hnorm) hn

name: T_pow'
statement: private theorem T_pow' (n : ℕ) : T ^ 2 ^ n < 1
proof: := T_pow hnorm (pow_ne_zero _ two_ne_zero)

name: ih_0
statement: private theorem ih_0 : ih 0 a
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, by simp [T_def, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (deriv_sq_norm_pos hnorm))]⟩

name: calc_norm_le_one
statement:
private theorem calc_norm_le_one {n : ℕ} {z : ℤ_[p]} (hz : ih n z) :
    ‖(↑(F.aeval z) : ℚ_[p]) / ↑(F.derivative.aeval z)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  calc
    ‖(↑(F.aeval z) : ℚ_[p]) / ↑(F.derivative.aeval z)‖ =
        ‖(↑(F.aeval z) : ℚ_[p])‖ / ‖(↑(F.derivative.aeval z) : ℚ_[p])‖ :=
      norm_div _ _
    _ = ‖F.aeval z‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by simp [hz.1]
    _ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by
      gcongr
      apply hz.2
    _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n := div_sq_cancel _ _
    _ ≤ 1 := by bound [T_pow' hnorm n]

name: calc_deriv_dist
proof:
:=
  calc
    ‖F.derivative.aeval z' - F.derivative.aeval z‖ ≤ ‖z' - z‖ := padic_polynomial_dist _ _ _
    _ = ‖z1‖ := by simp only [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, hz', add_add_neg_cancel'_right, norm_neg]
    _ = ‖F.aeval z‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := hz1
    _ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by
      gcongr
      apply hz.2
    _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n := div_sq_cancel _ _
    _ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := (mul_lt_iff_lt_one_right (deriv_norm_pos hnorm)).2
      (T_pow' hnorm _)

name: calc_eval_z'_norm
statement:
private theorem calc_eval_z'_norm {z z' z1 : ℤ_[p]} {n} (hz : ih n z) {q}
    (heq : F.aeval z' = q * z1 ^ 2)
    (h1 : ‖(↑(F.aeval z) : ℚ_[p]) / ↑(F.derivative.aeval z)‖ ≤ 1) (hzeq : z1 = ⟨_, h1⟩) :
    ‖F.aeval z'‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖F.aeval z'‖ = ‖q‖ * ‖z1‖ ^ 2 := by simp [heq]
    _ ≤ 1 * ‖z1‖ ^ 2 := by gcongr; apply PadicInt.norm_le_one
    _ = ‖F.aeval z‖ ^ 2 / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 := by simp [hzeq, hz.1, div_pow]
    _ ≤ (‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n) ^ 2 / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 := by
      gcongr
      exact hz.2
    _ = (‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (T ^ 2 ^ n) ^ 2 / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 := by
      simp only [mul_pow]
    _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * (T ^ 2 ^ n) ^ 2 := div_sq_cancel _ _
    _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by rw [← pow_mul, pow_succ 2]

name: newton_seq_deriv_norm
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_deriv_norm (n : ℕ) :
    ‖F.derivative.aeval (newton_seq n)‖ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  (newton_seq_aux hnorm n).2.1

name: newton_seq_norm_le
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_norm_le (n : ℕ) :
    ‖F.aeval (newton_seq n)‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n
proof:
:=
  (newton_seq_aux hnorm n).2.2

name: newton_seq_norm_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [newton_seq_gen, newton_seq_gen, newton_seq_aux, ih_n]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm]

name: newton_seq_succ_dist
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_succ_dist (n : ℕ) :
    ‖newton_seq (n + 1) - newton_seq n‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n
proof:
:=
  calc
    ‖newton_seq (n + 1) - newton_seq n‖ =
        ‖F.aeval (newton_seq n)‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval (newton_seq n)‖ :=
      newton_seq_norm_eq hnorm _
    _ = ‖F.aeval (newton_seq n)‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by rw [newton_seq_deriv_norm]
    _ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by
      gcongr
      apply newton_seq_norm_le
    _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n := div_sq_cancel _ _

name: newton_seq_dist_aux
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_dist_aux (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, ‖newton_seq (n + k) - newton_seq n‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n
  | 0 => by simp [T_pow_nonneg, mul_nonneg]
  | k + 1 =>
    have : 2 ^ n ≤ 2 ^ (n + k)
proof:
:= by
      apply pow_right_mono₀
      · simp
      · apply Nat.le_add_right
    calc
      ‖newton_seq (n + (k + 1)) - newton_seq n‖ = ‖newton_seq (n + k + 1) - newton_seq n‖ := by
        rw [add_assoc]
      _ = ‖newton_seq (n + k + 1) - newton_seq (n + k) + (newton_seq (n + k) - newton_seq n)‖ := by
        rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ max ‖newton_seq (n + k + 1) - newton_seq (n + k)‖ ‖newton_seq (n + k) - newton_seq n‖ :=
        (PadicInt.nonarchimedean _ _)
      _ ≤ max (‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ (n + k)) (‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n) :=
        (max_le_max (newton_seq_succ_dist _ _) (newton_seq_dist_aux _ _))
      _ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n :=
        max_eq_right <|
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
            (le_of_lt (T_lt_one hnorm)) this) (norm_nonneg _)

name: newton_seq_dist
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_dist {n k : ℕ} (hnk : n ≤ k) :
    ‖newton_seq k - newton_seq n‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ m, k = n + m := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnk
  let ⟨_, hex'⟩ := hex
  rw [hex']; apply newton_seq_dist_aux

name: bound'
statement: private theorem bound' : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_zero ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖]
  exact
    tendsto_const_nhds.mul
      (Tendsto.comp (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) (T_lt_one hnorm))
        (tendsto_pow_atTop_atTop_of_one_lt (by simp)))

name: bound
statement:
private theorem bound :
    ∀ {ε}, ε > 0 → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ {n}, n ≥ N → ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ n < ε
proof:
:= fun hε ↦
  eventually_atTop.1 <| (bound' hnorm).eventually <| gt_mem_nhds hε

name: bound'_sq
statement:
private theorem bound'_sq :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ^ 2 * T ^ 2 ^ n) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_zero ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖, sq]
  simp only [mul_assoc]
  apply Tendsto.mul
  · apply tendsto_const_nhds
  · apply bound'
    assumption

name: newton_seq_is_cauchy
statement: private theorem newton_seq_is_cauchy : IsCauSeq norm newton_seq
proof:
:= fun _ε hε ↦
  (bound hnorm hε).imp fun _N hN _j hj ↦ (newton_seq_dist hnorm hj).trans_lt <| hN le_rfl

name: soln_spec
statement:
private theorem soln_spec {ε : ℝ} (hε : ε > 0) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ {i : ℕ}, i ≥ N → ‖soln - newton_cau_seq hnorm i‖ < ε
proof:
:=
  Setoid.symm (CauSeq.equiv_lim (newton_cau_seq hnorm)) _ hε

name: soln_deriv_norm
statement: private theorem soln_deriv_norm : ‖F.derivative.aeval soln‖ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  norm_deriv_eq (newton_seq_deriv_norm hnorm)

name: newton_seq_norm_tendsto_zero
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_norm_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun i => ‖F.aeval (newton_cau_seq hnorm i)‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (newton_seq_norm_le hnorm) (bound'_sq hnorm)

name: newton_seq_dist_tendsto'
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_dist_tendsto' :
    Tendsto (fun n => ‖newton_cau_seq hnorm n - a‖) atTop (𝓝 ‖soln - a‖)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_norm.tendsto _).comp ((newton_cau_seq hnorm).tendsto_limit.sub tendsto_const_nhds)

name: eval_soln
statement: private theorem eval_soln : F.aeval soln = 0
proof:
:=
  limit_zero_of_norm_tendsto_zero (newton_seq_norm_tendsto_zero hnorm)

name: T_pos
statement: private theorem T_pos : T > 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [T_def]
  exact div_pos (norm_pos_iff.2 hnsol) (deriv_sq_norm_pos hnorm)

name: newton_seq_succ_dist_weak
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_succ_dist_weak (n : ℕ) :
    ‖newton_seq (n + 2) - newton_seq (n + 1)‖ < ‖F.aeval a‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  have : 2 ≤ 2 ^ (n + 1) := by
    have := pow_right_mono₀ (by simp : 1 ≤ 2) (Nat.le_add_left _ _ : 1 ≤ n + 1)
    simpa using this
  calc
    ‖newton_seq (n + 2) - newton_seq (n + 1)‖ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 ^ (n + 1) :=
      newton_seq_succ_dist hnorm _
    _ ≤ ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 2 :=
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (norm_nonneg _)
        (le_of_lt (T_lt_one hnorm)) this) (norm_nonneg _))
    _ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ * T ^ 1 :=
      (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (pow_lt_pow_right_of_lt_one₀ (T_pos hnorm hnsol)
        (T_lt_one hnorm) (by norm_num)) (deriv_norm_pos hnorm))
    _ = ‖F.aeval a‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ := by
      rw [T_gen, sq, pow_one, norm_div, ← mul_div_assoc, PadicInt.padic_norm_e_of_padicInt,
        PadicInt.coe_mul, norm_mul]
      apply mul_div_mul_left
      apply deriv_norm_ne_zero; assumption

name: newton_seq_dist_to_a
statement:
private theorem newton_seq_dist_to_a :
    ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → ‖newton_seq n - a‖ = ‖F.aeval a‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
  | 1, _h => by simp [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc, newton_seq_gen, newton_seq_aux, ih_n]
  | k + 2, _h =>
    have hlt : ‖newton_seq (k + 2) - newton_seq (k + 1)‖ < ‖newton_seq (k + 1) - a‖
proof:
:= by
      rw [newton_seq_dist_to_a (k + 1) (succ_pos _)]; apply newton_seq_succ_dist_weak
      assumption
    have hne' : ‖newton_seq (k + 2) - newton_seq (k + 1)‖ ≠ ‖newton_seq (k + 1) - a‖ := ne_of_lt hlt
    calc
      ‖newton_seq (k + 2) - a‖ =
          ‖newton_seq (k + 2) - newton_seq (k + 1) + (newton_seq (k + 1) - a)‖ := by
        rw [← sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ = max ‖newton_seq (k + 2) - newton_seq (k + 1)‖ ‖newton_seq (k + 1) - a‖ :=
        (PadicInt.norm_add_eq_max_of_ne hne')
      _ = ‖newton_seq (k + 1) - a‖ := max_eq_right_of_lt hlt
      _ = ‖Polynomial.aeval a F‖ / ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ :=
        newton_seq_dist_to_a (k + 1) (succ_pos _)

name: newton_seq_dist_tendsto
proof:
:=
  tendsto_const_nhds.congr' (eventually_atTop.2
    ⟨1, fun _ hx => (newton_seq_dist_to_a hnorm hnsol _ hx).symm⟩)

name: soln_dist_to_a
statement: private theorem soln_dist_to_a : ‖soln - a‖ = ‖F.aeval a‖ / ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:=
  tendsto_nhds_unique (newton_seq_dist_tendsto' hnorm) (newton_seq_dist_tendsto hnorm hnsol)

name: soln_dist_to_a_lt_deriv
statement: private theorem soln_dist_to_a_lt_deriv : ‖soln - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [soln_dist_to_a, div_lt_iff₀ (deriv_norm_pos _), ← sq] <;> assumption

name: soln_unique
statement:
private theorem soln_unique (z : ℤ_[p]) (hev : F.aeval z = 0)
    (hnlt : ‖z - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖) : z = soln
proof:
:= by
  have hsoln : ‖z - soln‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval soln‖ := by
    rw [soln_deriv_norm]
    calc
      ‖z - soln‖ = ‖z - a + (a - soln)‖ := by rw [sub_add_sub_cancel]
      _ ≤ max ‖z - a‖ ‖a - soln‖ := PadicInt.nonarchimedean _ _
      _ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ :=
        max_lt hnlt ((norm_sub_rev soln a ▸ (soln_dist_to_a_lt_deriv hnorm)) hnsol)
  exact a_soln_is_unique (eval_soln hnorm) z hev hsoln

name: a_is_soln
statement:
private theorem a_is_soln (ha : F.aeval a = 0) :
    F.aeval a = 0 ∧
      ‖a - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ∧
        ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ∧
          ∀ z', F.aeval z' = 0 → ‖z' - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ → z' = a
proof:
:=
  ⟨ha, by simp [deriv_ne_zero hnorm], rfl, a_soln_is_unique ha⟩

name: hensels_lemma
statement:
theorem hensels_lemma :
    ∃ z : ℤ_[p],
      F.aeval z = 0 ∧
        ‖z - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ∧
          ‖F.derivative.aeval z‖ = ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ ∧
            ∀ z', F.aeval z' = 0 → ‖z' - a‖ < ‖F.derivative.aeval a‖ → z' = z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact if ha : F.aeval a = 0 then ⟨a, a_is_soln hnorm ha⟩
  else by
    exact ⟨soln_gen hnorm, eval_soln hnorm,
      soln_dist_to_a_lt_deriv hnorm ha, soln_deriv_norm hnorm, fun z => soln_unique hnorm ha z⟩

name: serreDerivative_eq_smul
statement:
private lemma serreDerivative_eq_smul {k' : ℤ} {k l L : ℂ} {g F : ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k'}
    {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : F = serreDerivative k f)
    (hrank : Module.rank ℂ (ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k') = 1) (hf : MDiff f)
    (hl : Tendsto f atImInfty (𝓝 l)) (hg1 : Tendsto g atImInfty (𝓝 1))
    (hL : L = -(k * 12⁻¹ * l)) :
    serreDerivative k f = L • g
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ one_ne_zero (tendsto_nhds_unique (h ▸ hg1) tendsto_const_nhds)
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero' g hg).mp (Module.rank_eq_one_iff_finrank_eq_one.mp hrank) F
  have hfg : serreDerivative k f = c • g := hF ▸ congrArg DFunLike.coe hc.symm
  have hlim : Tendsto (c • ⇑g) atImInfty (𝓝 (-(k * 12⁻¹ * l))) := hfg ▸ by
    simpa using (isZeroAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex hf (hl.isBigO_one ℝ)).sub
      ((tendsto_E2_atImInfty.const_mul (k * 12⁻¹)).mul hl)
  rw [hfg, hL, ← tendsto_nhds_unique (hg1.const_mul c) hlim, mul_one]

name: serreDerivative_E
statement: theorem serreDerivative_E₄ : serreDerivative 4 E₄ = (-3⁻¹ : ℂ) • E₆
proof:
:=
  serreDerivative_eq_smul (F := serreDerivativeMF 4 E₄) rfl levelOne_weight_six_rank_one
    E₄.holo' tendsto_E_atImInfty tendsto_E_atImInfty (by norm_num)

name: serreDerivative_E
statement: theorem serreDerivative_E₆ : serreDerivative 6 E₆ = (-2⁻¹ : ℂ) • E₄ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun z ↦ E₄ z ^ 2) atImInfty (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_E_atImInfty).pow 2
  coe_pow E₄ 2 ▸ serreDerivative_eq_smul (F := serreDerivativeMF 6 E₆) (g := E₄.pow 2) rfl
    (by simpa [Nat.ModEq] using dimension_level_one 8 ⟨4, rfl⟩) E₆.holo'
    tendsto_E_atImInfty hlim (by norm_num)

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_D2
statement:
lemma normalizedDerivOfComplex_D2 (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) :
    D (D2 γ) = fun z : ℍ ↦ -(γ 1 0 : ℂ) ^ 2 / denom γ z ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hcomp : (D2 γ ∘ ofComplex) =ᶠ[𝓝 (z : ℂ)]
      fun w ↦ 2 * π * I * (γ 1 0 : ℂ) * denom γ w ^ (-1 : ℤ) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet.mem_nhds z.im_pos] with w hw
    simp [EisensteinSeries.D2, ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos hw, div_eq_mul_inv]
  simp only [normalizedDerivOfComplex, (((hasDerivAt_denom_zpow γ (-1) z).const_mul
    (2 * π * I * (γ 1 0 : ℂ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hcomp).deriv]
  push_cast [show ((γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) 1 0 : ℝ) = (γ 1 0 : ℝ) by norm_cast]
  field_simp

name: serreDerivativeOne_E2_slash
statement:
private lemma serreDerivativeOne_E2_slash (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) :
    serreDerivative 1 E2 ∣[(4 : ℤ)] γ = serreDerivative 1 E2
proof:
:= by
  have hD2 : MDiff (D2 γ) := mdifferentiable_const.div (mdifferentiable_denom _) (denom_ne_zero _)
  
  have h₁₂ : serreDerivative 1 E2 = serreDerivative 2 E2 + (12⁻¹ : ℂ) • (E2 * E2) := by
    ext z
    simp; ring
  have hslash : serreDerivative 1 E2 ∣[(4 : ℤ)] γ =
      serreDerivative 2 (E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ) +
        (12⁻¹ : ℂ) • ((E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ) * (E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ)) := by
    have heq : serreDerivative 2 E2 ∣[(4 : ℤ)] γ = serreDerivative 2 (E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ) := by
      grind [serreDerivative_slash_equivariant (k := 2) E2_mdifferentiable (γ := γ)]
    rw [h₁₂, SlashAction.add_slash, SL_smul_slash, heq, show (4 : ℤ) = 2 + 2 from rfl,
      mul_slash_SL2]
  
  have hDD2 : D (D2 γ) = (1 / (24 * riemannZeta 2)) • (D2 γ * D2 γ) := by
    rw [normalizedDerivOfComplex_D2, riemannZeta_two]
    ext z
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Pi.mul_apply, smul_eq_mul, EisensteinSeries.D2]
    field_simp [denom_ne_zero, Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Real.pi_ne_zero]
    linear_combination -24 * (γ 1 0 : ℂ) ^ 2 * I_sq
  
  rw [hslash, E2_slash_action, serreDerivative_sub 2 E2_mdifferentiable (hD2.const_smul _),
    serreDerivative_smul 2 _ hD2]
  ext z
  simp [hDD2]
  ring

name: serreDerivative_E

    E2_mdifferentiable tendsto_E2_atImInfty tendsto_E_atImInfty (by norm_num)

name: Gamma1_to_Gamma0_mem
statement:
theorem Gamma1_to_Gamma0_mem {N} (A : Gamma0 N) :
    A ∈ Gamma1' N ↔
    ((A.1 0 0 : ℤ) : ZMod N) = 1 ∧ ((A.1 1 1 : ℤ) : ZMod N) = 1
      ∧ ((A.1 1 0 : ℤ) : ZMod N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have adet : (A.1.1.det : ZMod N) = 1 := by simp only [A.1.property, Int.cast_one]
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_two] at adet
    simp only [Gamma1_mem', Gamma0Map, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, Int.cast_sub,
      Int.cast_mul] at *
    simpa only [Gamma1_mem', Gamma0Map, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk, Int.cast_sub,
      Int.cast_mul, ha, Gamma0_mem.mp A.property, and_self_iff, and_true, mul_one, mul_zero,
      sub_zero] using adet
  · intro ha
    simp only [Gamma1_mem', Gamma0Map, MonoidHom.coe_mk]
    exact ha.2.1

name: Gamma1_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Gamma1_mem (N : ℕ) (A : SL(2, ℤ)) : A ∈ Gamma1 N ↔
    (A 0 0 : ZMod N) = 1 ∧ (A 1 1 : ZMod N) = 1 ∧ (A 1 0 : ZMod N) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    simp_rw [Gamma1, Subgroup.mem_map] at ha
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxx⟩ := ha
    rw [Gamma1_to_Gamma0_mem] at hx
    simp only [Subgroup.mem_top, true_and] at hxx
    rw [← hxx]
    convert! hx
  · intro ha
    simp_rw [Gamma1, Subgroup.mem_map]
    have hA : A ∈ Gamma0 N := by simp [ha.right.right, Gamma0_mem]
    have HA : (⟨A, hA⟩ : Gamma0 N) ∈ Gamma1' N := by
      simp only [Gamma1_to_Gamma0_mem]
      exact ha
    refine ⟨(⟨(⟨A, hA⟩ : Gamma0 N), HA⟩ : (Gamma1' N : Subgroup (Gamma0 N))), ?_⟩
    simp

name: exists_Gamma_le_conj
statement:
theorem exists_Gamma_le_conj (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] :
    ∃ N ≠ 0, ∀ x ∈ Gamma N, g * (mapGL ℚ x) * g⁻¹ ∈ (Gamma M).map (mapGL ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  
  let A₁ := g.1
  let A₂ := (g⁻¹).1
  have hA₁₂ : A₁ * A₂ = 1 := by simp only [← Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_mul,
    mul_inv_cancel, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_one, A₁, A₂]
  let a₁ := A₁.den
  let a₂ := A₂.den
  
  refine ⟨a₁ * a₂ * M, mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero A₁.den_ne_zero A₂.den_ne_zero) (NeZero.ne _),
    fun ⟨y, hy⟩ hy' ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : ∃ k, y = 1 + (a₁ * a₂ * M) • k := by
    replace hy' : y.map (Int.cast : ℤ → ZMod (a₁ * a₂ * M)) = 1 := by
      rw [CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_mem', Subtype.ext_iff] at hy'
      simpa using! hy'
    use Matrix.of fun i j ↦ (y - 1) i j / (a₁ * a₂ * M)
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add']
    ext i j
    simp_rw [Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul]
    refine (Int.mul_ediv_cancel_of_dvd ?_).symm
    rw [← Matrix.map_one Int.cast (by simp) (by simp), ← sub_eq_zero,
      ← Matrix.map_sub _ (by simp)] at hy'
    simpa only [Matrix.zero_apply, Matrix.map_apply, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd,
      Nat.cast_mul] using! congr_fun₂ hy' i j
  
  let z := 1 + M • (A₁.num * k * A₂.num)
  have hz_coe : z.map Int.cast = A₁ * (y.map Int.cast) * A₂ := by
    simp only [Matrix.map_add _ Int.cast_add, Matrix.map_one _ Int.cast_zero Int.cast_one, hk,
      mul_add, mul_one, add_mul, hA₁₂, add_right_inj, z]
    conv_rhs => rw [← A₁.inv_denom_smul_num, ← A₂.inv_denom_smul_num, Matrix.map_smul _ _ (by simp)]
    simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.map_smul (Int.cast : ℤ → ℚ) M (by simp),
      Matrix.map_mul_intCast]
    rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul ℚ (_ * M), ← mul_smul, ← mul_smul,
      mul_comm a₁ a₂, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, mul_assoc _ _ (M : ℚ), mul_comm _ (M : ℚ),
      inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (mod_cast A₂.den_ne_zero),
      mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (mod_cast A₁.den_ne_zero), Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul]
  have hz_det : z.det = 1 := by
    have := congr_arg Matrix.det hz_coe
    simp_rw [Matrix.det_mul, ← Int.cast_det] at this
    rwa [mul_right_comm, ← Matrix.det_mul, hA₁₂, Matrix.det_one, one_mul, hy, Int.cast_inj] at this
  refine ⟨⟨z, hz_det⟩, ?_, by simpa only [Subtype.ext_iff, Subgroup.coe_mul, Units.ext_iff,
    Units.val_mul] using! hz_coe⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma_mem', Subtype.ext_iff]
  ext i j
  simp_rw [map_apply_coe, z, map_add, map_one, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Int.coe_castRingHom,
    Matrix.add_apply, map_apply, coe_one, add_eq_left, Matrix.smul_apply, nsmul_eq_mul,
    Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_self M, zero_mul]

name: exists_Gamma_le_conj'
statement:
theorem exists_Gamma_le_conj' (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) (M : ℕ) [NeZero M] :
    ∃ N ≠ 0, (toConjAct <| g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) • (Gamma N).map (mapGL ℝ)
      ≤ (Gamma M).map (mapGL ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, h⟩ := exists_Gamma_le_conj g M
  refine ⟨N, hN, fun y hy ↦ ?_⟩
  simp_rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, Subgroup.mem_map,
    eq_inv_smul_iff] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := h x hx
  use z, hz
  simpa only [Subtype.ext_iff, Units.ext_iff, map_mul] using!
    congr_arg (GeneralLinearGroup.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) hz'

name: finiteIndex_conjGL
statement: lemma finiteIndex_conjGL (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) : (conjGL ⊤ (g.map <| Rat.castHom ℝ)).FiniteIndex
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  let t := (toConjAct <| g.map <| Rat.castHom ℝ)⁻¹
  suffices (t • 𝒮ℒ ⊓ 𝒮ℒ).relIndex 𝒮ℒ ≠ 0 by
    rwa [conjGL, index_comap, ← inf_relIndex_right, Subgroup.map_top]
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩ := exists_Gamma_le_conj' g 1
  rw [Gamma_one_top, Subgroup.map_top] at hN'
  suffices Γ(N) ≤ (t • 𝒮ℒ ⊓ 𝒮ℒ).comap (mapGL ℝ) by
    have _ : NeZero N := ⟨hN⟩
    simpa only [index_comap] using! (finiteIndex_of_le this).index_ne_zero
  intro k hk
  simpa [mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem] using!
    hN' <| smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ _ ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩

name: isArithmetic_conj_SL2Z
statement:
lemma isArithmetic_conj_SL2Z (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) :
    (toConjAct (g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) • 𝒮ℒ).IsArithmetic
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  simp_rw [Subgroup.Commensurable, Subgroup.isFiniteRelIndex_iff_relIndex_ne_zero]
  rw [MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
  constructor
  · rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_comap, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
    exact (finiteIndex_conjGL g⁻¹).index_ne_zero
  · rw [← Subgroup.relIndex_pointwise_smul (toConjAct (g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)))⁻¹,
      inv_smul_smul, ← Subgroup.relIndex_comap, Subgroup.relIndex_top_right]
    exact (finiteIndex_conjGL g).index_ne_zero

name: _root_.Subgroup.IsArithmetic.conj
statement:
lemma _root_.Subgroup.IsArithmetic.conj (𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) [𝒢.IsArithmetic]
    (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) :
    (toConjAct (g.map (Rat.castHom ℝ)) • 𝒢).IsArithmetic
proof:
:=
  ⟨(Subgroup.IsArithmetic.is_commensurable.smul _).trans
    (isArithmetic_conj_SL2Z g).is_commensurable⟩

name: IsCongruenceSubgroup.conjGL
statement:
lemma IsCongruenceSubgroup.conjGL {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} (hΓ : IsCongruenceSubgroup Γ)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) ℚ) :
    IsCongruenceSubgroup (conjGL Γ (g.map <| Rat.castHom ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hN, hΓM⟩ := hΓ
  have _ : NeZero M := ⟨hN⟩
  obtain ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩ := exists_Gamma_le_conj' g M
  rw [Subgroup.pointwise_smul_subset_iff] at hN'
  refine ⟨N, ‹_›, fun x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := Subgroup.mem_inv_pointwise_smul_iff.mp <| hN' ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  exact mem_conjGL.mpr ⟨y, hΓM hy, hy'⟩

name: isBigO_comp_ofComplex_I_mul_sub_valueAtInfty

proof:

  refine (EventuallyEq.isBigO ?_).trans (isLittleO_exp_neg_mul_rpow_atTop hCpos r).isBigO
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
  simp [ht, ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos, ← coe_im]

name: hasSum_
statement:
private lemma hasSum_Λ_of_qExpansion_isBigO {r : ℝ}
    (hpos : 0 < s.re) (hs : r + 1 < s.re)
    (hΛ : Λ hk f s = mellin (fun t ↦ (weakFEPair hk f).f t - (weakFEPair hk f).f₀) s)
    (hcoeff : (fun n ↦ (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff n) =O[atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ r) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ π ^ (-s) * Gamma s * (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff n /
      ↑(2 * n / h Γ : ℝ) ^ s) (Λ hk f s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hΛ]
  have hh := Γ.strictWidthInfty_pos
  have hΓ := Γ.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods
  refine hasSum_mellin_pi_mul₀ (fun _ ↦ by positivity) hpos ?_ ?_
  · 
    intro t (ht : 0 < t)
    have := hasSum_qExpansion f hh hΓ (ofComplex (I * t))
    convert! hasSum_ite_sub_hasSum this 0 using 2 with n
    · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
      · simp
      · simp [hn.ne', Function.Periodic.qParam, ofComplex_apply_eq_ite, ht, ← exp_nat_mul]
        grind [I_sq]
    · simp only [weakFEPair]
      rw [qExpansion_coeff_zero hh, pow_zero, mul_one]
      · exact ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f hh hΓ
      · exact SlashInvariantFormClass.periodic_comp_ofComplex f hΓ
  · 
    simp_rw [mul_comm (2 : ℝ), mul_div_assoc,
      Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (show 0 ≤ 2 / h Γ by positivity), ← div_div]
    apply Summable.div_const
    apply summable_of_isBigO_nat (Real.summable_nat_rpow.mpr <| show r - s.re < -1 by linarith)
    simp only [Real.rpow_sub' (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (show r - s.re ≠ 0 by linarith)]
    apply IsBigO.mul _ (isBigO_refl _ _)
    simpa using hcoeff.norm_left

name: hasSum_
statement:
lemma hasSum_Λ (hs : k + 1 < s.re) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ π ^ (-s) * Gamma s * (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff n /
      ↑(2 * n / h Γ : ℝ) ^ s) (Λ hk f s)
proof:
:= by
  refine hasSum_Λ_of_qExpansion_isBigO hk f (r := k)
    (by linarith [show (0 : ℝ) < k from mod_cast hk]) (by exact_mod_cast hs) ?_ ?_
  · rw [Λ, ← ((weakFEPair hk f).hasMellin <| by grind [weakFEPair]).2]
  · simpa using ModularFormClass.qExpansion_isBigO hk.le f

name: hasSum_L_of_hasSum_
statement:
private lemma hasSum_L_of_hasSum_Λ (hs : 0 < s.re)
    (hΛ : HasSum (fun n ↦ π ^ (-s) * Gamma s *
      (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff n / ↑(2 * n / h Γ : ℝ) ^ s) (Λ hk f s)) :
    HasSum (fun i ↦ (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff i / ↑i ^ s) (h Γ ^ (-s) * L hk f s)
proof:
:= by
  convert! hΛ.mul_right (2 / Gammaℂ s * h Γ ^ (-s)) using 1
  · ext n
    generalize (PowerSeries.coeff n) (qExpansion (h Γ) f) = p
    rw [Gammaℂ, ← div_div, ← div_div, div_self two_ne_zero, one_div, cpow_neg (2 * _), inv_inv,
      ← ofReal_ofNat, mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg two_pos.le Real.pi_pos.le]
    simp only [ofReal_div, ofReal_mul, ofReal_ofNat, ofReal_natCast]
    have : (2 * n / h Γ : ℂ) ^ s = 2 ^ s * n ^ s / h Γ ^ s := by
      rw [← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_natCast, ← ofReal_mul,
        div_cpow_ofReal_nonneg (by grind) Γ.strictWidthInfty_nonneg, ofReal_mul,
        mul_cpow_ofReal_nonneg zero_le_two n.cast_nonneg]
    rw [this, cpow_neg, cpow_neg]
    have := Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos hs
    have := cpow_ne_zero_iff (y := s).mpr (.inl <| ofReal_ne_zero.mpr Γ.strictWidthInfty_pos.ne')
    field_simp
  · grind [L]

name: hasSum_L
statement:
theorem hasSum_L (hs : k + 1 < s.re) :
    HasSum (fun n ↦ (qExpansion (h Γ) f).coeff n / n ^ s) (h Γ ^ (-s) * L hk f s)
proof:
:=
  hasSum_L_of_hasSum_Λ hk f (by linarith [show (0 : ℝ) < k from mod_cast hk]) (hasSum_Λ hk f hs)

name: slash_action_eqn'

theorem slash_action_eqn' {k : ℤ} [Γ.HasDetOne] [SlashInvariantFormClass F Γ k]
    (f : F) {γ} (hγ : γ ∈ Γ) (z : ℍ) :
    f (γ • z) = (γ 1 0 * z + γ 1 1) ^ k * f z
proof:
:= by

    simpa [slash_def, σ, mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ (zpow_ne_zero _ (denom_ne_zero _ _)),
      Subgroup.HasDetOne.det_eq hγ] using congr_fun (slash_action_eqn f γ hγ) z
  rw [this, denom, mul_comm]

name: logDeriv_eta_comp_div_eq
statement:
lemma logDeriv_eta_comp_div_eq (z : ℍ) :
    logDeriv (η ∘ (-1 / ·)) z = ((z : ℂ) ^ (2 : ℤ))⁻¹ * logDeriv η (-z)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [neg_div, one_div, inv_neg]
  rw [logDeriv_comp, mul_comm]
  · simp [zpow_ofNat]
  · exact differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet (by grind [im_pnat_div_pos 1 z])
  · fun_prop (disch := exact z.ne_zero)

name: logDeriv_eta_comp_eq_logDeriv_csqrt_eta
statement:
lemma logDeriv_eta_comp_eq_logDeriv_csqrt_eta (z : ℍ) :
    logDeriv (η ∘ (-1 / ·)) z = logDeriv (sqrt * η) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDeriv_eta_comp_div_eq z,
      logDeriv_mul _ (by simp [sqrt, ne_zero z]) (eta_ne_zero z.2)
      (differentiableAt_sqrt (mem_slitPlane z))
      (differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet z.2), logDeriv_apply sqrt]
  have hE2 := congrFun (E2_slash_action ModularGroup.S) z
  simp only [one_div, SL_slash_def, modular_S_smul, ModularGroup.denom_S,
    Int.reduceNeg, zpow_neg, riemannZeta_two, mul_inv_rev, inv_div, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    D2, ModularGroup.denom_S, smul_eq_mul] at hE2
  rw [deriv_sqrt (mem_slitPlane z), div_eq_mul_inv, logDeriv_eta_eq_E2 z,
    logDeriv_eta_eq_E2 (.mk _ z.im_inv_neg_coe_pos), ← mul_assoc, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, hE2, sqrt,
    show ModularGroup.S 1 0 = 1 by simp [ModularGroup.S]]
  transitivity 1 / z / 2 + π * I / 12 * E2 z
  · field_simp
    grind [I_sq]
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div₀ _ _ (2 : ℂ), neg_div, cpow_neg, ← mul_inv, ← cpow_add _ _ z.ne_zero]
    norm_num

name: eta_comp_eqOn_const_mul_csqrt_eta
statement:
lemma eta_comp_eqOn_const_mul_csqrt_eta :
    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧ upperHalfPlaneSet.EqOn (η ∘ (fun z : ℂ ↦ -1 / z)) (c • (sqrt * η))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← logDeriv_eqOn_iff]
  · exact fun z hz ↦ logDeriv_eta_comp_eq_logDeriv_csqrt_eta ⟨z, hz⟩
  · apply DifferentiableOn.comp (t := upperHalfPlaneSet)
    · exact fun x hx ↦ (differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet hx).differentiableWithinAt
    · exact DifferentiableOn.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        (fun x hx ↦ ne_zero (⟨x, hx⟩ : ℍ))
    · exact fun y hy ↦ by grind [im_pnat_div_pos 1 (⟨y, hy⟩ : ℍ)]
  · exact fun x hx ↦ ((differentiableAt_sqrt (mem_slitPlane ⟨x, hx⟩)).mul
     (differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet hx)).differentiableWithinAt
  · exact isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet
  · exact Convex.isPreconnected (convex_halfSpace_im_gt 0)
  · exact fun x hx ↦ mul_ne_zero (by simp [sqrt, ne_zero ⟨x, hx⟩]) (eta_ne_zero hx)
  · exact fun x hx ↦ eta_ne_zero (by grind [im_pnat_div_pos 1 ⟨x, hx⟩])

name: discriminant_eq_q_prod
statement: lemma discriminant_eq_q_prod (z : ℍ) : Δ z = 𝕢 1 z * ∏' n, (1 - eta_q n z) ^ 24

  · exact ((multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_eta.multipliable z.2).tprod_pow _).symm

name: discriminant_T_invariant

proof:
:= by
  ext z

name: eta_comp_eq_csqrt_I_inv
statement:
lemma eta_comp_eq_csqrt_I_inv : upperHalfPlaneSet.EqOn
    (η ∘ (-1 / ·)) ((sqrt I)⁻¹ • (sqrt * η))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, h⟩ := eta_comp_eqOn_const_mul_csqrt_eta
  have h3 : η I = z * sqrt I * η I := by simpa [← mul_assoc] using h (show I ∈ _ by simp)
  grind [sqrt, eta_ne_zero (show 0 < I.im by simp)]

name: discriminant_S_invariant
statement: lemma discriminant_S_invariant : (Δ ∣[(12 : ℤ)] ModularGroup.S) = Δ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  suffices η (-(↑z)⁻¹) ^ 24 * ((z : ℂ) ^ 12)⁻¹ = η z ^ 24 by
    rw [SL_slash_apply, UpperHalfPlane.modular_S_smul]
    simpa [denom, ModularGroup.S]
  have he : η (-(↑z)⁻¹) = (sqrt I)⁻¹ * (sqrt z * η z) := by
    simpa [neg_div] using eta_comp_eq_csqrt_I_inv z.2
  simp only [he, mul_pow, mul_pow, inv_pow, csqrt_I_pow_24, csqrt_pow_24_eq (ne_zero z)]
  field_simp [z.ne_zero]

name: tendsto_atImInfty_tprod_one_sub_eta_q_pow
statement:
lemma tendsto_atImInfty_tprod_one_sub_eta_q_pow :
    Tendsto (fun x : ℍ ↦ ∏' (n : ℕ), (1 - eta_q n x) ^ 24) atImInfty (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  have htprod : Tendsto (fun q : ℂ ↦ ∏' (n : ℕ), (1 - q ^ (n + 1))) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 1) := by
    have := tendsto_tprod_one_add_of_dominated_convergence (𝓕 := 𝓝 0) (g := 0)
      (f := fun (q : ℂ) (n : ℕ) ↦ -q ^ (n + 1)) (bound := fun n ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1))
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, norm_neg, norm_pow, add_zero, tprod_one] at this
    simp_rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
    refine this
      (by simpa only [pow_succ'] using (summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one (by norm_num)).mul_left _)
      (fun k ↦ by simpa using ((continuous_pow (M := ℂ) (k + 1)).tendsto 0).neg) ?_
    filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2)] with q hq k
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hq).le _
  have := (htprod.comp (UpperHalfPlane.qParam_tendsto_atImInfty zero_lt_one)).pow 24
  simp only [Periodic.qParam, ofReal_one, div_one, comp_apply, one_pow, eta_q] at *
  convert! this using 2 with τ
  rw [Multipliable.tprod_pow]
  apply (multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_eta.multipliable τ.2).congr
  simp [eta_q, Periodic.qParam, ← exp_nat_mul]

name: discriminant_isZeroAtImInfty
statement: lemma discriminant_isZeroAtImInfty : IsZeroAtImInfty Δ
proof:
:= by
  apply Tendsto.congr (fun z ↦ (discriminant_eq_q_prod z).symm)
  rw [show (0 : ℂ) = 0 * 1 by ring]
  exact (qParam_tendsto_atImInfty zero_lt_one).mul
    (tendsto_atImInfty_tprod_one_sub_eta_q_pow.congr fun z ↦ by congr 1)

name: exp_isBigO_discriminant
statement: lemma exp_isBigO_discriminant : (fun τ ↦ Real.exp (-2 * π * τ.im)) =O[atImInfty] Δ
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_bound 2 ?_
  have hprod := tendsto_atImInfty_tprod_one_sub_eta_q_pow.eventually
    (Metric.ball_mem_nhds 1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/2))
  filter_upwards [hprod] with τ hτ
  rw [discriminant_eq_q_prod, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
  have hq_norm : ‖𝕢 1 τ‖ = Real.exp (-2 * π * τ.im) := by simp [Periodic.qParam, Complex.norm_exp]
  rw [← hq_norm]
  have hprod_bound : 1 / 2 ≤ ‖∏' n, (1 - eta_q n τ) ^ 24‖ := by
    have hsub : ‖∏' n, (1 - eta_q n τ) ^ 24 - 1‖ < 1 / 2 := by rwa [Complex.dist_eq] at hτ
    have h1 := norm_sub_norm_le 1 (∏' n, (1 - eta_q n τ) ^ 24)
    grind [norm_one, norm_sub_rev]
  linarith [norm_nonneg (𝕢 1 τ), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod_bound (norm_nonneg (𝕢 1 τ))]

name: discriminant_cuspFunction_eqOn
statement:
lemma discriminant_cuspFunction_eqOn : Set.EqOn (cuspFunction 1 Δ)
    (fun q ↦ q * ∏' i, (1 - q ^ (i + 1)) ^ 24) (Metric.ball 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  by_cases hq0 : q = 0
  · simpa [hq0] using! Periodic.cuspFunction_zero_of_zero_at_inf one_pos
      discriminant_isZeroAtImInfty.zero_at_infty_comp_ofComplex
  · have him := Periodic.im_invQParam_pos_of_norm_lt_one one_pos
      (by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hq) hq0
    simp [cuspFunction, Periodic.cuspFunction_eq_of_nonzero 1 _ hq0,
      ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos him, discriminant_eq_q_prod ⟨_, him⟩,
      Periodic.qParam_right_inv one_ne_zero hq0, eta_q]

name: discriminant_qExpansion_coeff_one
statement: lemma discriminant_qExpansion_coeff_one : (qExpansion 1 Δ).coeff 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := Metric.mem_ball_self one_pos
  calc (qExpansion 1 Δ).coeff 1
      = derivWithin (cuspFunction 1 Δ) (Metric.ball 0 1) 0 := by
        simp [qExpansion_coeff, ← derivWithin_of_isOpen Metric.isOpen_ball hmem]
    _ = derivWithin (fun q ↦ q * ∏' i, (1 - q ^ (i + 1)) ^ 24) (Metric.ball 0 1) 0 :=
        derivWithin_congr discriminant_cuspFunction_eqOn (discriminant_cuspFunction_eqOn hmem)
    _ = 1 := by
        simp [derivWithin_fun_mul differentiableWithinAt_fun_id
          (differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow_pow 24 _ hmem),
          derivWithin_id' _ _ (Metric.isOpen_ball.uniqueDiffWithinAt hmem)]

  have : {z | 0 < z.im}.EqOn (fun x ↦ conj (f <| ofComplex <| -conj ↑(ofComplex x)))
      (fun x ↦ conj (f <| ofComplex <| -conj x)) := fun z h ↦ by simp [ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos h]

name: gnpow_eq_pow
statement:
theorem gnpow_eq_pow {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne]
    {k : ℤ} (f : ModularForm Γ k) (n : ℕ) :
    (⟨n • k, GradedMonoid.GMonoid.gnpow n f⟩ : GradedMonoid (ModularForm Γ)) =
      ⟨(n : ℤ) * k, f.pow n⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    refine (GradedMonoid.GMonoid.gnpow_zero' ⟨k, f⟩).trans ?_
    exact gradedMonoid_eq_of_cast (zero_mul k).symm (ModularForm.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)
  | succ n ih =>
    refine (GradedMonoid.GMonoid.gnpow_succ' n ⟨k, f⟩).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun x : GradedMonoid (ModularForm Γ) ↦ x * ⟨k, f⟩) ih).trans ?_
    exact gradedMonoid_eq_of_cast (show ((n : ℤ) * k + k = (n + 1) * k) by ring)
      (ModularForm.ext fun _ ↦ rfl)

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_mdifferentiable
statement: theorem normalizedDerivOfComplex_mdifferentiable {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) : MDiff (D F)

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedDerivOfComplex_neg (F : ℍ → ℂ) (hF : MDiff F) : D (-F) = -D F
proof:
:= by
  have : -F = (-1 : ℂ) • F := by ext; simp
  rw [this, normalizedDerivOfComplex_smul _ _ hF]
  ext
  simp

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedDerivOfComplex_mul (F G : ℍ → ℂ) (hF : MDiff F) (hG : MDiff G) :
    D (F * G) = D F * G + F * D G
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hFz := UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp (hF z)
  have hGz := UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp (hG z)
  simp only [normalizedDerivOfComplex, Pi.add_apply, Pi.mul_apply]
  rw [show (F * G) ∘ ofComplex = (F ∘ ofComplex) * (G ∘ ofComplex) from rfl,
    deriv_mul hFz hGz]
  simp [Function.comp_apply, ofComplex_apply]
  ring

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem normalizedDerivOfComplex_pow (F : ℍ → ℂ) (n : ℕ) (hF : MDiff F) :
    D (F ^ n) = n * F ^ (n - 1) * D F
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hFz := UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp (hF z)
  simp only [normalizedDerivOfComplex, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [show (F ^ n) ∘ ofComplex = (F ∘ ofComplex) ^ n from rfl, deriv_pow hFz n]
  simp [Function.comp_apply, ofComplex_apply]
  ring

name: serreDerivative_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma serreDerivative_apply (k : ℂ) (F : ℍ → ℂ) (z : ℍ) :
    serreDerivative k F z = D F z - k * 12⁻¹ * EisensteinSeries.E2 z * F z
proof: := rfl

name: serreDerivative_eq
statement:
@[simp]
lemma serreDerivative_eq (k : ℂ) (F : ℍ → ℂ) :
    serreDerivative k F = fun z ↦ D F z - k * 12⁻¹ * EisensteinSeries.E2 z * F z
proof: := rfl

name: serreDerivative_add
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_add (k : ℂ) {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) (hG : MDiff G) :
    serreDerivative k (F + G) = serreDerivative k F + serreDerivative k G
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [serreDerivative, normalizedDerivOfComplex_add F G hF hG]
  ring_nf

name: serreDerivative_sub
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_sub (k : ℂ) {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) (hG : MDiff G) :
    serreDerivative k (F - G) = serreDerivative k F - serreDerivative k G
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [serreDerivative, normalizedDerivOfComplex_sub F G hF hG]
  ring_nf

name: serreDerivative_smul
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_smul (k c : ℂ) {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) :
    serreDerivative k (c • F) = c • (serreDerivative k F)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [serreDerivative, normalizedDerivOfComplex_smul c F hF, smul_eq_mul]
  ring_nf

name: serreDerivative_mul
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_mul (k₁ k₂ : ℂ) {F G : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) (hG : MDiff G) :
    serreDerivative (k₁ + k₂) (F * G) =
      (serreDerivative k₁ F) * G + F * (serreDerivative k₂ G)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [serreDerivative, normalizedDerivOfComplex_mul F G hF hG]
  ring_nf

name: serreDerivative_mdifferentiable
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_mdifferentiable {F : ℍ → ℂ} (k : ℂ) (hF : MDiff F) :
    MDiff (serreDerivative k F)
proof:
:= by
  refine (normalizedDerivOfComplex_mdifferentiable hF).sub ?_
  convert!
    (MDifferentiable.mul mdifferentiable_const (E2_mdifferentiable.mul hF) :
      MDiff (fun z ↦ (k * 12⁻¹) * (EisensteinSeries.E2 z * F z)))
  simp [Pi.mul_apply, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_slash
statement:
lemma normalizedDerivOfComplex_slash {k : ℤ} {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F)
    {g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ} (hg : 0 < g.val.det) :
    D (F ∣[k] g) = fun z : ℍ ↦ (g.val.det : ℂ)⁻¹ * (D F ∣[k + 2] g) z -
      (k : ℂ) * (2 * π * I)⁻¹ * (g 1 0 / denom g z) * (F ∣[k] g) z
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : g.det.val = g.val.det := Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply g
  have hdetℂ : (g.val.det : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hg.ne'
  have hσ (x) : σ g x = x := by grind [σ, ContinuousAlgEquiv.refl_apply]
  ext z
  simp only [normalizedDerivOfComplex, ModularForm.slash_apply]
  have hz := denom_ne_zero g z
  have h_smul : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ ↑(g • ofComplex w) : ℂ → ℂ)
      ((g.val.det : ℂ) / denom g z ^ 2) ↑z := (hasStrictDerivAt_smul hg z).hasDerivAt
  have h_F : HasDerivAt (F ∘ ofComplex) (deriv (F ∘ ofComplex) ↑(g • ofComplex (z : ℂ)))
      ↑(g • ofComplex (z : ℂ)) :=
    (ofComplex_apply z).symm ▸ (mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp (hF (g • z))).hasDerivAt
  have h_denom : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ (denom g w) ^ (-k))
      (-k * (g 1 0 : ℂ) * (denom g z) ^ (-k - 1)) ↑z := by
    simpa using hasDerivAt_denom_zpow g (-k) z
  have hcomp : ((F ∣[k] g) ∘ ofComplex) =ᶠ[𝓝 ↑z]
      fun w ↦ (g.val.det : ℂ) ^ (k - 1) *
        ((F ∘ ofComplex) ↑(g • ofComplex w) * (denom g w) ^ (-k)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet.mem_nhds z.im_pos] with w hw
    grind [ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos, ofComplex_apply, ModularForm.slash_apply]
  rw [((((h_F.comp (z : ℂ) h_smul).mul h_denom).const_mul _).congr_of_eventuallyEq hcomp).deriv]
  simp only [hσ, hdet, abs_of_pos hg, ofComplex_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [show k + 2 - 1 = (k - 1) + 2 by ring, show -(k + 2) = -k + -2 by ring,
    zpow_add₀ hdetℂ, zpow_add₀ hz, zpow_sub_one₀ hz]
  field

name: normalizedDerivOfComplex_SL_slash
statement:
lemma normalizedDerivOfComplex_SL_slash {k : ℤ} {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) {γ : SL(2, ℤ)} :
    D (F ∣[k] γ) = (D F ∣[k + 2] γ) -
      (fun z : ℍ ↦ (k : ℂ) * (2 * π * I)⁻¹ * (γ 1 0 / denom γ z) * (F ∣[k] γ) z)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : (γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ).val.det = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]; simp
  ext z
  have := congrFun
    (normalizedDerivOfComplex_slash (k := k) hF (g := (γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) (by grind)) z
  rw [hdet] at this
  simpa [ModularForm.SL_slash] using this

name: serreDerivative_slash_equivariant
statement:
theorem serreDerivative_slash_equivariant {k : ℤ} {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) {γ : SL(2, ℤ)} :
    serreDerivative k F ∣[k + 2] γ = serreDerivative k (F ∣[k] γ)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  have hLHS : (serreDerivative (k : ℂ) F ∣[k + 2] γ) z =
      (D F ∣[k + 2] γ) z - ↑k * 12⁻¹ * ((EisensteinSeries.E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ) z * (F ∣[k] γ) z) := by
    grind [ModularForm.SL_slash_apply, serreDerivative_apply, Pi.mul_apply,
      congrFun (ModularForm.mul_slash_SL2 2 k γ EisensteinSeries.E2 F) z]
  have hDz : (D (F ∣[k] γ)) z = (D F ∣[k + 2] γ) z -
      (k * (2 * π * I)⁻¹ * (γ 1 0 / denom γ z) * (F ∣[k] γ) z) := by
    simp [normalizedDerivOfComplex_SL_slash hF]
  have hE2z : (EisensteinSeries.E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ) z =
      EisensteinSeries.E2 z - 1 / (2 * riemannZeta 2) * EisensteinSeries.D2 γ z := by
    simp [EisensteinSeries.E2_slash_action]
  grind [serreDerivative_apply, EisensteinSeries.D2, riemannZeta_two, I_sq]

name: serreDerivative_slash_invariant
proof:
:= by
  grind [serreDerivative_slash_equivariant]

name: norm_normalizedDerivOfComplex_le
statement:
private lemma norm_normalizedDerivOfComplex_le {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F) {z : ℍ} {M : ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ w : ℍ, z.im / 2 ≤ w.im → ‖F w‖ ≤ M) : ‖D F z‖ ≤ M / (π * z.im)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 0 < z.im / 2 := half_pos z.im_pos
  have him : ∀ w ∈ Metric.closedBall (z : ℂ) (z.im / 2), z.im / 2 ≤ w.im := fun w hw ↦ by
    have h := (abs_im_le_norm (w - (z : ℂ))).trans (mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hw)
    rw [Complex.sub_im, UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, abs_le] at h
    linarith [h.1]
  have hbd (w) (hw : w ∈ Metric.sphere (↑z) (z.im / 2)) : ‖(F ∘ ofComplex) w‖ ≤ M := by
    have hwim := him w (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hw)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos (h2.trans_le hwim)]
    exact hM _ hwim
  have hd : ‖deriv (F ∘ ofComplex) (z : ℂ)‖ ≤ M / (z.im / 2) :=
    norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le h2
      ((UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiable_iff.mp hF).diffContOnCl_ball
        fun w hw ↦ h2.trans_le (him w hw)) hbd
  calc ‖D F z‖ = (2 * π)⁻¹ * ‖deriv (F ∘ ofComplex) (z : ℂ)‖ := by
        simp [normalizedDerivOfComplex, Real.pi_pos.le]
    _ ≤ (2 * π)⁻¹ * (M / (z.im / 2)) := by gcongr
    _ = M / (π * z.im) := by ring

name: isZeroAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex
statement:
theorem isZeroAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F)
    (hb : IsBoundedAtImInfty F) : IsZeroAtImInfty (D F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isBoundedAtImInfty_iff] at hb
  obtain ⟨M, A, hMA⟩ := hb
  rw [isZeroAtImInfty_iff]
  intro ε hε
  refine ⟨max (2 * A) (M / (π * ε)), fun z hz ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hzA, hzε⟩ := max_le_iff.mp hz
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := (norm_nonneg _).trans (hMA z (by linarith [z.im_pos]))
  refine (norm_normalizedDerivOfComplex_le hF fun w hw ↦ hMA w (by linarith)).trans ?_
  rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
  nlinarith [(div_le_iff₀ (show (0 : ℝ) < π * ε by positivity)).mp hzε]

name: isBoundedAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex
statement:
theorem isBoundedAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex {F : ℍ → ℂ} (hF : MDiff F)
    (hb : IsBoundedAtImInfty F) : IsBoundedAtImInfty (D F)
proof:
:=
  (isZeroAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex hF hb).isBoundedAtImInfty

name: isBoundedAtImInfty_serreDerivative
statement:
theorem isBoundedAtImInfty_serreDerivative {F : ℍ → ℂ} (k : ℂ) (hF : MDiff F)
    (hb : IsBoundedAtImInfty F) : IsBoundedAtImInfty (serreDerivative k F)
proof:
:=
  Asymptotics.IsBigO.sub (isBoundedAtImInfty_normalizedDerivOfComplex hF hb) <|
    ((Filter.const_boundedAtFilter atImInfty (k * 12⁻¹)).mul
      EisensteinSeries.isBoundedAtImInfty_E2).mul hb

name: coe_serreDerivativeMF
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_serreDerivativeMF {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} (k : ℤ) (f : ModularForm Γ k)
    (hΓ : Γ ≤ 𝒮ℒ) : serreDerivativeMF k f hΓ = serreDerivative k f
proof: := rfl

name: petersson_continuous
statement:
@[fun_prop]
lemma petersson_continuous (k : ℤ) {f f' : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f) (hf' : Continuous f') :
    Continuous (petersson k f f')
proof:
:= by
  unfold petersson
  fun_prop (disch := simp [im_ne_zero _])

name: petersson_slash
statement:
lemma petersson_slash (k : ℤ) (f f' : ℍ → ℂ) (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (τ : ℍ) :
    petersson k (f ∣[k] g) (f' ∣[k] g) τ =
      |g.det.val| ^ (k - 2) * σ g (petersson k f f' (g • τ))
proof:
:= by
  set D := |g.det.val|
  have hD : (D : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mod_cast abs_ne_zero.mpr g.det_ne_zero
  set j := denom g τ
  calc petersson k (f ∣[k] g) (f' ∣[k] g) τ
  _ = D ^ (k - 2 + k) * conj (σ g (f (g • τ))) * σ g (f' (g • τ))
      * (τ.im ^ k * j.normSq ^ (-k)) := by
    simp [Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self, (by abel : k - 2 + k = (k - 1) + (k - 1)), petersson,
      zpow_add₀ hD, mul_zpow, ModularForm.slash_def, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]
    ring
  _ = D ^ (k - 2) * (conj (σ g (f (g • τ))) * σ g (f' (g • τ)) * (D * τ.im / j.normSq) ^ k) := by
    rw [div_zpow, mul_zpow, zpow_neg, div_eq_mul_inv, zpow_add₀ hD]
    ring
  _ = D ^ (k - 2) * (conj (σ g (f (g • τ))) * σ g (f' (g • τ)) * (im (g • τ)) ^ k) := by
    rw [im_smul_eq_div_normSq, Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  _ = D ^ (k - 2) * σ g (petersson k f f' (g • τ)) := by simp [petersson, σ_conj]

name: petersson_slash_SL
statement:
lemma petersson_slash_SL (k : ℤ) (f f' : ℍ → ℂ) (g : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    petersson k (f ∣[k] g) (f' ∣[k] g) τ = petersson k f f' (g • τ)
proof:
:= by
  
  simp [σ, ModularForm.SL_slash, petersson_slash,
    -Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.map_apply_coe]

name: petersson_symm
statement:
lemma petersson_symm (k : ℤ) (f f' : ℍ → ℂ) (τ : ℍ) :
    petersson k f' f τ = conj (petersson k f f' τ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [petersson, mul_comm]

name: petersson_norm_symm
statement:
lemma petersson_norm_symm (k : ℤ) (f f' : ℍ → ℂ) (τ : ℍ) :
    ‖petersson k f' f τ‖ = ‖petersson k f f' τ‖
proof:
:= by
  simp [petersson_symm k f]

name: SlashInvariantFormClass.norm_petersson_smul
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← slash_action_eq f _ hg, ← slash_action_eq f' _ hg, petersson_slash,
    Subgroup.HasDetPlusMinusOne.abs_det hg, Complex.ofReal_one, one_zpow, one_mul, norm_σ]

name: SlashInvariantFormClass.petersson_smul
proof:
:= by
  simpa [SlashInvariantFormClass.slash_action_eq _ _ hg, Subgroup.HasDetOne.det_eq hg, σ]
    using (petersson_slash k f f' g τ).symm

name: petersson_exp_decay_left
statement:
lemma petersson_exp_decay_left {f : F} (h_bd : IsZeroAtImInfty f) (f' : F') :
    ∃ a > 0, petersson k f f' =O[atImInfty] fun τ ↦ Real.exp (-a * im τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbf⟩ := ModularFormClass.exp_decay_atImInfty' f h_bd
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha'⟩ := exists_between hb
  use a, ha
  apply IsBigO.of_norm_left
  simp_rw [petersson, norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj, mul_comm ‖f _‖ ‖f' _‖, norm_zpow, mul_assoc,
      Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (fun {τ : ℍ} ↦ τ.im_pos).le]
  conv_rhs => enter [τ]; rw [← one_mul (Real.exp _)]
  have hf' : IsBoundedAtImInfty f' := ModularFormClass.bdd_at_infty f'
  refine hf'.norm_left.mul ((hbf.norm_left.mul <| isBigO_refl _ _).trans ?_)
  refine IsBigO.comp_tendsto (f := fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-b * t) * t ^ k)
     (g := fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-a * t)) ?_ tendsto_comap
  simpa using (isLittleO_exp_mul_rpow_of_lt k (neg_lt_neg ha')).isBigO

name: petersson_exp_decay_right
statement:
lemma petersson_exp_decay_right (f : F) {f' : F'} (h_bd : IsZeroAtImInfty f') :
    ∃ a > 0, petersson k f f' =O[atImInfty] fun τ ↦ Real.exp (-a * im τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha'⟩ := h_bd.petersson_exp_decay_left k Γ f
  exact ⟨a, ha, .of_norm_left <| ha'.norm_left.congr_left <| petersson_norm_symm k f f'⟩

name: of_exp_decay
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, ha'⟩ := hf
  refine ha'.trans_tendsto <| (Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp ?_).comp tendsto_comap
  exact tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (neg_lt_zero.mpr ha)

name: petersson_isZeroAtImInfty_left
statement:
lemma petersson_isZeroAtImInfty_left {f : F} (h_bd : IsZeroAtImInfty f) (f' : F') :
    IsZeroAtImInfty (petersson k f f')
proof:
:=
  of_exp_decay (h_bd.petersson_exp_decay_left k Γ f')

name: petersson_isZeroAtImInfty_right
statement:
lemma petersson_isZeroAtImInfty_right (f : F) {f' : F'} (h_bd : IsZeroAtImInfty f') :
    IsZeroAtImInfty (petersson k f f')
proof:
:=
  of_exp_decay (h_bd.petersson_exp_decay_right k Γ f)

name: quotientFunc_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma quotientFunc_mk (h : ℋ) : quotientFunc f ⟦h⟧ = (f : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[k] h.val⁻¹
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: quotientFunc_smul
statement:
lemma quotientFunc_smul {h} (hh : h ∈ ℋ) (q : 𝒬) :
    quotientFunc f q ∣[k] h = quotientFunc f ((⟨h, hh⟩ : ℋ)⁻¹ • q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with

name: ModularForm.norm_ne_zero
statement:
lemma ModularForm.norm_ne_zero [ℋ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] [ModularFormClass F 𝒢 k]
    (hf : (f : ℍ → ℂ) ≠ 0) : ModularForm.norm ℋ f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose hf
  rw [← DFunLike.coe_injective.eq_iff, coe_norm, FunLike.coe_zero, prod_eq_zero_iff] at hf
  · simpa [QuotientGroup.exists_mk] using hf
  · exact Quotient.forall.mpr fun r _ ↦ (translate f r.val⁻¹).holo'

name: ModularForm.norm_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma ModularForm.norm_eq_zero_iff [ℋ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] [ModularFormClass F 𝒢 k] :
    ModularForm.norm ℋ f = 0 ↔ (f : ℍ → ℂ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hn ↦ ?_, fun hf ↦ ?_⟩
  · contrapose! hn
    exact norm_ne_zero ℋ hn
  · ext τ
    simpa [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, QuotientGroup.exists_mk]
      using ⟨1, by simpa using congr_fun hf τ⟩

name: ModularForm.isZero_of_neg_weight
statement:
lemma ModularForm.isZero_of_neg_weight [𝒢.IsArithmetic]
    {k : ℤ} (hk : k < 0) (f : ModularForm 𝒢 k) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  suffices ModularForm.norm 𝒮ℒ f = 0 by simpa [ModularForm.norm_eq_zero_iff]
  ext
  rw [ModularFormClass.levelOne_neg_weight_eq_zero
    (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hk <| mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero 𝒢.relIndex_ne_zero)
    (ModularForm.norm 𝒮ℒ f), Pi.zero_apply, zero_apply]

name: ModularForm.eq_const_of_weight_zero
statement:
private lemma ModularForm.eq_const_of_weight_zero₀ [𝒢.IsArithmetic] [𝒢.HasDetOne]
    (f : ModularForm 𝒢 0) : ∃ c, (f : ℍ → ℂ) = Function.const ℍ c
proof:
:= by
  
  let : ModularFormClass (ModularForm 𝒮ℒ (0 * Nat.card (𝒮ℒ ⧸ 𝒢.subgroupOf 𝒮ℒ))) 𝒮ℒ 0 := by
    rw [zero_mul]; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ModularFormClass.levelOne_weight_zero_const
    (ModularForm.norm 𝒮ℒ (f - .const (f I)))
  
  have : ModularForm.norm 𝒮ℒ (f - .const (f I)) I = 0 := by
    simpa [Finset.prod_eq_zero_iff, QuotientGroup.exists_mk] using ⟨1, by simp⟩
  obtain rfl : c = 0 := by simpa [hc]
  
  simp only [Function.const_zero, FunLike.coe_zero_iff, norm_eq_zero_iff, sub_eq_zero] at hc
  exact ⟨f I, by rw [hc, ModularForm.coe_const, Function.const_apply]⟩

name: ModularForm.eq_const_of_weight_zero
statement:
lemma ModularForm.eq_const_of_weight_zero [𝒢.IsArithmetic] (f : ModularForm 𝒢 0) :
    ∃ c, (f : ℍ → ℂ) = Function.const ℍ c

proof:
:= by
  simp [eta_q, Periodic.qParam]

name: one_sub_eta_q_ne_zero
statement: lemma one_sub_eta_q_ne_zero (n : ℕ) {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) : 1 - eta_q n z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eta_q_eq_cexp, sub_ne_zero]
  intro h
  simpa [← mul_assoc, ← h] using norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one ⟨(n + 1) • z, by
    simpa [(show 0 < (n + 1 : ℝ) by positivity)] using hz⟩

name: multipliable_one_sub_pow
statement:
lemma multipliable_one_sub_pow {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    Multipliable fun n : ℕ ↦ 1 - q ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply multipliable_one_add_of_summable (f := fun n ↦ -q ^ (n + 1))
  simpa using (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) hq)

name: multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_one_sub_pow
statement:
lemma multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_one_sub_pow :
    MultipliableLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n q ↦ 1 - q ^ (n + 1)) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  use fun q ↦ ∏' n, (1 - q ^ (n + 1))
  simp_rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_of_forall_compact Metric.isOpen_ball
  intro K hK hcK
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hN | hN
  · simpa [hasProdUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn, hN] using tendstoUniformlyOn_empty
  · obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, _, HB⟩ := hcK.exists_sSup_image_eq_and_ge hN
      (show ContinuousOn (fun q : ℂ ↦ ‖q‖) K by fun_prop)
    refine ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _)
      (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hK hq₀))).hasProdUniformlyOn_nat_one_add
      hcK (.of_forall fun n x hx ↦ ?_) (fun _ ↦ by fun_prop)
    simpa using pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (HB x hx) (n + 1)

name: differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q ↦ ∏' n, (1 - q ^ (n + 1))) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
proof:
:=
  multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_one_sub_pow.hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn
    (.of_forall fun _ ↦ by simpa [Finset.prod_fn] using
      DifferentiableOn.finsetProd (fun _ _ ↦ by fun_prop)) Metric.isOpen_ball

name: differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow_pow
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow_pow (k : ℕ) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun q ↦ ∏' n, (1 - q ^ (n + 1)) ^ k) (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1)
proof:
:=
  (differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow.fun_pow k).congr fun _ hq ↦
    (multipliable_one_sub_pow (by simpa using hq)).tprod_pow k

name: summable_eta_q
statement: theorem summable_eta_q (z : ℍ) : Summable fun n ↦ ‖-eta_q n z‖
proof:
:= by
  simpa [summable_nat_add_iff] using
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (norm_nonneg _) (mod_cast norm_qParam_lt_one 1 z)

name: multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_eta
statement:
lemma multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_eta :
    MultipliableLocallyUniformlyOn (fun n a ↦ 1 - eta_q n a) ℍₒ
proof:
:=
  multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_one_sub_pow.comp (𝕢 1)
    (fun z hz ↦ by simpa using norm_qParam_lt_one 1 ⟨z, hz⟩) (by fun_prop)

name: eta_tprod_ne_zero
statement: lemma eta_tprod_ne_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) : ∏' n, (1 - eta_q n z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine tprod_one_add_ne_zero_of_summable (f := fun n ↦ -eta_q n z) ?_ ?_
  · exact fun i ↦ by simpa using! one_sub_eta_q_ne_zero i hz
  · simpa [eta_q, ← summable_norm_iff] using! summable_eta_q ⟨z, hz⟩

name: eta_ne_zero
statement: lemma eta_ne_zero {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) : η z ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero (Periodic.qParam_ne_zero z) (eta_tprod_ne_zero hz)

name: logDeriv_one_sub_cexp
statement:
lemma logDeriv_one_sub_cexp (r : ℂ) : logDeriv (fun z ↦ 1 - r * cexp z) =
    fun z ↦ -r * cexp z / (1 - r * cexp z)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [logDeriv]

name: logDeriv_one_sub_mul_cexp_comp
statement:
lemma logDeriv_one_sub_mul_cexp_comp (r : ℂ) {g : ℂ → ℂ} (hg : Differentiable ℂ g) :
    logDeriv ((fun z ↦ 1 - r * cexp z) ∘ g) =
    fun z ↦ -r * (deriv g z) * cexp (g z) / (1 - r * cexp (g z))
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [logDeriv_comp (by fun_prop) (hg y), logDeriv_one_sub_cexp]
  ring

name: one_sub_eta_logDeriv_eq
statement:
private theorem one_sub_eta_logDeriv_eq (z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    logDeriv (1 - eta_q n ·) z = 2 * π * I * (n + 1) * -eta_q n z / (1 - eta_q n z)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (fun x ↦ 1 - cexp (2 * ↑π * I * (n + 1) * x)) =
      ((fun z ↦ 1 - 1 * cexp z) ∘ fun x ↦ 2 * ↑π * I * (n + 1) * x) := by aesop
  simp_rw [eta_q_eq_cexp, h2, logDeriv_one_sub_mul_cexp_comp 1
    (g := fun x ↦ (2 * π * I * (n + 1) * x)) (by fun_prop), deriv_const_mul_id]
  simp

name: tsum_logDeriv_eta_q
statement:
lemma tsum_logDeriv_eta_q (z : ℂ) : ∑' n, logDeriv (fun x ↦ 1 - eta_q n x) z =
    (2 * π * I) * ∑' n, (n + 1) * (-eta_q n z) / (1 - eta_q n z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tsum_congr (one_sub_eta_logDeriv_eq z), ← tsum_mul_left]
  grind

name: differentiableAt_eta_tprod
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_eta_tprod {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun x ↦ ∏' n, (1 - eta_q n x)) z
proof:
:= by
  have hq : 𝕢 1 z ∈ Metric.ball 0 1 := by simpa using norm_qParam_lt_one 1 ⟨z, hz⟩
  exact (differentiableOn_tprod_one_sub_pow.differentiableAt
    (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hq)).comp z (by fun_prop)

name: differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ eta z
proof:
:=
  .mul (by fun_prop) (differentiableAt_eta_tprod hz)

name: logDeriv_qParam
statement: lemma logDeriv_qParam (h : ℝ) (z : ℂ) : logDeriv (𝕢 h) z = 2 * π * I / h
proof:
:= by
  have : 𝕢 h = cexp ∘ ((2 * π * I / h) * ·) := by
    ext
    grind [Periodic.qParam]
  rw [this, logDeriv_comp (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop), deriv_const_mul_id]
  simp [logDeriv_exp]

name: summable_logDeriv_one_sub_eta_q
statement:
lemma summable_logDeriv_one_sub_eta_q {z : ℂ} (hz : z ∈ ℍₒ) :
    Summable fun i ↦ logDeriv (1 - eta_q i ·) z
proof:
:= by
  have := summable_norm_pow_mul_geometric_div_one_sub 1 (norm_qParam_lt_one 1 ⟨z, hz⟩)
  convert! ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr this).mul_left (-2 * π * I) using 1 with n
  grind [one_sub_eta_logDeriv_eq]

name: logDeriv_eta_eq_E2
statement: lemma logDeriv_eta_eq_E2 (z : ℍ) : logDeriv eta z = (π * I / 12) * E2 z
proof:
:= by
  unfold eta
  rw [logDeriv_fun_mul _ (Periodic.qParam_ne_zero _) (eta_tprod_ne_zero z.2) (by fun_prop)
    (differentiableAt_eta_tprod z.2)]
  have HG := logDeriv_tprod_eq_tsum isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet z.2
    (one_sub_eta_q_ne_zero · z.2) (by fun_prop) (summable_logDeriv_one_sub_eta_q z.2)
    multipliableLocallyUniformlyOn_eta (eta_tprod_ne_zero z.2)
  simp only [logDeriv_qParam 24 z, HG, tsum_logDeriv_eta_q z, E2, one_div,
    mul_inv_rev, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [G2_eq_tsum_cexp, riemannZeta_two, ← tsum_pow_div_one_sub_eq_tsum_sigma
    (norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one z), mul_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, mul_add]
  simp [eta_q_eq_pow, ← tsum_mul_left, tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ (f := fun n ↦
        n * cexp (2 * π * I * z) ^ n / (1 - cexp (2 * π * I * z) ^ n)), ← tsum_neg]
  grind

proof:
:=

name: isZeroAtImInfty_of_valueAtInfty_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isZeroAtImInfty_of_valueAtInfty_eq_zero {F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ]
    [DiscreteTopology Γ] [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] [Fact (IsCusp ∞ Γ)] [ModularFormClass F Γ k]
    (f : F) (h : valueAtInfty f = 0) : IsZeroAtImInfty f
proof:
:= by
  have hh : 0 < Γ.strictWidthInfty := Γ.strictWidthInfty_pos_iff.mpr Fact.out
  have hΓ : Γ.strictWidthInfty ∈ Γ.strictPeriods := Γ.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods
  have hanal := ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f hh hΓ
  have hper := periodic_comp_ofComplex f hΓ
  simp_rw [IsZeroAtImInfty, ZeroAtFilter, ← h, ← cuspFunction_apply_zero hh hanal hper]
  exact (hanal.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (qParam_tendsto_atImInfty hh)).congr
    (fun τ ↦ SlashInvariantFormClass.eq_cuspFunction f τ hΓ hh.ne')

name: isZeroAt_of_coeffZero_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isZeroAt_of_coeffZero_eq_zero (f : ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k)
    (h : (qExpansion 1 f).coeff 0 = 0) {c : OnePoint ℝ} (hc : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ) :
    c.IsZeroAt f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z] at hc
  rw [isZeroAt_iff_forall_SL2Z hc]
  intro γ _
  rw [show (⇑f ∣[k] γ) = ⇑f from f.slash_action_eq' _ ⟨γ, rfl⟩]
  exact isZeroAtImInfty_of_valueAtInfty_eq_zero f <| by
    rwa [← qExpansion_coeff_zero one_pos
      (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f one_pos one_mem_strictPeriods_SL)
      (periodic_comp_ofComplex f one_mem_strictPeriods_SL)]

name: toCuspForm_apply
statement:

lemma toCuspForm_apply (f : ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k) (h : (qExpansion 1 f).coeff 0 = 0)

name: isCuspForm_iff_coeffZero_eq_zero
statement:
lemma isCuspForm_iff_coeffZero_eq_zero (f : ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k) :
    IsCuspForm f ↔ (qExpansion 1 f).coeff 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨g, hg⟩ ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ (isCuspForm_iff f).mpr (isZeroAt_of_coeffZero_eq_zero f h)⟩
  rw [← hg, qExpansion_coeff_zero one_pos
    (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero _ one_pos one_mem_strictPeriods_SL)
    (periodic_comp_ofComplex _ one_mem_strictPeriods_SL)]
  exact (CuspFormClass.zero_at_infty g).valueAtInfty_eq_zero

name: sub_smul_isCuspForm

lemma sub_smul_isCuspForm (f g : ModularForm 𝒮ℒ k)

    ModularForm.IsCuspForm (f - (qExpansion 1 f).coeff 0 • g)

  rw [isCuspForm_iff_coeffZero_eq_zero, FunLike.coe_sub,
    ModularForm.qExpansion_sub one_pos one_mem_strictPeriods_SL, FunLike.coe_smul,
    ModularForm.qExpansion_smul one_pos one_mem_strictPeriods_SL, map_sub, PowerSeries.coeff_smul]

name: qParam_tendsto_atImInfty

lemma qParam_tendsto_atImInfty {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :

name: eq_cuspFunction
statement:
theorem eq_cuspFunction {f : ℍ → ℂ} (τ : ℍ) (hh : h ≠ 0)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) : cuspFunction h f (𝕢 h τ) = f τ
proof:
:= by
  simpa [cuspFunction] using (Periodic.eq_cuspFunction hh hfper τ)

name: differentiableAt_cuspFunction
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_cuspFunction {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) : DifferentiableAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with rfl | hq'
  · exact hfper.differentiableAt_cuspFunction_zero hh
      (eventually_of_mem (preimage_mem_comap (Ioi_mem_atTop 0))
        (fun z hz ↦ UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp (hfhol ⟨z, hz⟩)))
      (hfbdd.comp_tendsto tendsto_comap_im_ofComplex)
  · exact Periodic.qParam_right_inv hh.ne' hq' ▸
      hfper.differentiableAt_cuspFunction hh.ne' <| UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp <|
        hfhol ⟨_, Periodic.im_invQParam_pos_of_norm_lt_one hh hq hq'⟩

name: differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball
statement:
lemma differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    DifferentiableOn ℂ (cuspFunction h f) (Metric.ball 0 1)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hz ↦ (differentiableAt_cuspFunction hh hfper hfhol hfbdd <| mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hz)
    |>.differentiableWithinAt

name: analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero
statement:
lemma analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) 0
proof:
:=
  DifferentiableOn.analyticAt (differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball hh hfper hfhol hfbdd)
    (by simpa [ball_zero_eq] using Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℂ) zero_lt_one)

name: cuspFunction_apply_zero
statement:
lemma cuspFunction_apply_zero {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfanalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) 0)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex) h) : cuspFunction h f 0 = valueAtInfty f
proof:
:= by
  refine (Tendsto.limUnder_eq ?_).symm
  have : (cuspFunction h f ∘ fun τ ↦ 𝕢 h τ : ℍ → ℂ) = f := by
    funext τ
    simpa using eq_cuspFunction τ hh.ne' hfper
  simpa [this] using hfanalytic.continuousAt.tendsto.comp (qParam_tendsto_atImInfty hh)

name: differentiableAt_cuspFunction
statement:
protected theorem differentiableAt_cuspFunction [ModularFormClass F Γ k]
    (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :

name: qExpansion_coeff

name: qExpansion_coeff_zero

lemma qExpansion_coeff_zero {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)

name: hasSum_qExpansion_of_norm_lt
statement:
lemma hasSum_qExpansion_of_norm_lt {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    {q : ℂ} (hq : ‖q‖ < 1) :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ ↦ (qExpansion h f).coeff m • q ^ m) (cuspFunction h f q)
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball (differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball hh hfper hfhol hfbdd)
      (by simpa using hq) using
    2 with m
  grind [qExpansion_coeff, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul]

name: hasSum_qExpansion
statement:
lemma hasSum_qExpansion {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    (τ : ℍ) : HasSum (fun m : ℕ ↦ (qExpansion h f).coeff m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)
proof:
:= by
  have : ‖𝕢 h τ‖ < 1 := Periodic.norm_qParam_lt_one hh τ.im_pos
  simpa [eq_cuspFunction τ hh.ne' hfper] using
    hasSum_qExpansion_of_norm_lt hh hfper hfhol hfbdd this

name: qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_coeff

name: qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_apply_norm
