name: qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_radius
statement:
lemma qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_radius (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    1 ≤ (qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries h f).radius
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun r hr ↦ ?_
  lift r to NNReal using hr.ne_top
  apply FormalMultilinearSeries.le_radius_of_summable
  simp only [qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries_apply_norm]
  rw [← r.abs_eq]
  simp_rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Complex.norm_real, ← norm_pow, ← norm_mul]
  exact (UpperHalfPlane.hasSum_qExpansion_of_norm_lt hh hfper hfhol hfbdd
    (by simpa using hr)).summable.norm

name: hasSum_cuspFunction_of_hasSum_punctured
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Periodic.im_invQParam_pos_of_norm_lt_one hh hq hq1
  let τ : ℍ := ⟨Periodic.invQParam h q, h1⟩
  have h2 := (Periodic.cuspFunction_eq_of_nonzero h (f ∘ ofComplex) hq1)
  have : cuspFunction h f q = f τ := by simpa [UpperHalfPlane.ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos h1]
    using! h2
  grind [hf τ, Periodic.qParam_right_inv]

name: hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_update
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun r hr ↦ ?_
    rcases eq_or_ne r 0 with rfl | hr'
    · simp
    · lift r to NNReal using hr.ne_top
      let : FiniteDimensional ℝ ℂ := basisOneI.finiteDimensional_of_finite
      apply FormalMultilinearSeries.le_radius_of_summable
      simpa [smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
        (hasSum_cuspFunction_of_hasSum_punctured hh hf (q := r) (by simpa using hr)
          (mod_cast hr')).summable.norm
  · simp
  · intro y hy
    rw [← ENNReal.coe_one, Metric.eball_coe, NNReal.coe_one, mem_ball_zero_iff] at hy
    rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy'
    · simpa +contextual [zero_pow_eq] using hasSum_ite_eq 0 (c 0)
    · simpa [update_of_ne hy', mul_comm]
        using hasSum_cuspFunction_of_hasSum_punctured hh hf hy hy'

name: tendsto_atImInfty_of_hasSum_qExpansion
statement:
theorem tendsto_atImInfty_of_hasSum_qExpansion {f : ℍ → ℂ} {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) :
    Tendsto f atImInfty (𝓝 (c 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hfeq : f = fun τ : ℍ ↦ update (cuspFunction h f) 0 (c 0) (𝕢 h τ) := by
    funext τ
    rw [update_of_ne (Periodic.qParam_ne_zero _)]
    exact (hf τ).unique (hasSum_cuspFunction_of_hasSum_punctured hh hf
      (Periodic.norm_qParam_lt_one hh τ.im_pos) (exp_ne_zero _))
  rw [hfeq]
  simpa [update_self, Function.comp_def] using
    (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_update hh hf).hasFPowerSeriesAt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp
      (qParam_tendsto_atImInfty hh)

name: isBoundedAtImInfty_of_hasSum_qExpansion
statement:
theorem isBoundedAtImInfty_of_hasSum_qExpansion {f : ℍ → ℂ} {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) : IsBoundedAtImInfty f
proof:
:=
  
  (tendsto_atImInfty_of_hasSum_qExpansion hh hf).isBigO_one ℝ

name: hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_cuspFunction
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_cuspFunction {f : ℍ → ℂ} {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfanalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) 0)
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (cuspFunction h f) (.ofScalars ℂ c) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  
  have H1 : HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (update (cuspFunction h f) 0 (c 0)) (.ofScalars ℂ c) 0 1 :=
    hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_update hh hf
  
  
  have H2 : c 0 = cuspFunction h f 0 := by
    have L1 := H1.hasFPowerSeriesAt.continuousAt
    have L2 := hfanalytic.continuousAt
    have := (L1.eventuallyEq_nhds_iff_eventuallyEq_nhdsNE L2).mp <|
      by filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with a ha using update_of_ne ha ..
    simpa [update_self] using this.eq_of_nhds
  rwa [update_eq_self_iff.mpr H2] at H1

name: qExpansion_coeff_eq_circleIntegral
statement:
lemma qExpansion_coeff_eq_circleIntegral {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hR' : R < 1) : (qExpansion h f).coeff n =
      ((2 * π * Complex.I)⁻¹ * ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), cuspFunction h f z / z ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have := ((differentiableOn_cuspFunction_ball hh hfper hfhol hfbdd).mono
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hR')).circleIntegral_one_div_sub_center_pow_smul hR n
  rw [smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm, ← div_eq_iff two_pi_I_ne_zero] at this
  simp_rw [qExpansion, PowerSeries.coeff_mk, ← this, sub_zero, smul_eq_mul, one_div_mul_eq_div,
    div_eq_inv_mul]

name: qExpansion_coeff_eq_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma qExpansion_coeff_eq_intervalIntegral {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    (n : ℕ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : (qExpansion h f).coeff n =
      1 / h * ∫ u in 0..h, 1 / 𝕢 h (u + t * I) ^ n * f ⟨u + t * I, by simpa using ht⟩
proof:
:= by
  
  let R := Real.exp (-2 * π * t / h)
  have hR0 : 0 < R := Real.exp_pos _
  have hR1 : R < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.2 <| by simpa [neg_div] using div_pos (by positivity) hh
  
  rw [qExpansion_coeff_eq_circleIntegral hh hfper hfhol hfbdd n hR0 hR1, circleIntegral,
    show 2 * π = h * (2 * π / h) by field_simp]
  conv => enter [1, 2, 2]; rw [show 0 = 0 * (2 * π / h) by simp]
  simp_rw [← intervalIntegral.smul_integral_comp_mul_right, real_smul, ← mul_assoc,
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  
  congr 1 with u
  let τ : ℍ := ⟨u + t * I, by simpa using ht⟩
  have : circleMap 0 R (u * (2 * π / h)) = 𝕢 h τ := by
    simp only [circleMap, ofReal_exp, ← exp_add, zero_add, τ, R]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    have := I_sq
    grind
  
  simp_rw [deriv_circleMap, this, show ↑I = Complex.I by rfl, show u + t * Complex.I = τ by rfl,
    show ⟨↑τ, τ.2⟩ = τ by rfl, eq_cuspFunction _ hh.ne' hfper, smul_eq_mul, pow_succ]
  field_simp [(show 𝕢 h τ ≠ 0 from Complex.exp_ne_zero _), Real.pi_ne_zero, NeZero.ne]
  push_cast
  ring

name: exp_decay_sub_atImInfty
statement:
theorem exp_decay_sub_atImInfty {f : ℍ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    (fun τ ↦ f τ - valueAtInfty f) =O[atImInfty] fun τ ↦ Real.exp (-2 * π * τ.im / h)
proof:
:= by
  have := hfbdd.comp_tendsto tendsto_comap_im_ofComplex
  convert!
    (hfper.exp_decay_sub_of_bounded_at_inf hh
          (eventually_of_mem (preimage_mem_comap (Ioi_mem_atTop 0)) fun z hz ↦ by
            simpa using (UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiableAt_iff.mp <| hfhol ⟨z, hz⟩))
          this).comp_tendsto
      tendsto_coe_atImInfty
  simpa [cuspFunction] using
    (cuspFunction_apply_zero hh (analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero hh hfper hfhol hfbdd) hfper).symm

name: exp_decay_sub_atImInfty'
statement:
theorem exp_decay_sub_atImInfty' [ModularFormClass F Γ k] [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne]
    [DiscreteTopology Γ] [Fact (IsCusp OnePoint.infty Γ)] :
    ∃ c > 0, (fun τ ↦ f τ - valueAtInfty f) =O[atImInfty] (fun τ ↦ Real.exp (-c * τ.im))
proof:
:= by
  have hh : 0 < Γ.strictWidthInfty := Γ.strictWidthInfty_pos_iff.mpr Fact.out
  have hΓ : Γ.strictWidthInfty ∈ Γ.strictPeriods := Γ.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods
  refine ⟨2 * π / Γ.strictWidthInfty, div_pos Real.two_pi_pos hh, ?_⟩
  convert! exp_decay_sub_atImInfty hh (periodic_comp_ofComplex f hΓ) (holo f) (bdd_at_infty f) using
    3 with τ
  ring_nf

name: cuspFunction_mul_zero

theorem cuspFunction_mul_zero {f g : ℂ → ℂ} (hfcts : ContinuousAt (Periodic.cuspFunction h f) 0)
    (hgcts : ContinuousAt (Periodic.cuspFunction h g) 0) : Periodic.cuspFunction h (f * g) 0 =
    Periodic.cuspFunction h f 0 * Periodic.cuspFunction h g 0
proof:
:= by

  exact (Periodic.tendsto_nhds_zero hfcts).mul (Periodic.tendsto_nhds_zero hgcts) |>.limUnder_eq

  have hg' : AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h (-g)) 0 := by
    simpa [cuspFunction_neg hg.continuousAt] using hg.neg

    (hfper : Periodic (f ∘ ofComplex) h) (hfhol : MDiff f) (hfbdd : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    qExpansion h f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro H
    ext z
    simp [← (hasSum_qExpansion hh hfper hfhol hfbdd z).tsum_eq, H]
  · intro H
    simpa [H] using qExpansion_zero h

:= by
  ext m
  have h1 : cuspFunction h 1 = 1 := by
    ext q
    rcases eq_or_ne q 0 with rfl | hq
    · simpa [cuspFunction, Periodic.cuspFunction] using! tendsto_const_nhds.limUnder_eq
    · simp [cuspFunction, Periodic.cuspFunction_eq_of_nonzero h _ hq]
  have h2 : iteratedDeriv m (1 : ℂ → ℂ) 0 = if m = 0 then 1 else 0 := by
    simpa [ite_apply] using! iteratedDeriv_const
  simp +contextual [qExpansion_coeff, h1, h2]

statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_sub {G : Type*} [FunLike G ℍ ℂ] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {a b : ℤ} (f : F) [ModularFormClass F Γ a] (g : G)
    [ModularFormClass G Γ b] : qExpansion h (f - g) = qExpansion h f - qExpansion h g
proof:
:=
  qExpansion_sub (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f hh hΓ)
    (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero g hh hΓ)

name: qExpansion_mul_coe
statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_mul_coe {G : Type*} [FunLike G ℍ ℂ] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {a b : ℤ} (f : F) [ModularFormClass F Γ a] (g : G)
    [ModularFormClass G Γ b] : qExpansion h ((⇑f * ⇑g : ℍ → ℂ)) = qExpansion h f * qExpansion h g
proof:
:=
  qExpansion_mul (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f hh hΓ)
    (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero g hh hΓ)

name: qExpansion_mul
statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_mul [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {a b : ℤ} (f : ModularForm Γ a) (g : ModularForm Γ b) :
    qExpansion h (f.mul g) = qExpansion h f * qExpansion h g
proof:
:=
  ModularForm.qExpansion_mul_coe hh hΓ f g

name: qExpansion_eq_zero_iff
statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_eq_zero_iff (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {k : ℤ}
    (f : ModularForm Γ k) : qExpansion h f = 0 ↔ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Fact (IsCusp OnePoint.infty Γ) := ⟨Γ.isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods hh hΓ⟩
  simp [qExpansion_eq_zero_iff hh (periodic_comp_ofComplex f hΓ) (holo f) (bdd_at_infty f)]

name: qExpansion_one
statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_one [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] :
    qExpansion h (1 : ModularForm Γ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [qExpansion_one]

name: qExpansion_mcast
statement:
@[simp]
protected lemma qExpansion_mcast {a b : ℤ} {Γ' : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)}
    (heq : a = b) (hΓ : Γ' = Γ) (f : ModularForm Γ a) :
    qExpansion h (ModularForm.mcast heq f hΓ) = qExpansion h f
proof: := rfl

name: qExpansion_pow
statement:
protected lemma qExpansion_pow [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (f : ModularForm Γ k) (n : ℕ) :
    qExpansion h (f.pow n) = (qExpansion h f) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [coe_pow, pow_zero, qExpansion_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [coe_pow, pow_succ, ← coe_pow, ← coe_mul, ModularForm.qExpansion_mul hh hΓ, ih,
      pow_succ]

name: mul_ne_zero
statement:
protected lemma mul_ne_zero [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hΓ : ∃ h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods, 0 < h)
    {a b : ℤ} {f : ModularForm Γ a} {g : ModularForm Γ b} (hf : f ≠ 0) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    f.mul g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hΓ, hh⟩ := hΓ
  simp only [ne_eq, ← ModularForm.qExpansion_eq_zero_iff hh hΓ,
    ModularForm.qExpansion_mul hh hΓ] at hf hg ⊢
  exact mul_ne_zero hf hg

name: qExpansionAddHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qExpansionAddHom_apply (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (k : ℤ)
    (f : ModularForm Γ k) : qExpansionAddHom hh hΓ k f = qExpansion h f
proof: := rfl

name: qExpansion_injective
statement:
lemma qExpansion_injective (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {k : ℤ} :
    Function.Injective (fun f : ModularForm Γ k ↦ qExpansion h f)
proof:
:=
  (injective_iff_map_eq_zero (qExpansionAddHom hh hΓ k)).mpr
    fun f hf ↦ (ModularForm.qExpansion_eq_zero_iff hh hΓ f).mp hf

name: qExpansion_inj
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qExpansion_inj (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {k : ℤ} {f g : ModularForm Γ k} :
    qExpansion h f = qExpansion h g ↔ f = g
proof:
:=
  (qExpansion_injective hh hΓ).eq_iff

name: qExpansionRingHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qExpansionRingHom_apply [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (k : ℤ) (f : ModularForm Γ k) :
    qExpansionRingHom h hh hΓ (DirectSum.of _ k f) = qExpansion h f
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toSemiring_of ..

name: qExpansionAlgHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qExpansionAlgHom_apply [Γ.HasDetOne] (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods)
    (k : ℤ) (f : ModularForm Γ k) :
    qExpansionAlgHom h hh hΓ (DirectSum.of _ k f) = qExpansion h f
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.toSemiring_of _ ModularForm.qExpansion_one (ModularForm.qExpansion_mul hh hΓ) k f

name: qExpansionAlgHom_toRingHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma qExpansionAlgHom_toRingHom (h) [Γ.HasDetOne] (hh : 0 < h) (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) :
    (qExpansionAlgHom h hh hΓ : (⨁ k, ModularForm Γ k) →+* PowerSeries ℂ) =
      qExpansionRingHom h hh hΓ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: qExpansion_of_mul
statement:
lemma qExpansion_of_mul [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (a b : ℤ) (f : ModularForm Γ a) (g : ModularForm Γ b) :
    qExpansion h ((DirectSum.of _ a f * DirectSum.of _ b g) (a + b)) =
    qExpansion h f * qExpansion h g
proof:
:= by
  simpa [DirectSum.of_mul_of] using! ModularForm.qExpansion_mul hh hΓ f g

name: qExpansion_of_pow
statement:
lemma qExpansion_of_pow [Γ.HasDetPlusMinusOne] (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (f : ModularForm Γ k) (n : ℕ) :
    qExpansion h ((((DirectSum.of _ k f)) ^ n) (n * k)) = (qExpansion h f) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  have := (qExpansionRingHom h hh hΓ).map_pow (DirectSum.of _ k f) n
  simpa [DirectSum.ofPow]

name: hasSum_qExpansion
statement:
lemma hasSum_qExpansion (hh : 0 < h) {k : ℤ} [ModularFormClass F Γ k]
    [Fact (IsCusp .infty Γ)] (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) (τ : ℍ) :
    HasSum (fun m ↦ (qExpansion h f).coeff m * 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)
proof:
:=
  τ.hasSum_qExpansion hh (periodic_comp_ofComplex f hΓ) (holo f) (bdd_at_infty f)

name: hasFPowerSeries_cuspFunction
statement:
lemma hasFPowerSeries_cuspFunction {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfanalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) 0)
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) :
    HasFPowerSeriesOnBall (cuspFunction h f) (qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries h f) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_cuspFunction hh hfanalytic hf).hasFPowerSeriesAt
  have h2 : HasFPowerSeriesAt (cuspFunction h f) (qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries h f) 0 := by
    simpa [qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries, qExpansion_coeff, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
      using hfanalytic.hasFPowerSeriesAt
  simpa [h1.eq_formalMultilinearSeries h2] using hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_cuspFunction hh hfanalytic hf

name: qExpansion_coeff_unique
statement:
lemma qExpansion_coeff_unique {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hfanalytic : AnalyticAt ℂ (cuspFunction h f) 0)
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) (m : ℕ) :
    c m = (qExpansion h f).coeff m
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_cuspFunction hh hfanalytic hf).hasFPowerSeriesAt
  have h2 := (hasFPowerSeries_cuspFunction f hh hfanalytic hf).hasFPowerSeriesAt
  simpa using congr_arg (FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff · m) (h1.eq_formalMultilinearSeries h2)

name: ModularFormClass.qExpansion_coeff_unique
statement:
protected lemma ModularFormClass.qExpansion_coeff_unique {c : ℕ → ℂ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) {f : F} [ModularFormClass F Γ k]
    (hf : ∀ τ : ℍ, HasSum (fun m ↦ c m • 𝕢 h τ ^ m) (f τ)) (m : ℕ) :
    c m = (qExpansion h f).coeff m
proof:
:=
  qExpansion_coeff_unique f hh (ModularFormClass.analyticAt_cuspFunction_zero f hh hΓ) hf m

name: IsZeroAtImInfty.slash
statement:
lemma IsZeroAtImInfty.slash (hg : g 1 0 = 0) (hf : IsZeroAtImInfty f) :
    IsZeroAtImInfty (f ∣[k] g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZeroAtImInfty, ZeroAtFilter, tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero] at hf ⊢
  simpa [ModularForm.slash_def, denom, hg, mul_assoc]
    using (hf.comp <| tendsto_smul_atImInfty hg).mul_const _

name: IsBoundedAtImInfty.slash
statement:
lemma IsBoundedAtImInfty.slash (hg : g 1 0 = 0) (hf : IsBoundedAtImInfty f) :
    IsBoundedAtImInfty (f ∣[k] g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsBoundedAtImInfty, BoundedAtFilter, ← Asymptotics.isBigO_norm_left] at hf ⊢
  suffices (fun x ↦ (‖g.det.val ^ (k - 1)‖ * ‖g 1 1 ^ (-k)‖) * ‖f (g • x)‖) =O[atImInfty] 1 by
    simpa [ModularForm.slash_def, denom, hg, mul_assoc, mul_comm ‖f _‖]
  apply (hf.comp_tendsto (tendsto_smul_atImInfty hg)).const_mul_left

name: IsBoundedAt.smul_iff
statement: lemma IsBoundedAt.smul_iff : IsBoundedAt (g • c) f k ↔ IsBoundedAt c (f ∣[k] g) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsBoundedAt, IsBoundedAt, (Equiv.mulLeft g⁻¹).forall_congr_left]
  simp [mul_smul, ← SlashAction.slash_mul]

name: IsZeroAt.smul_iff
statement: lemma IsZeroAt.smul_iff : IsZeroAt (g • c) f k ↔ IsZeroAt c (f ∣[k] g) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsZeroAt, IsZeroAt, (Equiv.mulLeft g⁻¹).forall_congr_left]
  simp [mul_smul, ← SlashAction.slash_mul]

name: IsBoundedAt.add
statement:
lemma IsBoundedAt.add {f' : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : IsBoundedAt c f k) (hf' : IsBoundedAt c f' k) :
    IsBoundedAt c (f + f') k
proof:
:=
  fun g hg ↦ by simpa using! (hf g hg).add (hf' g hg)

name: IsZeroAt.add
statement:
lemma IsZeroAt.add {f' : ℍ → ℂ} (hf : IsZeroAt c f k) (hf' : IsZeroAt c f' k) :
    IsZeroAt c (f + f') k
proof:
:=
  fun g hg ↦ by simpa using! (hf g hg).add (hf' g hg)

name: isBoundedAt_infty_iff
statement: lemma isBoundedAt_infty_iff : IsBoundedAt ∞ f k ↔ IsBoundedAtImInfty f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h 1 (by simp), fun h _ hg ↦ h.slash _ (smul_infty_eq_self_iff.mp hg)⟩

name: isZeroAt_infty_iff
statement: lemma isZeroAt_infty_iff : IsZeroAt ∞ f k ↔ IsZeroAtImInfty f
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ by simpa using h 1 (by simp), fun h _ hg ↦ h.slash _ (smul_infty_eq_self_iff.mp hg)⟩

name: isBoundedAt_iff
statement: lemma isBoundedAt_iff (hg : g • ∞ = c) : IsBoundedAt c f k ↔ IsBoundedAtImInfty (f ∣[k] g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hc ↦ hc g hg , by simp [← hg, IsBoundedAt.smul_iff, isBoundedAt_infty_iff]⟩

name: isZeroAt_iff
statement: lemma isZeroAt_iff (hg : g • ∞ = c) : IsZeroAt c f k ↔ IsZeroAtImInfty (f ∣[k] g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hc ↦ hc g hg , by simp [← hg, IsZeroAt.smul_iff, isZeroAt_infty_iff]⟩

name: isBoundedAt_iff_exists_SL2Z
statement:
lemma isBoundedAt_iff_exists_SL2Z (hc : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ) :
    IsBoundedAt c f k ↔ ∃ γ : SL(2, ℤ), mapGL ℝ γ • ∞ = c ∧ IsBoundedAtImInfty (f ∣[k] γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := isCusp_SL2Z_iff'.mp hc
    simpa [IsBoundedAt.smul_iff, isBoundedAt_infty_iff] using! fun hfc ↦ ⟨γ, rfl, hfc⟩
  · rintro ⟨γ, rfl, b⟩
    simpa [IsBoundedAt.smul_iff, isBoundedAt_infty_iff] using! b

name: isZeroAt_iff_exists_SL2Z
statement:
lemma isZeroAt_iff_exists_SL2Z (hc : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ) :
    IsZeroAt c f k ↔ ∃ γ : SL(2, ℤ), mapGL ℝ γ • ∞ = c ∧ IsZeroAtImInfty (f ∣[k] γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := isCusp_SL2Z_iff'.mp hc
    simpa [IsZeroAt.smul_iff, isZeroAt_infty_iff] using! fun hfc ↦ ⟨γ, rfl, hfc⟩
  · rintro ⟨γ, rfl, b⟩
    simpa [IsZeroAt.smul_iff, isZeroAt_infty_iff] using! b

name: isBoundedAt_iff_forall_SL2Z
statement:
lemma isBoundedAt_iff_forall_SL2Z (hc : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ) :
    IsBoundedAt c f k ↔ ∀ γ : SL(2, ℤ), mapGL ℝ γ • ∞ = c → IsBoundedAtImInfty (f ∣[k] γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hc _ hγ ↦ by simpa using! hc _ hγ, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := isCusp_SL2Z_iff'.mp hc
  simpa [IsBoundedAt.smul_iff, isBoundedAt_infty_iff] using! h γ rfl

name: isZeroAt_iff_forall_SL2Z
statement:
lemma isZeroAt_iff_forall_SL2Z (hc : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ) :
    IsZeroAt c f k ↔ ∀ γ : SL(2, ℤ), mapGL ℝ γ • ∞ = c → IsZeroAtImInfty (f ∣[k] γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hc _ hγ ↦ by simpa using! hc _ hγ, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := isCusp_SL2Z_iff'.mp hc
  simpa [IsZeroAt.smul_iff, isZeroAt_infty_iff] using! h γ rfl

name: vAdd_apply_of_mem_strictPeriods
statement:
theorem vAdd_apply_of_mem_strictPeriods {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} {k : ℤ}
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [SlashInvariantFormClass F Γ k]
    (f : F) (τ : ℍ) {h : ℝ} (hH : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods) :
    f (h +ᵥ τ) = f τ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← congr_fun (slash_action_eqn f _ <| Γ.mem_strictPeriods_iff.mp hH) τ]
  suffices GeneralLinearGroup.upperRightHom h • τ = h +ᵥ τ by
    simp_rw [slash_def, this]
    simp [σ, denom, GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, denom]
  ext
  simp [σ, num, denom, coe_vadd, UpperHalfPlane.coe_smul, num, add_comm]

name: vAdd_width_periodic
statement:
theorem vAdd_width_periodic (N : ℕ) (k n : ℤ) (f : SlashInvariantForm (Gamma N) k) (z : ℍ) :
    f ((N * n : ℝ) +ᵥ z) = f z
proof:
:= by
  apply vAdd_apply_of_mem_strictPeriods
  simp [strictPeriods_Gamma, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff, mul_comm]

name: T_zpow_width_invariant
statement:
theorem T_zpow_width_invariant (N : ℕ) (k n : ℤ) (f : SlashInvariantForm (Gamma N) k) (z : ℍ) :
    f (((ModularGroup.T ^ (N * n))) • z) = f z
proof:
:= by
  rw [modular_T_zpow_smul z (N * n)]
  simpa only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast] using vAdd_width_periodic N k n f z

name: slash_S_apply
statement:
lemma slash_S_apply (f : ℍ → ℂ) (k : ℤ) (z : ℍ) :
    (f ∣[k] ModularGroup.S) z = f (.mk _ z.im_inv_neg_coe_pos) * z ^ (-k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SL_slash_apply, modular_S_smul]
  simp [ModularGroup.S, denom]

name: slash_action_generators
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h γ hγ
  · exact h γ (hΓ ▸ Subgroup.mem_closure_of_mem hγ)
  · apply Subgroup.closure_induction (p := fun γ _ ↦ f ∣[k] γ = f) h (by simp)
    · simp +contextual [SlashAction.slash_mul]
    · intro x hx hf
      rw [← hf, ← SlashAction.slash_mul]
      simp [hf]
    · simpa [← hΓ]

name: exists_mem_SL2
statement:
lemma exists_mem_SL2 (A : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [IsPrincipalIdealRing A] (c : OnePoint K) :
    ∃ g : SL(2, A), (mapGL K g) • ∞ = c
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | infty => exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
  | coe q =>
    obtain ⟨g, hg0, hg1⟩ := (IsFractionRing.num_den_reduced A q).isCoprime.exists_SL2_col 0
    exact ⟨g, by simp [hg0, hg1, smul_infty_eq_ite]⟩

name: isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular
statement:
lemma isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular {g} (hg : g ∈ 𝒢) (hg10 : g 1 0 = 0) :
    g.IsParabolic ↔ (∃ x ≠ 0, g = upperRightHom x) ∨ (∃ x ≠ (0 : K), g = -upperRightHom x)
proof:
:=
  isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular_of_det (HasDetPlusMinusOne.det_eq hg) hg10

name: IsCusp.smul
statement:
lemma IsCusp.smul {c : OnePoint ℝ} {𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} (hc : IsCusp c 𝒢)
    (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) : IsCusp (g • c) (ConjAct.toConjAct g • 𝒢)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp𝒢, hpp, hpc⟩ := hc
  refine ⟨_, 𝒢.smul_mem_pointwise_smul _ _ hp𝒢, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [ConjAct.toConjAct_smul] using hpp
  · simp [ConjAct.toConjAct_smul, mul_smul, hpc]

name: IsCusp.smul_of_mem
statement:
lemma IsCusp.smul_of_mem {c : OnePoint ℝ} {𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} (hc : IsCusp c 𝒢)
    {g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ} (hg : g ∈ 𝒢) : IsCusp (g • c) 𝒢
proof:
:= by
  convert! hc.smul g
  ext x
  rw [Subgroup.mem_pointwise_smul_iff_inv_smul_mem, ← ConjAct.toConjAct_inv,
    ConjAct.toConjAct_smul, inv_inv, Subgroup.mul_mem_cancel_right _ hg,
    Subgroup.mul_mem_cancel_left _ (inv_mem hg)]

name: isCusp_iff_of_relIndex_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨g, hg, hgp, hgc⟩ ↦ ⟨g, h𝒢 hg, hgp, hgc⟩, fun ⟨g, hg, hgp, hgc⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨n, hn, -, hgn⟩ := Subgroup.exists_pow_mem_of_relIndex_ne_zero h𝒢' hg
  refine ⟨g ^ n, (Subgroup.mem_inf.mpr hgn).1, hgp.pow hn.ne', ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero] at hn
  rwa [(hgp.pow hn).smul_eq_self_iff, hgp.parabolicFixedPoint_pow hn, ← hgp.smul_eq_self_iff]

name: Subgroup.Commensurable.isCusp_iff
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isCusp_iff_of_relIndex_ne_zero inf_le_left, isCusp_iff_of_relIndex_ne_zero inf_le_right]
  · simpa [Subgroup.inf_relIndex_right] using h𝒢.1.relIndex_ne_zero
  · simpa [Subgroup.inf_relIndex_left] using h𝒢.2.relIndex_ne_zero

name: IsCusp.mono
statement:
lemma IsCusp.mono {𝒢 ℋ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} {c : OnePoint ℝ} (hGH : 𝒢 ≤ ℋ)
    (hc : IsCusp c 𝒢) : IsCusp c ℋ
proof:
:=
  match hc with | ⟨h, hh, hp, hc⟩ => ⟨h, hGH hh, hp, hc⟩

name: IsCusp.of_isFiniteRelIndex
statement:
lemma IsCusp.of_isFiniteRelIndex {𝒢 ℋ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} {c : OnePoint ℝ}
    [𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex ℋ] (hc : IsCusp c ℋ) : IsCusp c 𝒢
proof:
:= by
  have hGH : 𝒢.relIndex ℋ ≠ 0 := 𝒢.relIndex_ne_zero
  rw [← Subgroup.inf_relIndex_right] at hGH
  rw [← isCusp_iff_of_relIndex_ne_zero inf_le_right hGH] at hc
  exact hc.mono inf_le_left

name: IsCusp.of_isFiniteRelIndex_conj
proof:
:= by
  suffices (ConjAct.toConjAct h • 𝒢).IsFiniteRelIndex ℋ from hc.of_isFiniteRelIndex
  constructor
  rw [← ℋ.conjAct_pointwise_smul_eq_self (ℋ.le_normalizer hh), 𝒢.relIndex_pointwise_smul]
  exact 𝒢.relIndex_ne_zero

name: isCusp_SL2Z_iff
statement: lemma isCusp_SL2Z_iff {c : OnePoint ℝ} : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ ↔ c ∈ Set.range (OnePoint.map Rat.cast)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, ⟨g, rfl⟩, hgp, hgc⟩
    simpa only [hgp.smul_eq_self_iff.mp hgc] using ⟨(mapGL ℚ g).parabolicFixedPoint,
      by simp [GeneralLinearGroup.parabolicFixedPoint, apply_ite]⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := c.exists_mem_SL2 ℤ
    refine ⟨_, ⟨a * ModularGroup.T * a⁻¹, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · suffices (mapGL ℝ ModularGroup.T).IsParabolic by simpa
      refine ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ ↦ zero_ne_one' ℝ (by simpa [ModularGroup.T] using congr_fun₂ ha 0 1), ?_⟩
      simp [discr_fin_two, trace_fin_two, det_fin_two, ModularGroup.T]
      norm_num
    · rw [← Rat.coe_castHom, ← (Rat.castHom ℝ).algebraMap_toAlgebra]
      simp [OnePoint.map_smul, mul_smul, smul_infty_eq_self_iff, ModularGroup.T]

name: isCusp_SL2Z_iff'
statement: lemma isCusp_SL2Z_iff' {c : OnePoint ℝ} : IsCusp c 𝒮ℒ ↔ ∃ g : SL(2, ℤ), c = mapGL ℝ g • ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [isCusp_SL2Z_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := c.exists_mem_SL2 ℤ
    refine ⟨g, ?_⟩
    rw [← Rat.coe_castHom, OnePoint.map_smul, OnePoint.map_infty,
      ← (Rat.castHom ℝ).algebraMap_toAlgebra, g.map_mapGL]
  · rintro ⟨g, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨mapGL ℚ g • ∞, ?_⟩
    rw [← Rat.coe_castHom, OnePoint.map_smul, OnePoint.map_infty,
       ← (Rat.castHom ℝ).algebraMap_toAlgebra, g.map_mapGL]

name: Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z

lemma Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z (𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) [𝒢.IsArithmetic]

name: cosetToCuspOrbit_apply_mk

lemma cosetToCuspOrbit_apply_mk {𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [𝒢.IsArithmetic] (g : SL(2, ℤ)) :
    cosetToCuspOrbit 𝒢 ⟦g⟧ = ⟦⟨mapGL ℝ g⁻¹ • ∞,
    (Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z 𝒢).mpr <| isCusp_SL2Z_iff.mpr
      ⟨mapGL ℚ g⁻¹ • ∞, by rw [← Rat.coe_castHom, OnePoint.map_smul, OnePoint.map_infty,

proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, (hc : IsCusp c _)⟩
  rw [Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z, isCusp_SL2Z_iff'] at hc
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := hc
  use ⟦g⁻¹⟧
  aesop

name: strictPeriods_le_periods

name: IsRegularAtInfty.eq

name: relIndex_strictPeriods
statement:
lemma relIndex_strictPeriods :
    𝒢.strictPeriods.relIndex 𝒢.periods = 1 ∨ 𝒢.strictPeriods.relIndex 𝒢.periods = 2
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 𝒢.strictPeriods = 𝒢.periods
  · simp [h]
  · replace h := 𝒢.strictPeriods_le_periods.lt_of_ne h
    obtain ⟨u, hu_mem, hu_notMem⟩ := (SetLike.lt_iff_le_and_exists.mp h).2
    rw [AddSubgroup.relIndex_eq_two_iff_exists_notMem_and]
    refine .inr ⟨u, hu_mem, hu_notMem, fun b hb ↦ ?_⟩
    simp only [Subgroup.periods, mem_strictPeriods_iff, mem_adjoinNegOne_iff,
      AddChar.map_add_eq_mul] at hu_mem hu_notMem hb ⊢
    rcases hb with h | h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · simpa only [neg_mul_neg] using Or.inl (mul_mem h <| hu_mem.resolve_left hu_notMem)

name: commensurable_strictPeriods_periods
statement:
lemma commensurable_strictPeriods_periods :
    𝒢.strictPeriods.Commensurable 𝒢.periods

  constructor
  · rcases 𝒢.relIndex_strictPeriods with h | h <;> simp [h]
  · simp [AddSubgroup.relIndex_eq_one.mpr 𝒢.strictPeriods_le_periods]

name: strictPeriods_eq_periods_of_neg_one_mem

name: isRegularAtInfty_of_neg_one_mem

name: strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_one_of_T_mem
statement:
lemma strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_one_of_T_mem {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} (hΓ : ModularGroup.T ∈ Γ) :
    strictPeriods (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) = AddSubgroup.zmultiples 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_strictPeriods_iff, Subgroup.mem_map, Units.ext_iff, mapGL_coe_matrix,
    map_apply_coe]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨g, _, hg⟩ ↦ ⟨g 0 1, by simpa using congr_fun₂ hg 0 1⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨m, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ModularGroup.T ^ m, zpow_mem hΓ m, ?_⟩
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ModularGroup.coe_T_zpow]

name: strictPeriods_SL2Z

name: strictWidthInfty_nonneg
statement: lemma strictWidthInfty_nonneg : 0 ≤ 𝒢.strictWidthInfty
proof:
:= by
  unfold strictWidthInfty; aesop

name: widthInfty_nonneg
statement: lemma widthInfty_nonneg : 0 ≤ 𝒢.widthInfty
proof: := 𝒢.adjoinNegOne.strictWidthInfty_nonneg

name: strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty
statement:
lemma strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty [DiscreteTopology 𝒢.strictPeriods] :
    𝒢.strictPeriods = AddSubgroup.zmultiples 𝒢.strictWidthInfty
proof:
:= by
  simp [Subgroup.strictWidthInfty, dite_eq_left,
    Exists.choose_spec <| 𝒢.strictPeriods.isAddCyclic_iff_exists_zmultiples_eq_top.mp
      <| AddSubgroup.discrete_iff_addCyclic.mpr inferInstance]

name: strictWidthInfty_eq_one_of_T_mem
statement:
lemma strictWidthInfty_eq_one_of_T_mem {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} (hΓ : ModularGroup.T ∈ Γ) :
    strictWidthInfty (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsp := strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_one_of_T_mem hΓ
  have : DiscreteTopology (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)).strictPeriods := by
    
    rw [hsp]
    infer_instance
  rw [strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty, Eq.comm,
    AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_zmultiples_iff (not_isOfFinAddOrder_of_isAddTorsionFree one_ne_zero)]
    at hsp
  grind [strictWidthInfty_nonneg]

name: strictWidthInfty_SL2Z
statement: lemma strictWidthInfty_SL2Z : strictWidthInfty 𝒮ℒ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [MonoidHom.range_eq_map] using strictWidthInfty_eq_one_of_T_mem (mem_top _)

name: strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods

proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : DiscreteTopology 𝒢.strictPeriods
  · simp [strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty]
  · simp [strictWidthInfty, dite_eq_right h]

name: periods_eq_zmultiples_widthInfty
statement:
lemma periods_eq_zmultiples_widthInfty [DiscreteTopology 𝒢.periods] :
    𝒢.periods = AddSubgroup.zmultiples 𝒢.widthInfty
proof:
:=
  have : DiscreteTopology 𝒢.adjoinNegOne.strictPeriods := ‹_›
  𝒢.adjoinNegOne.strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty

name: widthInfty_mem_periods
statement: lemma widthInfty_mem_periods : 𝒢.widthInfty ∈ 𝒢.periods
proof:
:=
  𝒢.adjoinNegOne.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods

name: two_mul_widthInfty_mem_strictPeriods
statement: lemma two_mul_widthInfty_mem_strictPeriods : 2 * 𝒢.widthInfty ∈ 𝒢.strictPeriods
proof:
:= by
  have := 𝒢.widthInfty_mem_periods
  simp only [Subgroup.periods, mem_strictPeriods_iff] at this
  rcases this with (h | h) <;>
    simpa [-upperRightHom_apply, ← AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow] using Subgroup.pow_mem _ h 2

name: strictWidthInfty_pos_iff
statement:
lemma strictWidthInfty_pos_iff [DiscreteTopology 𝒢.strictPeriods] [𝒢.HasDetPlusMinusOne] :
    0 < 𝒢.strictWidthInfty ↔ IsCusp ∞ 𝒢
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine fun h ↦ ⟨_, mem_strictPeriods_iff.mpr 𝒢.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [GeneralLinearGroup.isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular (by simp)]
      simpa using h.ne'
    · simp [smul_infty_eq_self_iff]
  · 
    rintro ⟨g, hgg, hgp, hgi⟩
    apply 𝒢.strictWidthInfty_nonneg.lt_of_ne'
    rw [← AddSubgroup.zmultiples_ne_bot]
    simp only [AddSubgroup.ne_bot_iff_exists_ne_zero, Subtype.exists, Ne, AddSubgroup.mk_eq_zero,
      exists_prop, and_comm, ← strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty, mem_strictPeriods_iff]
    
    rw [smul_infty_eq_self_iff] at hgi
    rw [Subgroup.HasDetPlusMinusOne.isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular hgg hgi] at hgp
    rcases hgp with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    · 
      exact ⟨x, hx, hgg⟩
    · 
      exact ⟨2 • x, by grind,
        by simpa only [AddChar.map_nsmul_eq_pow, neg_sq] using pow_mem hgg 2⟩

name: strictWidthInfty_pos
statement: lemma strictWidthInfty_pos [𝒢.IsArithmetic] : 0 < 𝒢.strictWidthInfty
proof:
:= by
  rw [strictWidthInfty_pos_iff]
  simpa [Subgroup.IsArithmetic.isCusp_iff_isCusp_SL2Z, isCusp_SL2Z_iff]
    using ⟨_, OnePoint.map_infty _⟩

name: isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods
statement:
lemma isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (h𝒢 : h ∈ 𝒢.strictPeriods) :
    IsCusp OnePoint.infty 𝒢
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨upperRightHom h, 𝒢.mem_strictPeriods_iff.mp h𝒢, ?_, smul_infty_eq_self_iff.mpr rfl⟩
  exact (GeneralLinearGroup.isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular rfl).mpr ⟨rfl, hh.ne'⟩

name: widthInfty_pos_iff
statement:
lemma widthInfty_pos_iff [DiscreteTopology 𝒢.periods] [𝒢.HasDetPlusMinusOne] :
    0 < 𝒢.widthInfty ↔ IsCusp ∞ 𝒢
proof:
:= by
  have : DiscreteTopology 𝒢.adjoinNegOne.strictPeriods := ‹_›
  rw [widthInfty, strictWidthInfty_pos_iff, (commensurable_adjoinNegOne_self 𝒢).isCusp_iff]

name: isRegularAtInfty_iff
statement:
lemma isRegularAtInfty_iff [DiscreteTopology 𝒢.periods] :
    𝒢.IsRegularAtInfty ↔ 𝒢.widthInfty ∈ 𝒢.strictPeriods
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ widthInfty_mem_periods 𝒢, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  apply 𝒢.strictPeriods_le_periods.antisymm
  rwa [periods_eq_zmultiples_widthInfty, AddSubgroup.zmultiples_le]

name: widthInfty_pos
statement: lemma widthInfty_pos [𝒢.IsArithmetic] : 0 < 𝒢.widthInfty
proof:
:= by
  apply strictWidthInfty_pos

name: strictPeriods_Gamma
statement:
@[simp] lemma strictPeriods_Gamma (N : ℕ) :
    strictPeriods (Gamma N : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) = AddSubgroup.zmultiples ↑N
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have : AddSubgroup.zmultiples ↑N = .map (Int.castAddHom ℝ) (.zmultiples N) := by simp
  simp only [this, mem_strictPeriods_iff, Subgroup.mem_map, Gamma_mem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, ⟨-, hg, -, -⟩, hx⟩
    rw [show x = g 0 1 by simpa using congr_arg (· 0 1) hx.symm]
    apply AddSubgroup.mem_map_of_mem
    rwa [Int.mem_zmultiples_iff, ← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd]
  · simp only [AddSubgroup.mem_map, AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff, existsAndEq, true_and,
      Units.ext_iff, mapGL_coe_matrix, map_apply_coe, forall_exists_index]
    refine fun a ha ↦ ⟨ModularGroup.T ^ (a * N), by simp [ModularGroup.coe_T_zpow], ?_⟩
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ModularGroup.coe_T_zpow, ← ha]

name: strictWidthInfty_Gamma
statement:
@[simp] lemma strictWidthInfty_Gamma (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] :
    strictWidthInfty (Gamma N : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) = N
proof:
:= by
  have hsp := strictPeriods_Gamma N
  rw [strictPeriods_eq_zmultiples_strictWidthInfty, Eq.comm,
    AddSubgroup.zmultiples_eq_zmultiples_iff
      (not_isOfFinAddOrder_of_isAddTorsionFree (NeZero.ne _))] at hsp
  grind [strictWidthInfty_nonneg, Nat.cast_nonneg]

name: SlashAction.neg_slash
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SlashAction.neg_slash {β G α : Type*} [Monoid G] [AddGroup α]
    [SlashAction β G α] (k : β) (g : G) (a : α) : (-a) ∣[k] g = -a ∣[k] g
proof:
:=
  eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left <| by
    rw [← add_slash, neg_add_cancel, zero_slash]

name: SlashAction.sum_slash
statement:
@[simp] lemma SlashAction.sum_slash {β G α ι : Type*} [Monoid G] [AddCommGroup α]
    [SlashAction β G α] (k : β) (g : G) {a : ι → α} {s : Finset ι} :
    (∑ i ∈ s, a i) ∣[k] g = ∑ i ∈ s, a i ∣[k] g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i t hi IH => simp [hi, IH]

name: SlashAction.slash_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma SlashAction.slash_eq_zero_iff {β G α : Type*} [Group G] [AddGroup α] [SlashAction β G α]
    (k : β) (g : G) (a : α) : a ∣[k] g = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by simp +contextual⟩
  apply_fun (· ∣[k] g⁻¹) at h
  simpa [← SlashAction.slash_mul] using h

name: slash_mul
statement:
private theorem slash_mul (k : ℤ) (A B : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) :
    f ∣[k] (A * B) = (f ∣[k] A) ∣[k] B
proof:
:= by
  ext1 τ
  calc σ (A * B) (f ((A * B) • τ)) * |(A * B).det.val| ^ (k - 1) * denom (A * B) τ ^ (-k)
  _ = σ B (σ A (f (A • B • τ))) * (|A.det.val| ^ (k - 1) * |B.det.val| ^ (k - 1)) *
      (((σ B) (denom A ↑(B • τ) ^ (-k))) * denom B τ ^ (-k)) := by
    rw [σ_mul_comm, σ_mul, denom_cocycle_σ, mul_zpow, mul_smul, map_mul, Units.val_mul,
      abs_mul, ofReal_mul, mul_zpow, map_zpow₀]
  _ = σ B (σ A (f (A • B • τ)) * |A.det.val| ^ (k - 1) * (denom A ↑(B • τ) ^ (-k)))
        * |B.det.val| ^ (k - 1) * denom B τ ^ (-k) := by
     rw [map_mul, map_zpow₀, map_mul, map_zpow₀, σ_ofReal]
     ring
  _ = ((f ∣[k] A) ∣[k] B) τ := rfl

name: add_slash
statement:
private theorem add_slash (k : ℤ) (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (f g : ℍ → ℂ) :
    (f + g) ∣[k] A = f ∣[k] A + g ∣[k] A
proof:
:= by
  ext1 τ
  simp [privateSlash, add_mul]

name: slash_one
statement: private theorem slash_one (k : ℤ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) : f ∣[k] 1 = f
proof:
:=
  funext <| by simp [privateSlash, σ, denom]

name: zero_slash
statement: private theorem zero_slash (k : ℤ) (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) : (0 : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[k] A = 0
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => by simp [privateSlash]

name: slash_def
statement:
theorem slash_def (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) :
    f ∣[k] g = fun τ ↦ σ g (f (g • τ)) * |g.det.val| ^ (k - 1) * denom g τ ^ (-k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: slash_apply
statement:
theorem slash_apply (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (τ : ℍ) :
    (f ∣[k] g) τ = σ g (f (g • τ)) * |g.det.val| ^ (k - 1) * denom g τ ^ (-k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_slash
statement:
theorem smul_slash (k : ℤ) (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) :
    (c • f) ∣[k] A = σ A c • f ∣[k] A
proof:
:= by
  ext τ : 1
  simp only [slash_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: SL_slash
statement: theorem SL_slash (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) : f ∣[k] γ = f ∣[k] (γ : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: SL_slash_def
statement:
theorem SL_slash_def (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) :
    f ∣[k] γ = fun τ ↦ f (γ • τ) * denom γ τ ^ (-k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [SL_slash, slash_def, σ]

name: SL_slash_apply
statement:
theorem SL_slash_apply (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) (τ : ℍ) :
    (f ∣[k] γ) τ = f (γ • τ) * denom γ τ ^ (-k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [SL_slash, slash_def, σ]

name: SL_smul_slash
statement:
@[simp]
theorem SL_smul_slash {α : Type*} [SMul α ℂ] [IsScalarTower α ℂ ℂ]
    (k : ℤ) (A : SL(2, ℤ)) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (c : α) :
    (c • f) ∣[k] A = c • f ∣[k] A
proof:
:= by
  ext τ : 1
  simp [SL_slash_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_mul_assoc]

name: is_invariant_const
statement:
theorem is_invariant_const (A : SL(2, ℤ)) (x : ℂ) :
    Function.const ℍ x ∣[(0 : ℤ)] A = Function.const ℍ x
proof:
:= by

  simp [SL_slash, slash_def, σ, zero_lt_one]

name: is_invariant_one
statement: theorem is_invariant_one (A : SL(2, ℤ)) : (1 : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(0 : ℤ)] A = (1 : ℍ → ℂ)
proof:
:=
  is_invariant_const _ _

name: is_invariant_one'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem is_invariant_one' (A : SL(2, ℤ)) : (1 : ℍ → ℂ) ∣[(0 : ℤ)] (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! is_invariant_one A

name: slash_action_eq'_iff
statement:
theorem slash_action_eq'_iff (k : ℤ) (f : ℍ → ℂ) (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) (z : ℍ) :
    (f ∣[k] γ) z = f z ↔ f (γ • z) = ((γ 1 0 : ℂ) * z + (γ 1 1 : ℂ)) ^ k * f z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SL_slash_apply]
  convert! inv_mul_eq_iff_eq_mul₀ (G₀ := ℂ) _ using 2
  · simp only [mul_comm (f _), denom, zpow_neg]
    rfl
  · exact zpow_ne_zero k (denom_ne_zero γ z)

name: mul_slash
statement:
theorem mul_slash (k1 k2 : ℤ) (A : GL (Fin 2) ℝ) (f g : ℍ → ℂ) :
    (f * g) ∣[k1 + k2] A = |(A.det : ℝ)| • (f ∣[k1] A * g ∣[k2] A)
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  simp only [slash_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, real_smul, map_mul, neg_add,
    zpow_add₀ (denom_ne_zero _ x)]
  set d := (↑|A.det.val| : ℂ)
  have h1 : d ^ (k1 + k2 - 1) = d * d ^ (k1 - 1) * d ^ (k2 - 1) := by
    have : d ≠ 0 := ofReal_ne_zero.mpr <| abs_ne_zero.mpr <| NeZero.ne _
    rw [← zpow_one_add₀ this, ← zpow_add₀ this]
    ring_nf
  rw [h1]
  ring

name: mul_slash_SL2
statement:
theorem mul_slash_SL2 (k1 k2 : ℤ) (A : SL(2, ℤ)) (f g : ℍ → ℂ) :
    (f * g) ∣[k1 + k2] A = f ∣[k1] A * g ∣[k2] A
proof:
:= by
  simp [SL_slash, mul_slash]

name: div_slash_SL2
statement:
theorem div_slash_SL2 (k1 k2 : ℤ) (A : SL(2, ℤ)) (f g : ℍ → ℂ) :
    (f / g) ∣[k1 - k2] A = f ∣[k1] A / g ∣[k2] A
proof:
:= by
  ext τ
  simp [SL_slash_apply, zpow_sub₀ (denom_ne_zero A τ)]
  grind

name: prod_slash_sum_weights
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    simp only [sum_empty, prod_empty, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply, card_empty,
      CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_sub, Int.reduceNeg, zpow_neg, zpow_one]
    ext _
    simp [slash_apply]
  | insert i t hi IH =>
    rcases t.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | ht
    · simp
    simp only [prod_insert hi, card_insert_of_notMem hi, Nat.cast_succ, add_sub_cancel_right,
    show ∑ i ∈ insert i t, k i = (k i) + ∑ i ∈ t, k i by grind, mul_slash, IH, mul_smul_comm,
      ← mul_smul]
    congr 1
    nth_rw 2 [show (#t : ℤ) = 1 + (#t - 1) by grind]
    rw [zpow_add', zpow_one]
    left
    exact abs_ne_zero.mpr (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.det_ne_zero g)

name: prod_slash
proof:
:= by
  have : k * (#s) = ∑ i ∈ s, k := by
    rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul']
  rw [this]
  exact prod_slash_sum_weights

name: exists_bound_fundamental_domain_of_isBigO
statement:
lemma exists_bound_fundamental_domain_of_isBigO
    {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) {t : ℝ} (hf_infinity : f =O[atImInfty] fun z ↦ z.im ^ t) :
    ∃ F, ∀ τ ∈ 𝒟, ‖f τ‖ ≤ F * τ.im ^ t
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hf_infinity⟩ := hf_infinity.exists_pos
  rw [IsBigOWith, atImInfty, eventually_comap, eventually_atTop] at hf_infinity
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf_infinity
  simp only [Real.norm_rpow_of_nonneg (_ : ℍ).im_pos.le,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (_ : ℍ).im_pos.le] at hy
  
  have hfm : ContinuousOn (fun τ ↦ ‖f τ‖ / (im τ) ^ t) (truncatedFundamentalDomain y) := by
    apply (hf_cont.norm.div ?_ fun τ ↦ by positivity).continuousOn
    exact continuous_im.rpow_const fun τ ↦ .inl τ.im_ne_zero
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ : ∃ E, ∀ τ ∈ truncatedFundamentalDomain y, ‖f τ‖ / (im τ) ^ t ≤ E := by
    simpa [norm_mul, norm_norm, Real.norm_rpow_of_nonneg (_ : ℍ).im_pos.le,
      Real.norm_of_nonneg (_ : ℍ).im_pos.le]
      using (isCompact_truncatedFundamentalDomain y).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hfm
  
  refine ⟨max D E, fun τ hτ ↦ ?_⟩
  rcases le_total y (im τ) with hτ' | hτ'
  · exact (hy _ hτ' _ rfl).trans <| mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left ..) (by positivity)
  · rw [← div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    exact (hE τ ⟨hτ, hτ'⟩).trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: exists_bound_of_invariant_of_isBigO
statement:
lemma exists_bound_of_invariant_of_isBigO {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hf_infinity : f =O[atImInfty] fun z ↦ (im z) ^ t)
    (hf_inv : ∀ (g : SL(2, ℤ)) τ, f (g • τ) = f τ) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C * (max (im τ) (1 / im τ)) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨F, hF𝒟⟩ : ∃ F, ∀ τ ∈ 𝒟, ‖f τ‖ ≤ F * τ.im ^ t :=
    exists_bound_fundamental_domain_of_isBigO hf_cont hf_infinity
  refine ⟨F, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_smul_mem_fd τ
  specialize hF𝒟 (g • τ) hg
  rw [hf_inv g τ] at hF𝒟
  grw [hF𝒟]
  gcongr
  · rw [← div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)] at hF𝒟
    exact le_trans (by positivity) hF𝒟
  
  
  rw [im_smul_eq_div_normSq, denom_apply]
  by_cases hg : g 1 0 = 0
  · 
    
    have : g 1 1 ≠ 0 := fun hg' ↦ zero_ne_one <| by
      simpa only [Matrix.det_fin_two, hg, hg', mul_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero] using g.det_coe
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ g 1 1 ^ 2 := mod_cast (one_le_sq_iff_one_le_abs _).mpr (Int.one_le_abs this)
    refine le_trans ?_ <| le_max_left _ _
    rw [show Complex.normSq ((g 1 0) * τ + (g 1 1)) = (g 1 1) ^ 2 by simp [hg, sq]]
    simpa [field] using inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ this
  · 
    
    refine le_trans ?_ <| le_max_right _ _
    rw [show 1 / τ.im = τ.im / τ.im ^ 2 by field_simp]
    gcongr
    rw [show Complex.normSq ((g 1 0) * τ + (g 1 1)) =
      ((g 1 0) * τ.re + (g 1 1)) ^ 2 + (g 1 0) ^ 2 * τ.im ^ 2 by simp [Complex.normSq_apply]; ring]
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ g 1 0 ^ 2 := mod_cast (one_le_sq_iff_one_le_abs _).mpr (Int.one_le_abs hg)
    nlinarith

name: exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isBigO
statement:
lemma exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isBigO
    {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hf_infinity : ∀ (g : SL(2, ℤ)), (fun τ ↦ f (g • τ)) =O[atImInfty] fun z ↦ (im z) ^ t)
    {Γ : Subgroup SL(2, ℤ)} [Γ.FiniteIndex] (hf_inv : ∀ g ∈ Γ, ∀ τ, f (g • τ) = f τ) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C * max τ.im (1 / τ.im) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  
  let f' τ : SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Γ → E := Quotient.lift (fun g ↦ f (g⁻¹ • τ)) fun g h hgh ↦ by
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hj'⟩ : ∃ j ∈ Γ, h = g * j := by
      rw [← Quotient.eq_iff_equiv, Quotient.eq, QuotientGroup.leftRel_apply] at hgh
      exact ⟨g⁻¹ * h, hgh, (mul_inv_cancel_left g h).symm⟩
    simp [-sl_moeb, hj', mul_smul, hf_inv j⁻¹ (inv_mem hj)]
  have hf'_cont γ : Continuous (f' · γ) := QuotientGroup.induction_on γ fun g ↦ by
    simp only [sl_moeb, f']
    fun_prop
  have hf'_inv τ (g : SL(2, ℤ)) γ : f' (g • τ) (g • γ) = f' τ γ := by
    induction γ using QuotientGroup.induction_on
    simp [-sl_moeb, f', mul_smul]
  have hf'_infty γ : (f' · γ) =O[_] _ := γ.induction_on fun h ↦ hf_infinity h⁻¹
  
  have : Fintype (SL(2, ℤ) ⧸ Γ) := Subgroup.fintypeQuotientOfFiniteIndex
  
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_bound_of_invariant_of_isBigO (by fun_prop) ht
    (.fun_sum fun i _ ↦ (hf'_infty i).norm_left)
    (fun g τ ↦ (Fintype.sum_equiv (MulAction.toPerm g) _ _ (by simp [-sl_moeb, hf'_inv])).symm)
  refine ⟨C, fun τ ↦ le_trans ?_ (hC τ)⟩
  simpa [Real.norm_of_nonneg <| show 0 ≤ ∑ γ, ‖f' τ γ‖ by positivity, -sl_moeb, f'] using
    Finset.univ.single_le_sum (fun γ _ ↦ norm_nonneg (f' τ γ)) (Finset.mem_univ ⟦1⟧)

name: exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isArithmetic_of_isBigO
statement:
lemma exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isArithmetic_of_isBigO
    {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hf_infinity : ∀ (g : SL(2, ℤ)), (fun τ ↦ f (g • τ)) =O[atImInfty] fun z ↦ (im z) ^ t)
    {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.IsArithmetic] (hf_inv : ∀ g ∈ Γ, ∀ τ, f (g • τ) = f τ) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C * max τ.im (1 / τ.im) ^ t
proof:
:=
  exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isBigO hf_cont ht hf_infinity (Γ := Γ.comap (mapGL ℝ))
    (hf_inv ·)

name: exists_bound_of_invariant
statement:
lemma exists_bound_of_invariant
    {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hf_infinity : IsBoundedAtImInfty f)
    (hf_inv : ∀ (g : SL(2, ℤ)) τ, f (g • τ) = f τ) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  simpa using! exists_bound_of_invariant_of_isBigO hf_cont le_rfl
    (by simpa only [Real.rpow_zero] using! hf_infinity) hf_inv

name: exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant
statement:
lemma exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant {f : ℍ → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f)
    (hf_infinity : ∀ (g : SL(2, ℤ)), IsBoundedAtImInfty fun τ ↦ f (g • τ))
    {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.IsArithmetic] (hf_inv : ∀ g ∈ Γ, ∀ τ, f (g • τ) = f τ) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by

name: ModularFormClass.exists_petersson_le
statement:
lemma ModularFormClass.exists_petersson_le {k : ℤ} (hk : 0 ≤ k) (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ))
    [Γ.IsArithmetic] {F F' : Type*} (f : F) (f' : F')
    [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [FunLike F' ℍ ℂ] [ModularFormClass F Γ k] [ModularFormClass F' Γ k] :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖petersson k f f' τ‖ ≤ C * max τ.im (1 / τ.im) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  conv => enter [1, C, τ, 1]; rw [← norm_norm]
  refine mod_cast ModularGroup.exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant_of_isArithmetic_of_isBigO
    (show Continuous (‖petersson k f f' ·‖) by fun_prop) (mod_cast hk : 0 ≤ (k : ℝ))
    (fun g ↦ ?_) (fun g hg τ ↦ SlashInvariantFormClass.norm_petersson_smul hg)
  simp_rw [← UpperHalfPlane.petersson_slash_SL, Real.rpow_intCast]
  simpa [petersson, Real.norm_of_nonneg (_ : ℍ).im_pos.le]
    using (bdd_at_infty_slash f g).norm_left.mul (bdd_at_infty_slash f' g).norm_left
      |>.mul (isBigO_refl ..)

name: CuspFormClass.petersson_bounded_left
statement:
lemma CuspFormClass.petersson_bounded_left
    (k : ℤ) (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) [Γ.IsArithmetic] {F F' : Type*} (f : F) (f' : F')
    [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [FunLike F' ℍ ℂ] [CuspFormClass F Γ k] [ModularFormClass F' Γ k] :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖petersson k f f' τ‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  conv => enter [1, C, τ, 1]; rw [← norm_norm]
  refine ModularGroup.exists_bound_of_subgroup_invariant (by fun_prop) (fun g ↦ ?_)
    fun g hg τ ↦ SlashInvariantFormClass.norm_petersson_smul hg
  apply IsZeroAtImInfty.isBoundedAtImInfty
  rw [IsZeroAtImInfty, ZeroAtFilter, ← tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
  simp_rw [← UpperHalfPlane.petersson_slash_SL]
  have : ((toConjAct (g : GL (Fin 2) ℝ)⁻¹) • Γ).IsArithmetic := by
    simpa [(show Rat.castHom ℝ = algebraMap ℚ ℝ by rfl), map_inv, map_mapGL]
      using! Subgroup.IsArithmetic.conj Γ (mapGL ℚ g)⁻¹
  exact (zero_at_infty <| CuspForm.translate f g).petersson_isZeroAtImInfty_left k _
    (ModularForm.translate f' g)

name: CuspFormClass.petersson_bounded_right
statement:
lemma CuspFormClass.petersson_bounded_right
    (k : ℤ) (Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)) [Γ.IsArithmetic] {F F' : Type*} (f : F) (f' : F')
    [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [FunLike F' ℍ ℂ] [ModularFormClass F Γ k] [CuspFormClass F' Γ k] :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖petersson k f f' τ‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  simpa [petersson_norm_symm] using petersson_bounded_left k Γ f' f

name: CuspFormClass.exists_bound
statement:
lemma CuspFormClass.exists_bound {k : ℤ} {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)} [Γ.IsArithmetic]
    {F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [CuspFormClass F Γ k] (f : F) :
    ∃ C, ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C / τ.im ^ (k / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := petersson_bounded_left k Γ f f
  refine ⟨C.sqrt, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  specialize hC τ
  rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ((norm_nonneg _).trans hC)]
  grw [← hC]
  rw [petersson, ← Real.rpow_mul_natCast τ.im_pos.le]
  simp [abs_of_pos τ.im_pos, field]

name: ModularFormClass.exists_bound
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := ModularFormClass.exists_petersson_le hk Γ f f
  refine ⟨C.sqrt, fun τ ↦ ?_⟩
  lift k to ℕ using hk
  specialize hC τ
  have hC' : 0 ≤ C := le_trans (by positivity) <| (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)).mpr hC
  have h : 0 < ‖(τ.im : ℂ) ^ (k : ℤ)‖ := mod_cast norm_pos_iff.mpr (pow_ne_zero _ τ.im_ne_zero)
  rw [petersson, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_conj, ← sq, ← le_div_iff₀ h, mul_div_assoc] at hC
  rw [← sq_le_sq₀ (by positivity) (by positivity), mul_pow, sq_sqrt hC']
  refine hC.trans (congrArg (C * ·) ?_).le
  
  
  generalize h : τ.im = t
  have ht : 0 < t := h ▸ τ.im_pos
  lift t to NNReal using ht.le
  rw [← coe_nnnorm]
  norm_cast at ⊢ ht
  rw [(pow_left_mono k).map_max, (pow_left_mono 2).map_max, ← max_div_div_right (by positivity)]
  congr <;> simp [field, ht.ne']

name: qExpansion_coeff_isBigO_of_norm_isBigO
statement:
lemma qExpansion_coeff_isBigO_of_norm_isBigO {k : ℤ} {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)}
    [Γ.IsArithmetic] {F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [ModularFormClass F Γ k] (f : F) (e : ℝ)
    (hF : IsBigO (comap UpperHalfPlane.im (𝓝 0)) f (fun τ ↦ τ.im ^ (-e))) :
    (fun n ↦ (qExpansion Γ.strictWidthInfty f).coeff n) =O[atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  let h := Γ.strictWidthInfty
  have hh : 0 < h := Γ.strictWidthInfty_pos_iff.mpr Fact.out
  have : NeZero h := ⟨hh.ne'⟩
  have hΓ : h ∈ Γ.strictPeriods := Γ.strictWidthInfty_mem_strictPeriods
  obtain ⟨C, Cpos, hC⟩ := hF.exists_pos
  rw [isBigO_iff]
  rw [IsBigOWith, eventually_comap] at hC
  use (1 / Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi / ↑h)) * C
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0,
    (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero.comp tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop).eventually hC] with n hn hn'
  rw [ModularFormClass.qExpansion_coeff_eq_intervalIntegral (t := 1 / n) f hh hΓ _ (by positivity),
    ← intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul]
  simp only [ofReal_div, ofReal_one, ofReal_natCast]
  refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm (by positivity) |>.trans ?_
  let F (x : ℝ) : ℝ := ‖1 / ↑h * (1 / 𝕢 h ((x : ℂ) + 1 / n * I) ^ n
      * f ⟨(x : ℂ) + 1 / n * Complex.I, by simp [hn]⟩)‖
  have hne : ‖(n : ℝ) ^ e‖ = n ^ e := Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)
  have (x : ℝ) : F x ≤ 1 / h * (1 / Real.exp (-2 * Real.pi / ↑h)) * (C * n ^ e) := by
    simp only [F, norm_mul, norm_div, norm_real, norm_one, norm_pow, mul_assoc]
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hh.le, Function.Periodic.norm_qParam, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    gcongr
    · simp [field]
    · grw [hn' _ (by simp [← UpperHalfPlane.coe_im])]
      simp [← UpperHalfPlane.coe_im, Real.rpow_neg_eq_inv_rpow, hne]
  refine (intervalIntegral.integral_mono (by positivity) ?_ ?_ this).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    fun_prop (disch := simp [Function.Periodic.qParam_ne_zero])
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable ..
  · simp [field, intervalIntegral.integral_const, hne]

name: ModularFormClass.qExpansion_isBigO
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← Real.rpow_intCast]
  apply qExpansion_coeff_isBigO_of_norm_isBigO
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_bound hk f
  simp_rw [IsBigO, ← Int.cast_neg, Real.rpow_intCast, IsBigOWith, eventually_comap]
  use C
  filter_upwards [eventually_le_nhds zero_lt_one] with _ hτ τ rfl
  refine (hC τ).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  rw [max_eq_right, zpow_neg, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), one_div]
  exact one_le_one_div (by positivity) (zpow_le_one₀ τ.im_pos hτ hk)

name: CuspFormClass.qExpansion_isBigO
statement:
lemma CuspFormClass.qExpansion_isBigO {k : ℤ} {Γ : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)}
    [Γ.IsArithmetic] {F : Type*} [FunLike F ℍ ℂ] [CuspFormClass F Γ k] (f : F) :
    (fun n ↦ (UpperHalfPlane.qExpansion Γ.strictWidthInfty f).coeff n)
      =O[atTop] fun n ↦ (n : ℝ) ^ ((k : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply qExpansion_coeff_isBigO_of_norm_isBigO
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_bound f
  refine isBigO_of_le' (c := C) _ fun τ ↦ (hC τ).trans (of_eq ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), Real.rpow_neg τ.im_pos.le, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: cosZeta_two_mul_nat
statement:
theorem cosZeta_two_mul_nat (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    cosZeta x (2 * k) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (2 * π) ^ (2 * k) / 2 / (2 * k)! *
      ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hasSum_nat_cosZeta x (?_ : 1 < re (2 * k))).tsum_eq]
  · refine Eq.trans ?_ <|
      (congr_arg ofReal (hasSum_one_div_nat_pow_mul_cos hk hx).tsum_eq).trans ?_
    · rw [ofReal_tsum]
      refine tsum_congr fun n ↦ ?_
      norm_cast
      ring_nf
    · push_cast
      congr 1
      have : (Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) = _ :=
        (Polynomial.map_map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) ofRealHom _).symm
      rw [this, ← ofRealHom_eq_coe, ← ofRealHom_eq_coe]
      apply Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by simp)
  · norm_cast
    lia

name: sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one
statement:
theorem sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc 0 1) :
    sinZeta x (2 * k + 1) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (2 * π) ^ (2 * k + 1) / 2 / (2 * k + 1)! *
      ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (hasSum_nat_sinZeta x (?_ : 1 < re (2 * k + 1))).tsum_eq]
  · refine Eq.trans ?_ <|
      (congr_arg ofReal (hasSum_one_div_nat_pow_mul_sin hk hx).tsum_eq).trans ?_
    · rw [ofReal_tsum]
      refine tsum_congr fun n ↦ ?_
      norm_cast
      ring_nf
    · push_cast
      congr 1
      have : (Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ) = _ :=
        (Polynomial.map_map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) ofRealHom _).symm
      rw [this, ← ofRealHom_eq_coe, ← ofRealHom_eq_coe]
      apply Polynomial.map_aeval_eq_aeval_map (by simp)
  · norm_cast
    lia

name: cosZeta_two_mul_nat'
statement:
theorem cosZeta_two_mul_nat' (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    cosZeta x (2 * k) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) / (2 * k) / Gammaℂ (2 * k) *
      ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosZeta_two_mul_nat hk hx]
  congr 1
  have : (2 * k)! = (2 * k) * Complex.Gamma (2 * k) := by
    rw [(by { norm_cast; lia } : 2 * (k : ℂ) = ↑(2 * k - 1) + 1), Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial,
      ← Nat.cast_add_one, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (by lia)]
  simp_rw [this, Gammaℂ, cpow_neg, ← div_div, div_inv_eq_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_div,
    mul_right_comm (2 : ℂ) (k : ℂ)]
  norm_cast

name: sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one'
statement:
theorem sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one' (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    sinZeta x (2 * k + 1) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) / (2 * k + 1) / Gammaℂ (2 * k + 1) *
      ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one hk hx]
  congr 1
  have : (2 * k + 1)! = (2 * k + 1) * Complex.Gamma (2 * k + 1) := by
    rw [(by simp : Complex.Gamma (2 * k + 1) = Complex.Gamma (↑(2 * k) + 1)),
       Complex.Gamma_nat_eq_factorial, ← Nat.cast_ofNat (R := ℂ), ← Nat.cast_mul,
      ← Nat.cast_add_one, ← Nat.cast_mul, ← Nat.factorial_succ]
  simp_rw [this, Gammaℂ, cpow_neg, ← div_div, div_inv_eq_mul, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_div]
  rw [(by simp : 2 * (k : ℂ) + 1 = ↑(2 * k + 1)), cpow_natCast]
  ring

name: hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub_two_mul_nat
statement:
theorem hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub_two_mul_nat (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    hurwitzZetaEven x (1 - 2 * k) =
      -1 / (2 * k) * ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 (n : ℕ) : (2 * k : ℂ) ≠ -n := by
    rw [← Int.cast_ofNat, ← Int.cast_natCast, ← Int.cast_mul, ← Int.cast_natCast n, ← Int.cast_neg,
      Ne, Int.cast_inj, ← Ne]
    refine ne_of_gt ((neg_nonpos_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg).trans_lt (mul_pos two_pos ?_))
    exact Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hk)
  have h2 : (2 * k : ℂ) ≠ 1 := by norm_cast; simp
  have h3 : Gammaℂ (2 * k) ≠ 0 := by
    refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ?_) (Gamma_ne_zero h1)
    simp [pi_ne_zero]
  rw [hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub _ h1 (Or.inr h2), ← Gammaℂ, cosZeta_two_mul_nat' hk hx, ← mul_assoc,
    ← mul_div_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h3, ← mul_div_assoc]
  congr 2
  rw [mul_div_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero, ← ofReal_natCast, ← ofReal_mul,
    ← ofReal_cos, mul_comm π, ← sub_zero (k * π), cos_nat_mul_pi_sub, Real.cos_zero, mul_one,
    ofReal_pow, ofReal_neg, ofReal_one, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, mul_neg, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul,
    neg_neg, one_pow]

name: hurwitzZetaOdd_neg_two_mul_nat
statement:
theorem hurwitzZetaOdd_neg_two_mul_nat (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    hurwitzZetaOdd x (-(2 * k)) =
    -1 / (2 * k + 1) * ((Polynomial.bernoulli (2 * k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 (n : ℕ) : (2 * k + 1 : ℂ) ≠ -n := by
    rw [← Int.cast_ofNat, ← Int.cast_natCast, ← Int.cast_mul, ← Int.cast_natCast n, ← Int.cast_neg,
      ← Int.cast_one, ← Int.cast_add, Ne, Int.cast_inj, ← Ne]
    refine ne_of_gt ((neg_nonpos_of_nonneg n.cast_nonneg).trans_lt ?_)
    positivity
  have h3 : Gammaℂ (2 * k + 1) ≠ 0 := by
    refine mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero ?_) (Gamma_ne_zero h1)
    simp [pi_ne_zero]
  rw [(by simp : -(2 * k : ℂ) = 1 - (2 * k + 1)),
    hurwitzZetaOdd_one_sub _ h1, ← Gammaℂ, sinZeta_two_mul_nat_add_one' hk hx, ← mul_assoc,
    ← mul_div_assoc, mul_assoc, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h3, ← mul_div_assoc]
  congr 2
  rw [mul_div_assoc, add_div, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ two_ne_zero, ← ofReal_natCast,
    ← ofReal_one, ← ofReal_ofNat, ← ofReal_div, ← ofReal_add, ← ofReal_mul,
    ← ofReal_sin, mul_comm π, add_mul, mul_comm (1 / 2), mul_one_div, Real.sin_add_pi_div_two,
    ← sub_zero (k * π), cos_nat_mul_pi_sub, Real.cos_zero, mul_one,
    ofReal_pow, ofReal_neg, ofReal_one, pow_succ, mul_neg_one, mul_neg, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul,
    neg_neg, one_pow]

name: hurwitzZeta_one_sub_two_mul_nat
proof:
:= by
  suffices hurwitzZetaOdd x (1 - 2 * k) = 0 by
    rw [hurwitzZeta, this, add_zero, hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub_two_mul_nat hk hx]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk
  rw [Nat.cast_succ, show (1 : ℂ) - 2 * (k + 1) = -2 * k - 1 by ring,
    hurwitzZetaOdd_neg_two_mul_nat_sub_one]

name: hurwitzZeta_neg_two_mul_nat
proof:
:= by
  suffices hurwitzZetaEven x (-(2 * k)) = 0 by
    rw [hurwitzZeta, this, zero_add, hurwitzZetaOdd_neg_two_mul_nat hk hx]
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hk
  simpa using hurwitzZetaEven_neg_two_mul_nat_add_one x k

name: hurwitzZeta_neg_nat
statement:
theorem hurwitzZeta_neg_nat (hk : k ≠ 0) (hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    hurwitzZeta x (-k) =
    -1 / (k + 1) * ((Polynomial.bernoulli (k + 1)).map (algebraMap ℚ ℂ)).eval (x : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd' k with ⟨n, (rfl | rfl)⟩
  · exact_mod_cast hurwitzZeta_neg_two_mul_nat (by lia : n ≠ 0) hx
  · exact_mod_cast hurwitzZeta_one_sub_two_mul_nat (by lia : n + 1 ≠ 0) hx

name: riemannZeta_two_mul_nat
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_two_mul_nat {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    riemannZeta (2 * k) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k - 1)
      * (π : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) * bernoulli (2 * k) / (2 * k)!
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) (hasSum_zeta_nat hk).tsum_eq
  · rw [← Nat.cast_two, ← Nat.cast_mul, zeta_nat_eq_tsum_of_gt_one (by lia)]
    simp [push_cast]
  · norm_cast

name: riemannZeta_two_mul_nat'
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_two_mul_nat' {k : ℕ} :
    riemannZeta (2 * k) = (-1) ^ (k + 1) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k - 1 : ℤ)
      * (π : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) * bernoulli (2 * k) / (2 * k)!
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk
  · simp [riemannZeta_zero]
    norm_num
  · convert riemannZeta_two_mul_nat hk
    grind [zpow_natCast]

name: riemannZeta_two
statement: theorem riemannZeta_two : riemannZeta 2 = (π : ℂ) ^ 2 / 6
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) hasSum_zeta_two.tsum_eq
  · rw [← Nat.cast_two, zeta_nat_eq_tsum_of_gt_one one_lt_two]
    simp [push_cast]
  · norm_cast

name: riemannZeta_four
statement: theorem riemannZeta_four : riemannZeta 4 = π ^ 4 / 90
proof:
:= by
  convert! congr_arg ((↑) : ℝ → ℂ) hasSum_zeta_four.tsum_eq
  · rw [← Nat.cast_one, show (4 : ℂ) = (4 : ℕ) by simp,
      zeta_nat_eq_tsum_of_gt_one (by simp : 1 < 4)]
    simp only [push_cast]
  · norm_cast

name: riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli'
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli' (k : ℕ) :
    riemannZeta (-k) = -bernoulli' (k + 1) / (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne k 0 with rfl | hk
  · rw [Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero, riemannZeta_zero, zero_add, zero_add, div_one,
      bernoulli'_one, Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_one, Rat.cast_ofNat, neg_div]
  · rw [← hurwitzZeta_zero, ← QuotientAddGroup.mk_zero, hurwitzZeta_neg_nat hk
      (left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one), ofReal_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero_map,
      Polynomial.bernoulli_eval_zero, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, Rat.smul_one_eq_cast,
      div_mul_eq_mul_div, neg_one_mul, bernoulli_eq_bernoulli'_of_ne_one (by simp [hk])]

name: riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli
statement:
theorem riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli (k : ℕ) :
    riemannZeta (-k) = (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * bernoulli (k + 1) / (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannZeta_neg_nat_eq_bernoulli', bernoulli, Rat.cast_mul, Rat.cast_pow, Rat.cast_neg,
    Rat.cast_one, ← neg_one_mul, ← mul_assoc, pow_succ, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul (-1),
    neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul]

name: ArithmeticFunction.one_eq_delta
statement: lemma ArithmeticFunction.one_eq_delta : ↗(1 : ArithmeticFunction ℂ) = δ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [one_apply, LSeries.delta]

name: not_LSeriesSummable_moebius_at_one
statement: lemma not_LSeriesSummable_moebius_at_one : ¬ LSeriesSummable ↗μ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine fun h ↦ not_summable_one_div_on_primes <| summable_ofReal.mp <| .of_neg ?_
  refine (h.indicator {n | n.Prime}).congr fun n ↦ ?_
  by_cases hn : n.Prime
  · simp [hn, hn.ne_zero, moebius_apply_prime hn, push_cast, neg_div]
  · simp [hn]

name: LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff
statement: lemma LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff {s : ℂ} : LSeriesSummable ↗μ s ↔ 1 < s.re
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, LSeriesSummable_of_bounded_of_one_lt_re (m := 1) fun n _ ↦ ?_⟩
  · by_contra! h
    exact not_LSeriesSummable_moebius_at_one <| LSeriesSummable.of_re_le_re (by simpa) H
  · norm_cast
    exact abs_moebius_le_one

name: abscissaOfAbsConv_moebius
statement: lemma abscissaOfAbsConv_moebius : abscissaOfAbsConv ↗μ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [abscissaOfAbsConv, LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff, Set.Ioi_def, EReal.image_coe_Ioi]
    using csInf_Ioo <| EReal.coe_lt_top 1

name: ArithmeticFunction.const_one_eq_zeta
statement:
lemma ArithmeticFunction.const_one_eq_zeta {R : Type*} [AddMonoidWithOne R] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (1 : ℕ → R) n = (ζ ·) n
proof:
:= by
  simp [hn]

name: LSeries.one_convolution_eq_zeta_convolution
statement:
lemma LSeries.one_convolution_eq_zeta_convolution {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (f : ℕ → R) :
    (1 : ℕ → R) ⍟ f = ((ArithmeticFunction.zeta ·) : ℕ → R) ⍟ f
proof:
:=
  convolution_congr ArithmeticFunction.const_one_eq_zeta fun _ ↦ rfl

name: LSeries.convolution_one_eq_convolution_zeta
statement:
lemma LSeries.convolution_one_eq_convolution_zeta {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (f : ℕ → R) :
    f ⍟ (1 : ℕ → R) = f ⍟ ((ArithmeticFunction.zeta ·) : ℕ → R)
proof:
:=
  convolution_congr (fun _ ↦ rfl) ArithmeticFunction.const_one_eq_zeta

name: isMultiplicative_toArithmeticFunction
statement:
lemma isMultiplicative_toArithmeticFunction {N : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter R N) :
    (toArithmeticFunction (χ ·)).IsMultiplicative
proof:
:= by
  refine IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero.mpr ⟨?_, fun {m} {n} hm hn _ ↦ ?_⟩
  · simp [toArithmeticFunction]
  · simp [toArithmeticFunction, hm, hn]

name: apply_eq_toArithmeticFunction_apply
statement:
lemma apply_eq_toArithmeticFunction_apply {N : ℕ} {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R]
    (χ : DirichletCharacter R N) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    χ n = toArithmeticFunction (χ ·) n
proof:
:= by
  simp [toArithmeticFunction, hn]

name: mul_convolution_distrib
statement:
lemma mul_convolution_distrib {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter R n)
    (f g : ℕ → R) :
    (((χ ·) : ℕ → R) * f) ⍟ (((χ ·) : ℕ → R) * g) = ((χ ·) : ℕ → R) * (f ⍟ g)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, LSeries.convolution_def, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  rw [(mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mp hp).1.symm, cast_mul, map_mul]
  exact mul_mul_mul_comm ..

name: mul_delta
statement: lemma mul_delta {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) : ↗χ * δ = δ
proof:
:=
  LSeries.mul_delta <| by rw [cast_one, map_one]

name: delta_mul
statement: lemma delta_mul {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) : δ * ↗χ = δ
proof:
:=
  mul_comm δ _ ▸ mul_delta ..

name: convolution_mul_moebius
statement: lemma convolution_mul_moebius {n : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ n) : ↗χ ⍟ (↗χ * ↗μ) = δ
proof:
:= by
  have : (1 : ℕ → ℂ) ⍟ (μ ·) = δ := by
    rw [one_convolution_eq_zeta_convolution, ← one_eq_delta]
    simp_rw [← natCoe_apply, ← intCoe_apply, coe_mul, coe_zeta_mul_coe_moebius]
  nth_rewrite 1 [← mul_one ↗χ]
  simpa only [mul_convolution_distrib χ 1 ↗μ, this] using mul_delta _

name: modZero_eq_delta
statement: lemma modZero_eq_delta {χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 0} : ↗χ = δ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp_rw [cast_zero, χ.map_nonunit not_isUnit_zero, delta, reduceCtorEq, ite_false]
  rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with rfl | hn'
  · simp [delta]
  have : ¬ IsUnit (n : ZMod 0) := fun h ↦ hn' <| ZMod.eq_one_of_isUnit_natCast h
  simp_all [χ.map_nonunit this, delta]

name: modOne_eq_one
statement:
lemma modOne_eq_one {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] {χ : DirichletCharacter R 1} :
    ((χ ·) : ℕ → R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [χ.level_one, MulChar.one_apply (isUnit_of_subsingleton _), Pi.one_apply]

name: LSeries_modOne_eq
statement: lemma LSeries_modOne_eq : L ↗χ₁ = L 1
proof:
:=
  congr_arg L modOne_eq_one

name: not_LSeriesSummable_at_one
statement:
lemma not_LSeriesSummable_at_one {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    ¬ LSeriesSummable ↗χ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine fun h ↦ (Real.not_summable_indicator_one_div_natCast hN 1) ?_
  refine h.norm.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m ↦ Set.indicator_apply_nonneg (fun _ ↦ by positivity))
    (fun n ↦ ?_)
  simp only [norm_term_eq, Set.indicator, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · simp [h₂]
  · simp [h₁, χ.map_one]
  all_goals positivity

name: LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re
statement:
lemma LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    LSeriesSummable ↗χ s
proof:
:=
  LSeriesSummable_of_bounded_of_one_lt_re (fun _ _ ↦ χ.norm_le_one _) hs

name: LSeriesSummable_iff
statement:
lemma LSeriesSummable_iff {N : ℕ} (hN : N ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} :
    LSeriesSummable ↗χ s ↔ 1 < s.re
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re χ⟩
  by_contra! h
  exact not_LSeriesSummable_at_one hN χ <| LSeriesSummable.of_re_le_re (by simp [h]) H

name: absicssaOfAbsConv_eq_one
statement:
lemma absicssaOfAbsConv_eq_one {N : ℕ} (hn : N ≠ 0) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    abscissaOfAbsConv ↗χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [abscissaOfAbsConv, LSeriesSummable_iff hn χ, Set.Ioi_def, EReal.image_coe_Ioi]
    using csInf_Ioo <| EReal.coe_lt_top 1

name: LSeriesSummable_mul
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_norm <| h.norm.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) fun n ↦ norm_term_le s ?_
  simpa using mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg <| f n) <| χ.norm_le_one n

name: LSeries.mul_mu_eq_one
statement:
lemma LSeries.mul_mu_eq_one {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ}
    (hs : 1 < s.re) : L ↗χ s * L (↗χ * ↗μ) s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LSeries_convolution' (LSeriesSummable_of_one_lt_re χ hs) <|
          LSeriesSummable_mul χ <| ArithmeticFunction.LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff.mpr hs,
    convolution_mul_moebius, LSeries_delta, Pi.one_apply]

name: LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
statement:
lemma LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    L ↗χ s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simpa [h] using LSeries.mul_mu_eq_one χ hs

name: LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_one
statement: lemma LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_one : abscissaOfAbsConv 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  modOne_eq_one (χ := χ₁) ▸ absicssaOfAbsConv_eq_one one_ne_zero χ₁

name: LSeriesSummable_one_iff
statement: theorem LSeriesSummable_one_iff {s : ℂ} : LSeriesSummable 1 s ↔ 1 < s.re
proof:
:=
  modOne_eq_one (χ := χ₁) ▸ LSeriesSummable_iff one_ne_zero χ₁

name: LSeries_zeta_eq
statement: lemma LSeries_zeta_eq : L ↗ζ = L 1
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  exact (LSeries_congr const_one_eq_zeta s).symm

name: LSeriesSummable_zeta_iff
statement: theorem LSeriesSummable_zeta_iff {s : ℂ} : LSeriesSummable (ζ ·) s ↔ 1 < s.re
proof:
:=
  (LSeriesSummable_congr s const_one_eq_zeta).symm.trans <| LSeriesSummable_one_iff

name: abscissaOfAbsConv_zeta
statement: lemma abscissaOfAbsConv_zeta : abscissaOfAbsConv ↗ζ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [abscissaOfAbsConv_congr (g := 1) fun hn ↦ by simp [hn], abscissaOfAbsConv_one]

name: LSeries_zeta_eq_riemannZeta
statement: lemma LSeries_zeta_eq_riemannZeta {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L ↗ζ s = riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∑' n, term (fun n ↦ if n = 0 then 0 else 1) s n = ∑' n : ℕ, 1 / (n : ℂ) ^ s by
    simpa [LSeries, zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_cpow hs]
  refine tsum_congr fun n ↦ ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with hn | hn <;>
  simp [hn, ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs]

name: LSeriesHasSum_zeta
statement: lemma LSeriesHasSum_zeta {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesHasSum ↗ζ s (riemannZeta s)
proof:
:=
  LSeries_zeta_eq_riemannZeta hs ▸ (LSeriesSummable_zeta_iff.mpr hs).LSeriesHasSum

name: LSeries_zeta_mul_Lseries_moebius
statement: lemma LSeries_zeta_mul_Lseries_moebius {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L ↗ζ s * L ↗μ s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LSeries_convolution' (LSeriesSummable_zeta_iff.mpr hs)
    (LSeriesSummable_moebius_iff.mpr hs)]
  simp [← natCoe_apply, ← intCoe_apply, coe_mul, one_eq_delta, LSeries_delta, -zeta_apply]

name: LSeries_zeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re
statement: lemma LSeries_zeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L ↗ζ s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ by simpa [h, -zeta_apply] using LSeries_zeta_mul_Lseries_moebius hs

name: LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta
statement: lemma LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L 1 s = riemannZeta s
proof:
:=
  LSeries_zeta_eq ▸ LSeries_zeta_eq_riemannZeta hs

name: LSeriesHasSum_one
statement: lemma LSeriesHasSum_one {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesHasSum 1 s (riemannZeta s)
proof:
:=
  LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hs ▸ (LSeriesSummable_one_iff.mpr hs).LSeriesHasSum

name: LSeries_one_mul_Lseries_moebius
statement: lemma LSeries_one_mul_Lseries_moebius {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L 1 s * L ↗μ s = 1
proof:
:=
  LSeries_zeta_eq ▸ LSeries_zeta_mul_Lseries_moebius hs

name: LSeries_one_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re

name: riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re

name: riemannZeta_pos_of_one_lt
statement: lemma riemannZeta_pos_of_one_lt {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) : 0 < riemannZeta x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : 1 < (x : ℂ).re := by simpa using hx
  rw [← LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hx']
  refine LSeries.positive (fun _ ↦ by simp) (by simp) ?_
  simpa [LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_one] using (by exact_mod_cast hx : (1 : EReal) < x)

name: convolution_vonMangoldt_zeta
statement: lemma convolution_vonMangoldt_zeta : ↗Λ ⍟ ↗ζ = ↗Complex.log
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simpa [apply_ite, LSeries.convolution_def, -vonMangoldt_mul_zeta]
    using congr_arg (ofReal <| · n) vonMangoldt_mul_zeta

name: convolution_vonMangoldt_const_one
statement: lemma convolution_vonMangoldt_const_one : ↗Λ ⍟ 1 = ↗Complex.log
proof:
:=

name: LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt
statement: lemma LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : LSeriesSummable ↗Λ s
proof:
:= by
  have hf := LSeriesSummable_logMul_of_lt_re
    (show abscissaOfAbsConv 1 < s.re by rw [abscissaOfAbsConv_one]; exact_mod_cast hs)
  rw [LSeriesSummable, ← summable_norm_iff] at hf ⊢
  refine hf.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun n ↦ norm_term_le s ?_)
  have hΛ : ‖↗Λ n‖ ≤ ‖Complex.log n‖ := by
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg, vonMangoldt_nonneg, ← natCast_log, Real.log_natCast_nonneg]
      using vonMangoldt_le_log
  exact hΛ.trans <| by simp

name: convolution_twist_vonMangoldt
statement:
lemma convolution_twist_vonMangoldt {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) :
    (↗χ * ↗Λ) ⍟ ↗χ = ↗χ * ↗Complex.log
proof:
:= by
  rw [← convolution_vonMangoldt_const_one, ← χ.mul_convolution_distrib, mul_one]

name: LSeriesSummable_twist_vonMangoldt
proof:
:=
  LSeriesSummable_mul χ <| LSeriesSummable_vonMangoldt hs

name: LSeries_twist_vonMangoldt_eq
statement:
lemma LSeries_twist_vonMangoldt_eq {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    L (↗χ * ↗Λ) s = -deriv (L ↗χ) s / L ↗χ s
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne N 0 with rfl | hN
  · simp [modZero_eq_delta, delta_mul_eq_smul_delta, LSeries_delta]
  
  have hχ : LSeriesSummable ↗χ s := (LSeriesSummable_iff hN χ).mpr hs
  have hs' : abscissaOfAbsConv ↗χ < s.re := by
    rwa [absicssaOfAbsConv_eq_one hN, ← EReal.coe_one, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
  have hΛ : LSeriesSummable (↗χ * ↗Λ) s := LSeriesSummable_twist_vonMangoldt χ hs
  rw [eq_div_iff <| LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re χ hs, ← LSeries_convolution' hΛ hχ,
    convolution_twist_vonMangoldt, LSeries_deriv hs', neg_neg]
  exact LSeries_congr (fun _ ↦ by simp [mul_comm, logMul]) s

name: LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq
statement: lemma LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : L ↗Λ s = - deriv (L 1) s / L 1 s
proof:
:= by
  refine (LSeries_congr (fun {n} _ ↦ ?_) s).trans <|
    LSeries_modOne_eq ▸ LSeries_twist_vonMangoldt_eq χ₁ hs
  simp [Subsingleton.eq_one (α := ZMod 1)]

name: LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div
statement:
lemma LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq_deriv_riemannZeta_div {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    L ↗Λ s = - deriv riemannZeta s / riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  suffices deriv (L 1) s = deriv riemannZeta s by
    rw [LSeries_vonMangoldt_eq hs, ← LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta hs, this]
  refine Filter.EventuallyEq.deriv_eq <| Filter.eventuallyEq_iff_exists_mem.mpr ?_
  exact ⟨{z | 1 < z.re}, (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_re).mem_nhds hs,
    fun _ ↦ LSeries_one_eq_riemannZeta⟩

name: toArithmeticFunction_congr
proof:

name: ArithmeticFunction.toArithmeticFunction_eq_self

@[simp]

name: LSeries.convolution_congr

name: ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul
statement:
lemma ArithmeticFunction.coe_mul {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) :
    f ⍟ g = ⇑(f * g)
proof:
:= by

name: convolution_def
statement:
lemma convolution_def {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (f g : ℕ → R) :
    f ⍟ g = fun n ↦ ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, f p.1 * g p.2
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simpa [convolution, toArithmeticFunction] using
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ by simp [ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal hp]

name: convolution_map_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma convolution_map_zero {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (f g : ℕ → R) : (f ⍟ g) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [convolution_def]

name: term_convolution
statement:
lemma term_convolution (f g : ℕ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    term (f ⍟ g) s n = ∑ p ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, term f s p.1 * term g s p.2
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp
  
  rw [term_of_ne_zero hn, convolution_def, Finset.sum_div]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ ?_
  have ⟨hp₁, hp₂⟩ := ne_zero_of_mem_divisorsAntidiagonal hp
  rw [term_of_ne_zero hp₁, term_of_ne_zero hp₂, mul_comm_div, div_div, ← mul_div_assoc,
    ← natCast_mul_natCast_cpow, ← cast_mul, mul_comm p.2, (mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.mp hp).1]

name: term_convolution'
statement:
lemma term_convolution' (f g : ℕ → ℂ) (s : ℂ) :
    term (f ⍟ g) s = fun n ↦
      ∑' (b : (fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' {n}), term f s b.val.1 * term g s b.val.2
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · 
    refine (term_zero ..).trans ?_
    
    have hS : (fun p ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' {0} = {0} ×ˢ univ ∪ univ ×ˢ {0} := by
      ext
      simp
    have : ∀ p : (fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' {0}, term f s p.val.1 * term g s p.val.2 = 0 := by
      rintro ⟨⟨_, _⟩, hp⟩
      rcases hS ▸ hp with ⟨rfl, -⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩ <;> simp
    simp [this]
  
  rw [show (fun p : ℕ × ℕ ↦ p.1 * p.2) ⁻¹' {n} = n.divisorsAntidiagonal by ext; simp [hn],
    Finset.tsum_subtype' n.divisorsAntidiagonal fun p ↦ term f s p.1 * term g s p.2,
    term_convolution f g s n]

name: LSeriesHasSum.convolution
statement:
lemma LSeriesHasSum.convolution {f g : ℕ → ℂ} {s a b : ℂ} (hf : LSeriesHasSum f s a)
    (hg : LSeriesHasSum g s b) :
    LSeriesHasSum (f ⍟ g) s (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := summable_mul_of_summable_norm hf.summable.norm hg.summable.norm
  
  simpa only [LSeriesHasSum, term_convolution'] using (hf.mul hg hsum).tsum_fiberwise _

name: LSeries_convolution'
statement:
lemma LSeries_convolution' {f g : ℕ → ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hf : LSeriesSummable f s)

    LSeries (f ⍟ g) s = LSeries f s * LSeries g s
proof:

  (LSeriesHasSum.convolution hf.LSeriesHasSum hg.LSeriesHasSum).LSeries_eq

name: LSeries_convolution
proof:

name: LSeriesSummable.convolution

name: LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_convolution_le

lemma LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_convolution_le (f g : ℕ → ℂ) :

proof:

name: LSeriesHasSum_mul
statement:
lemma LSeriesHasSum_mul {f g : ArithmeticFunction ℂ} {s a b : ℂ} (hf : LSeriesHasSum ↗f s a)
    (hg : LSeriesHasSum ↗g s b) :
    LSeriesHasSum ↗(f * g) s (a * b)

name: LSeries_mul'
statement:
lemma LSeries_mul' {f g : ArithmeticFunction ℂ} {s : ℂ} (hf : LSeriesSummable ↗f s)
    (hg : LSeriesSummable ↗g s) :

name: LSeriesSummable_mul

name: riemannZeta_eq_completedRiemannZeta

lemma riemannZeta_eq_completedRiemannZeta₀ {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 0) : riemannZeta s =
    (completedRiemannZeta₀ s - 1 / s - 1 / (1 - s)) / (π ^ (-s / 2) * Gamma (s / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [riemannZeta_def_of_ne_zero hs, completedRiemannZeta_eq, Gammaℝ]

name: riemannZeta_eq_mul_completedRiemannZeta
statement:
lemma riemannZeta_eq_mul_completedRiemannZeta₀ (s : ℂ) :
