  · exact (B.χ.differentiableAt_LFunction 1 (.inr B.χ_ne)).hasDerivAt.continuousAt_div

name: F_neg_two
statement: private lemma F_neg_two (B : BadChar N) : B.F (-2 : ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := riemannZeta_neg_two_mul_nat_add_one 0
  rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, mul_one] at this
  rw [F, ofReal_neg, ofReal_ofNat, Function.update_of_ne (mod_cast (by lia : (-2 : ℤ) ≠ 1)),
    this, zero_mul]

name: LFunction_apply_one_ne_zero_of_quadratic
proof:
:= by
  intro hL
  
  let B : BadChar N := { χ := χ, χ_sq := hχ, hχ := hL, χ_ne := χ_ne }
  refine B.F_neg_two.not_gt ?_
  refine ArithmeticFunction.LSeries_positive_of_differentiable_of_eqOn (zetaMul_nonneg hχ)
    (χ.isMultiplicative_zetaMul.map_one ▸ zero_lt_one) B.F_differentiable ?_
    (fun _ ↦ B.F_eq_LSeries) _
  exact LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv_le_of_forall_lt_LSeriesSummable
    fun _ a ↦ χ.LSeriesSummable_zetaMul a

name: re_log_comb_nonneg'
statement:
private lemma re_log_comb_nonneg' {a : ℝ} (ha₀ : 0 ≤ a) (ha₁ : a < 1) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ = 1) :
      0 ≤ 3 * (-log (1 - a)).re + 4 * (-log (1 - a * z)).re + (-log (1 - a * z ^ 2)).re
proof:
:= by
  have hac₀ : ‖(a : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by
    simp only [Complex.norm_of_nonneg ha₀, ha₁]
  have hac₁ : ‖a * z‖ < 1 := by rwa [norm_mul, hz, mul_one]
  have hac₂ : ‖a * z ^ 2‖ < 1 := by rwa [norm_mul, norm_pow, hz, one_pow, mul_one]
  rw [← ((hasSum_re <| hasSum_taylorSeries_neg_log hac₀).mul_left 3).add
    ((hasSum_re <| hasSum_taylorSeries_neg_log hac₁).mul_left 4) |>.add
    (hasSum_re <| hasSum_taylorSeries_neg_log hac₂) |>.tsum_eq]
  refine tsum_nonneg fun n ↦ ?_
  simp only [← ofReal_pow, div_natCast_re, ofReal_re, mul_pow, mul_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul,
    sub_zero]
  rcases n.eq_zero_or_pos with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · simp only [← mul_div_assoc, ← add_div]
    refine div_nonneg ?_ n.cast_nonneg
    rw [← pow_mul, pow_mul', sq, mul_re, ← sq, ← sq, ← sq_norm_sub_sq_re, norm_pow, hz]
    convert! (show 0 ≤ 2 * a ^ n * ((z ^ n).re + 1) ^ 2 by positivity) using 1
    ring

name: re_log_comb_nonneg
statement:
private lemma re_log_comb_nonneg {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 < x) (y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ 3 * (-log (1 - (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) n * n ^ (-x : ℂ))).re +
          4 * (-log (1 - χ n * n ^ (-(x + I * y)))).re +
          (-log (1 - (χ n ^ 2) * n ^ (-(x + 2 * I * y)))).re
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn' : IsUnit (n : ZMod N)
  · have hn : (n : ℝ) ^ (-x) < 1 := by
      rw [Real.rpow_neg (Nat.cast_nonneg n), inv_lt_one_iff₀]
      exact .inr <| Real.one_lt_rpow (mod_cast one_lt_two.trans_le hn) <| zero_lt_one.trans hx
    have hz : ‖χ n * (n : ℂ) ^ (-(I * y))‖ = 1 := by
      rw [norm_mul, ← hn'.unit_spec, DirichletCharacter.unit_norm_eq_one χ hn'.unit,
        ← ofReal_natCast, norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_pos (mod_cast by lia)]
      simp only [neg_re, mul_re, I_re, ofReal_re, zero_mul, I_im, ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_self,
        neg_zero, Real.rpow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [MulChar.one_apply hn', one_mul]
    convert! re_log_comb_nonneg' (by positivity) hn hz using 6
    · simp only [ofReal_cpow n.cast_nonneg (-x), ofReal_natCast, ofReal_neg]
    · congr 2
      rw [neg_add, cpow_add _ _ <| mod_cast by lia, ← ofReal_neg, ofReal_cpow n.cast_nonneg (-x),
        ofReal_natCast, mul_left_comm]
    · rw [neg_add, cpow_add _ _ <| mod_cast by lia, ← ofReal_neg, ofReal_cpow n.cast_nonneg (-x),
        ofReal_natCast, show -(2 * I * y) = (2 : ℕ) * -(I * y) by ring, cpow_nat_mul, mul_pow,
        mul_left_comm]
  · simp only [MulChar.map_nonunit _ hn', zero_mul, sub_zero, log_one, neg_zero, zero_re, mul_zero,
      neg_add_rev, add_zero, pow_two, le_refl]

name: summable_neg_log_one_sub_mul_prime_cpow
statement:
lemma summable_neg_log_one_sub_mul_prime_cpow {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    Summable fun p : Nat.Primes ↦ -log (1 - χ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s))
proof:
:= by
  have (p : Nat.Primes) : ‖χ p * (p : ℂ) ^ (-s)‖ ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (-s).re := by
    simpa only [norm_mul, norm_natCast_cpow_of_re_ne_zero _ <| re_neg_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs]
      using mul_le_of_le_one_left (by positivity) (χ.norm_le_one _)
  refine (Nat.Primes.summable_rpow.mpr ?_).of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ ↦ norm_nonneg _) this
    |>.of_norm.clog_one_sub.neg
  simp only [neg_re, neg_lt_neg_iff, hs]

name: one_lt_re_one_add
statement:
private lemma one_lt_re_one_add {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) :
    1 < (1 + x : ℂ).re ∧ 1 < (1 + x + I * y).re ∧ 1 < (1 + x + 2 * I * y).re
proof:
:= by
  simp only [add_re, one_re, ofReal_re, lt_add_iff_pos_right, hx, mul_re, I_re, zero_mul, I_im,
    ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_self, add_zero, re_ofNat, im_ofNat, mul_one, mul_im, and_self]

name: norm_LSeries_product_ge_one
statement:
lemma norm_LSeries_product_ge_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖L ↗(1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (1 + x) ^ 3 * L ↗χ (1 + x + I * y) ^ 4 *
      L ↗(χ ^ 2 :) (1 + x + 2 * I * y)‖ ≥ 1
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ := one_lt_re_one_add hx y
  have H₀ := summable_neg_log_one_sub_mul_prime_cpow (N := N) 1 h₀
  have H₁ := summable_neg_log_one_sub_mul_prime_cpow χ h₁
  have H₂ := summable_neg_log_one_sub_mul_prime_cpow (χ ^ 2) h₂
  have hsum₀ := (hasSum_re H₀.hasSum).summable.mul_left 3
  have hsum₁ := (hasSum_re H₁.hasSum).summable.mul_left 4
  have hsum₂ := (hasSum_re H₂.hasSum).summable
  rw [← LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log _ h₀, ← LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log χ h₁,
    ← LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log _ h₂]
  simp only [← exp_nat_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← exp_add, norm_exp, add_re, mul_re,
    re_ofNat, im_ofNat, zero_mul, sub_zero, Real.one_le_exp_iff]
  rw [re_tsum H₀, re_tsum H₁, re_tsum H₂, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_mul_left,
    ← hsum₀.tsum_add hsum₁, ← (hsum₀.add hsum₁).tsum_add hsum₂]
  simpa only [neg_add_rev, neg_re, mul_neg, χ.pow_apply' two_ne_zero, ge_iff_le, add_re, one_re,
    ofReal_re, ofReal_add, ofReal_one] using
      tsum_nonneg fun (p : Nat.Primes) ↦ χ.re_log_comb_nonneg p.prop.two_le h₀ y

name: norm_LFunction_product_ge_one
statement:
lemma norm_LFunction_product_ge_one {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (y : ℝ) :
    ‖LFunctionTrivChar N (1 + x) ^ 3 * LFunction χ (1 + x + I * y) ^ 4 *
      LFunction (χ ^ 2) (1 + x + 2 * I * y)‖ ≥ 1
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨h₀, h₁, h₂⟩ := one_lt_re_one_add hx y
  rw [LFunctionTrivChar, DirichletCharacter.LFunction_eq_LSeries 1 h₀,
    χ.LFunction_eq_LSeries h₁, (χ ^ 2).LFunction_eq_LSeries h₂]
  exact norm_LSeries_product_ge_one χ hx y

name: LFunctionTrivChar_isBigO_near_one_horizontal
statement:
lemma LFunctionTrivChar_isBigO_near_one_horizontal :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ LFunctionTrivChar N (1 + x)) =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun x ↦ (1 : ℂ) / x
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun w : ℂ ↦ LFunctionTrivChar N (1 + w)) =O[𝓝[≠] 0] (1 / ·) := by
    have H : Tendsto (fun w ↦ w * LFunctionTrivChar N (1 + w)) (𝓝[≠] 0)
        (𝓝 <| ∏ p ∈ N.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℂ)⁻¹)) := by
      convert! (LFunctionTrivChar_residue_one (N := N)).comp (f := fun w ↦ 1 + w) ?_ using 1
      · simp only [Function.comp_def, add_sub_cancel_left]
      · simpa only [tendsto_iff_comap, Homeomorph.coe_addLeft, add_zero, map_le_iff_le_comap] using
          ((Homeomorph.addLeft (1 : ℂ)).map_punctured_nhds_eq 0).le
    exact (isBigO_mul_iff_isBigO_div eventually_mem_nhdsWithin).mp <| H.isBigO_one ℂ
  exact (isBigO_comp_ofReal_nhds_ne this).mono <| nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE 0

name: one_add_I_mul_ne_one_or
statement:
private lemma one_add_I_mul_ne_one_or {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0 ∨ χ ≠ 1) :
    1 + I * y ≠ 1 ∨ χ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ne_eq, add_eq_left, _root_.mul_eq_zero, I_ne_zero, ofReal_eq_zero, false_or]
    using hy

name: LFunction_isBigO_horizontal
statement:
lemma LFunction_isBigO_horizontal {y : ℝ} (hy : y ≠ 0 ∨ χ ≠ 1) :
    (fun x : ℝ ↦ LFunction χ (1 + x + I * y)) =O[𝓝[>] 0] fun _ ↦ (1 : ℂ)
proof:
:= by
  refine IsBigO.mono ?_ nhdsWithin_le_nhds
  simp_rw [add_comm (1 : ℂ), add_assoc]
  have := (χ.differentiableAt_LFunction _ <| one_add_I_mul_ne_one_or χ hy).continuousAt
  rw [← zero_add (1 + _)] at this
  exact this.comp (f := fun x : ℝ ↦ x + (1 + I * y)) (x := 0) (by fun_prop) |>.tendsto.isBigO_one ℂ

name: LFunction_isBigO_horizontal_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [add_comm (1 : ℂ), add_assoc]
  have := (χ.differentiableAt_LFunction _ <| one_add_I_mul_ne_one_or χ hy).hasDerivAt
  rw [← zero_add (1 + _)] at this
  simpa only [zero_add, h, sub_zero]
    using (Complex.isBigO_comp_ofReal_nhds
      (this.comp_add_const 0 _).differentiableAt.isBigO_sub) |>.mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds

name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_not_quadratic_or_ne_one
statement:
private lemma LFunction_ne_zero_of_not_quadratic_or_ne_one {t : ℝ} (h : χ ^ 2 ≠ 1 ∨ t ≠ 0) :
    LFunction χ (1 + I * t) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro Hz
  have hz₁ : t ≠ 0 ∨ χ ≠ 1 := by
    refine h.symm.imp_right (fun h H ↦ ?_)
    simp only [H, one_pow, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false] at h
  have hz₂ : 2 * t ≠ 0 ∨ χ ^ 2 ≠ 1 :=
    h.symm.imp_left <| mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero
  have help (x : ℝ) : ((1 / x) ^ 3 * x ^ 4 * 1 : ℂ) = x := by
    rcases eq_or_ne x 0 with rfl | h
    · rw [ofReal_zero, zero_pow (by lia), mul_zero, mul_one]
    · rw [one_div, inv_pow, pow_succ _ 3, ← mul_assoc,
        inv_mul_cancel₀ <| pow_ne_zero 3 (ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h), one_mul, mul_one]
  
  
  have H₀ : (fun _ : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) =O[𝓝[>] 0]
      fun x ↦ LFunctionTrivChar N (1 + x) ^ 3 * LFunction χ (1 + x + I * t) ^ 4 *
                   LFunction (χ ^ 2) (1 + x + 2 * I * t) :=
    IsBigO.of_bound' <| eventually_nhdsWithin_of_forall
      fun _ hx ↦ (norm_one (α := ℝ)).symm ▸ (χ.norm_LFunction_product_ge_one hx t).le
  have H := (LFunctionTrivChar_isBigO_near_one_horizontal (N := N)).pow 3 |>.mul <|
    (χ.LFunction_isBigO_horizontal_of_eq_zero hz₁ Hz).pow 4 |>.mul <|
    LFunction_isBigO_horizontal _ hz₂
  simp only [ofReal_mul, ofReal_ofNat, mul_left_comm I, ← mul_assoc, help] at H
  
  replace H := (H₀.trans H).norm_right
  simp only [norm_real] at H
  exact isLittleO_irrefl (.of_forall (fun _ ↦ one_ne_zero)) <|
    H.of_norm_right.trans_isLittleO <| isLittleO_id_one.mono nhdsWithin_le_nhds

name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_re_eq_one
statement:
theorem LFunction_ne_zero_of_re_eq_one {s : ℂ} (hs : s.re = 1) (hχs : χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) :
    LFunction χ s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : χ ^ 2 = 1 ∧ s = 1
  · exact h.2 ▸ LFunction_apply_one_ne_zero_of_quadratic h.1 <| hχs.neg_resolve_right h.2
  · have hs' : s = 1 + I * s.im := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← re_add_im s, hs, ofReal_one, mul_comm]
    rw [not_and_or, ← ne_eq, ← ne_eq, hs', add_ne_left] at h
    replace h : χ ^ 2 ≠ 1 ∨ s.im ≠ 0 :=
      h.imp_right (fun H ↦ by exact_mod_cast right_ne_zero_of_mul H)
    exact hs'.symm ▸ χ.LFunction_ne_zero_of_not_quadratic_or_ne_one h

name: LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re
statement:
theorem LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re ⦃s : ℂ⦄ (hχs : χ ≠ 1 ∨ s ≠ 1) (hs : 1 ≤ s.re) :
    LFunction χ s ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  hs.eq_or_lt.casesOn (fun hs ↦ LFunction_ne_zero_of_re_eq_one χ hs.symm hχs)
    fun hs ↦ LFunction_eq_LSeries χ hs ▸ LSeries_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re χ hs

name: LFunction_apply_one_ne_zero
statement: theorem LFunction_apply_one_ne_zero (hχ : χ ≠ 1) : LFunction χ 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re χ (.inl hχ) <| one_re ▸ le_rfl

name: _root_.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re
statement:
lemma _root_.riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_le_re ⦃s : ℂ⦄ (hs : 1 ≤ s.re) :
    riemannZeta s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne s 1 with rfl | hs₀
  · exact riemannZeta_one_ne_zero
  · exact LFunction_modOne_eq (χ := 1) ▸ LFunction_ne_zero_of_one_le_re _ (.inr hs₀) hs

name: logDeriv_riemannZeta_one_sub
statement:
theorem logDeriv_riemannZeta_one_sub {s : ℂ} (hs : ∀ n : ℤ, s ≠ n) (hz : riemannZeta s ≠ 0) :
    logDeriv riemannZeta s =
      -logDeriv riemannZeta (1 - s) + log (2 * π) - digamma s + π / 2 * tan (π * s / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2π : 2 * (π : ℂ) ≠ 0 := mod_cast by positivity
  have (m : ℕ) : s ≠ -m := mod_cast hs (-m)
  have : s ≠ 1 := mod_cast hs 1
  have : cos (π * s / 2) ≠ 0 :=
    mt cos_eq_zero_iff.mp fun ⟨k, _⟩ ↦ hs (2 * k + 1) (mod_cast by grind)
  have : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ ↦ π * z / 2) (π / 2) s := by
    simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (π : ℂ)).div_const 2
  have := (hasDerivAt_neg' s).differentiableAt.const_cpow (Or.inl h2π)
  have : riemannZeta ∘ (1 - ·) =ᶠ[𝓝 s]
      fun z ↦ 2 * (2 * π) ^ (-z) * Gamma z * cos (π * z / 2) * riemannZeta z := by
    filter_upwards [isClosed_range_intCast.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds (by grind)] with z hz
    rw [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_range, not_exists] at hz
    exact riemannZeta_one_sub (fun n h ↦ hz (-n) (by simp [h])) (by grind [hz 1])
  have := (logDeriv_congr_nhds this).eq_of_nhds
  rw [logDeriv_comp, logDeriv_fun_mul, logDeriv_fun_mul, logDeriv_fun_mul, logDeriv_fun_mul,
    logDeriv_fun_comp (f := cos), ← digamma_def] at this
  <;> first | fun_prop | simp_all <;> grind [differentiableAt_riemannZeta, Gamma_ne_zero, hs 0]

name: hurwitzZetaEven_eq
statement:
lemma hurwitzZetaEven_eq (a : UnitAddCircle) (s : ℂ) :
    hurwitzZetaEven a s = (hurwitzZeta a s + hurwitzZeta (-a) s) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, hurwitzZetaEven_neg, hurwitzZetaOdd_neg]
  ring_nf

name: hurwitzZetaOdd_eq
statement:
lemma hurwitzZetaOdd_eq (a : UnitAddCircle) (s : ℂ) :
    hurwitzZetaOdd a s = (hurwitzZeta a s - hurwitzZeta (-a) s) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, hurwitzZetaEven_neg, hurwitzZetaOdd_neg]
  ring_nf

name: differentiableAt_hurwitzZeta
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_hurwitzZeta (a : UnitAddCircle) {s : ℂ} (hs : s ≠ 1) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (hurwitzZeta a) s
proof:
:=
  (differentiableAt_hurwitzZetaEven a hs).add (differentiable_hurwitzZetaOdd a s)

name: hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re
statement:
lemma hasSum_hurwitzZeta_of_one_lt_re {a : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < re s) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ ↦ 1 / (n + a : ℂ) ^ s) (hurwitzZeta a s)
proof:
:= by
  convert!
    (hasSum_nat_hurwitzZetaEven_of_mem_Icc ha hs).add (hasSum_nat_hurwitzZetaOdd_of_mem_Icc ha hs)
    using 1
  ext1 n
  
  apply show ∀ (x y : ℂ), x = (x + y) / 2 + (x - y) / 2 by intros; ring

name: hurwitzZeta_residue_one
statement:
lemma hurwitzZeta_residue_one (a : UnitAddCircle) :
    Tendsto (fun s ↦ (s - 1) * hurwitzZeta a s) (𝓝[≠] 1) (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, mul_add, (by simp : 𝓝 (1 : ℂ) = 𝓝 (1 + (1 - 1) * hurwitzZetaOdd a 1))]
  refine (hurwitzZetaEven_residue_one a).add ((Tendsto.mul ?_ ?_).mono_left nhdsWithin_le_nhds)
  exacts [tendsto_id.sub_const _, (differentiable_hurwitzZetaOdd a).continuous.tendsto _]

name: differentiableAt_hurwitzZeta_sub_one_div
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_hurwitzZeta_sub_one_div (a : UnitAddCircle) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun s ↦ hurwitzZeta a s - 1 / (s - 1) / Gammaℝ s) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, add_sub_right_comm]
  exact (differentiableAt_hurwitzZetaEven_sub_one_div a).add (differentiable_hurwitzZetaOdd a 1)

name: tendsto_hurwitzZeta_sub_one_div_nhds_one
statement:
lemma tendsto_hurwitzZeta_sub_one_div_nhds_one (a : UnitAddCircle) :
    Tendsto (fun s ↦ hurwitzZeta a s - 1 / (s - 1) / Gammaℝ s) (𝓝 1) (𝓝 (hurwitzZeta a 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, add_sub_right_comm]
  refine (tendsto_hurwitzZetaEven_sub_one_div_nhds_one a).add
    (differentiable_hurwitzZetaOdd a 1).continuousAt.tendsto

name: differentiable_hurwitzZeta_sub_hurwitzZeta
statement:
lemma differentiable_hurwitzZeta_sub_hurwitzZeta (a b : UnitAddCircle) :
    Differentiable ℂ (fun s ↦ hurwitzZeta a s - hurwitzZeta b s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hurwitzZeta, add_sub_add_comm]
  refine (differentiable_hurwitzZetaEven_sub_hurwitzZetaEven a b).add (.sub ?_ ?_)
  all_goals apply differentiable_hurwitzZetaOdd

name: cosZeta_eq
statement:
lemma cosZeta_eq (a : UnitAddCircle) (s : ℂ) :
    cosZeta a s = (expZeta a s + expZeta (-a) s) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [expZeta, expZeta, cosZeta_neg, sinZeta_neg]
  ring_nf

name: sinZeta_eq
statement:
lemma sinZeta_eq (a : UnitAddCircle) (s : ℂ) :
    sinZeta a s = (expZeta a s - expZeta (-a) s) / (2 * I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [expZeta, expZeta, cosZeta_neg, sinZeta_neg]
  field

name: hasSum_expZeta_of_one_lt_re
statement:
lemma hasSum_expZeta_of_one_lt_re (a : ℝ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < re s) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ ↦ cexp (2 * π * I * a * n) / n ^ s) (expZeta a s)
proof:
:= by
  convert! (hasSum_nat_cosZeta a hs).add ((hasSum_nat_sinZeta a hs).mul_left I) using 1
  ext1 n
  simp only [mul_right_comm _ I, ← cos_add_sin_I, push_cast]
  rw [add_div, mul_div, mul_comm _ I]

name: differentiableAt_expZeta
statement:
lemma differentiableAt_expZeta (a : UnitAddCircle) (s : ℂ) (hs : s ≠ 1 ∨ a ≠ 0) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (expZeta a) s
proof:
:= by
  apply DifferentiableAt.add
  · exact differentiableAt_cosZeta a hs
  · apply (differentiableAt_const _).mul (differentiableAt_sinZeta a s)

name: differentiable_expZeta_of_ne_zero
statement:
lemma differentiable_expZeta_of_ne_zero {a : UnitAddCircle} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Differentiable ℂ (expZeta a)
proof:
:=
  (differentiableAt_expZeta a · (Or.inr ha))

name: LSeriesHasSum_exp
statement:
lemma LSeriesHasSum_exp (a : ℝ) {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < re s) :
    LSeriesHasSum (cexp <| 2 * π * I * a * ·) s (expZeta a s)
proof:
:=
  (hasSum_expZeta_of_one_lt_re a hs).congr_fun
    (LSeries.term_of_ne_zero' (ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs) _)

name: hurwitzZeta_one_sub
statement:
lemma hurwitzZeta_one_sub (a : UnitAddCircle) {s : ℂ}
    (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -n) (hs' : a ≠ 0 ∨ s ≠ 1) :
    hurwitzZeta a (1 - s) = (2 * π) ^ (-s) * Gamma s *
    (exp (-π * I * s / 2) * expZeta a s + exp (π * I * s / 2) * expZeta (-a) s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hurwitzZeta, hurwitzZetaEven_one_sub a hs hs', hurwitzZetaOdd_one_sub a hs,
    expZeta, expZeta, Complex.cos, Complex.sin, sinZeta_neg, cosZeta_neg]
  rw [show ↑π * I * s / 2 = ↑π * s / 2 * I by ring,
    show -↑π * I * s / 2 = -(↑π * s / 2) * I by ring]
  
  
  generalize (2 * π : ℂ) ^ (-s) = x
  generalize (↑π * s / 2 * I).exp = y
  generalize (-(↑π * s / 2) * I).exp = z
  ring_nf

name: expZeta_one_sub
statement:
lemma expZeta_one_sub (a : UnitAddCircle) {s : ℂ} (hs : ∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ 1 - n) :
    expZeta a (1 - s) = (2 * π) ^ (-s) * Gamma s *
    (exp (π * I * s / 2) * hurwitzZeta a s + exp (-π * I * s / 2) * hurwitzZeta (-a) s)
proof:
:= by
  have hs' (n : ℕ) : s ≠ -↑n := by
    convert! hs (n + 1) using 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [expZeta, cosZeta_one_sub a hs, sinZeta_one_sub a hs', hurwitzZeta, hurwitzZeta,
    hurwitzZetaEven_neg, hurwitzZetaOdd_neg, Complex.cos, Complex.sin]
  rw [show ↑π * I * s / 2 = ↑π * s / 2 * I by ring,
    show -↑π * I * s / 2 = -(↑π * s / 2) * I by ring]
  
  
  generalize (2 * π : ℂ) ^ (-s) = x
  generalize (↑π * s / 2 * I).exp = y
  generalize (-(↑π * s / 2) * I).exp = z
  ring_nf
  rw [I_sq]
  ring_nf

name: euler_criterion_units
statement: theorem euler_criterion_units (x : (ZMod p)ˣ) : (∃ y : (ZMod p)ˣ, y ^ 2 = x) ↔ x ^ (p / 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : p = 2
  · subst hc
    simp only [eq_iff_true_of_subsingleton, exists_const]
  · have h₀ := FiniteField.unit_isSquare_iff (by rwa [ringChar_zmod_n]) x
    have hs : (∃ y : (ZMod p)ˣ, y ^ 2 = x) ↔ IsSquare x := by
      rw [isSquare_iff_exists_sq x]
      simp_rw [eq_comm]
    rw [hs]
    rwa [card p] at h₀

name: euler_criterion
statement: theorem euler_criterion {a : ZMod p} (ha : a ≠ 0) : IsSquare (a : ZMod p) ↔ a ^ (p / 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (iff_congr _ (by simp [Units.ext_iff])).mp (euler_criterion_units p (Units.mk0 a ha))
  simp only [Units.ext_iff, sq, Units.val_mk0, Units.val_mul]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩; exact ⟨y, hy.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      simp [mul_zero, ne_eq] at ha
    refine ⟨Units.mk0 y hy, ?_⟩; simp

name: pow_div_two_eq_neg_one_or_one
statement:
theorem pow_div_two_eq_neg_one_or_one {a : ZMod p} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    a ^ (p / 2) = 1 ∨ a ^ (p / 2) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rcases Prime.eq_two_or_odd (@Fact.out p.Prime _) with rfl | hp_odd
  · revert a ha; intro a; fin_cases a
    · tauto
    · simp
  rw [← mul_self_eq_one_iff, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, two_mul_odd_div_two hp_odd]
  exact pow_card_sub_one_eq_one ha

name: eq_pow
statement: theorem eq_pow (a : ℤ) : (legendreSym p a : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p) ^ (p / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (ringChar (ZMod p)) 2 with hc | hc
  · by_cases ha : (a : ZMod p) = 0
    · rw [legendreSym, ha, quadraticChar_zero,
        zero_pow (Nat.div_pos (@Fact.out p.Prime).two_le (succ_pos 1)).ne']
      norm_cast
    · have := (ringChar_zmod_n p).symm.trans hc
      
      subst p
      rw [legendreSym, quadraticChar_eq_one_of_char_two hc ha]
      revert ha
      push_cast
      generalize (a : ZMod 2) = b; fin_cases b
      · tauto
      · simp
  · convert! quadraticChar_eq_pow_of_char_ne_two' hc (a : ZMod p)
    exact (card p).symm

name: eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem eq_one_or_neg_one {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    legendreSym p a = 1 ∨ legendreSym p a = -1
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_dichotomy ha

name: eq_neg_one_iff_not_one
statement:
theorem eq_neg_one_iff_not_one {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    legendreSym p a = -1 ↔ ¬legendreSym p a = 1
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_eq_neg_one_iff_not_one ha

name: eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff (a : ℤ) : legendreSym p a = 0 ↔ (a : ZMod p) = 0
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_eq_zero_iff

name: at_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem at_zero : legendreSym p 0 = 0
proof: := by rw [legendreSym, Int.cast_zero, MulChar.map_zero]

name: at_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem at_one : legendreSym p 1 = 1
proof: := by rw [legendreSym, Int.cast_one, MulChar.map_one]

name: mul
statement: protected theorem mul (a b : ℤ) : legendreSym p (a * b) = legendreSym p a * legendreSym p b
proof:
:= by
  simp [legendreSym, Int.cast_mul, map_mul]

name: sq_one
statement: theorem sq_one {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : legendreSym p a ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_sq_one ha

name: sq_one'
statement: theorem sq_one' {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : legendreSym p (a ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [legendreSym]
  rw [Int.cast_pow]
  exact quadraticChar_sq_one' ha

name: mod
statement: protected theorem mod (a : ℤ) : legendreSym p a = legendreSym p (a % p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [legendreSym, intCast_mod]

name: eq_one_iff
statement: theorem eq_one_iff {a : ℤ} (ha0 : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : legendreSym p a = 1 ↔ IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_one_iff_isSquare ha0

name: eq_one_iff'
statement:
theorem eq_one_iff' {a : ℕ} (ha0 : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    legendreSym p a = 1 ↔ IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_one_iff]
  · norm_cast
  · exact mod_cast ha0

name: eq_neg_one_iff
statement: theorem eq_neg_one_iff {a : ℤ} : legendreSym p a = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_neg_one_iff_not_isSquare

name: eq_neg_one_iff'
statement: theorem eq_neg_one_iff' {a : ℕ} : legendreSym p a = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_neg_one_iff]; norm_cast

name: card_sqrts
statement:
theorem card_sqrts (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ℤ) :
    ↑{x : ZMod p | x ^ 2 = a}.toFinset.card = legendreSym p a + 1
proof:
:=
  quadraticChar_card_sqrts ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hp) a

name: eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0)
    {x y : ZMod p} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2 = 0) : legendreSym p a = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun (· * y⁻¹ ^ 2) at hxy
  simp only [zero_mul] at hxy
  rw [(by ring : (x ^ 2 - ↑a * y ^ 2) * y⁻¹ ^ 2 = (x * y⁻¹) ^ 2 - a * (y * y⁻¹) ^ 2),
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hy, one_pow, mul_one, sub_eq_zero, pow_two] at hxy
  exact (eq_one_iff p ha).mpr ⟨x * y⁻¹, hxy.symm⟩

name: eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero'
statement:
theorem eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero' {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0)
    {x y : ZMod p} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxy : x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2 = 0) : legendreSym p a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_pow two_ne_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero, sq_eq_zero_iff] at hxy
    exact hx hxy
  exact eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero ha hy hxy

name: eq_zero_mod_of_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem eq_zero_mod_of_eq_neg_one {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (h : legendreSym p a = -1)
    {x y : ZMod p} (hxy : x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2 = 0) : x = 0 ∧ y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    rw [(eq_zero_iff p a).mpr hf] at h
    simp at h
  by_contra hf
  rcases imp_iff_or_not.mp (not_and'.mp hf) with hx | hy
  · rw [eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero' ha hx hxy, CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff] at h
    exact one_ne_zero h
  · rw [eq_one_of_sq_sub_mul_sq_eq_zero ha hy hxy, CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff] at h
    exact one_ne_zero h

name: prime_dvd_of_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_of_eq_neg_one {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (h : legendreSym p a = -1) {x y : ℤ}
    (hxy : (p : ℤ) ∣ x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2) : ↑p ∣ x ∧ ↑p ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [← ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at hxy ⊢
  push_cast at hxy
  exact eq_zero_mod_of_eq_neg_one h hxy

name: legendreSym.at_neg_one
statement: theorem legendreSym.at_neg_one (hp : p ≠ 2) : legendreSym p (-1) = χ₄ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [legendreSym, card p, quadraticChar_neg_one ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hp),
    Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_one]

name: legendreSym.at_neg
statement: theorem legendreSym.at_neg (hp : p ≠ 2) (a : ℤ) : legendreSym p (-a) = χ₄ p * legendreSym p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, legendreSym.mul p (-1) a, legendreSym.at_neg_one hp]

name: exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff
statement: theorem exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 4 ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_one_iff, card p]

name: mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_one
statement: theorem mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_one {y : ZMod p} (hy : y ^ 2 = -1) : p % 4 ≠ 3
proof:
:=
  exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff.1 ⟨y, hy ▸ pow_two y⟩

name: mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq'
statement:
theorem mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq' {x y : ZMod p} (hy : y ≠ 0) (hxy : x ^ 2 = -y ^ 2) :
    p % 4 ≠ 3
proof:
:=
  @mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_one p _ (x / y)
    (by
      apply_fun fun z => z / y ^ 2 at hxy
      rwa [neg_div, ← div_pow, ← div_pow, div_self hy, one_pow] at hxy)

name: mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq
statement:
theorem mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq {x y : ZMod p} (hx : x ≠ 0) (hxy : x ^ 2 = -y ^ 2) :
    p % 4 ≠ 3
proof:
:=
  mod_four_ne_three_of_sq_eq_neg_sq' hx (neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mpr hxy).symm

name: val_mem_rootsOfUnity
statement:
lemma val_mem_rootsOfUnity (φ : AddChar R R') (a : R) (h : 0 < ringChar R) :
    (φ.val_isUnit a).unit ∈ rootsOfUnity (ringChar R).toPNat' R'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_rootsOfUnity', IsUnit.unit_spec, Nat.toPNat'_coe, h, ↓reduceIte,
    ← map_nsmul_eq_pow, nsmul_eq_mul, CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul, map_zero_eq_one]

name: IsPrimitive.compMulHom_of_isPrimitive
proof:
:= fun a ha ↦ by
  simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff] using (MonoidHom.compAddChar_injective_right f hf).ne (hφ ha)

name: to_mulShift_inj_of_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem to_mulShift_inj_of_isPrimitive {ψ : AddChar R R'} (hψ : IsPrimitive ψ) :
    Function.Injective ψ.mulShift
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  apply_fun fun x => x * mulShift ψ (-b) at h
  simp only [mulShift_mul, mulShift_zero, add_neg_cancel] at h
  simpa [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_eq_zero] using (hψ · h)

name: IsPrimitive.of_ne_one
statement:
theorem IsPrimitive.of_ne_one {F : Type u} [Field F] {ψ : AddChar F R'} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) :
    IsPrimitive ψ
proof:
:=
  fun a ha h ↦ hψ <| by simpa [mulShift_mulShift, ha] using! congr_arg (mulShift · a⁻¹) h

name: not_isPrimitive_mulShift
statement:
lemma not_isPrimitive_mulShift [Finite R] (e : AddChar R R') {r : R}
    (hr : ¬ IsUnit r) : ¬ IsPrimitive (e.mulShift r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsPrimitive, not_forall]
  simp only [isUnit_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_finite,
    mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right, not_forall] at hr
  rcases hr with ⟨x, h, h'⟩
  exact ⟨x, h', by simp only [mulShift_mulShift, mul_comm r, h, mulShift_zero, not_ne_iff]⟩

name: exists_divisor_of_not_isPrimitive
statement:
lemma exists_divisor_of_not_isPrimitive (he : ¬e.IsPrimitive) :
    ∃ d : ℕ, d ∣ N ∧ d < N ∧ e.mulShift d = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsPrimitive, not_forall, not_ne_iff] at he
  rcases he with ⟨b, hb_ne, hb⟩
  
  obtain ⟨d, hd, u, hu, rfl⟩ := b.eq_unit_mul_divisor
  refine ⟨d, hd, lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.le_of_dvd (NeZero.pos _) hd) ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fun h ↦ by simp only [h, ZMod.natCast_self, mul_zero, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false] at hb_ne
  · rw [← mulShift_unit_eq_one_iff _ hu, ← hb, mul_comm]
    ext1 y
    rw [mulShift_apply, mulShift_apply, mulShift_apply, mul_assoc]

name: zmodChar_apply
statement:
theorem zmodChar_apply {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : C} (hζ : ζ ^ n = 1) (a : ZMod n) :
    zmodChar n hζ a = ζ ^ a.val
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zmodChar_apply'
statement:
theorem zmodChar_apply' {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {ζ : C} (hζ : ζ ^ n = 1) (a : ℕ) :
    zmodChar n hζ a = ζ ^ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_eq_pow_mod a hζ, zmodChar_apply, ZMod.val_natCast]

name: zmod_char_ne_one_iff
statement: theorem zmod_char_ne_one_iff (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (ψ : AddChar (ZMod n) C) : ψ ≠ 1 ↔ ψ 1 ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ne_one_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨_, h⟩⟩
  contrapose!
  rintro h₁ a
  have ha₁ : a = a.val • (1 : ZMod ↑n) := by
    rw [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]; exact (ZMod.natCast_zmod_val a).symm
  rw [ha₁, map_nsmul_eq_pow, h₁, one_pow]

name: IsPrimitive.zmod_char_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem IsPrimitive.zmod_char_eq_one_iff (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    {ψ : AddChar (ZMod n) C} (hψ : IsPrimitive ψ) (a : ZMod n) :
    ψ a = 1 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => not_imp_comm.mp (@hψ a) ?_, fun ha => by rw [ha, map_zero_eq_one]⟩
  rw [zmod_char_ne_one_iff n (mulShift ψ a), mulShift_apply, mul_one, h, Classical.not_not]

name: zmod_char_primitive_of_eq_one_only_at_zero
statement:
theorem zmod_char_primitive_of_eq_one_only_at_zero (n : ℕ) (ψ : AddChar (ZMod n) C)
    (hψ : ∀ a, ψ a = 1 → a = 0) : IsPrimitive ψ
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha hf
  have h : mulShift ψ a 1 = (1 : AddChar (ZMod n) C) (1 : ZMod n) :=
    congr_fun (congr_arg (↑) hf) 1
  rw [mulShift_apply, mul_one] at h; norm_cast at h
  exact ha (hψ a h)

name: zmodChar_primitive_of_primitive_root
statement:
theorem zmodChar_primitive_of_primitive_root (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] {ζ : C} (h : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n) :
    IsPrimitive (zmodChar n ((IsPrimitiveRoot.iff_def ζ n).mp h).left)
proof:
:= by
  apply zmod_char_primitive_of_eq_one_only_at_zero
  intro a ha
  rw [zmodChar_apply, ← pow_zero ζ] at ha
  exact (ZMod.val_eq_zero a).mp (IsPrimitiveRoot.pow_inj h (ZMod.val_lt a) (NeZero.pos _) ha)

name: sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one
statement: theorem sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one [IsDomain R'] {ψ : AddChar R R'} (hψ : ψ ≠ 1) : ∑ a, ψ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases ne_one_iff.1 hψ with ⟨b, hb⟩
  have h₁ : ∑ a : R, ψ (b + a) = ∑ a : R, ψ a :=
    Fintype.sum_bijective _ (AddGroup.addLeft_bijective b) _ _ fun x => rfl
  simp_rw [map_add_eq_mul] at h₁
  have h₂ : ∑ a : R, ψ a = Finset.univ.sum ↑ψ := rfl
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, h₂] at h₁
  exact eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hb h₁

name: sum_eq_card_of_eq_one
statement:
theorem sum_eq_card_of_eq_one {ψ : AddChar R R'} (hψ : ψ = 1) :
    ∑ a, ψ a = Fintype.card R
proof: := by simp [hψ]

name: sum_mulShift
statement:
theorem sum_mulShift {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Fintype R] [DecidableEq R]
    {R' : Type*} [CommRing R'] [IsDomain R'] {ψ : AddChar R R'} (b : R)
    (hψ : IsPrimitive ψ) : ∑ x : R, ψ (x * b) = if b = 0 then Fintype.card R else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · 
    simp only [h, mul_zero, map_zero_eq_one, Finset.sum_const, Nat.smul_one_eq_cast]
    rfl
  · 
    simp_rw [mul_comm]
    exact mod_cast sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one (hψ h)

name: starComp_eq_inv
statement:
lemma starComp_eq_inv (hR : 0 < ringChar R) {φ : AddChar R ℂ} :
    (starRingEnd ℂ).compAddChar φ = φ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  ext1 a
  simp only [RingHom.toMonoidHom_eq_coe, MonoidHom.coe_compAddChar, MonoidHom.coe_coe,
    Function.comp_apply, inv_apply']
  have H := Complex.norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity <| φ.val_mem_rootsOfUnity a hR
  exact (Complex.inv_eq_conj H).symm

name: starComp_apply
statement:
lemma starComp_apply (hR : 0 < ringChar R) {φ : AddChar R ℂ} (a : R) :
    (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ a) = φ⁻¹ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← starComp_eq_inv hR]
  rfl

name: at_two
statement: theorem at_two (hp : p ≠ 2) : legendreSym p 2 = χ₈ p
proof:
:= by
  have : (2 : ZMod p) = (2 : ℤ) := by norm_cast
  rw [legendreSym, ← this, quadraticChar_two ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hp), card p]

name: at_neg_two
statement: theorem at_neg_two (hp : p ≠ 2) : legendreSym p (-2) = χ₈' p
proof:
:= by
  have : (-2 : ZMod p) = (-2 : ℤ) := by norm_cast
  rw [legendreSym, ← this, quadraticChar_neg_two ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hp), card p]

name: exists_sq_eq_two_iff
statement: theorem exists_sq_eq_two_iff (hp : p ≠ 2) : IsSquare (2 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 7
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteField.isSquare_two_iff, card p]
  have h₁ := (Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two Fact.out).mpr hp
  lia

name: exists_sq_eq_neg_two_iff
statement: theorem exists_sq_eq_neg_two_iff (hp : p ≠ 2) : IsSquare (-2 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteField.isSquare_neg_two_iff, card p]
  have h₁ := (Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two Fact.out).mpr hp
  lia

name: quadratic_reciprocity
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    legendreSym q p * legendreSym p q = (-1) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hp₁ := (Prime.eq_two_or_odd <| @Fact.out p.Prime _).resolve_left hp
  have hq₁ := (Prime.eq_two_or_odd <| @Fact.out q.Prime _).resolve_left hq
  have hq₂ : ringChar (ZMod q) ≠ 2 := (ringChar_zmod_n q).substr hq
  have h :=
    quadraticChar_odd_prime ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hp) hq ((ringChar_zmod_n p).substr hpq)
  rw [card p] at h
  have nc : ∀ n r : ℕ, ((n : ℤ) : ZMod r) = n := fun n r => by norm_cast
  have nc' : (((-1) ^ (p / 2) : ℤ) : ZMod q) = (-1) ^ (p / 2) := by norm_cast
  rw [legendreSym, legendreSym, nc, nc, h, map_mul, mul_rotate', mul_comm (p / 2), ← pow_two,
    quadraticChar_sq_one (prime_ne_zero q p hpq.symm), mul_one, pow_mul, χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow hp₁, nc',
    map_pow, quadraticChar_neg_one hq₂, card q, χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow hq₁]

name: quadratic_reciprocity'
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity' (hp : p ≠ 2) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q p = (-1) ^ (p / 2 * (q / 2)) * legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p q with rfl | h
  · rw [(eq_zero_iff p p).mpr (mod_cast natCast_self p), mul_zero]
  · have qr := congr_arg (· * legendreSym p q) (quadratic_reciprocity hp hq h)
    have : ((q : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := mod_cast prime_ne_zero p q h
    simpa only [mul_assoc, ← pow_two, sq_one p this, mul_one] using qr

name: quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four (hp : p % 4 = 1) (hq : q ≠ 2) :
    legendreSym q p = legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadratic_reciprocity'
      ((Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two Fact.out).mp (odd_of_mod_four_eq_one hp)) hq,
    pow_mul, neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four hp, one_pow, one_mul]

name: quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four (hp : p % 4 = 3) (hq : q % 4 = 3) :
    legendreSym q p = -legendreSym p q
proof:
:= by
  let nop := @neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four
  rw [quadratic_reciprocity', pow_mul, nop hp, nop hq, neg_one_mul] <;>
  rwa [← Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two Fact.out, odd_of_mod_four_eq_three]

name: exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_one (hp1 : p % 4 = 1) (hq1 : q ≠ 2) :
    IsSquare (q : ZMod p) ↔ IsSquare (p : ZMod q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p q with rfl | h
  · rfl
  · rw [← eq_one_iff' p (prime_ne_zero p q h), ← eq_one_iff' q (prime_ne_zero q p h.symm),
      quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four hp1 hq1]

name: exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_three
statement:
theorem exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_three (hp3 : p % 4 = 3) (hq3 : q % 4 = 3)
    (hpq : p ≠ q) : IsSquare (q : ZMod p) ↔ ¬IsSquare (p : ZMod q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← eq_one_iff' p (prime_ne_zero p q hpq), ← eq_neg_one_iff' q,
    quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four hp3 hq3, neg_inj]

name: Ico_map_valMinAbs_natAbs_eq_Ico_map_id
statement:
theorem Ico_map_valMinAbs_natAbs_eq_Ico_map_id (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (a : ZMod p)
    (hap : a ≠ 0) : ((Ico 1 (p / 2).succ).1.map fun (x : ℕ) => (a * x).valMinAbs.natAbs) =
    (Ico 1 (p / 2).succ).1.map fun a => a
proof:
:= by
  have he : ∀ {x}, x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ → x ≠ 0 ∧ x ≤ p / 2 := by grind
  have hep : ∀ {x}, x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ → x < p := fun hx =>
    lt_of_le_of_lt (he hx).2 (Nat.div_lt_self hp.1.pos (by decide))
  have hpe : ∀ {x}, x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ → ¬p ∣ x := fun hx hpx =>
    not_lt_of_ge (le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (he hx).1) hpx) (hep hx)
  have hmem : ∀ (x : ℕ) (_ : x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ),
      (a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ := by
    intro x hx
    simp [hap, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p, hpe hx, one_le_iff_ne_zero, natAbs_valMinAbs_le _]
  have hsurj : ∀ (b : ℕ) (hb : b ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ),
      ∃ x, ∃ _ : x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, (a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs = b := by
    intro b hb
    refine ⟨(b / a : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs, mem_Ico.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, hap, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p, hpe hb, not_false_iff,
        valMinAbs_eq_zero, inv_eq_zero, Int.natAbs_eq_zero, Ne, _root_.mul_eq_zero, or_self_iff]
    · apply lt_succ_of_le; apply natAbs_valMinAbs_le
    · rw [natCast_natAbs_valMinAbs]
      split_ifs
      · rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hap, valMinAbs_def_pos, val_cast_of_lt (hep hb),
          ite_eq_left (le_of_lt_succ (mem_Ico.1 hb).2), Int.natAbs_natCast]
      · rw [mul_neg, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hap, natAbs_valMinAbs_neg, valMinAbs_def_pos,
          val_cast_of_lt (hep hb), ite_eq_left (le_of_lt_succ (mem_Ico.1 hb).2), Int.natAbs_natCast]
  exact Multiset.map_eq_map_of_bij_of_nodup _ _ (Finset.nodup _) (Finset.nodup _)
    (fun x _ => (a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs) hmem
    (inj_on_of_surj_on_of_card_le _ hmem hsurj le_rfl) hsurj (fun _ _ => rfl)

name: gauss_lemma_aux
proof:
:=
  calc
    (a ^ (p / 2) * (p / 2)! : ZMod p) = ∏ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * x := by
      rw [prod_mul_distrib, ← prod_natCast, prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial, prod_const, card_Ico,
        Nat.add_one_sub_one]; simp
    _ = ∏ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, ↑((a * x : ZMod p).val) := by simp
    _ = ∏ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, (if (a * x : ZMod p).val ≤ p / 2 then (1 : ZMod p) else -1) *
        (a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs :=
      (prod_congr rfl fun _ _ => by
        simp only [natCast_natAbs_valMinAbs]
        split_ifs <;> simp)
    _ = (-1 : ZMod p) ^ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | ¬(a * x.cast : ZMod p).val ≤ p / 2} *
          ∏ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, ↑((a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs) := by
      rw [prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_ite]
      simp
    _ = (-1 : ZMod p) ^ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | ¬(a * x.cast : ZMod p).val ≤ p / 2} *
          (p / 2)! := by
      rw [← prod_natCast, Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod,
        Ico_map_valMinAbs_natAbs_eq_Ico_map_id p a hap, ← Finset.prod_eq_multiset_prod,
        prod_Ico_id_eq_factorial]

name: gauss_lemma_aux
statement:
theorem gauss_lemma_aux (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (hap : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    (a ^ (p / 2) : ZMod p) =
      ((-1) ^ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} :)
proof:
:=
  (mul_left_inj' (show ((p / 2)! : ZMod p) ≠ 0 by
    rw [Ne, CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff (ZMod p) p, hp.1.dvd_factorial, not_le]
    exact Nat.div_lt_self hp.1.pos (by decide))).1 <| by
      simpa using gauss_lemma_aux₁ p hap

name: gauss_lemma
statement:
theorem gauss_lemma {p : ℕ} [h : Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (hp : p ≠ 2) (ha0 : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    legendreSym p a = (-1) ^ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val}
proof:
:= by
  replace hp : Odd p := h.out.odd_of_ne_two hp
  have : (legendreSym p a : ZMod p) =
      (((-1) ^ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} : ℤ) : ZMod p) := by
    rw [legendreSym.eq_pow, gauss_lemma_aux p ha0]
  cases legendreSym.eq_one_or_neg_one p ha0 <;>
  cases neg_one_pow_eq_or ℤ #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} <;>
  simp_all [ne_neg_self hp one_ne_zero, (ne_neg_self hp one_ne_zero).symm]

name: eisenstein_lemma_aux
statement:
private theorem eisenstein_lemma_aux₁ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [hp2 : Fact (p % 2 = 1)] {a : ℕ}
    (hap : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    ((∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * x : ℕ) : ZMod 2) =
      #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} +
        ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, x + (∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * x / p : ℕ)
proof:
:=
  have hp2 : (p : ZMod 2) = (1 : ℕ) := (natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).2 hp2.1
  calc
    ((∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * x : ℕ) : ZMod 2) =
        ((∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, (a * x % p + p * (a * x / p)) : ℕ) : ZMod 2) := by
      simp only [mod_add_div]
    _ = (∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, ((a * x : ℕ) : ZMod p).val : ℕ) +
        (∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * x / p : ℕ) := by
      simp only [val_natCast]
      simp [sum_add_distrib, ← mul_sum, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sum, hp2]
    _ = _ :=
      congr_arg (· + _) <|
        calc
          ((∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, ((a * x : ℕ) : ZMod p).val : ℕ) : ZMod 2) =
              ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, (((a * x : ZMod p).valMinAbs +
                if (a * x : ZMod p).val ≤ p / 2 then 0 else p : ℤ) : ZMod 2) := by
            simp only [(val_eq_ite_valMinAbs _).symm]; simp [Nat.cast_sum]
          _ = #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} +
              (∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, (a * x.cast : ZMod p).valMinAbs.natAbs : ℕ) := by
            simp [add_comm, sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite, hp2, Nat.cast_sum]
          _ = _ := by
            rw [Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum, Ico_map_valMinAbs_natAbs_eq_Ico_map_id p a hap, ←
              Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]

name: eisenstein_lemma_aux
statement:
theorem eisenstein_lemma_aux (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact (p % 2 = 1)] {a : ℕ} (ha2 : a % 2 = 1)
    (hap : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | p / 2 < (a * x.cast : ZMod p).val} ≡
      ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, x * a / p [MOD 2]
proof:
:=
  have ha2 : (a : ZMod 2) = (1 : ℕ) := (natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).2 ha2
  (natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ 2).1 <| sub_eq_zero.1 <| by
    simpa [add_left_comm, sub_eq_add_neg, ← mul_sum, mul_comm, ha2, Nat.cast_sum,
      add_neg_eq_iff_eq_add.symm, add_assoc] using
      Eq.symm (eisenstein_lemma_aux₁ p hap)

name: div_eq_filter_card
statement:
theorem div_eq_filter_card {a b c : ℕ} (hb0 : 0 < b) (hc : a / b ≤ c) :
    a / b = #{x ∈ Ico 1 c.succ | x * b ≤ a}
proof:
:=
  calc
    a / b = #(Ico 1 (a / b).succ) := by simp
    _ = #{x ∈ Ico 1 c.succ | x * b ≤ a} :=
      congr_arg _ <| Finset.ext fun x => by
        have : x * b ≤ a → x ≤ c := fun h => le_trans (by rwa [le_div_iff_mul_le hb0]) hc
        simp [le_div_iff_mul_le hb0]; tauto

name: sum_Ico_eq_card_lt
proof:
:=
  if hp0 : p = 0 then by simp [hp0]
  else
    calc
      ∑ a ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * q / p =
          ∑ a ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, #{x ∈ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x * p ≤ a * q} :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x hx => div_eq_filter_card (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hp0) <|
          calc
            x * q / p ≤ p / 2 * q / p := by have := le_of_lt_succ (mem_Ico.mp hx).2; gcongr
            _ ≤ _ := Nat.div_mul_div_le_div _ _ _
      _ = _ := by simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter, sum_product]

name: sum_mul_div_add_sum_mul_div_eq_mul
statement:
theorem sum_mul_div_add_sum_mul_div_eq_mul (p q : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hq0 : (q : ZMod p) ≠ 0) :
    ∑ a ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, a * q / p + ∑ a ∈ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ, a * p / q =
    p / 2 * (q / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hswap :
    #{x ∈ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ | x.2 * q ≤ x.1 * p} =
      #{x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x.1 * q ≤ x.2 * p} :=
    card_equiv (Equiv.prodComm _ _)
      (fun ⟨_, _⟩ => by
        simp +contextual only [mem_filter, Prod.swap_prod_mk,
          mem_product, Equiv.prodComm_apply, and_assoc, and_left_comm])
  have hdisj :
    Disjoint {x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x.2 * p ≤ x.1 * q}
      {x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x.1 * q ≤ x.2 * p} := by
    apply disjoint_filter.2 fun x hx hpq hqp => ?_
    have hxp : x.1 < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (b := p / 2)
      (by grind) (Nat.div_lt_self hp.1.pos (by decide))
    have : (x.1 : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      simpa [hq0] using congr_arg ((↑) : ℕ → ZMod p) (le_antisymm hpq hqp)
    apply_fun ZMod.val at this
    rw [val_cast_of_lt hxp, val_zero] at this
    simp only [this, nonpos_iff_eq_zero, mem_Ico, one_ne_zero, false_and, mem_product] at hx
  have hunion :
      {x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x.2 * p ≤ x.1 * q} ∪
        {x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ | x.1 * q ≤ x.2 * p} =
      Ico 1 (p / 2).succ ×ˢ Ico 1 (q / 2).succ :=
    Finset.ext fun x => by
      have := le_total (x.2 * p) (x.1 * q)
      simp only [mem_union, mem_filter, mem_Ico, mem_product]
      tauto
  rw [sum_Ico_eq_card_lt, sum_Ico_eq_card_lt, hswap, ← card_union_of_disjoint hdisj, hunion,
    card_product]
  simp only [card_Ico, succ_sub_succ_eq_sub, Nat.sub_zero]

name: eisenstein_lemma
statement:
theorem eisenstein_lemma {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p ≠ 2) {a : ℕ} (ha1 : a % 2 = 1)
    (ha0 : (a : ZMod p) ≠ 0) : legendreSym p a = (-1) ^ ∑ x ∈ Ico 1 (p / 2).succ, x * a / p
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : Fact (p % 2 = 1) := ⟨(Nat.Prime.mod_two_eq_one_iff_ne_two Fact.out).mpr hp⟩
  have ha0' : ((a : ℤ) : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := by norm_cast
  rw [neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two, gauss_lemma hp ha0', neg_one_pow_eq_pow_mod_two,
    (by norm_cast : ((a : ℤ) : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p)),
    show _ = _ from eisenstein_lemma_aux p ha1 ha0]

name: ringChar_ne
statement: lemma ringChar_ne : ringChar ℂ ≠ ringChar F
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ringChar.eq_zero] using (CharP.ringChar_ne_zero_of_finite F).symm

name: isQuadratic_
statement: theorem isQuadratic_χ₄ : χ₄.IsQuadratic
proof:
:= by
  unfold MulChar.IsQuadratic
  decide

name: neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four {n : ℕ} (hn : n % 4 = 1) : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n / 2) = 1
proof:
:=
  χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow (Nat.odd_of_mod_four_eq_one hn) ▸ χ₄_nat_one_mod_four hn

name: neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four
statement: theorem neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four {n : ℕ} (hn : n % 4 = 3) : (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n / 2) = -1
proof:
:=
  χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow (Nat.odd_of_mod_four_eq_three hn) ▸ χ₄_nat_three_mod_four hn

name: isQuadratic_
statement: theorem isQuadratic_χ₈ : χ₈.IsQuadratic
proof:
:= by
  unfold MulChar.IsQuadratic
  decide

name: isQuadratic_
statement: theorem isQuadratic_χ₈' : χ₈'.IsQuadratic
proof:
:= by
  unfold MulChar.IsQuadratic
  decide

name: zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_right (a : ℤ) : J(a | 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jacobiSym, primeFactorsList_zero, List.prod_nil, List.pmap]

name: one_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_right (a : ℤ) : J(a | 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jacobiSym, primeFactorsList_one, List.prod_nil, List.pmap]

name: legendreSym.to_jacobiSym
statement:
theorem legendreSym.to_jacobiSym (p : ℕ) [fp : Fact p.Prime] (a : ℤ) :
    legendreSym p a = J(a | p)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jacobiSym, primeFactorsList_prime fp.1, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one,
    List.pmap]

name: mul_right'
statement:
theorem mul_right' (a : ℤ) {b₁ b₂ : ℕ} (hb₁ : b₁ ≠ 0) (hb₂ : b₂ ≠ 0) :
    J(a | b₁ * b₂) = J(a | b₁) * J(a | b₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobiSym, ((perm_primeFactorsList_mul hb₁ hb₂).pmap _).prod_eq, List.pmap_append,
    List.prod_append]
  pick_goal 2
  · exact fun p hp =>
      (List.mem_append.mp hp).elim prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList
  · rfl

name: mul_right
statement:
theorem mul_right (a : ℤ) (b₁ b₂ : ℕ) [NeZero b₁] [NeZero b₂] :
    J(a | b₁ * b₂) = J(a | b₁) * J(a | b₂)
proof:
:=
  mul_right' a (NeZero.ne b₁) (NeZero.ne b₂)

name: trichotomy
statement: theorem trichotomy (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : J(a | b) = 0 ∨ J(a | b) = 1 ∨ J(a | b) = -1
proof:
:=
  ((MonoidHom.mrange (@SignType.castHom ℤ _ _).toMonoidHom).copy {0, 1, -1} <| by
    rw [Set.pair_comm]
    exact (SignType.range_eq SignType.castHom).symm).list_prod_mem
      (by
        intro _ ha'
        rcases List.mem_pmap.mp ha' with ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
        have : Fact p.Prime := ⟨prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hp⟩
        exact quadraticChar_isQuadratic (ZMod p) a)

name: one_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_left (b : ℕ) : J(1 | b) = 1
proof:
:=
  List.prod_eq_one fun z hz => by
    let ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := List.mem_pmap.1 hz
    rw [← he, legendreSym.at_one]

name: mul_left
statement: theorem mul_left (a₁ a₂ : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : J(a₁ * a₂ | b) = J(a₁ | b) * J(a₂ | b)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [jacobiSym, List.pmap_eq_map_attach, legendreSym.mul]
  exact List.prod_map_mul (l := (primeFactorsList b).attach)
    (f := fun x ↦ @legendreSym x { out := prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList x.2 } a₁)
    (g := fun x ↦ @legendreSym x { out := prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList x.2 } a₂)

name: eq_zero_iff_not_coprime
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff_not_coprime {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} [NeZero b] : J(a | b) = 0 ↔ a.gcd b ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  List.prod_eq_zero_iff.trans
    (by
      rw [List.mem_pmap, Int.gcd_eq_natAbs, Ne, Prime.not_coprime_iff_dvd]
      simp_rw [legendreSym.eq_zero_iff _ _, intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd,
        mem_primeFactorsList (NeZero.ne b), ← Int.natCast_dvd, Int.natCast_dvd_natCast, exists_prop,
        and_assoc, _root_.and_comm])

name: ne_zero
statement: protected theorem ne_zero {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b = 1) : J(a | b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_neZero b with hb | _
  · rw [hb, zero_right]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · contrapose! h; exact eq_zero_iff_not_coprime.1 h

name: eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem eq_zero_iff {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} : J(a | b) = 0 ↔ b ≠ 0 ∧ a.gcd b ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with hb | hb
    · rw [hb, zero_right] at h; cases h
    exact ⟨hb, mt jacobiSym.ne_zero <| Classical.not_not.2 h⟩, fun ⟨hb, h⟩ => by
    rw [← neZero_iff] at hb; exact eq_zero_iff_not_coprime.2 h⟩

name: zero_left
statement: theorem zero_left {b : ℕ} (hb : 1 < b) : J(0 | b) = 0
proof:
:=
  (@eq_zero_iff_not_coprime 0 b ⟨ne_zero_of_lt hb⟩).mpr <| by
    rw [Int.gcd_zero_left, Int.natAbs_natCast]; exact hb.ne'

name: eq_one_or_neg_one
statement: theorem eq_one_or_neg_one {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b = 1) : J(a | b) = 1 ∨ J(a | b) = -1
proof:
:=
  (trichotomy a b).resolve_left <| jacobiSym.ne_zero h

name: pow_left
statement: theorem pow_left (a : ℤ) (e b : ℕ) : J(a ^ e | b) = J(a | b) ^ e
proof:
:=
  Nat.recOn e (by rw [_root_.pow_zero, _root_.pow_zero, one_left]) fun _ ih => by
    rw [_root_.pow_succ, _root_.pow_succ, mul_left, ih]

name: pow_right
statement: theorem pow_right (a : ℤ) (b e : ℕ) : J(a | b ^ e) = J(a | b) ^ e
proof:
:= by
  induction e with
  | zero => rw [Nat.pow_zero, _root_.pow_zero, one_right]
  | succ e ih =>
    rcases eq_zero_or_neZero b with hb | _
    · rw [hb, zero_pow e.succ_ne_zero, zero_right, one_pow]
    · rw [_root_.pow_succ, _root_.pow_succ, mul_right, ih]

name: sq_one
statement: theorem sq_one {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b = 1) : J(a | b) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_one_or_neg_one h with h₁ | h₁ <;> rw [h₁] <;> rfl

name: sq_one'
statement: theorem sq_one' {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a.gcd b = 1) : J(a ^ 2 | b) = 1
proof: := by rw [pow_left, sq_one h]

name: mod_left
statement: theorem mod_left (a : ℤ) (b : ℕ) : J(a | b) = J(a % b | b)
proof:
:=
  congr_arg List.prod <|
    List.pmap_congr_left _
      (by
        rintro p hp _ h₂
        conv_rhs =>
          rw [legendreSym.mod, Int.emod_emod_of_dvd _ (Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.2 <|
            dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hp), ← legendreSym.mod])

name: mod_left'
statement: theorem mod_left' {a₁ a₂ : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : a₁ % b = a₂ % b) : J(a₁ | b) = J(a₂ | b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mod_left, h, ← mod_left]

name: prime_dvd_of_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem prime_dvd_of_eq_neg_one {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] {a : ℤ} (h : J(a | p) = -1) {x y : ℤ}
    (hxy : ↑p ∣ (x ^ 2 - a * y ^ 2 : ℤ)) : ↑p ∣ x ∧ ↑p ∣ y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← legendreSym.to_jacobiSym] at h
  exact legendreSym.prime_dvd_of_eq_neg_one h hxy

name: list_prod_left
statement: theorem list_prod_left {l : List ℤ} {n : ℕ} : J(l.prod | n) = (l.map fun a => J(a | n)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [List.prod_nil, List.map_nil, one_left]
  | cons n l' ih => rw [List.map, List.prod_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_left, ih]

name: list_prod_right
statement:
theorem list_prod_right {a : ℤ} {l : List ℕ} (hl : ∀ n ∈ l, n ≠ 0) :
    J(a | l.prod) = (l.map fun n => J(a | n)).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp only [List.prod_nil, one_right, List.map_nil]
  | cons n l' ih =>
    have hn := hl n List.mem_cons_self
    
    have hl' := List.prod_ne_zero fun hf => hl 0 (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf) rfl
    
    have h := fun m hm => hl m (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hm)
    
    rw [List.map, List.prod_cons, List.prod_cons, mul_right' a hn hl', ih h]

name: eq_neg_one_at_prime_divisor_of_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem eq_neg_one_at_prime_divisor_of_eq_neg_one {a : ℤ} {n : ℕ} (h : J(a | n) = -1) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p ∣ n ∧ J(a | p) = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hn₀ : n ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [zero_right, CharZero.eq_neg_self_iff] at h
    exact one_ne_zero h
  have hf₀ (p) (hp : p ∈ n.primeFactorsList) : p ≠ 0 := (Nat.pos_of_mem_primeFactorsList hp).ne.symm
  rw [← Nat.prod_primeFactorsList hn₀, list_prod_right hf₀] at h
  obtain ⟨p, hmem, hj⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.neg_one_mem_of_prod_eq_neg_one h)
  exact ⟨p, Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList hmem, Nat.dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList hmem, hj⟩

name: nonsquare_of_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem nonsquare_of_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (h : J(a | b) = -1) :
    ¬IsSquare (a : ZMod b)
proof:
:= fun ⟨r, ha⟩ => by
  rw [← r.coe_valMinAbs, ← Int.cast_mul, intCast_eq_intCast_iff', ← sq] at ha
  apply (by simp : ¬(0 : ℤ) ≤ -1)
  rw [← h, mod_left, ha, ← mod_left, pow_left]
  apply sq_nonneg

name: nonsquare_iff_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one
statement:
theorem nonsquare_iff_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one {a : ℤ} {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] :
    J(a | p) = -1 ↔ ¬IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← legendreSym.to_jacobiSym]
  exact legendreSym.eq_neg_one_iff p

name: isSquare_of_jacobiSym_eq_one
statement:
theorem isSquare_of_jacobiSym_eq_one {a : ℤ} {p : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (h : J(a | p) = 1) :
    IsSquare (a : ZMod p)
proof:
:=
  Classical.not_not.mp <| by rw [← nonsquare_iff_jacobiSym_eq_neg_one, h]; decide

name: value_at
statement:
theorem value_at (a : ℤ) {R : Type*} [Semiring R] (χ : R →* ℤ)
    (hp : ∀ (p : ℕ) (pp : p.Prime), p ≠ 2 → @legendreSym p ⟨pp⟩ a = χ p) {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) :
    J(a | b) = χ b
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← prod_primeFactorsList hb.pos.ne', cast_list_prod, map_list_prod χ]
  rw [jacobiSym, List.map_map, ← List.pmap_eq_map
    fun _ => prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList]
  congr 1; apply List.pmap_congr_left
  exact fun p h pp _ => hp p pp (hb.ne_two_of_dvd_nat <| dvd_of_mem_primeFactorsList h)

name: at_neg_one
statement: theorem at_neg_one {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(-1 | b) = χ₄ b
proof:
:=
  
  
  value_at (-1) χ₄.toMonoidHom (fun p pp => @legendreSym.at_neg_one p ⟨pp⟩) hb

name: neg
statement: protected theorem neg (a : ℤ) {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(-a | b) = χ₄ b * J(a | b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_eq_neg_one_mul, mul_left, at_neg_one hb]

name: at_two
statement: theorem at_two {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(2 | b) = χ₈ b
proof:
:=
  value_at 2 χ₈.toMonoidHom (fun p pp => @legendreSym.at_two p ⟨pp⟩) hb

name: at_neg_two
statement: theorem at_neg_two {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(-2 | b) = χ₈' b
proof:
:=
  value_at (-2) χ₈'.toMonoidHom (fun p pp => @legendreSym.at_neg_two p ⟨pp⟩) hb

name: div_four_left
statement:
theorem div_four_left {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (ha4 : a % 4 = 0) (hb2 : b % 2 = 1) :
    J(a / 4 | b) = J(a | b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ha4
  have : Int.gcd (2 : ℕ) b = 1 := by
    rw [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, ← b.mod_add_div 2, hb2, Nat.gcd_add_mul_left_right,
      Nat.gcd_one_right]
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by decide), jacobiSym.mul_left,
    (by decide : (4 : ℤ) = (2 : ℕ) ^ 2), jacobiSym.sq_one' this, one_mul]

name: at_four
statement: theorem at_four {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(4 | b) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : J((4 : ℤ) | b) = J((4 : ℤ) / 4 | b) :=
    (div_four_left (by decide) (Nat.odd_iff.mp hb)).symm
  simpa [one_left]

name: even_odd
statement:
theorem even_odd {a : ℤ} {b : ℕ} (ha2 : a % 2 = 0) (hb2 : b % 2 = 1) :
    (if b % 8 = 3 ∨ b % 8 = 5 then -J(a / 2 | b) else J(a / 2 | b)) = J(a | b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ha2
  rw [Int.mul_ediv_cancel_left _ (by decide), jacobiSym.mul_left,
    jacobiSym.at_two (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hb2), ZMod.χ₈_nat_eq_if_mod_eight,
    ite_eq_right (Nat.mod_two_ne_zero.mpr hb2)]
  grind

name: neg_one_pow
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow {m n : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hn : Odd n) :
    qrSign m n = (-1) ^ (m / 2 * (n / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [qrSign, pow_mul, ← χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow (odd_iff.mp hm)]
  rcases odd_mod_four_iff.mp (odd_iff.mp hm) with h | h
  · rw [χ₄_nat_one_mod_four h, jacobiSym.one_left, one_pow]
  · rw [χ₄_nat_three_mod_four h, ← χ₄_eq_neg_one_pow (odd_iff.mp hn), jacobiSym.at_neg_one hn]

name: sq_eq_one
statement: theorem sq_eq_one {m n : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hn : Odd n) : qrSign m n ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_one_pow hm hn, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]

name: mul_left
statement: theorem mul_left (m₁ m₂ n : ℕ) : qrSign (m₁ * m₂) n = qrSign m₁ n * qrSign m₂ n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [qrSign, Nat.cast_mul, map_mul, jacobiSym.mul_left]

name: mul_right
statement:
theorem mul_right (m n₁ n₂ : ℕ) [NeZero n₁] [NeZero n₂] :
    qrSign m (n₁ * n₂) = qrSign m n₁ * qrSign m n₂
proof:
:=
  jacobiSym.mul_right (χ₄ m) n₁ n₂

name: symm
statement: protected theorem symm {m n : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hn : Odd n) : qrSign m n = qrSign n m
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_one_pow hm hn, neg_one_pow hn hm, mul_comm (m / 2)]

name: eq_iff_eq
statement:
theorem eq_iff_eq {m n : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hn : Odd n) (x y : ℤ) :
    qrSign m n * x = y ↔ x = qrSign m n * y
proof:
:= by
  refine
      ⟨fun h' =>
        let h := h'.symm
        ?_,
        fun h => ?_⟩ <;>
    rw [h, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_two, sq_eq_one hm hn, one_mul]

name: quadratic_reciprocity'
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity' {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b) :
    J(a | b) = qrSign b a * J(b | a)
proof:
:= by
  
  let rhs : ℕ → ℕ →* ℤ := fun a =>
    { toFun := fun x => qrSign x a * J(x | a)
      map_one' := by convert! ← mul_one (M := ℤ) _; (on_goal 1 => symm); all_goals apply one_left
      map_mul' := fun x y => by
        simp_rw [qrSign.mul_left x y a, Nat.cast_mul, mul_left, mul_mul_mul_comm] }
  have rhs_apply : ∀ a b : ℕ, rhs a b = qrSign b a * J(b | a) := fun a b => rfl
  refine value_at a (rhs a) (fun p pp hp => Eq.symm ?_) hb
  have hpo := pp.eq_two_or_odd'.resolve_left hp
  rw [@legendreSym.to_jacobiSym p ⟨pp⟩, rhs_apply, Nat.cast_id, qrSign.eq_iff_eq hpo ha,
    qrSign.symm hpo ha]
  refine value_at p (rhs p) (fun q pq hq => ?_) ha
  have hqo := pq.eq_two_or_odd'.resolve_left hq
  rw [rhs_apply, Nat.cast_id, ← @legendreSym.to_jacobiSym p ⟨pp⟩, qrSign.symm hqo hpo,
    qrSign.neg_one_pow hpo hqo, @legendreSym.quadratic_reciprocity' p q ⟨pp⟩ ⟨pq⟩ hp hq]

name: quadratic_reciprocity
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : Odd b) :
    J(a | b) = (-1) ^ (a / 2 * (b / 2)) * J(b | a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← qrSign.neg_one_pow ha hb, qrSign.symm ha hb, quadratic_reciprocity' ha hb]

name: quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four {a b : ℕ} (ha : a % 4 = 1) (hb : Odd b) :
    J(a | b) = J(b | a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadratic_reciprocity (odd_iff.mpr (odd_of_mod_four_eq_one ha)) hb, pow_mul,
    neg_one_pow_div_two_of_one_mod_four ha, one_pow, one_mul]

name: quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four'
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four' {a b : ℕ} (ha : Odd a) (hb : b % 4 = 1) :
    J(a | b) = J(b | a)
proof:
:=
  (quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four hb ha).symm

name: quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four {a b : ℕ} (ha : a % 4 = 3) (hb : b % 4 = 3) :
    J(a | b) = -J(b | a)
proof:
:= by
  let nop := @neg_one_pow_div_two_of_three_mod_four
  rw [quadratic_reciprocity, pow_mul, nop ha, nop hb, neg_one_mul] <;>
    rwa [odd_iff, odd_of_mod_four_eq_three]

name: quadratic_reciprocity_if
statement:
theorem quadratic_reciprocity_if {a b : ℕ} (ha2 : a % 2 = 1) (hb2 : b % 2 = 1) :
    (if a % 4 = 3 ∧ b % 4 = 3 then -J(b | a) else J(b | a)) = J(a | b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.odd_mod_four_iff.mp ha2 with ha1 | ha3
  · simpa [ha1] using jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four' (Nat.odd_iff.mpr hb2) ha1
  rcases Nat.odd_mod_four_iff.mp hb2 with hb1 | hb3
  · simpa [hb1] using jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_one_mod_four hb1 (Nat.odd_iff.mpr ha2)
  simpa [ha3, hb3] using (jacobiSym.quadratic_reciprocity_three_mod_four ha3 hb3).symm

name: mod_right'
statement: theorem mod_right' (a : ℕ) {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(a | b) = J(a | b % (4 * a))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha₀)
  · rw [mul_zero, mod_zero]
  have hb' : Odd (b % (4 * a)) := hb.mod_even (Even.mul_right (by decide) _)
  rcases exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd ha₀ 2 (by simp) with ⟨e, a', ha₁', ha₂⟩
  have ha₁ := odd_iff.mpr (two_dvd_ne_zero.mp ha₁')
  nth_rw 2 [ha₂]; nth_rw 1 [ha₂]
  rw [Nat.cast_mul, mul_left, mul_left, quadratic_reciprocity' ha₁ hb,
    quadratic_reciprocity' ha₁ hb', Nat.cast_pow, pow_left, pow_left, Nat.cast_two, at_two hb,
    at_two hb']
  congr 1; swap
  · congr 1
    · simp_rw [qrSign]
      rw [χ₄_nat_mod_four, χ₄_nat_mod_four (b % (4 * a)), mod_mod_of_dvd b (dvd_mul_right 4 a)]
    · rw [mod_left ↑(b % _), mod_left b, Int.natCast_mod, Int.emod_emod_of_dvd b]
      simp only [ha₂, Nat.cast_mul, ← mul_assoc]
      apply dvd_mul_left
  rcases e with - | e; · simp
  · rw [χ₈_nat_mod_eight, χ₈_nat_mod_eight (b % (4 * a)), mod_mod_of_dvd b]
    use 2 ^ e * a'; rw [ha₂, Nat.pow_succ]; ring

name: mod_right
statement: theorem mod_right (a : ℤ) {b : ℕ} (hb : Odd b) : J(a | b) = J(a | b % (4 * a.natAbs))
proof:
:= by
  rcases Int.natAbs_eq a with ha | ha <;> nth_rw 2 [ha] <;> nth_rw 1 [ha]
  · exact mod_right' a.natAbs hb
  · have hb' : Odd (b % (4 * a.natAbs)) := hb.mod_even (Even.mul_right (by decide) _)
    rw [jacobiSym.neg _ hb, jacobiSym.neg _ hb', mod_right' _ hb, χ₄_nat_mod_four,
      χ₄_nat_mod_four (b % (4 * _)), mod_mod_of_dvd b (dvd_mul_right 4 _)]

name: fastJacobiSymAux.eq_jacobiSym
proof:
:= by
  induction a using Nat.strongRecOn generalizing b flip with | ind a IH =>
  unfold fastJacobiSymAux
  split <;> rename_i ha4
  · rw [IH (a / 4) (a.div_lt_self ha0 (by decide)) hb2 hb1]
    simp only [Int.natCast_ediv, Nat.cast_ofNat, div_four_left (a := a) (mod_cast ha4) hb2]
  split <;> rename_i ha2
  · rw [IH (a / 2) (a.div_lt_self ha0 (by decide)) hb2 hb1]
    simp only [Int.natCast_ediv, Nat.cast_ofNat, ← even_odd (a := a) (mod_cast ha2) hb2]
    by_cases h : b % 8 = 3 ∨ b % 8 = 5 <;> simp [h]; cases flip <;> simp
  split <;> rename_i ha1
  · subst ha1; simp
  split <;> rename_i hba
  · suffices J(a | b) = 0 by simp [this]
    refine eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨fun h ↦ absurd (h ▸ hb1) (by decide), ?_⟩
    rwa [Int.gcd_natCast_natCast, Nat.gcd_eq_left (Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hba)]
  rw [IH (b % a) (b.mod_lt ha0) (Nat.mod_two_ne_zero.mp ha2) (lt_of_le_of_ne ha0 (Ne.symm ha1))]
  simp only [Int.natCast_mod, ← mod_left]
  rw [← quadratic_reciprocity_if (Nat.mod_two_ne_zero.mp ha2) hb2]
  by_cases h : a % 4 = 3 ∧ b % 4 = 3 <;> simp [h]; cases flip <;> simp

name: fastJacobiSym.eq
statement: @[csimp] private theorem fastJacobiSym.eq : jacobiSym = fastJacobiSym
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  induction b using Nat.strongRecOn with | ind b IH =>
  unfold fastJacobiSym
  split_ifs with hb0 hb2 ha2 hb1 hab
  · rw [hb0, zero_right]
  · refine eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨hb0, ne_of_gt ?_⟩
    refine Nat.le_of_dvd (Int.gcd_pos_iff.mpr (mod_cast .inr hb0)) ?_
    refine Nat.dvd_gcd (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero ha2)) ?_
    exact Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mp (Int.dvd_of_emod_eq_zero (mod_cast hb2))
  · dsimp only
    rw [← IH (b / 2) (b.div_lt_self (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb0) one_lt_two)]
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Nat.dvd_of_mod_eq_zero hb2
    rw [mul_right' a (by decide) fun h ↦ hb0 (mul_eq_zero_of_right 2 h),
      b.mul_div_cancel_left (by decide), mod_left a 2, Nat.cast_ofNat,
      Int.emod_two_ne_zero.mp ha2, one_left, one_mul]
  · rw [hb1, one_right]
  · rw [mod_left, hab, zero_left (lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb0) (Ne.symm hb1))]
  · rw [fastJacobiSymAux.eq_jacobiSym, ite_eq_right Bool.false_ne_true, mod_left a b,
      Int.natAbs_of_nonneg (a.emod_nonneg (mod_cast hb0))]
    · exact Nat.mod_two_ne_zero.mp hb2
    · exact lt_of_le_of_ne (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb0) (Ne.symm hb1)

name: fastLegendreSym.eq
statement: @[csimp] private theorem fastLegendreSym.eq : legendreSym = fastLegendreSym
proof:
:= by
  ext p _ a; rw [legendreSym.to_jacobiSym, fastLegendreSym]

name: zeta_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeta_apply {x : ℕ} : ζ x = if x = 0 then 0 else 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: zeta_apply_ne
statement: theorem zeta_apply_ne {x : ℕ} (h : x ≠ 0) : ζ x = 1
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right h

name: zeta_eq_zero
statement: theorem zeta_eq_zero {x : ℕ} : ζ x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof: := by simp [zeta]

name: zeta_pos
statement: theorem zeta_pos {x : ℕ} : 0 < ζ x ↔ 0 < x
proof: := by simp [pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: coe_zeta_smul_apply
statement:
theorem coe_zeta_smul_apply {M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [MulAction R M]
    {f : ArithmeticFunction M} {x : ℕ} :
    ((↑ζ : ArithmeticFunction R) • f) x = ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_apply]
  trans ∑ i ∈ divisorsAntidiagonal x, f i.snd
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    rcases mem_divisorsAntidiagonal.1 hi with ⟨rfl, h⟩
    rw [natCoe_apply, zeta_apply_ne (left_ne_zero_of_mul h), cast_one, one_smul]
  · rw [← map_div_left_divisors, sum_map, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]

name: sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_eq_sum_divisors
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sum_divisorsAntidiagonal_eq_sum_divisors {M} [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [MulAction R M]
    {f : ArithmeticFunction M} {x : ℕ} :
    (∑ x ∈ x.divisorsAntidiagonal, if x.1 = 0 then (0 : R) • f x.2 else f x.2) =
      ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:= by
  simp [← coe_zeta_smul_apply (R := R)]

name: coe_zeta_mul_comm
statement: theorem coe_zeta_mul_comm [Semiring R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R} : ζ * f = f * ζ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp_rw [mul_apply, natCoe_apply, (cast_commute ..).eq]
  rw [sum_divisorsAntidiagonal fun x y ↦ f y * ζ x, sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' fun x y ↦ f x * ζ y]

name: coe_zeta_mul_apply
statement:
theorem coe_zeta_mul_apply [Semiring R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R} {x : ℕ} :
    (ζ * f) x = ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:=
  coe_zeta_smul_apply

name: coe_mul_zeta_apply
statement:
theorem coe_mul_zeta_apply [Semiring R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R} {x : ℕ} :
    (f * ζ) x = ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_zeta_mul_comm, coe_zeta_mul_apply]

name: zeta_mul_apply
statement: theorem zeta_mul_apply {f : ArithmeticFunction ℕ} {x : ℕ} : (ζ * f) x = ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natCoe_nat ζ, coe_zeta_mul_apply]

name: mul_zeta_apply
statement: theorem mul_zeta_apply {f : ArithmeticFunction ℕ} {x : ℕ} : (f * ζ) x = ∑ i ∈ divisors x, f i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natCoe_nat ζ, coe_mul_zeta_apply]

name: zeta_mul_comm
statement: theorem zeta_mul_comm {f : ArithmeticFunction ℕ} : ζ * f = f * ζ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← natCoe_nat ζ, coe_zeta_mul_comm]

name: pmul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pmul_apply [MulZeroClass R] {f g : ArithmeticFunction R} {x : ℕ} : f.pmul g x = f x * g x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: pmul_comm
statement: theorem pmul_comm [CommMonoidWithZero R] (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) : f.pmul g = g.pmul f
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [mul_comm]

name: pmul_assoc
statement:
lemma pmul_assoc [SemigroupWithZero R] (f₁ f₂ f₃ : ArithmeticFunction R) :
    pmul (pmul f₁ f₂) f₃ = pmul f₁ (pmul f₂ f₃)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [pmul_apply, mul_assoc]

name: pmul_zeta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pmul_zeta (f : ArithmeticFunction R) : f.pmul ↑ζ = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  cases x <;> simp

name: zeta_pmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeta_pmul (f : ArithmeticFunction R) : (ζ : ArithmeticFunction R).pmul f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  cases x <;> simp

name: ppow_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ppow_zero {f : ArithmeticFunction R} : f.ppow 0 = ζ
proof: := by rw [ppow, dite_eq_left rfl]

name: ppow_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ppow_one {f : ArithmeticFunction R} : f.ppow 1 = f
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp [ppow]

name: ppow_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ppow_apply {f : ArithmeticFunction R} {k x : ℕ} (kpos : 0 < k) : f.ppow k x = f x ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ppow, dite_eq_right (Nat.ne_of_gt kpos), coe_mk]

name: ppow_succ'
statement: theorem ppow_succ' {f : ArithmeticFunction R} {k : ℕ} : f.ppow (k + 1) = f.pmul (f.ppow k)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [ppow_apply (succ_pos k), _root_.pow_succ']
  induction k <;> simp

name: ppow_succ
statement:
theorem ppow_succ {f : ArithmeticFunction R} {k : ℕ} {kpos : 0 < k} :
    f.ppow (k + 1) = (f.ppow k).pmul f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [ppow_apply (succ_pos k), _root_.pow_succ]
  induction k <;> simp

name: pdiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pdiv_apply [GroupWithZero R] (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) (n : ℕ) :
    pdiv f g n = f n / g n
proof: := rfl

name: pdiv_zeta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pdiv_zeta [DivisionSemiring R] (f : ArithmeticFunction R) :
    pdiv f zeta = f
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  cases n <;> simp

name: isMultiplicative_zeta
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_zeta : IsMultiplicative ζ
proof:
:=
  IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero.2 ⟨by simp, by simp +contextual⟩

name: pmul
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem pmul [CommSemiring R] {f g : ArithmeticFunction R} (hf : f.IsMultiplicative)
    (hg : g.IsMultiplicative) : IsMultiplicative (f.pmul g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [hf, hg], fun cop => by
    simp only [pmul_apply, hf.map_mul_of_coprime cop, hg.map_mul_of_coprime cop]
    ring⟩

name: pdiv
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem pdiv [CommGroupWithZero R] {f g : ArithmeticFunction R} (hf : IsMultiplicative f)
    (hg : IsMultiplicative g) : IsMultiplicative (pdiv f g)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [hf, hg], fun cop => by
    simp only [pdiv_apply, map_mul_of_coprime hf cop, map_mul_of_coprime hg cop, div_eq_mul_inv,
      mul_inv]
    apply mul_mul_mul_comm ⟩

name: ppow
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem ppow [CommSemiring R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R} (hf : f.IsMultiplicative)
    {k : ℕ} : IsMultiplicative (f.ppow k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast
  | succ k hi => rw [ppow_succ']; apply hf.pmul hi

name: ofPowerSeries_apply
statement:
theorem ofPowerSeries_apply {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (f : PowerSeries R) (n : ℕ) :
    ofPowerSeries q f n = Function.extend (q ^ ·) (f.coeff ·) 0 n
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofPowerSeries, dite_eq_left hq]

name: ofPowerSeries_apply_pow
statement:
theorem ofPowerSeries_apply_pow {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 < q) (f : PowerSeries R) (k : ℕ) :
    ofPowerSeries q f (q ^ k) = f.coeff k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofPowerSeries_apply hq, (Nat.pow_right_injective hq).extend_apply]

name: ofPowerSeries_apply_zero
statement: theorem ofPowerSeries_apply_zero (q : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries R) : ofPowerSeries q f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: ofPowerSeries_apply_one
statement:
@[simp]

theorem ofPowerSeries_apply_one (q : ℕ) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    ofPowerSeries q f 1 = f.constantCoeff
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : 1 < q
  · rw [← pow_zero q, ofPowerSeries_apply_pow hq, PowerSeries.coeff_zero_eq_constantCoeff]
  · simp [ofPowerSeries, dite_eq_right hq]

name: ofPowerSeries_pow
statement:
theorem ofPowerSeries_pow (q : ℕ) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (f : PowerSeries R) :
    ofPowerSeries (q ^ k) f = ofPowerSeries q (f.subst (PowerSeries.X ^ k))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : 1 < q
  · ext n
    by_cases hn : ∃ i, q ^ i = n
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hn
      rw [ofPowerSeries_apply_pow hq, PowerSeries.coeff_subst_X_pow hk]
      split_ifs with hn
      · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hn
        rw [pow_mul, ofPowerSeries_apply_pow (one_lt_pow' hq hk)]
        simp [hk]
      · rw [ofPowerSeries_apply (one_lt_pow' hq hk), Function.extend_apply', Pi.zero_apply]
        simp_rw [← pow_mul, Nat.pow_right_inj hq, eq_comm, ← dvd_def]
        exact hn
    · rwa [ofPowerSeries_apply hq, ofPowerSeries_apply (one_lt_pow' hq hk),
        Function.extend_apply', Function.extend_apply']
      contrapose! hn
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hn
      exact ⟨k * i, pow_mul q k i⟩
  · simp [ofPowerSeries, hq, hk]

name: isMultiplicative_ofPowerSeries_of_isPrimePow
statement:
theorem isMultiplicative_ofPowerSeries_of_isPrimePow
    (q : ℕ) (hq : IsPrimePow q) (f : PowerSeries R) (hf : f.constantCoeff = 1) :
    IsMultiplicative (ofPowerSeries q f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(ofPowerSeries_apply_one q f).trans hf, fun {m n} hmn ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩ := hq
  rw [← Nat.prime_iff] at hp
  rw [ofPowerSeries_pow p hk.ne']
  by_cases hm : ∃ i, p ^ i = m
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hm
    by_cases hn : ∃ j, p ^ j = n
    · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hn
      cases i
      · simp [hk.ne', hf]
      · cases j
        · simp [hk.ne', hf]
        · simp [hp.ne_one] at hmn
    · simp_rw [ofPowerSeries_apply hp.one_lt]
      rw [Function.extend_apply', Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hn,
        Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero]
      contrapose! hn
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hn
      obtain ⟨v, -, rfl⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp (Dvd.intro_left _ hj.symm)
      exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  · simp_rw [ofPowerSeries_apply hp.one_lt]
    rw [Function.extend_apply', Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hm,
      Pi.zero_apply, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]
    contrapose! hm
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hm
    obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp).mp ⟨n, hi⟩
    exact ⟨j, rfl⟩

name: tendsto_iff
statement:
private theorem tendsto_iff
    {f : ι → ArithmeticFunction R} {F : Filter ι} {g : ArithmeticFunction R} :
    Tendsto f F (nhds g) ↔ ∀ n, ∀ᶠ i in F, f i n = g n
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  have : Topology.IsInducing ((↑) : ArithmeticFunction R → (ℕ → R)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  simp [this.tendsto_nhds_iff, tendsto_pi_nhds]

name: tendsTo_eulerProduct_of_tendsTo
statement:
theorem tendsTo_eulerProduct_of_tendsTo (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : ∀ n, ∀ᶠ i in cofinite, f i n = (1 : ArithmeticFunction R) n) :
    ∀ n, ∀ᶠ s in atTop, (∏ i ∈ s, f i) n = eulerProduct f n
proof:
:= by
  let : UniformSpace R := ⊥
  have : IsUniformInducing ((↑) : ArithmeticFunction R → (ℕ → R)) := ⟨rfl⟩
  classical
  suffices Multipliable f from tendsto_iff.mp this.hasProd
  simp_rw [multipliable_iff_cauchySeq_finset, CauchySeq, ← this.cauchy_map_iff,
    Filter.map_map, cauchy_map_iff', Pi.uniformity, DiscreteUniformity.eq_principal_setRelId,
    tendsto_iInf, tendsto_comap_iff, tendsto_principal, Function.comp_apply, prod_atTop_atTop_eq,
    eventually_atTop_prod_self, SetRel.mem_id]
  intro n
  replace hf : ∀ k ∈ Set.Iic n, ∀ᶠ (x : ι) in cofinite, (f x) k = (1 : ArithmeticFunction R) k :=
    fun k hk ↦ hf k
  rw [← eventually_all_finite (Set.finite_Iic n), eventually_iff_exists_mem] at hf
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs'⟩ := hf
  let t := (mem_cofinite.mp hs).toFinset
  refine ⟨t, fun u v hu hv ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [← Finset.prod_sdiff hu, ← Finset.prod_sdiff hv]
  replace hu : ∀ i ∈ u \ t, i ∈ s := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.notMem_compl_iff] at hi
    exact hi.2
  replace hv : ∀ i ∈ v \ t, i ∈ s := by
    intro i hi
    rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.notMem_compl_iff] at hi
    exact hi.2
  suffices ∀ k ≤ n, (∏ x ∈ u \ t, f x) k = (∏ x ∈ v \ t, f x) k by
    rw [mul_apply, mul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk ↦ ?_
    rw [this k.1 (Nat.divisor_le (Nat.fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hk))]
  suffices ∀ w, (∀ i ∈ w, i ∈ s) → ∀ k ≤ n, (∏ x ∈ w, f x) k = (1 : ArithmeticFunction R) k by
    intro k hk
    rw [this (u \ t) hu k hk, this (v \ t) hv k hk]
  intro w hw
  induction w using Finset.induction_on
  case empty => simp
  case insert i w hi hw' =>
    intro k hk
    rw [← one_mul (1 : ArithmeticFunction R), Finset.prod_insert hi, mul_apply, mul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj ↦ ?_
    have h1 := hs' i (hw i (Finset.mem_insert_self i w)) j.1
      ((Nat.divisor_le (Nat.fst_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hj)).trans hk)
    have h2 := hw' (fun i hi ↦ hw i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)) j.2
      ((Nat.divisor_le (Nat.snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hj)).trans hk)
    rw [h1, h2]

name: isMultiplicative_eulerProduct
statement:
theorem isMultiplicative_eulerProduct (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : ∀ i, IsMultiplicative (f i)) : IsMultiplicative (eulerProduct f)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf' : Multipliable f
  · have h (s : Finset ι) : (∏ b ∈ s, f b).IsMultiplicative :=
      isMultiplicative_finsetProd f s fun i a ↦ hf i
    have key := tendsto_iff.mp hf'.hasProd
    refine (forall_and.mp h).imp (fun h ↦ ?_) fun h m n hmn ↦ ?_
    · specialize key 1
      simp_rw [h] at key
      rwa [eventually_const, eq_comm] at key
    · replace h s : (∏ b ∈ s, f b) (m * n) = (∏ b ∈ s, f b) m * (∏ b ∈ s, f b) n := h s hmn
      have h2 := key (m * n)
      simp_rw [h] at h2
      exact eventually_const.mp (EventuallyEq.trans (.symm h2) (.mul (key m) (key n)))
  · rw [eulerProduct, tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable hf']
    exact isMultiplicative_one

name: tendsTo_eulerProduct_ofPowerSeries
statement:
theorem tendsTo_eulerProduct_ofPowerSeries (q : ι → ℕ) [hq : Northcott q]
    (f : ι → PowerSeries R) (hf : ∀ i, (f i).constantCoeff = 1) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ᶠ s in atTop, (∏ i ∈ s, ofPowerSeries (q i) (f i)) n =
      eulerProduct (fun i ↦ ofPowerSeries (q i) (f i)) n
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsTo_eulerProduct_of_tendsTo
  refine fun n ↦ (tendsto_atTop.mp ((northcott_iff_tendsto q).mp hq) (n + 1)).mono fun i hi ↦ ?_
  rcases n with rfl | rfl | n
  · simp
  · simp [hf]
  · have hqi : 1 < q i := by lia
    rw [ofPowerSeries_apply hqi, Function.extend_apply', Pi.zero_apply, one_apply_ne (by lia)]
    rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have h : k ≠ 0 := fun h ↦ by simp_all
    grind [Nat.le_pow h.pos (a := q i)]

name: log_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_apply {n : ℕ} : log n = Real.log n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: vonMangoldt_apply
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_apply {n : ℕ} : Λ n = if IsPrimePow n then Real.log (minFac n) else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: vonMangoldt_apply_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonMangoldt_apply_one : Λ 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [vonMangoldt_apply]

name: vonMangoldt_nonneg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonMangoldt_nonneg {n : ℕ} : 0 ≤ Λ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [vonMangoldt_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact Real.log_nonneg (one_le_cast.2 (Nat.minFac_pos n))
  rfl

name: vonMangoldt_apply_pow
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_apply_pow {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : Λ (n ^ k) = Λ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vonMangoldt_apply, isPrimePow_pow_iff hk, pow_minFac hk]

name: vonMangoldt_apply_prime
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Λ p = Real.log p
proof:
:= by
  rw [vonMangoldt_apply, Prime.minFac_eq hp, ite_eq_left hp.prime.isPrimePow]

name: vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} : Λ n ≠ 0 ↔ IsPrimePow n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with (rfl | hn); · simp [not_isPrimePow_one]
  exact (Real.log_pos (one_lt_cast.2 (minFac_prime hn).one_lt)).ne'.ite_ne_right_iff

name: vonMangoldt_pos_iff
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_pos_iff {n : ℕ} : 0 < Λ n ↔ IsPrimePow n
proof:
:=
