  vonMangoldt_nonneg.lt_iff_ne.trans (ne_comm.trans vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff)

name: vonMangoldt_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} : Λ n = 0 ↔ ¬IsPrimePow n
proof:
:=
  vonMangoldt_ne_zero_iff.not_right

name: vonMangoldt_sum
statement: theorem vonMangoldt_sum {n : ℕ} : ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, Λ i = Real.log n
proof:
:= by
  refine recOnPrimeCoprime ?_ ?_ ?_ n
  · simp
  · intro p k hp
    rw [sum_divisors_prime_pow hp, cast_pow, Real.log_pow, Finset.sum_range_succ', Nat.pow_zero,
      vonMangoldt_apply_one]
    simp [vonMangoldt_apply_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero _), vonMangoldt_apply_prime hp]
  intro a b ha' hb' hab ha hb
  simp only [vonMangoldt_apply, ← sum_filter] at ha hb ⊢
  rw [mul_divisors_filter_prime_pow hab, filter_union,
    sum_union (disjoint_divisors_filter_isPrimePow hab), ha, hb, Nat.cast_mul,
    Real.log_mul (cast_ne_zero.2 (pos_of_gt ha').ne') (cast_ne_zero.2 (pos_of_gt hb').ne')]

name: vonMangoldt_mul_zeta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vonMangoldt_mul_zeta : Λ * ζ = log
proof:
:= by
  ext n; rw [coe_mul_zeta_apply, vonMangoldt_sum]; rfl

name: zeta_mul_vonMangoldt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeta_mul_vonMangoldt : (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * Λ = log
proof: := by rw [mul_comm]; simp

name: log_mul_moebius_eq_vonMangoldt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem log_mul_moebius_eq_vonMangoldt : log * μ = Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← vonMangoldt_mul_zeta, mul_assoc, coe_zeta_mul_coe_moebius, mul_one]

name: moebius_mul_log_eq_vonMangoldt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moebius_mul_log_eq_vonMangoldt : (μ : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * log = Λ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]; simp

name: sum_moebius_mul_log_eq
statement: theorem sum_moebius_mul_log_eq {n : ℕ} : (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (μ d : ℝ) * log d) = -Λ n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← log_mul_moebius_eq_vonMangoldt, mul_comm log, mul_apply, log_apply, intCoe_apply, ←
    Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_mul_eq_mul_neg]
  rw [sum_divisorsAntidiagonal fun i j => (μ i : ℝ) * -Real.log j]
  have : (∑ i ∈ n.divisors, (μ i : ℝ) * -Real.log (n / i : ℕ)) =
      ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, ((μ i : ℝ) * Real.log i - μ i * Real.log n) := by
    apply sum_congr rfl
    simp only [and_imp, Ne, mem_divisors]
    intro m mn hn
    have : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [cast_ne_zero]
      rintro rfl
      exact hn (by simpa using mn)
    rw [Nat.cast_div mn this, Real.log_div (cast_ne_zero.2 hn) this, neg_sub, mul_sub]
  rw [this, sum_sub_distrib, ← sum_mul, ← Int.cast_sum, ← coe_mul_zeta_apply, eq_comm, sub_eq_self,
    moebius_mul_coe_zeta]
  rcases eq_or_ne n 1 with (hn | hn) <;> simp [hn]

name: vonMangoldt_le_log
statement:
theorem vonMangoldt_le_log : ∀ {n : ℕ}, Λ n ≤ Real.log (n : ℝ)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [← vonMangoldt_sum]
    exact single_le_sum (by exact fun _ _ => vonMangoldt_nonneg)
      (mem_divisors_self _ n.succ_ne_zero)

end ArithmeticFunction

namespace Mathlib.Meta.Positivity

open Lean Meta Qq

/
@[positivity ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt _]
meta def evalVonMangoldt : PositivityExt where eval {u α} _zα pα? e
proof:
:=
  match pα? with | none => pure .none | some _ => do
  match u, α, e with
  | 0, ~q(ℝ), ~q(@ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt $a) =>
    assertInstancesCommute
    pure (.nonnegative q(ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg))
  | _, _, _ => throwError "not von Mangoldt"

name: moebius_apply_of_squarefree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moebius_apply_of_squarefree {n : ℕ} (h : Squarefree n) : μ n = (-1) ^ cardFactors n
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left h

name: moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree {n : ℕ} (h : ¬Squarefree n) : μ n = 0
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right h

name: moebius_apply_one
statement: theorem moebius_apply_one : μ 1 = 1
proof: := by simp

name: moebius_ne_zero_iff_squarefree
statement: theorem moebius_ne_zero_iff_squarefree {n : ℕ} : μ n ≠ 0 ↔ Squarefree n
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · contrapose h
    simp [h]
  · simp [h]

name: moebius_eq_or
statement: theorem moebius_eq_or (n : ℕ) : μ n = 0 ∨ μ n = 1 ∨ μ n = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moebius, coe_mk]
  split_ifs
  · right
    exact neg_one_pow_eq_or ..
  · left
    rfl

name: moebius_ne_zero_iff_eq_or
statement: theorem moebius_ne_zero_iff_eq_or {n : ℕ} : μ n ≠ 0 ↔ μ n = 1 ∨ μ n = -1
proof:
:= by
  have := moebius_eq_or n
  lia

name: moebius_sq_eq_one_of_squarefree
statement: theorem moebius_sq_eq_one_of_squarefree {l : ℕ} (hl : Squarefree l) : μ l ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [moebius_apply_of_squarefree hl, ← pow_mul, mul_comm, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]

name: abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree
statement: theorem abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree {l : ℕ} (hl : Squarefree l) : |μ l| = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moebius_apply_of_squarefree hl, abs_pow, abs_neg, abs_one, one_pow]

name: moebius_sq
statement:
theorem moebius_sq {n : ℕ} :
    μ n ^ 2 = if Squarefree n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact moebius_sq_eq_one_of_squarefree h
  · simp only [moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree h, zero_pow (show 2 ≠ 0 by simp)]

name: abs_moebius
statement:
theorem abs_moebius {n : ℕ} :
    |μ n| = if Squarefree n then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact abs_moebius_eq_one_of_squarefree h
  · simp only [moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree h, abs_zero]

name: abs_moebius_le_one
statement: theorem abs_moebius_le_one {n : ℕ} : |μ n| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_moebius, apply_ite (· ≤ 1)]
  simp

name: moebius_apply_prime
statement: theorem moebius_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : μ p = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [moebius_apply_of_squarefree hp.squarefree, cardFactors_apply_prime hp, pow_one]

name: moebius_apply_prime_pow
statement:
theorem moebius_apply_prime_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    μ (p ^ k) = if k = 1 then -1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h, pow_one, moebius_apply_prime hp]
  rw [moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree]
  rw [squarefree_pow_iff hp.ne_one hk, not_and_or]
  exact Or.inr h

name: moebius_apply_isPrimePow_not_prime
statement:
theorem moebius_apply_isPrimePow_not_prime {n : ℕ} (hn : IsPrimePow n) (hn' : ¬n.Prime) :
    μ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, k, hp, hk, rfl⟩ := (isPrimePow_nat_iff _).1 hn
  rw [moebius_apply_prime_pow hp hk.ne', ite_eq_right]
  rintro rfl
  exact hn' (by simpa)

name: isMultiplicative_moebius
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_moebius : IsMultiplicative μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero]
  refine ⟨by simp, fun {n m} hn hm hnm => ?_⟩
  simp only [moebius, coe_mk, squarefree_mul hnm, ite_zero_mul_ite_zero, cardFactors_mul hn hm,
    pow_add]

name: IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors_one_add_of_squarefree
statement:
theorem IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors_one_add_of_squarefree [CommSemiring R]
    {f : ArithmeticFunction R} (h_mult : f.IsMultiplicative) {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) :
    ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 + f p) = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, f d
proof:
:= by
  trans (∏ᵖ p ∣ n, ((ζ : ArithmeticFunction R) + f) p)
  · simp_rw [prodPrimeFactors_apply hn.ne_zero, add_apply, natCoe_apply]
    apply prod_congr rfl; intro p hp
    rw [zeta_apply_ne (prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList <| List.mem_toFinset.mp hp).ne_zero, cast_one]
  rw [isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast.prodPrimeFactors_add_of_squarefree h_mult hn,
    coe_zeta_mul_apply]

name: IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors_one_sub_of_squarefree
statement:
theorem IsMultiplicative.prodPrimeFactors_one_sub_of_squarefree [CommRing R]
    (f : ArithmeticFunction R) (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) {n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) :
    ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - f p) = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, μ d * f d
proof:
:= by
  trans (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 + (ArithmeticFunction.pmul (μ : ArithmeticFunction R) f) p))
  · apply prod_congr rfl; intro p hp
    rw [pmul_apply, intCoe_apply, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_apply_prime
        (prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList (List.mem_toFinset.mp hp))]
    ring
  · rw [(isMultiplicative_moebius.intCast.pmul hf).prodPrimeFactors_one_add_of_squarefree hn]
    simp_rw [pmul_apply, intCoe_apply]

name: moebius_mul_coe_zeta
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moebius_mul_coe_zeta : (μ * ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  induction n using recOnPosPrimePosCoprime with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | one => simp
  | prime_pow p n hp hn =>
    rw [coe_mul_zeta_apply, sum_divisors_prime_pow hp, sum_range_succ']
    simp [moebius_apply_prime_pow, hp.ne_one, hn.ne', hp, hn]
  | coprime a b _ha _hb hab ha' hb' =>
    rw [IsMultiplicative.map_mul_of_coprime _ hab, ha', hb',
      IsMultiplicative.map_mul_of_coprime isMultiplicative_one hab]
    exact isMultiplicative_moebius.mul isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast

name: sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq
statement:
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq [AddCommGroup R] {f g : ℕ → R} :
    (∀ n > 0, ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, μ x.fst • g x.snd = f n
proof:
:= by
  let f' : ArithmeticFunction R := ⟨fun x => if x = 0 then 0 else f x, ite_eq_left rfl⟩
  let g' : ArithmeticFunction R := ⟨fun x => if x = 0 then 0 else g x, ite_eq_left rfl⟩
  trans (ζ : ArithmeticFunction ℤ) • f' = g'
  · rw [ArithmeticFunction.ext_iff]
    apply forall_congr'
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      rw [coe_zeta_smul_apply]
      simp only [forall_prop_of_true, succ_pos', f', g', coe_mk, succ_ne_zero, ite_false]
      rw [sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ite_eq_right (pos_of_mem_divisors hx).ne']
  trans μ • g' = f'
  · constructor <;> intro h <;>
      simp only [← h, ← mul_smul, moebius_mul_coe_zeta, coe_zeta_mul_moebius, one_smul]
  · rw [ArithmeticFunction.ext_iff]
    apply forall_congr'
    intro n
    cases n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      simp only [forall_prop_of_true, succ_pos', smul_apply, f', g', coe_mk, succ_ne_zero,
        ite_false]
      rw [sum_congr rfl fun x hx => ?_]
      rw [ite_eq_right (pos_of_mem_divisors (snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx)).ne']

name: sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq
statement:
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq [NonAssocRing R] {f g : ℕ → R} :
    (∀ n > 0, ∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.fst : R) * g x.snd = f n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq]
  apply forall_congr'
  refine fun a => imp_congr_right fun _ => (sum_congr rfl fun x _hx => ?_).congr_left
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul]

name: prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq
statement:
theorem prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq [CommGroup R] {f g : ℕ → R} :
    (∀ n > 0, ∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f i = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, ∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, g x.snd ^ μ x.fst = f n
proof:
:=
  @sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq (Additive R) _ _ _

name: prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_of_nonzero [CommGroupWithZero R] {f g : ℕ → R}
    (hf : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0) (hg : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n ≠ 0) :
    (∀ n > 0, ∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f i = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, ∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, g x.snd ^ μ x.fst = f n
proof:
:= by
  refine
      Iff.trans
        (Iff.trans (forall_congr' fun n => ?_)
          (@prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq Rˣ _
            (fun n => if h : 0 < n then Units.mk0 (f n) (hf n h) else 1) fun n =>
            if h : 0 < n then Units.mk0 (g n) (hg n h) else 1))
        (forall_congr' fun n => ?_) <;>
    refine imp_congr_right fun hn => ?_
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn, ← Units.val_inj, ← Units.coeHom_apply, map_prod, Units.val_mk0,
      prod_congr rfl _]
    intro x hx
    rw [dite_eq_left (pos_of_mem_divisors hx), Units.coeHom_apply, Units.val_mk0]
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn, ← Units.val_inj, ← Units.coeHom_apply, map_prod, Units.val_mk0,
      prod_congr rfl _]
    intro x hx
    rw [dite_eq_left (pos_of_mem_divisors (snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx)),
      Units.coeHom_apply, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, Units.val_mk0]

name: sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on
statement:
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on [AddCommGroup R] {f g : ℕ → R}
    (s : Set ℕ) (hs : ∀ m n, m ∣ n → n ∈ s → m ∈ s) :
    (∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i) = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, μ x.fst • g x.snd) = f n
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    let G := fun (n : ℕ) => (∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i)
    intro n hn hnP
    suffices ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, μ (n / d) • G d = f n by
      rw [sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' (f := fun x y => μ x • g y), ← this, sum_congr rfl]
      intro d hd
      rw [← h d (pos_of_mem_divisors hd) <| hs d n (dvd_of_mem_divisors hd) hnP]
    rw [← sum_divisorsAntidiagonal' (f := fun x y => μ x • G y)]
    apply sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq.mp _ n hn
    intro _ _; rfl
  · intro h
    let F := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, μ x.fst • g x.snd
    intro n hn hnP
    suffices ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, F d = g n by
      rw [← this, sum_congr rfl]
      intro d hd
      rw [← h d (pos_of_mem_divisors hd) <| hs d n (dvd_of_mem_divisors hd) hnP]
    apply sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq.mpr _ n hn
    intro _ _; rfl

name: sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on'
statement:
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on' [AddCommGroup R] {f g : ℕ → R}
    (s : Set ℕ) (hs : ∀ m n, m ∣ n → n ∈ s → m ∈ s) (hs₀ : 0 ∉ s) :
    (∀ n ∈ s, (∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i) = g n) ↔
     ∀ n ∈ s, (∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, μ x.fst • g x.snd) = f n
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ P : ℕ → Prop, ((∀ n ∈ s, P n) ↔ (∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → P n)) := fun P ↦ by
    refine forall_congr' (fun n ↦ ⟨fun h _ ↦ h, fun h hn ↦ h ?_ hn⟩)
    contrapose! hs₀
    simpa [nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp hs₀] using hn
  simpa only [this] using sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on s hs

name: sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq_on
statement:
theorem sum_eq_iff_sum_mul_moebius_eq_on [NonAssocRing R] {f g : ℕ → R}
    (s : Set ℕ) (hs : ∀ m n, m ∣ n → n ∈ s → m ∈ s) :
    (∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∑ i ∈ n.divisors, f i) = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, n ∈ s →
        (∑ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, (μ x.fst : R) * g x.snd) = f n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on s hs]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro a; refine imp_congr_right ?_
  refine fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ => (sum_congr rfl fun x _hx => ?_).congr_left
  rw [zsmul_eq_mul]

name: prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_on
statement:
theorem prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_on [CommGroup R] {f g : ℕ → R}
    (s : Set ℕ) (hs : ∀ m n, m ∣ n → n ∈ s → m ∈ s) :
    (∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f i) = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, g x.snd ^ μ x.fst) = f n
proof:

  @sum_eq_iff_sum_smul_moebius_eq_on (Additive R) _ _ _ s hs

name: prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_on_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_on_of_nonzero [CommGroupWithZero R]
    (s : Set ℕ) (hs : ∀ m n, m ∣ n → n ∈ s → m ∈ s) {f g : ℕ → R}
    (hf : ∀ n > 0, f n ≠ 0) (hg : ∀ n > 0, g n ≠ 0) :
    (∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∏ i ∈ n.divisors, f i) = g n) ↔
      ∀ n > 0, n ∈ s → (∏ x ∈ n.divisorsAntidiagonal, g x.snd ^ μ x.fst) = f n
proof:
:= by
  refine
      Iff.trans
        (Iff.trans (forall_congr' fun n => ?_)
          (@prod_eq_iff_prod_pow_moebius_eq_on Rˣ _
            (fun n => if h : 0 < n then Units.mk0 (f n) (hf n h) else 1)
            (fun n => if h : 0 < n then Units.mk0 (g n) (hg n h) else 1)
            s hs))
        (forall_congr' fun n => ?_) <;>
    refine imp_congr_right fun hn => ?_
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn, ← Units.val_inj, ← Units.coeHom_apply, map_prod, Units.val_mk0,
      prod_congr rfl _]
    intro x hx
    rw [dite_eq_left (pos_of_mem_divisors hx), Units.coeHom_apply, Units.val_mk0]
  · rw [dite_eq_left hn, ← Units.val_inj, ← Units.coeHom_apply, map_prod, Units.val_mk0,
      prod_congr rfl _]
    intro x hx
    rw [dite_eq_left (pos_of_mem_divisors (snd_mem_divisors_of_mem_antidiagonal hx)),
      Units.coeHom_apply, Units.val_zpow_eq_zpow_val, Units.val_mk0]

    | empty => simp [hf]
    | insert _ _ has ih =>
      rw [coe_insert, Set.pairwise_insert_of_symm] at hs
      rw [prod_insert has, prod_insert has, hf.map_mul_of_coprime, ih hs.1]
      exact Coprime.prod_right fun i hi => hs.2 _ hi (hi.ne_of_notMem has).symm

name: map_prod_of_prime
statement:
theorem map_prod_of_prime [CommMonoidWithZero R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R}
    (h_mult : ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative f)
    (t : Finset ℕ) (ht : ∀ p ∈ t, p.Prime) :
    f (∏ a ∈ t, a) = ∏ a ∈ t, f a
proof:
:=
  map_prod _ h_mult t fun x hx y hy hxy => (coprime_primes (ht x hx) (ht y hy)).mpr hxy

name: map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors
statement:
theorem map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors [CommMonoidWithZero R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R}
    (h_mult : ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative f) (l : ℕ)
    (t : Finset ℕ) (ht : t ⊆ l.primeFactors) :
    f (∏ a ∈ t, a) = ∏ a ∈ t, f a
proof:
:=
  map_prod_of_prime h_mult t fun _ a => prime_of_mem_primeFactors (ht a)

name: prod_primeFactors
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h_mult.map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors l _ Subset.rfl,
    prod_primeFactors_of_squarefree hl]

name: map_div_of_coprime
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_eq_of_eq_mul hd ..).symm
  rw [← hf.right hl, Nat.div_mul_cancel hdl]

name: natCast
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem natCast {f : ArithmeticFunction ℕ} [Semiring R] (h : f.IsMultiplicative) :
    IsMultiplicative (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [h], fun cop => by simp [h.2 cop]⟩

name: intCast
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem intCast {f : ArithmeticFunction ℤ} [Ring R] (h : f.IsMultiplicative) :
    IsMultiplicative (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simp [h], fun cop => by simp [h.2 cop]⟩

name: mul
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem mul [CommSemiring R] {f g : ArithmeticFunction R} (hf : f.IsMultiplicative)
    (hg : g.IsMultiplicative) : IsMultiplicative (f * g)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simp [hf.1, hg.1], ?_⟩
  simp only [mul_apply]
  intro m n cop
  rw [sum_mul_sum, ← sum_product']
  symm
  apply sum_nbij fun ((i, j), k, l) ↦ (i * k, j * l)
  · rintro ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨b1, b2⟩⟩ h
    simp only [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, Ne, mem_product] at h
    rcases h with ⟨⟨rfl, ha⟩, ⟨rfl, hb⟩⟩
    simp only [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mul_eq_zero, Ne]
    constructor
    · ring
    rw [mul_eq_zero] at *
    exact not_or_intro ha hb
  · simp only [Set.InjOn, mem_coe, mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mem_product, Prod.mk_inj]
    rintro ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨b1, b2⟩⟩ ⟨⟨rfl, ha⟩, ⟨rfl, hb⟩⟩ ⟨⟨c1, c2⟩, ⟨d1, d2⟩⟩ hcd h
    ext
    · trans gcd (a1 * a2) (a1 * b1)
      · rw [gcd_mul_left, cop.coprime_mul_left.coprime_mul_right_right.gcd_eq_one, mul_one]
      · rw [← hcd.1.1, ← hcd.2.1] at cop
        rw [← hcd.1.1, h.1, gcd_mul_left, cop.coprime_mul_left.coprime_mul_right_right.gcd_eq_one,
          mul_one]
    · trans gcd (a1 * a2) (a2 * b2)
      · rw [mul_comm, gcd_mul_left, cop.coprime_mul_right.coprime_mul_left_right.gcd_eq_one,
          mul_one]
      · rw [← hcd.1.1, ← hcd.2.1] at cop
        rw [← hcd.1.1, h.2, mul_comm, gcd_mul_left,
          cop.coprime_mul_right.coprime_mul_left_right.gcd_eq_one, mul_one]
    · trans gcd (b1 * b2) (a1 * b1)
      · rw [mul_comm, gcd_mul_right, cop.coprime_mul_right.coprime_mul_left_right.symm.gcd_eq_one,
          one_mul]
      · rw [← hcd.1.1, ← hcd.2.1] at cop
        rw [← hcd.2.1, h.1, mul_comm c1 d1, gcd_mul_left,
          cop.coprime_mul_right.coprime_mul_left_right.symm.gcd_eq_one, mul_one]
    · trans gcd (b1 * b2) (a2 * b2)
      · rw [gcd_mul_right, cop.coprime_mul_left.coprime_mul_right_right.symm.gcd_eq_one, one_mul]
      · rw [← hcd.1.1, ← hcd.2.1] at cop
        rw [← hcd.2.1, h.2, gcd_mul_right,
          cop.coprime_mul_left.coprime_mul_right_right.symm.gcd_eq_one, one_mul]
  · simp only [Set.SurjOn, Set.subset_def, mem_coe, mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mem_product,
      Set.mem_image]
    rintro ⟨b1, b2⟩ h
    use ((b1.gcd m, b2.gcd m), (b1.gcd n, b2.gcd n))
    rw [← cop.gcd_mul _, ← cop.gcd_mul _, ← h.1, gcd_mul_gcd_of_coprime_of_mul_eq_mul cop h.1,
      gcd_mul_gcd_of_coprime_of_mul_eq_mul cop.symm _]
    · rw [Ne, mul_eq_zero, not_or] at h
      simp [h.2.1, h.2.2]
    rw [mul_comm n m, h.1]
  · simp only [mem_divisorsAntidiagonal, mem_product]
    rintro ⟨⟨a1, a2⟩, ⟨b1, b2⟩⟩ ⟨⟨rfl, ha⟩, ⟨rfl, hb⟩⟩
    rw [hf.map_mul_of_coprime cop.coprime_mul_right.coprime_mul_right_right,
      hg.map_mul_of_coprime cop.coprime_mul_left.coprime_mul_left_right]
    ring

name: multiplicative_factorization
statement:
theorem multiplicative_factorization [CommMonoidWithZero R] (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    f n = n.factorization.prod fun p k => f (p ^ k)
proof:
:=
  Nat.multiplicative_factorization f (fun _ _ => hf.2) hf.1 hn

name: iff_ne_zero
statement:
theorem iff_ne_zero [MonoidWithZero R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R} :
    IsMultiplicative f ↔
      f 1 = 1 ∧ ∀ {m n : ℕ}, m ≠ 0 → n ≠ 0 → m.Coprime n → f (m * n) = f m * f n
proof:
:= by
  refine and_congr_right' (forall₂_congr fun m n => ⟨fun h _ _ => h, fun h hmn => ?_⟩)
  rcases eq_or_ne m 0 with (rfl | hm)
  · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  exact h hm hn hmn

name: eq_iff_eq_on_prime_powers
statement:
theorem eq_iff_eq_on_prime_powers [CommMonoidWithZero R] (f : ArithmeticFunction R)
    (hf : f.IsMultiplicative) (g : ArithmeticFunction R) (hg : g.IsMultiplicative) :
    f = g ↔ ∀ p i : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → f (p ^ i) = g (p ^ i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h
  · simp [h]
  ext n
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · rw [hn, ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, ArithmeticFunction.map_zero]
  rw [multiplicative_factorization f hf hn, multiplicative_factorization g hg hn]
  exact prod_congr rfl fun p hp ↦ h p _ (prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)

name: lcm_apply_mul_gcd_apply
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp only [hx, f.map_zero, zero_mul, lcm_zero_left, gcd_zero_left]
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · simp only [hy, f.map_zero, mul_zero, lcm_zero_right, gcd_zero_right, zero_mul]
  have hgcd_ne_zero : x.gcd y ≠ 0 := gcd_ne_zero_left hx
  have hlcm_ne_zero : x.lcm y ≠ 0 := lcm_ne_zero hx hy
  have hfi_zero : ∀ {i}, f (i ^ 0) = 1 := by
    intro i; rw [pow_zero, hf.1]
  iterate 4 rw [hf.multiplicative_factorization f (by assumption),
    Finsupp.prod_of_support_subset _ _ _ (fun _ _ => hfi_zero)
      (s := (x.primeFactors ∪ y.primeFactors))]
  · rw [← prod_mul_distrib, ← prod_mul_distrib]
    apply prod_congr rfl
    intro p _
    rcases Nat.le_or_le (x.factorization p) (y.factorization p) with h | h <;>
      simp only [factorization_lcm hx hy, Finsupp.sup_apply, h, sup_of_le_right,
        sup_of_le_left, inf_of_le_right, factorization_gcd hx hy, Finsupp.inf_apply,
        inf_of_le_left, mul_comm]
  · apply subset_union_right
  · apply subset_union_left
  · rw [factorization_gcd hx hy, Finsupp.support_inf]
    apply inter_subset_union
  · simp [factorization_lcm hx hy]

name: map_gcd
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.lcm_apply_mul_gcd_apply, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hf_lcm]

name: map_lcm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hf.lcm_apply_mul_gcd_apply, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hf_gcd]

name: eq_zero_of_squarefree_of_dvd_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_squarefree_of_dvd_eq_zero [MonoidWithZero R] {f : ArithmeticFunction R}
    (hf : IsMultiplicative f) {m n : ℕ} (hn : Squarefree n) (hmn : m ∣ n)
    (h_zero : f m = 0) :
    f n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hmn with ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [zero_mul, hf.map_mul_of_coprime (coprime_of_squarefree_mul hn), h_zero]

name: isMultiplicative_one
statement:
@[simp, arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_one [MonoidWithZero R] : IsMultiplicative (1 : ArithmeticFunction R)
proof:
:=
  IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero.2 ⟨by simp, by
    intro m n hm hn hmn
    by_cases h : m = 1 <;> aesop⟩

name: isMultiplicative_finsetProd
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_finsetProd [CommSemiring R] {ι : Type*}
    (f : ι → ArithmeticFunction R) (s : Finset ι) (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, IsMultiplicative (f i)) :
    IsMultiplicative (∏ i ∈ s, f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction
  case empty => simp
  case cons a s ha ih =>
    rw [Finset.prod_cons]
    exact (hf a (by grind)).mul (by grind)

name: IsMultiplicative.pow
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  case zero => simp
  case succ k hk =>
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact hk.mul hf

name: liouville_apply
statement: theorem liouville_apply {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) : liouville n = (-1) ^ cardFactors n
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right h

name: liouville_ne_zero
statement: theorem liouville_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 0) : liouville n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [liouville_apply h]

name: liouville_apply_one
statement: theorem liouville_apply_one : liouville 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [liouville_apply]

name: liouville_apply_mul
statement: theorem liouville_apply_mul (m n : ℕ) : liouville (m * n) = liouville m * liouville n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · simp [hm]
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  simp [liouville_apply, cardFactors_mul, hm, hn, pow_add]

name: isMultiplicative_liouville
statement: theorem isMultiplicative_liouville : IsMultiplicative liouville
proof:
:=
  ⟨liouville_apply_one, fun {m n} _ ↦ liouville_apply_mul m n⟩

name: prodPrimeFactors_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodPrimeFactors_apply [CommMonoidWithZero R] {f : ℕ → R} {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∏ᵖ p ∣ n, f p = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, f p
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right hn

name: prodPrimeFactors
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem prodPrimeFactors [CommMonoidWithZero R] (f : ℕ → R) :
    IsMultiplicative (prodPrimeFactors f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [iff_ne_zero]
  simp only [ne_eq, one_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, prodPrimeFactors_apply, primeFactors_one,
    prod_empty, true_and]
  intro x y hx hy hxy
  have hxy₀ : x * y ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hx hy
  rw [prodPrimeFactors_apply hxy₀, prodPrimeFactors_apply hx, prodPrimeFactors_apply hy,
    primeFactors_mul hx hy, ← prod_union hxy.disjoint_primeFactors]

name: prodPrimeFactors_add_of_squarefree
proof:
:= by
  rw [prodPrimeFactors_apply hn.ne_zero]
  simp_rw [add_apply (f := f) (g := g)]
  rw [prod_add, mul_apply, sum_divisorsAntidiagonal (f · * g ·),
    ← divisors_filter_squarefree_of_squarefree hn, sum_divisors_filter_squarefree hn.ne_zero,
    factors_eq]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  rw [t.prod_val, Function.id_def,
    ← prod_primeFactors_sdiff_of_squarefree hn (mem_powerset.mp ht),
    hf.map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors n t (mem_powerset.mp ht),
    ← hg.map_prod_of_subset_primeFactors n (_ \ t) sdiff_subset]

name: id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_apply {x : ℕ} : ArithmeticFunction.id x = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: isMultiplicative_id
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_id : IsMultiplicative .id
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: pow_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_apply {k n : ℕ} : pow k n = if k = 0 ∧ n = 0 then 0 else n ^ k
proof:
:= by
  cases k <;> simp [pow]

name: pow_zero_eq_zeta
statement: theorem pow_zero_eq_zeta : pow 0 = ζ
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp

name: pow_one_eq_id
statement: theorem pow_one_eq_id : pow 1 = .id
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp

name: isMultiplicative_pow
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_pow {k : ℕ} : IsMultiplicative (pow k)
proof:
:=
  isMultiplicative_id.ppow

name: sigma_apply
statement: theorem sigma_apply {k n : ℕ} : σ k n = ∑ d ∈ divisors n, d ^ k
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sigma_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigma_eq_zero {k n : ℕ} : σ k n = 0 ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · simp only [ArithmeticFunction.sigma_apply]
    aesop

name: sigma_pos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigma_pos_iff {k n} : 0 < σ k n ↔ 0 < n
proof:
:= by
  simp [pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: sigma_apply_prime_pow
statement:
theorem sigma_apply_prime_pow {k p i : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    σ k (p ^ i) = ∑ j ∈ .range (i + 1), p ^ (j * k)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigma_apply, divisors_prime_pow hp, pow_mul]

name: sigma_one_apply
statement: theorem sigma_one_apply (n : ℕ) : σ 1 n = ∑ d ∈ divisors n, d
proof: := by simp [sigma_apply]

name: sigma_one_apply_prime_pow
statement:
theorem sigma_one_apply_prime_pow {p i : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    σ 1 (p ^ i) = ∑ k ∈ .range (i + 1), p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigma_apply_prime_pow hp]

name: sigma_eq_sum_div
statement: theorem sigma_eq_sum_div (k n : ℕ) : sigma k n = ∑ d ∈ divisors n, (n / d) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigma_apply, ← sum_div_divisors]

name: sigma_zero_apply
statement: theorem sigma_zero_apply (n : ℕ) : σ 0 n = #n.divisors
proof: := by simp [sigma_apply]

name: sigma_zero_apply_prime_pow
statement: theorem sigma_zero_apply_prime_pow {p i : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : σ 0 (p ^ i) = i + 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigma_apply_prime_pow hp]

name: sigma_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigma_one (k : ℕ) : σ k 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sigma_apply, divisors_one, sum_singleton, one_pow]

name: sigma_pos
statement: theorem sigma_pos (k n : ℕ) (hn0 : n ≠ 0) : 0 < σ k n
proof:
:= by
  rwa [sigma_pos_iff, pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: sigma_mono
statement: theorem sigma_mono (k k' n : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ k') : σ k n ≤ σ k' n
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sigma_apply]
  gcongr with d hd
  exact pos_of_mem_divisors hd

name: zeta_mul_pow_eq_sigma
statement: theorem zeta_mul_pow_eq_sigma {k : ℕ} : ζ * pow k = σ k
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [sigma, zeta_mul_apply]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  aesop

name: isMultiplicative_sigma
statement:
@[arith_mult]
theorem isMultiplicative_sigma {k : ℕ} : IsMultiplicative (σ k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeta_mul_pow_eq_sigma]
  apply isMultiplicative_zeta.mul isMultiplicative_pow

name: sigma_eq_prod_primeFactors_sum_range_factorization_pow_mul
statement:
theorem sigma_eq_prod_primeFactors_sum_range_factorization_pow_mul {k n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    σ k n = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ∑ i ∈ .range (n.factorization p + 1), p ^ (i * k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isMultiplicative_sigma.multiplicative_factorization _ hn]
  exact prod_congr n.support_factorization fun _ h ↦
    sigma_apply_prime_pow <| prime_of_mem_primeFactors h

name: sigma_le_pow_succ
statement: theorem sigma_le_pow_succ (k n : ℕ) : σ k n ≤ n ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sigma_apply, pow_succ']
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum fun d hd ↦ Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.divisor_le hd) k).trans ?_
  simpa [Finset.sum_const] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (n ^ k) (Nat.card_divisors_le_self n)

name: _root_.Nat.card_divisors
statement:
theorem _root_.Nat.card_divisors {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    #n.divisors = n.primeFactors.prod (n.factorization · + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sigma_zero_apply, isMultiplicative_sigma.multiplicative_factorization _ hn]
  exact prod_congr n.support_factorization fun _ h =>
    sigma_zero_apply_prime_pow <| prime_of_mem_primeFactors h

name: _root_.Nat.divisors_card_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.Nat.divisors_card_eq_one_iff (n : ℕ) : #n.divisors = 1 ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
  · simp
  · refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ by simp [h]⟩
    exact (card_le_one.mp h.le 1 (one_mem_divisors.mpr hn) n (n.mem_divisors_self hn)).symm

name: sigma_zero_eq_one_iff
statement: private theorem sigma_zero_eq_one_iff (n : ℕ) : σ 0 n = 1 ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [sigma_zero_apply]

name: sigma_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sigma_eq_one_iff (k n : ℕ) : σ k n = 1 ↔ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn0 : n = 0
  · aesop
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← sigma_zero_eq_one_iff]
    have zero_lt_sigma := sigma_pos 0 n hn0
    have sigma_zero_le_sigma := sigma_mono 0 k n k.zero_le
    lia
  · simp +contextual

name: _root_.Nat.sum_divisors
statement:
theorem _root_.Nat.sum_divisors {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, ∑ k ∈ .range (n.factorization p + 1), p ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sigma_one_apply, isMultiplicative_sigma.multiplicative_factorization _ hn]
  exact prod_congr n.support_factorization fun _ h =>
    sigma_one_apply_prime_pow <| prime_of_mem_primeFactors h

name: cardFactors_apply
statement: theorem cardFactors_apply {n : ℕ} : Ω n = n.primeFactorsList.length
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: cardFactors_zero
statement: lemma cardFactors_zero : Ω 0 = 0
proof: := by simp

name: cardFactors_one
statement: @[simp] theorem cardFactors_one : Ω 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [cardFactors_apply]

name: cardFactors_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardFactors_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero_or_one {n : ℕ} : Ω n = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardFactors_apply, List.length_eq_zero_iff, primeFactorsList_eq_nil]

name: cardFactors_pos_iff_one_lt
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardFactors_pos_iff_one_lt {n : ℕ} : 0 < Ω n ↔ 1 < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardFactors_apply, List.length_pos_iff, primeFactorsList_ne_nil]

name: cardFactors_eq_one_iff_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardFactors_eq_one_iff_prime {n : ℕ} : Ω n = 1 ↔ n.Prime
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => List.length_eq_one_iff.2 ⟨n, primeFactorsList_prime h⟩⟩
  cases n with | zero => simp at h | succ n =>
  rcases List.length_eq_one_iff.1 h with ⟨x, hx⟩
  rw [← prod_primeFactorsList n.add_one_ne_zero, hx, List.prod_singleton]
  apply prime_of_mem_primeFactorsList
  rw [hx, List.mem_singleton]

name: cardFactors_mul
statement: theorem cardFactors_mul {m n : ℕ} (m0 : m ≠ 0) (n0 : n ≠ 0) : Ω (m * n) = Ω m + Ω n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cardFactors_apply, cardFactors_apply, cardFactors_apply, ← Multiset.coe_card, ← factors_eq,
    UniqueFactorizationMonoid.normalizedFactors_mul m0 n0, factors_eq, factors_eq,
    Multiset.card_add, Multiset.coe_card, Multiset.coe_card]

name: cardFactors_multiset_prod
statement:
theorem cardFactors_multiset_prod {s : Multiset ℕ} (h0 : s.prod ≠ 0) :
    Ω s.prod = (Multiset.map Ω s).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons ih => simp_all [cardFactors_mul, not_or]

name: cardFactors_apply_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardFactors_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Ω p = 1
proof:
:=
  cardFactors_eq_one_iff_prime.2 hp

name: cardFactors_pow
statement: lemma cardFactors_pow {m k : ℕ} : Ω (m ^ k) = k * Ω m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · cases k <;> aesop
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [pow_succ, cardFactors_mul (pow_ne_zero n hm) hm, ih]
    ring

name: cardFactors_apply_prime_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardFactors_apply_prime_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : Ω (p ^ k) = k
proof:
:= by
  simp [cardFactors_pow, hp]

name: cardFactors_eq_sum_factorization
statement:
theorem cardFactors_eq_sum_factorization {n : ℕ} :
    Ω n = n.factorization.sum fun _ k => k
proof:
:= by
  simp [cardFactors_apply, ← List.sum_toFinset_count_eq_length, Finsupp.sum]

name: cardDistinctFactors_zero
statement: theorem cardDistinctFactors_zero : ω 0 = 0
proof: := by simp

name: cardDistinctFactors_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardDistinctFactors_one : ω 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [cardDistinctFactors]

name: cardDistinctFactors_apply
statement: theorem cardDistinctFactors_apply {n : ℕ} : ω n = n.primeFactorsList.dedup.length
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: cardDistinctFactors_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardDistinctFactors_eq_zero {n : ℕ} : ω n = 0 ↔ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [cardDistinctFactors_apply, le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one]

name: cardDistinctFactors_pos
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardDistinctFactors_pos {n : ℕ} : 0 < ω n ↔ 1 < n
proof: := by simp [pos_iff_ne_zero]

name: cardDistinctFactors_eq_cardFactors_iff_squarefree
statement:
theorem cardDistinctFactors_eq_cardFactors_iff_squarefree {n : ℕ} (h0 : n ≠ 0) :
    ω n = Ω n ↔ Squarefree n
proof:
:= by
  rw [squarefree_iff_nodup_primeFactorsList h0, cardDistinctFactors_apply]
  constructor <;> intro h
  · rw [← n.primeFactorsList.dedup_sublist.eq_of_length h]
    apply List.nodup_dedup
  · simp [h.dedup, cardFactors]

name: cardDistinctFactors_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem cardDistinctFactors_eq_one_iff {n : ℕ} : ω n = 1 ↔ IsPrimePow n
proof:
:= by
  rw [ArithmeticFunction.cardDistinctFactors_apply, isPrimePow_iff_card_primeFactors_eq_one,
    ← toFinset_factors, List.card_toFinset]

name: cardDistinctFactors_apply_prime_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardDistinctFactors_apply_prime_pow {p k : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    ω (p ^ k) = 1
proof:
:=
  cardDistinctFactors_eq_one_iff.mpr <| hp.isPrimePow.pow hk

name: cardDistinctFactors_apply_prime
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cardDistinctFactors_apply_prime {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : ω p = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one p, cardDistinctFactors_apply_prime_pow hp one_ne_zero]

name: cardDistinctFactors_mul
statement: theorem cardDistinctFactors_mul {m n : ℕ} (h : m.Coprime n) : ω (m * n) = ω m + ω n
proof:
:= by
  simp [cardDistinctFactors_apply, perm_primeFactorsList_mul_of_coprime h |>.dedup |>.length_eq,
    coprime_primeFactorsList_disjoint h |>.dedup_append]

name: cardDistinctFactors_prod
statement:
theorem cardDistinctFactors_prod {ι : Type*} {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → ℕ}
    (h : (s : Set ι).Pairwise (Coprime on f)) : ω (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, ω (f i)
proof:
:= by
  induction s using cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    rw [prod_cons, sum_cons, cardDistinctFactors_mul, ih]
    · exact fun x hx y hy hxy => h (by simp [hx]) (by simp [hy]) hxy
    · exact Coprime.prod_right fun i hi =>
        h (by simp) (by simp [hi]) (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hi ha).symm

name: sum_Ioc_zeta
statement: theorem sum_Ioc_zeta (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, zeta n = N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [zeta_apply, sum_ite, sum_const_zero, sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, zero_add]
  rw [show {x ∈ Ioc 0 N | ¬x = 0} = Ioc 0 N by ext; simp; lia]
  simp

name: sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_prod_filter
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_prod_filter (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (f * g) n = ∑ x ∈ Ioc 0 N ×ˢ Ioc 0 N with x.1 * x.2 ≤ N, f x.1 * g x.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mul_apply]
  trans ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, ∑ x ∈ Ioc 0 N ×ˢ Ioc 0 N with x.1 * x.2 = n, f x.1 * g x.2
  · refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
    simp only [mem_Ioc] at hn
    rw [divisorsAntidiagonal_eq_prod_filter_of_le hn.1.ne' hn.2]
  · simp_rw [sum_filter]
    rw [sum_comm]
    exact sum_congr rfl fun _ _ ↦ (by simp_all)

name: sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_sum
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_sum (f g : ArithmeticFunction R) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (f * g) n = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, f n * ∑ m ∈ Ioc 0 (N / n), g m
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_prod_filter, sum_filter, sum_product]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
  simp only [sum_ite, not_le, sum_const_zero, add_zero, mul_sum]
  congr
  ext
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_Ioc, and_assoc, and_congr_right_iff] at hn ⊢
  intro _
  constructor
  · intro ⟨_, h⟩
    grw [← h, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by lia)]
  · intro hm
    grw [hm]
    simp [mul_div_le, div_le_self]

name: sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum (f : ArithmeticFunction R) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (f * zeta) n = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, f n * ↑(N / n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Ioc_mul_eq_sum_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [natCoe_apply]
  rw_mod_cast [sum_Ioc_zeta]

name: sum_Ioc_sigma0_eq_sum_div
statement:
theorem sum_Ioc_sigma0_eq_sum_div (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, sigma 0 n = ∑ n ∈ Ioc 0 N, (N / n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zeta_mul_pow_eq_sigma, pow_zero_eq_zeta]
  convert! sum_Ioc_mul_zeta_eq_sum zeta N using 1
  simpa using sum_congr rfl (by grind)

name: card_divisors_mul
statement:
theorem card_divisors_mul {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    #(m * n).divisors = #m.divisors * #n.divisors
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sigma_zero_apply, isMultiplicative_sigma.map_mul_of_coprime hmn]

name: sum_divisors_mul
statement:
theorem sum_divisors_mul {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m.Coprime n) :
    ∑ d ∈ (m * n).divisors, d = (∑ d ∈ m.divisors, d) * ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← sigma_one_apply, isMultiplicative_sigma.map_mul_of_coprime hmn]

name: carmichael_eq_exponent
statement: theorem carmichael_eq_exponent {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : carmichael n = exponent (ZMod n)ˣ
proof:
:= by
  cases n with | zero => contradiction | succ n =>
  change Nat.find _ = _
  grind [exponent, ExponentExists.of_finite]

name: carmichael_eq_exponent'
statement: theorem carmichael_eq_exponent' (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] : carmichael n = exponent (ZMod n)ˣ
proof:
:=
  carmichael_eq_exponent <| NeZero.ne n

name: pow_carmichael
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pow_carmichael {n : ℕ} (a : (ZMod n)ˣ) : a ^ carmichael n = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · rw [map_zero, pow_zero]
  rw [carmichael_eq_exponent']
  exact pow_exponent_eq_one a

name: carmichael_dvd_totient
statement: theorem carmichael_dvd_totient (n : ℕ) : carmichael n ∣ n.totient
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp
  rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, carmichael_eq_exponent']
  exact Group.exponent_dvd_card

name: carmichael_dvd
statement: theorem carmichael_dvd {a b : ℕ} (h : a ∣ b) : carmichael a ∣ carmichael b
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · simp
  rw [carmichael_eq_exponent <| ne_zero_of_dvd_ne_zero (by lia) h, carmichael_eq_exponent']
  exact MonoidHom.exponent_dvd <| ZMod.unitsMap_surjective h

name: carmichael_lcm
statement:
theorem carmichael_lcm (a b : ℕ) :
    carmichael (Nat.lcm a b) = Nat.lcm (carmichael a) (carmichael b)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases! h₀ : a = 0 ∨ b = 0
  · grind [Nat.lcm_eq_zero_iff, map_zero]
  apply dvd_antisymm
  · rw [carmichael_eq_exponent h₀.left, carmichael_eq_exponent h₀.right,
      carmichael_eq_exponent <| lcm_ne_zero h₀.left h₀.right, ← lcm_eq_nat_lcm <| exponent _,
      ← exponent_prod, ← exponent_eq_of_mulEquiv .prodUnits]
    exact exponent_dvd_of_monoidHom _ <| Units.map_injective <| ZMod.castHom_injective _
  · have ha := carmichael_dvd <| Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b
    have hb := carmichael_dvd <| Nat.dvd_lcm_right a b
    exact Nat.lcm_dvd ha hb

name: carmichael_mul
statement:
theorem carmichael_mul {a b : ℕ} (h : Coprime a b) :
    carmichael (a * b) = Nat.lcm (carmichael a) (carmichael b)
proof:
:=
  h.lcm_eq_mul ▸ carmichael_lcm ..

name: carmichael_finset_lcm
statement:
theorem carmichael_finset_lcm {α : Type*} (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℕ) :
    carmichael (s.lcm f) = s.lcm (carmichael ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine s.induction ?_ fun a s ha ih ↦ ?_
  · exact carmichael_eq_exponent' 1 |>.trans exp_eq_one_of_subsingleton
  rw [Finset.lcm_insert, Finset.lcm_insert, ← ih]
  exact carmichael_lcm ..

name: carmichael_finsetProd
statement:
theorem carmichael_finsetProd {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℕ}
    (h : Set.Pairwise s <| Coprime.onFun f) : carmichael (s.prod f) = s.lcm (carmichael ∘ f)
proof:
:=
  s.lcm_eq_prod h ▸ carmichael_finset_lcm ..

name: carmichael_factorization
statement:
theorem carmichael_factorization (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] :
    carmichael n = n.primeFactors.lcm fun p ↦ carmichael (p ^ n.factorization p)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 1 [← n.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self <| NeZero.ne _]
  exact carmichael_finsetProd pairwise_coprime_pow_primeFactors_factorization.set_of_subtype

name: carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two_eq_totient
statement:
theorem carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two_eq_totient {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    carmichael (2 ^ n) = (2 ^ n).totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [carmichael_eq_exponent', ← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  exact IsCyclic.iff_exponent_eq_card.mp <| ZMod.isCyclic_units_two_pow_iff n |>.mpr hn

name: carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2) :
    carmichael (2 ^ n) = 2 ^ (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two_eq_totient hn]
  interval_cases n <;> decide

name: carmichael_two_pow_of_ne_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carmichael_two_pow_of_ne_two {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 2) :
    carmichael (2 ^ n) = 2 ^ (n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn' : n ≤ 2
  · grind [carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two]
  refine carmichael_eq_exponent' _ |>.trans <| dvd_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have hcard : Nat.card (ZMod (2 ^ n))ˣ = 2 ^ (n - 1) := by
      rw [card_eq_fintype_card, ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, totient_prime_pow prime_two <| by lia,
        Nat.add_one_sub_one, mul_one]
    have ⟨k, hk, h⟩ := dvd_prime_pow prime_two |>.mp <| hcard ▸ Group.exponent_dvd_nat_card
    have := IsCyclic.iff_exponent_eq_card.not.mp <| ZMod.isCyclic_units_two_pow_iff n |>.not.mpr hn'
    exact h ▸ Nat.pow_dvd_pow 2 (by grind)
  · let five : (ZMod (2 ^ n))ˣ := ZMod.unitOfCoprime 5 <| gcd_pow_right_of_gcd_eq_one rfl
    rw [← ZMod.orderOf_five (n - 2), show n - 2 + 2 = n by lia,
      show (5 : ZMod (2 ^ n)) = five by rfl, orderOf_units]
    exact order_dvd_exponent five

name: two_mul_carmichael_two_pow_of_three_le_eq_totient
statement:
theorem two_mul_carmichael_two_pow_of_three_le_eq_totient {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
    2 * carmichael (2 ^ n) = (2 ^ n).totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [carmichael_two_pow_of_ne_two, ← pow_succ', totient_prime_pow prime_two] <;>
  · #adaptation_note /
    we need to re-enable model-based theory combination in `lia` for this to go through. -/
    lia +mbtc

name: carmichael_pow_of_prime_ne_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carmichael_pow_of_prime_ne_two {p : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp₂ : p ≠ 2) :
    carmichael (p ^ n) = (p ^ n).totient
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  rw [carmichael_eq_exponent', ← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient, Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  exact IsCyclic.iff_exponent_eq_card.mp <| ZMod.isCyclic_units_of_prime_pow p hp hp₂ n

name: carmichael_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carmichael_one : carmichael 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_zero 2, carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two (zero_le 2), pow_zero]

name: carmichael_two
statement:
@[simp]
theorem carmichael_two : carmichael 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_one 2, carmichael_two_pow_of_le_two one_le_two, tsub_self, pow_zero]

name: carmichael_of_prime
statement: theorem carmichael_of_prime {n : ℕ} (hn : n.Prime) : carmichael n = n - 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ne_two : n = 2
  · simp [ne_two]
  · rw [← Nat.totient_prime hn, ← pow_one n, ← carmichael_pow_of_prime_ne_two 1 hn ne_two]

name: mulEquiv_units
statement: lemma mulEquiv_units : Nonempty (DirichletCharacter R n ≃* (ZMod n)ˣ)
proof:
:=
  MulChar.mulEquiv_units ..

name: card_eq_totient_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity
statement:
lemma card_eq_totient_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity :
    Nat.card (DirichletCharacter R n) = n.totient
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.card_units_eq_totient n, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Nat.card_congr (mulEquiv_units R n).some.toEquiv

name: exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity
statement:
theorem exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity [Nontrivial R] ⦃a : ZMod n⦄ (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  MulChar.exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity (ZMod n) R ha

name: sum_characters_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sum_characters_eq_zero ⦃a : ZMod n⦄ (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ⟩ := exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R ha
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hχ ?_
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum, ← MulChar.mul_apply]
  exact Fintype.sum_bijective _ (Group.mulLeft_bijective χ) _ _ fun χ' ↦ rfl

name: sum_characters_eq
statement:
theorem sum_characters_eq (a : ZMod n) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a = if a = 1 then (n.totient : R) else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with ha
  · simpa only [ha, map_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one,
      ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      using congrArg Nat.cast <| card_eq_totient_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity R n
  · exact sum_characters_eq_zero R ha

name: sum_char_inv_mul_char_eq
statement:
theorem sum_char_inv_mul_char_eq {a : ZMod n} (ha : IsUnit a) (b : ZMod n) :
    ∑ χ : DirichletCharacter R n, χ a⁻¹ * χ b = if a = b then (n.totient : R) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← map_mul, sum_characters_eq, ZMod.inv_mul_eq_one_of_isUnit ha]

name: gaussSum_aux_of_mulShift
proof:
:= by
  suffices e.mulShift u = e by conv_lhs => rw [← this, gaussSum_mulShift]
  rw [(by ring : u.val = (u - 1) + 1), ← mulShift_mul, mulShift_one, mul_eq_right]
  rsuffices ⟨a, ha⟩ : (d : ℤ) ∣ (u.val.val - 1 : ℤ)
  · have : u.val - 1 = ↑(u.val.val - 1 : ℤ) := by simp only [ZMod.natCast_val, Int.cast_sub,
      ZMod.intCast_cast, ZMod.cast_id', id_eq, Int.cast_one]
    rw [this, ha]
    ext1 y
    simpa only [Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_natCast, mulShift_apply, mul_assoc, one_apply]
      using DFunLike.ext_iff.mp he (a * y)
  rw [← Units.val_inj, Units.val_one, ZMod.unitsMap_def, Units.coe_map] at hu
  have : ZMod.castHom hd (ZMod d) u.val = ((u.val.val : ℤ) : ZMod d) := by simp
  rwa [MonoidHom.coe_coe, this, ← Int.cast_one, eq_comm,
    ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff_dvd_sub] at hu

name: factorsThrough_of_gaussSum_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [DirichletCharacter.factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap hd]
  intro _ hu
  simpa [← Units.val_inj, h_ne] using gaussSum_aux_of_mulShift e χ hd he hu

name: gaussSum_eq_zero_of_isPrimitive_of_not_isPrimitive
statement:
lemma gaussSum_eq_zero_of_isPrimitive_of_not_isPrimitive [IsDomain R]
    {χ : DirichletCharacter R N} (hχ : IsPrimitive χ) (he : ¬IsPrimitive e) :
    gaussSum χ e = 0
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hχ
  rcases e.exists_divisor_of_not_isPrimitive he with ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂, hed⟩
  have : χ.conductor ≤ d := Nat.sInf_le <| factorsThrough_of_gaussSum_ne_zero e hd₁ hed hχ
  exact (this.trans_lt hd₂).ne

name: gaussSum_mulShift_of_isPrimitive
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsUnit a
  · simpa [ha.unit_spec] using gaussSum_mulShift_eq χ e ha.unit
  · rw [MulChar.map_nonunit _ ha, zero_mul]
    exact gaussSum_eq_zero_of_isPrimitive_of_not_isPrimitive _ hχ (not_isPrimitive_mulShift e ha)

name: toUnitHom_eq_char'
statement: lemma toUnitHom_eq_char' {a : ZMod n} (ha : IsUnit a) : χ a = χ.toUnitHom ha.unit
proof: := by simp

name: toUnitHom_inj
statement: lemma toUnitHom_inj (ψ : DirichletCharacter R n) : toUnitHom χ = toUnitHom ψ ↔ χ = ψ
proof: := by simp

name: eval_modulus_sub
statement: lemma eval_modulus_sub (x : ZMod n) : χ (n - x) = χ (-x)
proof: := by simp

name: apply_ne_zero_iff
statement: lemma apply_ne_zero_iff [Nontrivial R] (a : ℤ) : χ a ≠ 0 ↔ IsCoprime a n
proof:
:= by
  rw [MulChar.apply_ne_zero_iff, ZMod.coe_int_isUnit_iff_isCoprime, isCoprime_comm]

name: apply_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma apply_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial R] (a : ℤ) : χ a = 0 ↔ ¬ IsCoprime a n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (apply_ne_zero_iff χ a).not, ne_eq, not_not]

name: changeLevel_def
statement:
lemma changeLevel_def {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) :
    changeLevel hm χ = MulChar.ofUnitHom (χ.toUnitHom.comp (ZMod.unitsMap hm))
proof: := rfl

name: changeLevel_toUnitHom
statement:
lemma changeLevel_toUnitHom {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) :
    (changeLevel hm χ).toUnitHom = χ.toUnitHom.comp (ZMod.unitsMap hm)
proof:
:= by
  simp [changeLevel]

name: changeLevel_injective
statement:
lemma changeLevel_injective {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hm : n ∣ m) :
    Function.Injective (changeLevel (R := R) hm)
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ h
  ext1 y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ZMod.unitsMap_surjective hm y
  rw [MulChar.ext_iff] at h
  simpa [changeLevel_def] using h z

name: changeLevel_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma changeLevel_eq_one_iff {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} (hm : n ∣ m) :
    changeLevel hm χ = 1 ↔ χ = 1
proof:
:=
  map_eq_one_iff _ (changeLevel_injective hm)

name: changeLevel_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma changeLevel_self : changeLevel (dvd_refl n) χ = χ
proof:
:= by
  simp [changeLevel, ZMod.unitsMap]

name: changeLevel_self_toUnitHom
statement: lemma changeLevel_self_toUnitHom : (changeLevel (dvd_refl n) χ).toUnitHom = χ.toUnitHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [changeLevel_self]

name: changeLevel_trans
statement:
lemma changeLevel_trans {m d : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) (hd : m ∣ d) :
    changeLevel (dvd_trans hm hd) χ = changeLevel hd (changeLevel hm χ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [changeLevel_def, MonoidHom.comp_assoc, ZMod.unitsMap_comp]

name: changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd
statement:
lemma changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) (a : Units (ZMod m)) :
    (changeLevel hm χ) a = χ (ZMod.cast (a : ZMod m))
proof:
:= by
  simp [changeLevel_def, ZMod.unitsMap_val]

name: changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd'
statement:
lemma changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) {a : ℤ} (ha : IsCoprime a m) :
    changeLevel hm χ a = χ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ZMod.coe_unitOfIsCoprime _ ha, changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd _ hm, ZMod.coe_unitOfIsCoprime,
    ZMod.cast_intCast hm]

name: changeLevel_factorsThrough
statement: lemma changeLevel_factorsThrough {m : ℕ} (hm : n ∣ m) : FactorsThrough (changeLevel hm χ) n
proof:
:=
  ⟨hm, χ, rfl⟩

name: dvd
statement: lemma dvd {d : ℕ} (h : FactorsThrough χ d) : d ∣ n

name: eq_changeLevel
statement: lemma eq_changeLevel {d : ℕ} (h : FactorsThrough χ d) : χ = changeLevel h.dvd h.χ₀
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec h.2

name: existsUnique
statement:
lemma existsUnique {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (h : FactorsThrough χ d) :
    ∃! χ' : DirichletCharacter R d, χ = changeLevel h.dvd χ'
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hd, χ₂, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨χ₂, rfl, fun χ₃ hχ₃ ↦ (changeLevel_injective hd hχ₃).symm⟩

name: same_level
statement: lemma same_level : FactorsThrough χ n
proof: := ⟨dvd_refl n, χ, (changeLevel_self χ).symm⟩

name: factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap
statement:
lemma factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hd : d ∣ n) :
    FactorsThrough χ d ↔ (ZMod.unitsMap hd).ker ≤ χ.toUnitHom.ker
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨χ₀, hχ₀⟩⟩ x hx ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker, hχ₀, changeLevel_toUnitHom, MonoidHom.comp_apply, hx, map_one]
  · let E := MonoidHom.liftOfSurjective _ (ZMod.unitsMap_surjective hd) ⟨_, h⟩
    have hE : E.comp (ZMod.unitsMap hd) = χ.toUnitHom := MonoidHom.liftOfRightInverse_comp ..
    refine ⟨hd, MulChar.ofUnitHom E, equivToUnitHom.injective (?_ : toUnitHom _ = toUnitHom _)⟩
    simp_rw [changeLevel_toUnitHom, toUnitHom_eq, ofUnitHom_eq, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hE,
      toUnitHom_eq]

name: FactorsThrough.mono
statement:
theorem FactorsThrough.mono {d m : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hχ : FactorsThrough χ d) (hd : d ∣ m)
    (hm : m ∣ n) :
    FactorsThrough χ m
proof:
:= by
  refine (factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap hm).mpr fun x hx ↦ ?_
  apply (factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap hχ.dvd).mp hχ
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
  rw [← ZMod.unitsMap_comp hd hm, MonoidHom.comp_apply, hx, map_one]

name: factorsThrough_gcd
statement:
theorem factorsThrough_gcd {m : ℕ} [NeZero n] (ψ : DirichletCharacter R m)
    (h : χ.changeLevel (n.dvd_mul_right m) = ψ.changeLevel (m.dvd_mul_left n)) :
    χ.FactorsThrough (n.gcd m)
proof:
:= by
  refine (factorsThrough_iff_ker_unitsMap (n.gcd_dvd_left m)).mpr fun x hx ↦
    MonoidHom.mem_ker.mpr ?_
  rw [Units.ext_iff, MulChar.coe_toUnitHom, Units.val_one]
  obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ : ∃ z : ℕ, z = x.val ∧ (z : ZMod m) = 1 := by
    suffices x.val.val ≡ 1 [MOD n.gcd m] by
      obtain ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩ := Nat.chineseRemainder' this
      refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simpa [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] using hz₁
      · rwa [← ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff, Nat.cast_one] at hz₂
    rwa [MonoidHom.mem_ker, Units.ext_iff, ZMod.unitsMap_val, ← ZMod.natCast_val,
      Units.val_one, ← Nat.cast_one, ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at hx
  have hz₀ : z.gcd (n * m) = 1 := by
    refine Nat.Coprime.mul_right ?_ ?_
    · exact (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime _ _).mp <| hz₁ ▸ x.isUnit
    · exact (ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime _ _).mp <| hz₂ ▸ isUnit_one
  have := changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd χ (n.dvd_mul_right m) (ZMod.unitOfCoprime z hz₀)
  simp only [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime, dvd_mul_right, ZMod.cast_natCast] at this
  rw [← hz₁, ← this, h]
  have := changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd ψ (m.dvd_mul_left n) (ZMod.unitOfCoprime z hz₀)
  simp only [ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime, dvd_mul_left, ZMod.cast_natCast] at this
  rw [this, hz₂, map_one]

name: level_one
statement: lemma level_one (χ : DirichletCharacter R 1) : χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp [Units.eq_one]

name: level_one'
statement: lemma level_one' (hn : n = 1) : χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  subst hn
  exact level_one _

name: map_zero'
statement: lemma map_zero' (hn : n ≠ 1) : χ 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  have := ZMod.nontrivial_iff.mpr hn; χ.map_zero

name: changeLevel_one
statement:
lemma changeLevel_one {d : ℕ} (h : d ∣ n) :
    changeLevel h (1 : DirichletCharacter R d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: factorsThrough_one_iff
statement: lemma factorsThrough_one_iff : FactorsThrough χ 1 ↔ χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, χ₀, hχ₀⟩ ↦ ?_,
          fun h ↦ ⟨one_dvd n, 1, by rw [h, changeLevel_one]⟩⟩
  rwa [level_one χ₀, changeLevel_one] at hχ₀

name: mem_conductorSet_iff
statement: lemma mem_conductorSet_iff {x : ℕ} : x ∈ conductorSet χ ↔ FactorsThrough χ x
proof: := Iff.refl _

name: level_mem_conductorSet
statement: lemma level_mem_conductorSet : n ∈ conductorSet χ
proof: := FactorsThrough.same_level χ

name: mem_conductorSet_dvd
statement: lemma mem_conductorSet_dvd {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ conductorSet χ) : x ∣ n
proof: := hx.dvd

name: zero_ne_mem_conductorSet
statement: theorem zero_ne_mem_conductorSet [NeZero n] : 0 ∉ χ.conductorSet
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ NeZero.ne n <| Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd <| FactorsThrough.dvd h

name: conductor_mem_conductorSet
statement: lemma conductor_mem_conductorSet : conductor χ ∈ conductorSet χ
proof:
:=
  Nat.sInf_mem (Set.nonempty_of_mem (level_mem_conductorSet χ))

name: conductor_dvd_level
statement: lemma conductor_dvd_level : conductor χ ∣ n
proof: := (conductor_mem_conductorSet χ).dvd

name: factorsThrough_conductor
statement: lemma factorsThrough_conductor : FactorsThrough χ (conductor χ)
proof: := conductor_mem_conductorSet χ

name: conductor_ne_zero
statement: lemma conductor_ne_zero [NeZero n] : conductor χ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h ↦ NeZero.ne n <| Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd <| h ▸ conductor_dvd_level _

name: conductor_one
statement: lemma conductor_one [NeZero n] : conductor (1 : DirichletCharacter R n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  suffices FactorsThrough (1 : DirichletCharacter R n) 1 by
    have h : conductor (1 : DirichletCharacter R n) ≤ 1 :=
      Nat.sInf_le <| (mem_conductorSet_iff _).mpr this
    exact Nat.le_antisymm h (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| conductor_ne_zero _)
  exact (factorsThrough_one_iff _).mpr rfl

name: eq_one_iff_conductor_eq_one
statement: lemma eq_one_iff_conductor_eq_one [NeZero n] : χ = 1 ↔ conductor χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ conductor_one, fun hχ ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨h', χ₀, h⟩ := factorsThrough_conductor χ
  exact (level_one' χ₀ hχ ▸ h).trans <| changeLevel_one h'

name: conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero
statement: lemma conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero : conductor χ = 0 ↔ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · contrapose!
    exact fun h ↦ @conductor_ne_zero _ _ _ χ ⟨h⟩
  · rintro rfl
    exact Nat.sInf_eq_zero.mpr <| Or.inl <| level_mem_conductorSet χ

name: conductor_le_conductor_mem_conductorSet
statement:
lemma conductor_le_conductor_mem_conductorSet {d : ℕ} (hd : d ∈ conductorSet χ) :
    χ.conductor ≤ (Classical.choose hd.2).conductor
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.sInf_le <| (mem_conductorSet_iff χ).mpr <|
    ⟨dvd_trans (conductor_dvd_level _) hd.1,
     (factorsThrough_conductor (Classical.choose hd.2)).2.choose, ?_⟩
  rw [changeLevel_trans _ (conductor_dvd_level _) hd.dvd,
      ← (factorsThrough_conductor (Classical.choose hd.2)).2.choose_spec]
  exact hd.eq_changeLevel

name: isPrimitive_def
statement: lemma isPrimitive_def : IsPrimitive χ ↔ conductor χ = n
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isPrimitive_one_level_one
statement: lemma isPrimitive_one_level_one : IsPrimitive (1 : DirichletCharacter R 1)
proof:
:=
  Nat.dvd_one.mp (conductor_dvd_level _)

name: isPrimitive_one_level_zero
statement: lemma isPrimitive_one_level_zero : IsPrimitive (1 : DirichletCharacter R 0)
proof:
:=
  conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero.mpr rfl

name: conductor_one_dvd
statement: lemma conductor_one_dvd (n : ℕ) : conductor (1 : DirichletCharacter R 1) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [(isPrimitive_def _).mp isPrimitive_one_level_one]
  apply one_dvd _

name: changeLevel_primitiveCharacter
statement:
theorem changeLevel_primitiveCharacter :
    (changeLevel χ.conductor_dvd_level) χ.primitiveCharacter = χ
proof:
:=
  (factorsThrough_conductor χ).choose_spec.choose_spec.symm

name: primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive
statement: lemma primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive : IsPrimitive (χ.primitiveCharacter)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : χ.conductor = 0
  · rw [isPrimitive_def]
    convert! conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero.mpr h
  · exact le_antisymm (Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h) (conductor_dvd_level _)) <|
      conductor_le_conductor_mem_conductorSet <| conductor_mem_conductorSet χ

name: primitiveCharacter_one
statement: lemma primitiveCharacter_one [NeZero n] : (1 : DirichletCharacter R n).primitiveCharacter = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (conductor (1 : DirichletCharacter R n)) :=
    ⟨@conductor_one R _ n _ ▸ Nat.one_ne_zero⟩
  rw [eq_one_iff_conductor_eq_one,
    (isPrimitive_def _).1 (1 : DirichletCharacter R n).primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive,
    conductor_one]

name: primitiveCharacter_apply_of_isCoprime
statement:
theorem primitiveCharacter_apply_of_isCoprime {a : ℤ} (ha : IsCoprime a n) :
    χ.primitiveCharacter a = χ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [← changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' χ.primitiveCharacter χ.conductor_dvd_level ha,
    changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: conductor_dvd_of_mem_conductorSet
statement:
theorem conductor_dvd_of_mem_conductorSet {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hd : d ∈ χ.conductorSet) :
    χ.conductor ∣ d
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero d := ⟨by
    contrapose hd
    exact hd ▸ zero_ne_mem_conductorSet χ⟩
  suffices d.gcd χ.conductor ∈ χ.conductorSet by
    have : χ.conductor ≤ d.gcd χ.conductor := Nat.sInf_le this
    contrapose! this
    refine Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne ?_ (Nat.gcd_eq_right_iff_dvd.not.mpr this)
    exact Nat.gcd_le_right _ <| Nat.pos_of_ne_zero <| conductor_ne_zero χ
  obtain ⟨hd, χ₀, hχ₀⟩ := hd
  suffices (changeLevel (d.dvd_mul_right χ.conductor)) χ₀ =
      (changeLevel (χ.conductor.dvd_mul_left d)) χ.primitiveCharacter by
    obtain ⟨_, χ₁, hχ₁⟩ := factorsThrough_gcd χ₀ χ.primitiveCharacter this
    refine ⟨Nat.dvd_trans (d.gcd_dvd_left χ.conductor) hd, χ₁, ?_⟩
    rw [changeLevel_trans _ (d.gcd_dvd_left χ.conductor), ← hχ₁, hχ₀]
  have : NeZero (d * χ.conductor * n) :=
    ⟨Nat.mul_ne_zero (Nat.mul_ne_zero (NeZero.ne d) χ.conductor_ne_zero) (NeZero.ne n)⟩
  apply changeLevel_injective <| Nat.dvd_mul_right (d * χ.conductor) n
  rw [← changeLevel_trans, ← changeLevel_trans,
    changeLevel_trans _ hd (n.dvd_mul_left (d * χ.conductor)), ← hχ₀,
    changeLevel_trans χ.primitiveCharacter χ.conductor_dvd_level, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd
statement:
theorem mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd {d : ℕ} [NeZero n] (hd : d ∣ n) :
    d ∈ χ.conductorSet ↔ χ.conductor ∣ d
proof:
:=
  ⟨conductor_dvd_of_mem_conductorSet χ, fun h ↦ χ.factorsThrough_conductor.mono χ h hd⟩

name: conductor_changeLevel
statement:
theorem conductor_changeLevel {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hm : n ∣ m) :
    (changeLevel hm χ).conductor = χ.conductor
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero n := ⟨by aesop⟩
  have h : (changeLevel hm χ).conductor ∣ χ.conductor := by
    refine conductor_dvd_of_mem_conductorSet _
      ⟨χ.conductor_dvd_level.trans hm, χ.primitiveCharacter, ?_⟩
    rw [changeLevel_trans _ χ.conductor_dvd_level, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]
  refine h.antisymm <| conductor_dvd_of_mem_conductorSet _
    ⟨h.trans χ.conductor_dvd_level, (changeLevel hm χ).primitiveCharacter, ?_⟩
  apply changeLevel_injective hm
  rw [← changeLevel_trans, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: primitiveCharacter_changeLevel_apply
statement:
theorem primitiveCharacter_changeLevel_apply [Nontrivial R] {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] (hm : n ∣ m)
    (χ : DirichletCharacter R n) (a : ℤ) :
    (changeLevel hm χ).primitiveCharacter a = χ.primitiveCharacter a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsCoprime a χ.conductor
  · suffices changeLevel (dvd_of_eq <| conductor_changeLevel ..)
        (changeLevel hm χ).primitiveCharacter = χ.primitiveCharacter by
      have := DFunLike.congr_fun this (a : ZMod _)
      rwa [changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' _ _ ha] at this
    apply changeLevel_injective (χ.conductor_dvd_level.trans hm)
    rw [← changeLevel_trans, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter,
      χ.primitiveCharacter.changeLevel_trans χ.conductor_dvd_level, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]
  · rw [(apply_eq_zero_iff ..).mpr ha, (apply_eq_zero_iff ..).mpr (by rwa [conductor_changeLevel])]

name: conductor_zpow_dvd
statement:
lemma conductor_zpow_dvd (χ : DirichletCharacter R n) (m : ℤ) :
    conductor (χ ^ m) ∣ conductor χ
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_zero_or_neZero n
  · simp [conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero.mpr]
  rw [← mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd _ χ.conductor_dvd_level, mem_conductorSet_iff]
  refine ⟨χ.conductor_dvd_level, χ.primitiveCharacter ^ m, ?_⟩
  rw [MonoidHom.map_zpow, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: conductor_pow_dvd
statement:
lemma conductor_pow_dvd (χ : DirichletCharacter R n) (m : ℕ) :
    conductor (χ ^ m) ∣ conductor χ
proof:
:=
  zpow_natCast χ m ▸ conductor_zpow_dvd ..

name: conductor_inv
statement:
theorem conductor_inv (χ : DirichletCharacter R n) :
    χ⁻¹.conductor = χ.conductor
proof:
:= by
  rw [← zpow_neg_one]
  refine dvd_antisymm (conductor_zpow_dvd ..) ?_
  nth_rewrite 1 [← inv_inv χ, ← zpow_neg_one, ← zpow_neg_one]
  exact conductor_zpow_dvd ..

name: mul_def
statement:
lemma mul_def {n m : ℕ} {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} {ψ : DirichletCharacter R m} :
    χ.primitive_mul ψ = primitiveCharacter (mul χ ψ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: primitive_mul_isPrimitive
statement:
lemma primitive_mul_isPrimitive {m : ℕ} (ψ : DirichletCharacter R m) :
    IsPrimitive (primitive_mul χ ψ)
proof:
:=
  primitiveCharacter_isPrimitive _

name: conductor_mul_dvd_lcm_conductor
statement:
theorem conductor_mul_dvd_lcm_conductor (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter R n) :
    (χ * ψ).conductor ∣ χ.conductor.lcm ψ.conductor
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_zero_or_neZero n
  · simp [conductor_eq_zero_iff_level_eq_zero.mpr]
  have h := Nat.lcm_dvd χ.conductor_dvd_level ψ.conductor_dvd_level
  rw [← mem_conductorSet_iff_conductor_dvd _ h, mem_conductorSet_iff]
  refine ⟨h, χ.primitiveCharacter.mul ψ.primitiveCharacter, ?_⟩
  rw [mul, MonoidHom.map_mul, ← changeLevel_trans, ← changeLevel_trans,
    changeLevel_primitiveCharacter, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: mem_subgroupOfCoprimeConductor
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_subgroupOfCoprimeConductor [NeZero n] {d : ℕ} {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} :
    χ ∈ subgroupOfCoprimeConductor d ↔ d.Coprime χ.conductor
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: mem_annihilator_iff_mem_closure
statement:
theorem mem_annihilator_iff_mem_closure {H : Set (ZMod n)ˣ} {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} :
    χ ∈ annihilator R H ↔ ∀ x ∈ Submonoid.closure H, χ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [annihilator, MonoidHom.mem_ker, MulChar.domRestrictHom_apply,
    MulChar.domRestrict_eq_one_iff]
  refine ⟨fun hχ x hx ↦ ?_, fun h u ↦ ?_⟩
  · exact hχ <| (Submonoid.unitsEquivUnitsType _) <|
      ⟨x, Submonoid.mem_units_of_val_mem_inv_val_mem _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        ⟨x⁻¹, by simpa [← Subgroup.closure_toSubmonoid_of_finite] using hx, rfl⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyu⟩ := Submonoid.mem_map.mp u.val.prop
    exact hyu ▸ h _ hy

name: mem_annihilator_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_annihilator_iff {H : Set (ZMod n)ˣ} {χ : DirichletCharacter R n} :
    χ ∈ annihilator R H ↔ ∀ a ∈ H, χ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_annihilator_iff_mem_closure]
  refine ⟨fun h a ha ↦ h a (Submonoid.subset_closure ha), fun h x hx ↦ ?_⟩
  refine Submonoid.closure_induction h (by simp) (fun a b _ _ ha hb ↦ ?_) hx
  simp [map_mul, ha, hb]

name: mem_subgroupOfPrimitiveMapToOne_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_subgroupOfPrimitiveMapToOne_iff [NeZero n] [Nontrivial R] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    χ ∈ subgroupOfPrimitiveMapToOne R n p ↔ χ.primitiveCharacter p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : NeZero (n / p ^ n.factorization p) := ⟨(Nat.ordCompl_pos p (NeZero.ne n)).ne'⟩
  have hcop := Nat.coprime_ordCompl hp.out (NeZero.ne n)
  simp only [subgroupOfPrimitiveMapToOne, Subgroup.mem_map, mem_annihilator_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff, forall_eq, ZMod.coe_unitOfCoprime]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨ψ, hψ, rfl⟩
    rw [← Int.cast_natCast] at hψ ⊢
    rw [primitiveCharacter_changeLevel_apply, primitiveCharacter_apply_of_isCoprime, hψ]
    exact Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hcop
  · have hdvd : χ.conductor ∣ n / p ^ n.factorization p := by
      apply Nat.dvd_ordCompl_of_dvd_not_dvd χ.conductor_dvd_level
      simp [← hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd, ← Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime,
        ← apply_ne_zero_iff (χ := χ.primitiveCharacter), h]
    refine ⟨changeLevel hdvd χ.primitiveCharacter, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [show (p : ZMod (n / p ^ n.factorization p))
          = ((p : ℤ) : ZMod (n / p ^ n.factorization p)) from (Int.cast_natCast p).symm,
        changeLevel_eq_cast_of_dvd' χ.primitiveCharacter hdvd (Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.mpr hcop),
        Int.cast_natCast]
      exact h
    · rw [← changeLevel_trans, changeLevel_primitiveCharacter]

name: even_or_odd
statement: lemma even_or_odd [NoZeroDivisors S] : ψ.Even ∨ ψ.Odd
proof:
:= by
  suffices ψ (-1) ^ 2 = 1 by convert! sq_eq_one_iff.mp this
  rw [← map_pow _, neg_one_sq, map_one]

name: not_even_and_odd
statement: lemma not_even_and_odd [NeZero (2 : S)] : ¬(ψ.Even ∧ ψ.Odd)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨(h : _ = 1), (h' : _ = -1)⟩
  simp only [h', neg_eq_iff_add_eq_zero, one_add_one_eq_two, two_ne_zero] at h

name: Even.not_odd
statement: lemma Even.not_odd [NeZero (2 : S)] (hψ : Even ψ) : ¬Odd ψ
proof:
:=
  not_and.mp ψ.not_even_and_odd hψ

name: Odd.not_even
statement: lemma Odd.not_even [NeZero (2 : S)] (hψ : Odd ψ) : ¬Even ψ
proof:
:=
  not_and'.mp ψ.not_even_and_odd hψ

name: Odd.toUnitHom_eval_neg_one
statement: lemma Odd.toUnitHom_eval_neg_one (hψ : ψ.Odd) : ψ.toUnitHom (-1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.val_inj, MulChar.coe_toUnitHom]
  exact hψ

name: Even.toUnitHom_eval_neg_one
statement: lemma Even.toUnitHom_eval_neg_one (hψ : ψ.Even) : ψ.toUnitHom (-1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Units.val_inj, MulChar.coe_toUnitHom]
  exact hψ

name: Odd.eval_neg
statement: lemma Odd.eval_neg (x : ZMod m) (hψ : ψ.Odd) : ψ (-x) = - ψ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Odd] at hψ
  rw [← neg_one_mul, map_mul]
  simp [hψ]

name: Even.eval_neg
statement: lemma Even.eval_neg (x : ZMod m) (hψ : ψ.Even) : ψ (-x) = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Even] at hψ
  rw [← neg_one_mul, map_mul]
  simp [hψ]

name: Even.to_fun
statement: lemma Even.to_fun {χ : DirichletCharacter S m} (hχ : Even χ) : Function.Even χ

name: Odd.to_fun

name: unit_norm_eq_one
statement: @[simp] lemma unit_norm_eq_one (a : (ZMod n)ˣ) : ‖χ a‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (pow_eq_one_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (Nat.card_pos (α := (ZMod n)ˣ)).ne').mp ?_
  rw [← norm_pow, ← map_pow, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, pow_card_eq_one', Units.val_one, map_one,

name: norm_le_one

proof:

name: mem_commensurator_left

theorem mem_commensurator_left (H₂ : Subgroup G) [IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₂] (g : Δ) :
    (g : G) ∈ commensurator H₁

name: commensurable_conjAct_right
statement:
theorem commensurable_conjAct_right [IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₂] (g : Δ) :

proof:
:= by
  have hg : Commensurable (ConjAct.toConjAct (g : G) • H₂) H₂ := mem_commensurator_right H₁ g
  exact hg.trans (commensurable (Δ := Δ)).symm

name: trans
statement:
theorem trans [IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₂] [IsHeckeTriple Δ H₂ H₃] :
    IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₃
proof:
:=
  ⟨left_le H₂, right_le H₂,
    (commensurable (Δ := Δ) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂)).trans
      (commensurable (Δ := Δ) (H₁ := H₂) (H₂ := H₃)),
    le_commensurator_right H₂⟩

name: diag_left
statement: theorem diag_left [IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₂] : IsHeckeTriple Δ H₁ H₁

proof:

  ⟨right_le H₁, right_le H₁, .refl H₂, le_commensurator_right H₁⟩

name: inv_goldenRatio
statement: theorem inv_goldenRatio : φ⁻¹ = -ψ
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: inv_goldenConj

proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, ← neg_inv, ← neg_eq_iff_eq_neg]
  exact inv_goldenRatio.symm

name: goldenRatio_mul_goldenConj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem goldenRatio_mul_goldenConj : φ * ψ = -1
proof:
:= by

name: goldenConj_mul_goldenRatio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem goldenConj_mul_goldenRatio : ψ * φ = -1
proof:

name: goldenRatio_add_goldenConj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem goldenRatio_add_goldenConj : φ + ψ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [goldenRatio, goldenConj]
  ring

name: one_sub_goldenConj
statement: theorem one_sub_goldenConj : 1 - φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  linarith [goldenRatio_add_goldenConj]

name: one_sub_goldenRatio
statement: theorem one_sub_goldenRatio : 1 - ψ = φ
proof:
:= by
  linarith [goldenRatio_add_goldenConj]

name: goldenRatio_sub_goldenConj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem goldenRatio_sub_goldenConj : φ - ψ = √5
proof: := by ring

name: goldenRatio_pow_sub_goldenRatio_pow
statement: theorem goldenRatio_pow_sub_goldenRatio_pow (n : ℕ) : φ ^ (n + 2) - φ ^ (n + 1) = φ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: goldenRatio_sq
statement:
@[simp 1200]
theorem goldenRatio_sq : φ ^ 2 = φ + 1
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: goldenConj_sq
statement:
@[simp 1200]
theorem goldenConj_sq : ψ ^ 2 = ψ + 1
proof:
:= by
  grind

name: goldenRatio_pos
statement: theorem goldenRatio_pos : 0 < φ
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (by apply add_pos <;> norm_num) <| inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two

name: goldenRatio_ne_zero
statement: theorem goldenRatio_ne_zero : φ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_of_gt goldenRatio_pos

name: one_lt_goldenRatio
statement: theorem one_lt_goldenRatio : 1 < φ
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_mul_lt_mul_left ?_ (le_of_lt goldenRatio_pos)
  simp [← sq, zero_lt_one]

name: goldenRatio_lt_two
statement: theorem goldenRatio_lt_two : φ < 2
proof:
:= by calc
  (1 + √5) / 2 < (1 + 3) / 2 := by gcongr; rw [sqrt_lt'] <;> norm_num
  _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: goldenConj_neg
statement: theorem goldenConj_neg : ψ < 0
proof:
:= by
  linarith [one_sub_goldenConj, one_lt_goldenRatio]

name: goldenConj_ne_zero
statement: theorem goldenConj_ne_zero : ψ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_of_lt goldenConj_neg

name: neg_one_lt_goldenConj
statement: theorem neg_one_lt_goldenConj : -1 < ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_lt, ← inv_goldenRatio]
  exact inv_lt_one_of_one_lt₀ one_lt_goldenRatio

name: goldenRatio_irrational
statement: theorem goldenRatio_irrational : Irrational φ
proof:
:= by
  have := Nat.Prime.irrational_sqrt (show Nat.Prime 5 by norm_num)
  have := this.ratCast_add 1
  convert! this.ratCast_mul (show (0.5 : ℚ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
  simp
  ring

name: goldenConj_irrational
statement: theorem goldenConj_irrational : Irrational ψ
proof:
:= by
  have := Nat.Prime.irrational_sqrt (show Nat.Prime 5 by norm_num)
  have := this.ratCast_sub 1
  convert! this.ratCast_mul (show (0.5 : ℚ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
  simp
  ring

name: fibRec_charPoly_eq
statement:
theorem fibRec_charPoly_eq {β : Type*} [CommRing β] :
    fibRec.charPoly = X ^ 2 - (X + (1 : β[X]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibRec, LinearRecurrence.charPoly]
  simp [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ', ← smul_X_eq_monomial]

name: fib_isSol_fibRec
statement: theorem fib_isSol_fibRec : fibRec.IsSolution (fun x => x.fib : ℕ → α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibRec]
  intro n
  simp only
  rw [Nat.fib_add_two, add_comm]
  simp [Finset.sum_fin_eq_sum_range, Finset.sum_range_succ']

name: geom_goldenRatio_isSol_fibRec
statement: theorem geom_goldenRatio_isSol_fibRec : fibRec.IsSolution (φ ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibRec.geom_sol_iff_root_charPoly, fibRec_charPoly_eq]
  simp

name: geom_goldenConj_isSol_fibRec
statement: theorem geom_goldenConj_isSol_fibRec : fibRec.IsSolution (ψ ^ ·)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibRec.geom_sol_iff_root_charPoly, fibRec_charPoly_eq]
  simp

name: coe_fib_eq'
statement:
theorem coe_fib_eq' :
    (fun n => Nat.fib n : ℕ → ℝ) = fun n => (φ ^ n - ψ ^ n) / √5
proof:
:= by
  rw [fibRec.eq_iff_eqOn_range_order]
  · intro i hi
    norm_cast at hi
    fin_cases hi <;> simp
  · exact fib_isSol_fibRec
  · suffices LinearRecurrence.IsSolution fibRec
        ((fun n ↦ (√5)⁻¹ * φ ^ n) - (fun n ↦ (√5)⁻¹ * ψ ^ n)) by
      convert! this
      rw [Pi.sub_apply]
      ring
    apply (@fibRec ℝ _).solSpace.sub_mem
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem fibRec.solSpace (√5)⁻¹ geom_goldenRatio_isSol_fibRec
    · exact Submodule.smul_mem fibRec.solSpace (√5)⁻¹ geom_goldenConj_isSol_fibRec

name: coe_fib_eq
statement: theorem coe_fib_eq : ∀ n, (Nat.fib n : ℝ) = (φ ^ n - ψ ^ n) / √5
proof:
:= by
  rw [← funext_iff, Real.coe_fib_eq']

name: coe_intFib_eq
statement: theorem coe_intFib_eq (n : ℤ) : (Int.fib n : ℝ) = (φ ^ n - ψ ^ n) / √5
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, (rfl | rfl)⟩ := n.eq_nat_or_neg
  · exact coe_fib_eq n
  · simp only [Int.fib_neg, Int.even_coe_nat, Int.fib_natCast, Int.cast_ite, Int.cast_neg,
      Int.cast_natCast, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, ← inv_pow, inv_goldenRatio, inv_goldenConj,
      ← neg_one_mul ψ, ← neg_one_mul φ, mul_pow, neg_one_pow_eq_ite]
    grind [coe_fib_eq]

name: fib_succ_sub_goldenRatio_mul_fib
statement: theorem fib_succ_sub_goldenRatio_mul_fib (n : ℕ) : Nat.fib (n + 1) - φ * Nat.fib n = ψ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  repeat rw [coe_fib_eq]
  rw [mul_div, div_sub_div_same, mul_sub, ← pow_succ']
  ring_nf
  have nz : √5 ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  rw [← (mul_inv_cancel₀ nz).symm, one_mul]

name: goldenConj_mul_fib_succ_add_fib
statement: lemma goldenConj_mul_fib_succ_add_fib (n : ℕ) : ψ * Nat.fib (n + 1) + Nat.fib n = ψ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  grind [fib_succ_sub_goldenRatio_mul_fib]

name: goldenRatio_mul_fib_succ_add_fib
statement: lemma goldenRatio_mul_fib_succ_add_fib (n : ℕ) : φ * Nat.fib (n + 1) + Nat.fib n = φ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      _ = φ * (Nat.fib n) + φ ^ 2 * (Nat.fib (n + 1)) := by
        simp only [Nat.fib_add_one (Nat.succ_ne_zero n), Nat.succ_sub_succ_eq_sub,
          Nat.cast_add, goldenRatio_sq, Nat.sub_zero]; ring
      _ = φ * ((Nat.fib n) + φ * (Nat.fib (n + 1))) := by ring
      _ = φ ^ (n + 2) := by rw [add_comm, ih]; ring

name: fib_succ_sub_goldenConj_mul_fib
statement: theorem fib_succ_sub_goldenConj_mul_fib (n : ℕ) : Nat.fib (n + 1) - ψ * Nat.fib n = φ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  grind [goldenRatio_mul_fib_succ_add_fib]

name: irrational_iff_ne_rational
statement: theorem irrational_iff_ne_rational (x : ℝ) : Irrational x ↔ ∀ a b : ℤ, b ≠ 0 → x ≠ a / b
proof:

name: Irrational.ne_rational
statement: theorem Irrational.ne_rational {x : ℝ} (hx : Irrational x) (a b : ℤ) : x ≠ a / b
proof:

  rintro rfl; exact hx ⟨a / b, by simp⟩

name: exists_rat_of_not_irrational
statement: theorem exists_rat_of_not_irrational {x : ℝ} (hx : ¬ Irrational x) : ∃ (q : ℚ), x = q
proof:
:= by
