name: ramificationIdx'_spec
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_spec {n : ℕ} (hle : map f p ≤ P ^ n) (hgt : ¬map f p ≤ P ^ (n + 1)) :
    ramificationIdx' p P = n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q : ℕ → Prop := fun m => ∀ k : ℕ, map f p ≤ P ^ k → k ≤ m
  have : Q n := by
    intro k hk
    refine le_of_not_gt fun hnk => ?_
    exact hgt (hk.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hnk))
  rw [ramificationIdx'_eq_find ⟨n, this⟩]
  refine le_antisymm (Nat.find_min' _ this) (le_of_not_gt fun h : Nat.find _ < n => ?_)
  obtain this' := Nat.find_spec ⟨n, this⟩
  exact h.not_ge (this' _ hle)

name: ramificationIdx'_lt
statement: theorem ramificationIdx'_lt {n : ℕ} (hgt : ¬map f p ≤ P ^ n) : ramificationIdx' p P < n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases n with - | n
  · simp at hgt
  · rw [Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    have : ∀ k, map f p ≤ P ^ k → k ≤ n := by
      refine fun k hk => le_of_not_gt fun hnk => ?_
      exact hgt (hk.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hnk))
    rw [ramificationIdx'_eq_find ⟨n, this⟩]
    exact Nat.find_min' ⟨n, this⟩ this

name: ramificationIdx'_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ramificationIdx'_bot : ramificationIdx' (⊥ : Ideal R) P = 0
proof:
:=
  dite_eq_right <| not_exists.mpr fun n hn => n.lt_succ_self.not_ge (hn _ (by simp))

name: ramificationIdx'_of_not_le
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ramificationIdx'_of_not_le (h : ¬map f p ≤ P) : ramificationIdx' p P = 0
proof:
:=
  ramificationIdx'_spec (by simp) (by simpa using h)

name: ramificationIdx'_bot'
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_bot' (hp : p ≠ ⊥) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ramificationIdx' p (⊥ : Ideal S) = 0
proof:
:=
  ramificationIdx'_of_not_le <| le_bot_iff.not.mpr <| (map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective hf).not.mpr hp

name: ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_ne_zero {e : ℕ} (he : e ≠ 0) (hle : map f p ≤ P ^ e)
    (hnle : ¬map f p ≤ P ^ (e + 1)) : ramificationIdx' p P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rwa [ramificationIdx'_spec hle hnle]

name: le_pow_of_le_ramificationIdx'
statement:
theorem le_pow_of_le_ramificationIdx' {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ ramificationIdx' p P) :
    map f p ≤ P ^ n
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! hn
  exact ramificationIdx'_lt hn

name: le_pow_ramificationIdx'
statement: theorem le_pow_ramificationIdx' : map f p ≤ P ^ ramificationIdx' p P
proof:
:=
  le_pow_of_le_ramificationIdx' (le_refl _)

name: le_comap_pow_ramificationIdx'
statement: theorem le_comap_pow_ramificationIdx' : p ≤ comap f (P ^ ramificationIdx' p P)
proof:
:=
  map_le_iff_le_comap.mp le_pow_ramificationIdx'

name: le_comap_of_ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
statement: theorem le_comap_of_ramificationIdx'_ne_zero (h : ramificationIdx' p P ≠ 0) : p ≤ comap f P
proof:
:=
  Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap.mp <| le_pow_ramificationIdx'.trans <| Ideal.pow_le_self <| h

name: ramificationIdx'_comap_eq
statement:
lemma ramificationIdx'_comap_eq (e : S ≃ₐ[R] S₁) (P : Ideal S₁) :
    ramificationIdx' p (P.comap e) = ramificationIdx' p P
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [ramificationIdx']
  congr 1
  ext n
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  rw [← comap_coe e, ← e.toRingEquiv_toRingHom, comap_coe, ← RingEquiv.symm_symm (e : S ≃+* S₁),
    ← map_comap_of_equiv, ← Ideal.map_pow, map_comap_of_equiv, ← comap_coe (RingEquiv.symm _),
    comap_comap, RingEquiv.symm_symm, e.toRingEquiv_toRingHom, ← e.toAlgHom_toRingHom,
    AlgHom.comp_algebraMap]

name: ramificationIdx'_map_eq
statement:
lemma ramificationIdx'_map_eq {E : Type*} [EquivLike E S S₁] [AlgEquivClass E R S S₁]
    (P : Ideal S) (e : E) :
    ramificationIdx' p (P.map e) = ramificationIdx' p P
proof:
:= by
  rw [show P.map e = _ from P.map_comap_of_equiv (RingEquivClass.toRingEquiv e : S ≃+* S₁)]
  exact p.ramificationIdx'_comap_eq (AlgEquiv.ofClass e).symm P

name: ramificationIdx'_ne_one_iff
statement:
lemma ramificationIdx'_ne_one_iff (hp : map f p ≤ P) :
    ramificationIdx' p P ≠ 1 ↔ p.map f ≤ P ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases! H : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ k, p.map f ≤ P ^ k ∧ n < k
  · obtain ⟨k, hk, h2k⟩ := H 2
    simp [Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_zero H, hk.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right h2k.le)]
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_find H]
  constructor
  · intro he
    have : 1 ≤ Nat.find H := Nat.find_spec H 1 (by simpa)
    have := Nat.find_min H (m := 1) (by lia)
    push Not at this
    obtain ⟨k, hk, h1k⟩ := this
    exact hk.trans (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr h1k))
  · intro he
    have := Nat.find_spec H 2 he
    lia

name: ramificationIdx'_eq_one_of_map_localization
statement:
lemma ramificationIdx'_eq_one_of_map_localization
    {p : Ideal R} {P : Ideal S} [P.IsPrime] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (hpP : map (algebraMap R S) p ≤ P) (hp : P ≠ ⊥) (hp' : P.primeCompl ≤ nonZeroDivisors S)
    (H : p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)) :
    ramificationIdx' p P = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_ne_iff (b := 1), Ideal.ramificationIdx'_ne_one_iff hpP]
  intro h₂
  replace h₂ := Ideal.map_mono («f» := algebraMap S (Localization.AtPrime P)) h₂
  rw [Ideal.map_pow, Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_map,
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq, H, pow_two] at h₂
  have := Submodule.eq_bot_of_le_smul_of_le_jacobson_bot _ _ (IsNoetherian.noetherian _) h₂
    (maximalIdeal_le_jacobson _)
  rw [← Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal, Ideal.map_eq_bot_iff_of_injective] at this
  · exact hp this
  · exact IsLocalization.injective _ hp'

name: ramificationIdx'_map_self_eq_one
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_map_self_eq_one [IsDedekindDomain S]
    (h₁ : map f p ≠ ⊤) (h₂ : map f p ≠ ⊥) : ramificationIdx' p (map f p) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ramificationIdx'_spec (by simp) fun h ↦ ?_
  have : map f p ^ 1 = (map f p) ^ 2 := by
    rw [pow_one]
    exact le_antisymm h <| pow_le_self two_ne_zero
  have := IsMulTorsionFree.pow_right_injective₀ (by rwa [one_eq_top]) h₂ this
  simp_all

name: ramificationIdx'_le_ramificationIdx'
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_le_ramificationIdx' {T : Type*} [CommRing T] [Algebra R T]
    [Algebra S T] [IsScalarTower R S T] (Q : Ideal T) (hp : p = comap f P)
    (h : ramificationIdx' p Q ≠ 0) : ramificationIdx' P Q ≤ ramificationIdx' p Q
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ramificationIdx', Ne] at *
  refine csSup_le_csSup' (h.imp_symm Nat.sSup_of_not_bddAbove) fun n hn ↦ ?_
  simp_rw [hp, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T, ← map_map, map_le_iff_le_comap]
  exact comap_mono <| by rwa [← map_le_iff_le_comap]

name: ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count
    (hp0 : map f p ≠ ⊥) (hP : P.IsPrime)
    (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) : ramificationIdx' p P = (normalizedFactors (map f p)).count P
proof:
:= by
  have hPirr := (Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 hP).irreducible
  refine ramificationIdx'_spec (Ideal.le_of_dvd ?_) (mt Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr ?_) <;>
    rw [dvd_iff_normalizedFactors_le_normalizedFactors (pow_ne_zero _ hP0) hp0,
      normalizedFactors_pow, normalizedFactors_irreducible hPirr, normalize_eq,
      Multiset.nsmul_singleton, ← Multiset.le_count_iff_replicate_le]
  exact (Nat.lt_succ_self _).not_ge

name: ramificationIdx'_eq_multiplicity
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_eq_multiplicity (hp : map f p ≠ ⊥) (hP : P.IsPrime) :
    ramificationIdx' p P = multiplicity P (Ideal.map f p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP₂ : P = ⊥
  · rw [hP₂, ← Ideal.zero_eq_bot, multiplicity_zero_eq_zero_of_ne_zero _ hp]
    exact Ideal.ramificationIdx'_of_not_le (mt le_bot_iff.mp hp)
  rw [multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some]
  rw [ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hp hP hP₂, ← normalize_eq P,
    ← UniqueFactorizationMonoid.emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors _ hp, normalize_eq]
  exact irreducible_iff_prime.mpr <| prime_of_isPrime hP₂ hP

name: ramificationIdx'_eq_factors_count
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_eq_factors_count
    (hp0 : map f p ≠ ⊥) (hP : P.IsPrime) (hP0 : P ≠ ⊥) :
    ramificationIdx' p P = (factors (map f p)).count P
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hp0 hP hP0,
    factors_eq_normalizedFactors]

name: ramificationIdx'_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_ne_zero (hp0 : map f p ≠ ⊥) (hP : P.IsPrime) (le : map f p ≤ P) :
    ramificationIdx' p P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP0 : P ≠ ⊥ := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hp0 (le_bot_iff.mp le)
  have hPirr := (Ideal.prime_of_isPrime hP0 hP).irreducible
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hp0 hP hP0]
  obtain ⟨P', hP', P'_eq⟩ :=
    exists_mem_normalizedFactors_of_dvd hp0 hPirr (Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr le)
  rwa [Multiset.count_ne_zero, associated_iff_eq.mp P'_eq]

name: ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R S]
    (P : Ideal S) [hP : P.IsPrime] {p : Ideal R} (hp : p ≠ ⊥) [hPp : P.LiesOver p] :
    ramificationIdx' p P ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_ne_zero (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp) hP <|
    map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr <| le_of_eq <| (liesOver_iff _ _).mp hPp

name: ramificationIdx'_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma ramificationIdx'_eq_one_iff
    {p : Ideal R} {P : Ideal S} [P.IsPrime]
    (hp : P ≠ ⊥) (hpP : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≤ P) :
    ramificationIdx' p P = 1 ↔
      p.map (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime P)) = maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime P)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ramificationIdx'_eq_one_of_map_localization hpP hp (primeCompl_le_nonZeroDivisors _)⟩
  let Sₚ := Localization.AtPrime P
  rw [← not_ne_iff (b := 1), ramificationIdx'_ne_one_iff hpP, pow_two]
  intro H₁
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ : P ∣ p.map (algebraMap R S) := Ideal.dvd_iff_le.mpr hpP
  have ha' : ¬ a ≤ P := fun h ↦ H₁ (ha.trans_le (Ideal.mul_mono_right h))
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq _ S, ← Ideal.map_map, ha, Ideal.map_mul,
    Localization.AtPrime.map_eq_maximalIdeal]
  convert! Ideal.mul_top _
  on_goal 2 => infer_instance
  rw [← not_ne_iff, IsLocalization.map_algebraMap_ne_top_iff_disjoint P.primeCompl]
  simpa [primeCompl, Set.disjoint_compl_left_iff_subset]

name: ramificationIdx'_le_ramificationIdx'
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_le_ramificationIdx' [IsDomain R] [IsTorsionFree R S] {S₀ : Type*}
    [CommRing S₀] [Algebra R S₀] [Algebra S₀ S] [IsScalarTower R S₀ S] (p : Ideal R)
    (P : Ideal S₀) (Q : Ideal S) [Q.LiesOver p] [hP : P.LiesOver p] [Q.IsPrime] (hp : p ≠ ⊥) :
    Ideal.ramificationIdx' P Q ≤ Ideal.ramificationIdx' p Q
proof:
:=
  p.ramificationIdx'_le_ramificationIdx' P Q ((liesOver_iff ..).mp hP) <|
    ramificationIdx'_ne_zero_of_liesOver _ hp

name: emultiplicity_map_eq_zero_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  refine emultiplicity_eq_zero.2 fun h ↦ hvp.symm ?_
  rw [Ideal.dvd_iff_le, Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap, ← under_def, ← Ideal.over_def w v] at h
  exact ((isPrime_of_prime hp).isMaximal hp.ne_zero).eq_of_le (isPrime_of_prime hv.prime).ne_top h

name: emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul_of_prime
statement:
private theorem emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul_of_prime [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] {v : Ideal R} {w : Ideal S} {p : Ideal R}
    (hv : Irreducible v) (hp : Prime p) (hw : Irreducible w) (hw_bot : w ≠ ⊥)
    [w.LiesOver v] : emultiplicity w (p.map (algebraMap R S)) =
      v.ramificationIdx' w * emultiplicity v p
proof:
:= by
  have hp_bot : p.map (algebraMap R S) ≠ ⊥ := map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp.ne_zero
  by_cases hvp : v = p
  · simp [hvp, (FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left hp hp.ne_zero).emultiplicity_self,
      ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hp_bot (isPrime_of_prime hw.prime) hw_bot,
      emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hw hp_bot]
  · rw [emultiplicity_eq_zero_of_irreducible_ne hv hp.irreducible hvp, mul_zero,
      emultiplicity_map_eq_zero_of_ne hv hp hvp]

name: emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul
statement:
theorem emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul [IsDedekindDomain R]
    [FaithfulSMul R S] {v : Ideal R} {w : Ideal S} {I : Ideal R} (h : I ≠ ⊥)
    (hv : Irreducible v) (hw : Irreducible w) (hw_bot : w ≠ ⊥) [w.LiesOver v] :
    emultiplicity w (I.map (algebraMap R S)) =
      v.ramificationIdx' w * emultiplicity v I
proof:
:= by
  induction I using induction_on_prime with
  | h₁ => aesop
  | h₂ I hI =>
    obtain rfl : I = ⊤ := by simpa using hI
    simp_rw [Ideal.map_top, emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hw top_ne_bot,
      emultiplicity_eq_count_normalizedFactors hv h, ← Ideal.one_eq_top, normalizedFactors_one]
    simp
  | h₃ I p hI hp IH =>
    rw [Ideal.map_mul, emultiplicity_mul hw.prime, emultiplicity_mul hv.prime, IH hI, mul_add,
      emultiplicity_map_eq_ramificationIdx'_mul_of_prime hv hp hw hw_bot]

name: ramificationIdx'_algebra_tower
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_algebra_tower [IsDedekindDomain S] [IsDedekindDomain T]
    {p : Ideal R} {P : Ideal S} {Q : Ideal T} [hpm : P.IsPrime] [hqm : Q.IsPrime]
    (hg0 : map (algebraMap S T) P ≠ ⊥)
    (hfg : map (algebraMap R T) p ≠ ⊥) (hg : map (algebraMap S T) P ≤ Q) :
    ramificationIdx' p Q =
    ramificationIdx' p P * ramificationIdx' P Q
proof:
:= by
  have hf0 : map (algebraMap R S) p ≠ ⊥ := by
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T, ← map_map] at hfg
    exact ne_bot_of_map_ne_bot hfg
  have hp0 : P ≠ ⊥ := ne_bot_of_map_ne_bot hg0
  have hq0 : Q ≠ ⊥ := ne_bot_of_le_ne_bot hg0 hg
  let : P.IsMaximal := Ring.DimensionLEOne.maximalOfPrime hp0 hpm
  rw [IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hf0 hpm hp0,
    IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hg0 hqm hq0,
    IsDedekindDomain.ramificationIdx'_eq_normalizedFactors_count hfg hqm hq0,
    IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R S T, ← map_map]
  rcases eq_prime_pow_mul_coprime hf0 P with ⟨I, hcp, heq⟩
  have hcp : ⊤ = map (algebraMap S T) P ⊔ map (algebraMap S T) I := by rw [← map_sup, hcp, map_top]
  have hntq : ¬ ⊤ ≤ Q := fun ht ↦ IsPrime.ne_top hqm (Iff.mpr (eq_top_iff_one Q) (ht trivial))
  nth_rw 1 [heq, Ideal.map_mul, Ideal.map_pow, normalizedFactors_mul (pow_ne_zero _ hg0) <| by
    by_contra h
    simp only [h, Submodule.zero_eq_bot, bot_le, sup_of_le_left] at hcp
    exact hntq (hcp.trans_le hg), Multiset.count_add, normalizedFactors_pow, Multiset.count_nsmul]
  exact add_eq_left.mpr <| Decidable.byContradiction fun h ↦ hntq <| hcp.trans_le <|
    sup_le hg <| le_of_dvd <| dvd_of_mem_normalizedFactors <| Multiset.count_ne_zero.mp h

name: ramificationIdx'_algebra_tower'
statement:
theorem ramificationIdx'_algebra_tower' [IsDedekindDomain S] [IsDedekindDomain T] [IsDomain R]
    [Module.IsTorsionFree R S] [Module.IsTorsionFree S T] (p : Ideal R) (P : Ideal S) (Q : Ideal T)
    [Q.IsPrime] [Q.LiesOver P] [P.LiesOver p] :
    ramificationIdx' p Q =
      ramificationIdx' p P * ramificationIdx' P Q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p ⊥
  · simp
  have : P.IsPrime := isPrime_of_liesOver Q P
  have : Module.IsTorsionFree R T := by
    refine Module.IsTorsionFree.of_smul_eq_zero fun r m h ↦ ?_
    rwa [algebra_compatible_smul S, smul_eq_zero, FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff] at h
  have hP : P ≠ ⊥ := ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot hp _
  exact ramificationIdx'_algebra_tower (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hP) (map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp)
    <| map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr <| le_of_eq <| over_def Q P

name: exists_apply_ne_one_iff_exists_monoidHom
statement:
lemma exists_apply_ne_one_iff_exists_monoidHom (a : Mˣ) :
    (∃ χ : MulChar M R, χ a ≠ 1) ↔ ∃ φ : Mˣ →* Rˣ, φ a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨χ, hχ⟩ ↦ ⟨χ.toUnitHom, ?_⟩, fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ ↦ ⟨ofUnitHom φ, ?_⟩⟩
  · contrapose hχ
    rwa [Units.ext_iff, coe_toUnitHom] at hχ
  · contrapose hφ
    simpa only [ofUnitHom_eq, equivToUnitHom_symm_coe, Units.val_eq_one] using hφ

name: exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity
statement:
theorem exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity [Nontrivial R] {a : M} (ha : a ≠ 1) :
    ∃ χ : MulChar M R, χ a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : IsUnit a
  · refine (exists_apply_ne_one_iff_exists_monoidHom hu.unit).mpr ?_
    refine CommGroup.exists_apply_ne_one_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity Mˣ R ?_
    contrapose ha
    rw [← hu.unit_spec, ha, Units.val_eq_one]
  · exact ⟨1, by simpa only [map_nonunit _ hu] using zero_ne_one⟩

name: mulEquiv_units
statement: lemma mulEquiv_units : Nonempty (MulChar M R ≃* Mˣ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mulEquivToUnitHom.trans
    (CommGroup.monoidHom_mulEquiv_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity Mˣ R).some⟩

name: card_eq_card_units_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity
statement: lemma card_eq_card_units_of_hasEnoughRootsOfUnity : Nat.card (MulChar M R) = Nat.card Mˣ
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr (mulEquiv_units M R).some.toEquiv

name: domRestrictHom_surjective
statement:
theorem domRestrictHom_surjective (N : Submonoid M) :
    Function.Surjective (MulChar.domRestrictHom N R)
proof:
:= by
  intro χ
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := (χ.toUnitHom.comp N.unitsEquivUnitsType).domRestrict_surjective R N.units
  refine ⟨MulChar.ofUnitHom ψ, ext fun _ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [MonoidHom.domRestrictHom_apply] at hψ
  rw [domRestrictHom_apply, domRestrict_ofUnitHom]
  simp [hψ]

name: mulCharEquiv_symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mulCharEquiv_symm_apply_apply (m : Mˣ) (χ : MulChar M R) :
    (mulCharEquiv M R).symm m χ = χ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show ((mulCharEquiv M R).symm m) χ =
    if IsUnit χ then ↑(mulEquivToUnitHom χ m) else (0 : R) by rfl, ite_eq_left (Group.isUnit χ),
    mulEquivToUnitHom_apply, coe_equivToUnitHom]

name: apply_mulCharEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem apply_mulCharEquiv (χ : MulChar M R) (η : MulChar (MulChar M R) R) :
    χ (mulCharEquiv M R η) = η χ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mulCharEquiv_symm_apply_apply (mulCharEquiv M R η) χ, MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_iff {H : Subgroup Mˣ} {χ : MulChar M R} :
    χ ∈ (subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar M R H).ofDual ↔ ∀ m ∈ H, χ m = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar, OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.dual_apply,
    MulEquiv.coe_mapSubgroup, OrderDual.ofDual_toDual, Subgroup.mem_map_equiv]
  simp [← Units.val_eq_one]

name: mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_symm_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar_symm_iff {X : Subgroup (MulChar M R)} {m : Mˣ} :
    m ∈ (subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar M R).symm (OrderDual.toDual X) ↔ ∀ χ ∈ X, χ m = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar, ← Units.val_eq_one]

name: card_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar
statement:
theorem card_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar {H : Subgroup Mˣ} :
    Nat.card (subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar M R H).ofDual = Nat.card (Mˣ ⧸ H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMulChar, OrderIso.trans_apply, OrderIso.dual_apply,
    OrderDual.ofDual_toDual, Subgroup.card_mapSubgroup,
    CommGroup.card_subgroupOrderIsoSubgroupMonoidHom]

name: eq_iff
statement:
lemma eq_iff {g : Rˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar R R') :
    χ₁ = χ₂ ↔ χ₁ g.val = χ₂ g.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq equivToUnitHom, MonoidHom.eq_iff_eq_on_generator hg,
    ← coe_equivToUnitHom, ← coe_equivToUnitHom, Units.ext_iff]

name: domRestrict_ofUnitHom
statement:
theorem domRestrict_ofUnitHom (f : Rˣ →* R'ˣ) (S : Submonoid R) : domRestrict S (ofUnitHom f) =
      ofUnitHom ((f.domRestrict S.units).comp S.unitsEquivUnitsType.symm)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [ofUnitHom_eq, domRestrict_apply, Units.isUnit, reduceIte, equivToUnitHom_symm_coe,
    MonoidHom.coe_comp, MonoidHom.coe_coe, Function.comp_apply, MonoidHom.domRestrict_apply]
  rw [← Submonoid.val_unitsEquivUnitsType_symm_apply_coe S x, equivToUnitHom_symm_coe]

name: star_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma star_apply [StarRing R'] (χ : MulChar R R') (a : R) : (star χ) a = star (χ a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: apply_mem_rootsOfUnity
statement:
lemma apply_mem_rootsOfUnity [Fintype Rˣ] (a : Rˣ) {χ : MulChar R R'} :
    equivToUnitHom χ a ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card Rˣ) R'
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_rootsOfUnity, ← map_pow, ← (equivToUnitHom χ).map_one, pow_card_eq_one]

name: star_eq_inv
statement: lemma star_eq_inv (χ : MulChar R ℂ) : star χ = χ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype Rˣ
  ext1 a
  simp only [inv_apply_eq_inv']
  exact (inv_eq_conj <| norm_eq_one_of_mem_rootsOfUnity <| χ.apply_mem_rootsOfUnity a).symm

name: star_apply'
statement: lemma star_apply' (χ : MulChar R ℂ) (a : R) : star (χ a) = χ⁻¹ a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RCLike.star_def, ← star_eq_inv, star_apply]

name: ofRootOfUnity_spec
statement:
lemma ofRootOfUnity_spec {ζ : Rˣ} (hζ : ζ ∈ rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card Mˣ) R)
    {g : Mˣ} (hg : ∀ x, x ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g) :
    ofRootOfUnity hζ hg g = ζ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofRootOfUnity, ofUnitHom_eq, equivToUnitHom_symm_coe,
    monoidHomOfForallMemZpowers_apply_gen]

name: exists_mulChar_orderOf
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn₀ : 0 < n := by
    refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun hn ↦ ?_
    simp only [hn, zero_dvd_iff, Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le] at h
    exact (Fintype.one_lt_card.trans_le h).false
  let e := MulChar.equiv_rootsOfUnity F R
  let ζ' : Rˣ := (hζ.isUnit hn₀.ne').unit
  have h' : ζ' ^ (Fintype.card Fˣ : ℕ) = 1 :=
    Units.ext_iff.mpr <| (hζ.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd _).mpr <| Fintype.card_units (α := F) ▸ h
  use e.symm ⟨ζ', (mem_rootsOfUnity (Fintype.card Fˣ) ζ').mpr h'⟩
  rw [e.symm.orderOf_eq, orderOf_eq_iff hn₀]
  refine ⟨?_, fun m hm hm₀ h ↦ ?_⟩
  · ext
    push_cast
    exact hζ.pow_eq_one
  · rw [Subtype.ext_iff, Units.ext_iff] at h
    push_cast at h
    exact ((Nat.le_of_dvd hm₀ <| hζ.dvd_of_pow_eq_one _ h).trans_lt hm).false

name: orderOf_dvd_card_sub_one
statement: lemma orderOf_dvd_card_sub_one (χ : MulChar F R) : orderOf χ ∣ Fintype.card F - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Fintype.card_units]
  exact orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one χ.pow_card_eq_one

name: exists_mulChar_orderOf_eq_card_units
statement:
lemma exists_mulChar_orderOf_eq_card_units [DecidableEq F]
    {ζ : R} (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (Fintype.card Fˣ)) :
    ∃ χ : MulChar F R, orderOf χ = Fintype.card Fˣ
proof:
:=
  exists_mulChar_orderOf F (by rw [Fintype.card_units]) hζ

name: apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_orderOf
statement:
lemma apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_orderOf (χ : MulChar F R) {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ζ ∈ rootsOfUnity (orderOf χ) R, ζ = χ a
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (χ a) := ha.isUnit.map χ
  refine ⟨hu.unit, ?_, hu.unit_spec⟩
  rw [mem_rootsOfUnity, Units.ext_iff, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, Units.val_one,
    IsUnit.unit_spec, ← χ.pow_apply' χ.orderOf_pos.ne', pow_orderOf_eq_one,
    show a = (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha).unit by simp only [IsUnit.unit_spec],
    MulChar.one_apply_coe]

name: apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_of_pow_eq_one
statement:
lemma apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_of_pow_eq_one {χ : MulChar F R} {n : ℕ} (hχ : χ ^ n = 1)
    {a : F} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ζ ∈ rootsOfUnity n R, ζ = χ a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ₁, hμ₂⟩ := χ.apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_orderOf ha
  exact ⟨μ, rootsOfUnity_le_of_dvd (orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one hχ) hμ₁, hμ₂⟩

name: exists_apply_eq_pow
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ζ, hζ₁, hζ₂⟩ := apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_of_pow_eq_one hχ ha
  have hζ' : ζ.val ^ n = 1 := (mem_rootsOfUnity' n ↑ζ).mp hζ₁
  obtain ⟨k, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := hμ.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hζ'
  exact ⟨k, hk₁, (hζ₂ ▸ hk₂).symm⟩

name: apply_mem_algebraAdjoin_of_pow_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with rfl | h
  · exact χ.map_zero ▸ Subalgebra.zero_mem _
  · obtain ⟨ζ, hζ₁, hζ₂⟩ := apply_mem_rootsOfUnity_of_pow_eq_one hχ h
    rw [mem_rootsOfUnity, Units.ext_iff, Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val] at hζ₁
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := IsPrimitiveRoot.eq_pow_of_pow_eq_one hμ hζ₁
    exact hζ₂ ▸ hk ▸ Subalgebra.pow_mem _ (Algebra.self_mem_adjoin_singleton ℤ μ) k

name: apply_mem_algebraAdjoin
proof:
:=
  have : NeZero (orderOf χ) := ⟨χ.orderOf_pos.ne'⟩
  apply_mem_algebraAdjoin_of_pow_eq_one (pow_orderOf_eq_one χ) hμ a

name: coe_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mk (f : R →* R') (hf) : (MulChar.mk f hf : R → R') = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ext'
statement: theorem ext' {χ χ' : MulChar R R'} (h : ∀ a, χ a = χ' a) : χ = χ'
proof: := DFunLike.ext _ _ h

name: map_nonunit
statement: theorem map_nonunit (χ : MulChar R R') {a : R} (ha : ¬IsUnit a) : χ a = 0
proof:
:=
  χ.map_nonunit' a ha

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {χ χ' : MulChar R R'} (h : ∀ a : Rˣ, χ a = χ' a) : χ = χ'
proof:
:= by
  apply ext'
  intro a
  by_cases ha : IsUnit a
  · exact h ha.unit
  · rw [map_nonunit χ ha, map_nonunit χ' ha]

name: coe_toUnitHom
statement: theorem coe_toUnitHom (χ : MulChar R R') (a : Rˣ) : ↑(χ.toUnitHom a) = χ a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ofUnitHom_coe
statement: theorem ofUnitHom_coe (f : Rˣ →* R'ˣ) (a : Rˣ) : ofUnitHom f ↑a = f a
proof: := by simp [ofUnitHom]

name: toUnitHom_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toUnitHom_eq (χ : MulChar R R') : toUnitHom χ = equivToUnitHom χ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ofUnitHom_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofUnitHom_eq (χ : Rˣ →* R'ˣ) : ofUnitHom χ = equivToUnitHom.symm χ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coe_equivToUnitHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_equivToUnitHom (χ : MulChar R R') (a : Rˣ) : ↑(equivToUnitHom χ a) = χ a
proof:
:=
  coe_toUnitHom χ a

name: equivToUnitHom_symm_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem equivToUnitHom_symm_coe (f : Rˣ →* R'ˣ) (a : Rˣ) : equivToUnitHom.symm f ↑a = f a
proof:
:=
  ofUnitHom_coe f a

name: coe_toMonoidHom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_toMonoidHom (χ : MulChar R R')
    (x : R) : χ.toMonoidHom x = χ x
proof: := rfl

name: apply_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem apply_ne_zero_iff [Nontrivial R'] {χ : MulChar R R'} {a : R} :
    χ a ≠ 0 ↔ IsUnit a
proof:
:=
  ⟨by simpa using (map_nonunit χ).mt, fun h ↦ (h.map χ).ne_zero⟩

name: apply_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem apply_eq_zero_iff [Nontrivial R'] {χ : MulChar R R'} {a : R} :
    χ a = 0 ↔ ¬ IsUnit a
proof:
:= by
  simpa using χ.apply_ne_zero_iff.not

name: map_one
statement: protected theorem map_one (χ : MulChar R R') : χ (1 : R) = 1
proof:
:=
  χ.map_one'

name: map_zero
statement:
protected theorem map_zero {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] [Nontrivial R] (χ : MulChar R R') :
    χ (0 : R) = 0
proof: := by rw [map_nonunit χ not_isUnit_zero]

name: map_ringChar
statement:
theorem map_ringChar {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [Nontrivial R] (χ : MulChar R R') :
    χ (ringChar R) = 0
proof: := by rw [ringChar.Nat.cast_ringChar, χ.map_zero]

name: one_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem one_apply_coe (a : Rˣ) : (1 : MulChar R R') a = 1
proof: := by exact dite_eq_left a.isUnit

name: one_apply
statement: lemma one_apply {x : R} (hx : IsUnit x) : (1 : MulChar R R') x = 1
proof: := one_apply_coe hx.unit

name: mul_apply
statement: theorem mul_apply (χ χ' : MulChar R R') (a : R) : (χ * χ') a = χ a * χ' a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coeToFun_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeToFun_mul (χ χ' : MulChar R R') : ⇑(χ * χ') = χ * χ'
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: one_mul
statement: protected theorem one_mul (χ : MulChar R R') : (1 : MulChar R R') * χ = χ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [one_mul, Pi.mul_apply, MulChar.coeToFun_mul, MulChar.one_apply_coe]

name: mul_one
statement: protected theorem mul_one (χ : MulChar R R') : χ * 1 = χ
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [mul_one, Pi.mul_apply, MulChar.coeToFun_mul, MulChar.one_apply_coe]

name: inv_apply_eq_inv
statement: theorem inv_apply_eq_inv (χ : MulChar R R') (a : R) : χ⁻¹ a = (χ a)⁻¹ʳ
proof:
:=
  Eq.refl <| inv χ a

name: inv_apply_eq_inv'
statement:
theorem inv_apply_eq_inv' {R' : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero R'] (χ : MulChar R R') (a : R) :
    χ⁻¹ a = (χ a)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (inv_apply_eq_inv χ a).trans <| Ring.inverse_eq_inv (χ a)

name: inv_apply
statement:
theorem inv_apply {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] (χ : MulChar R R') (a : R) :
    χ⁻¹ a = χ a⁻¹ʳ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsUnit a
  · rw [inv_apply_eq_inv]
    have h := IsUnit.map χ ha
    apply_fun (χ a * ·) using IsUnit.mul_right_injective h
    dsimp only
    rw [Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ h, ← map_mul, Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ ha, map_one]
  · revert ha
    nontriviality R
    intro ha
    
    rw [map_nonunit _ ha, Ring.inverse_non_unit a ha, MulChar.map_zero χ]

name: inv_apply'
statement: theorem inv_apply' {R : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero R] (χ : MulChar R R') (a : R) : χ⁻¹ a = χ a⁻¹
proof:
:=
  (inv_apply χ a).trans <| congr_arg _ (Ring.inverse_eq_inv a)

name: inv_mul
statement: theorem inv_mul (χ : MulChar R R') : χ⁻¹ * χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [coeToFun_mul, Pi.mul_apply, inv_apply_eq_inv]
  simp only [Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (IsUnit.map χ x.isUnit)]
  rw [one_apply_coe]

name: pow_apply_coe
statement: theorem pow_apply_coe (χ : MulChar R R') (n : ℕ) (a : Rˣ) : (χ ^ n) a = χ a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, one_apply_coe]
  | succ n ih => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, mul_apply, ih]

name: pow_apply'
statement: theorem pow_apply' (χ : MulChar R R') {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) (a : R) : (χ ^ n) a = χ a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : IsUnit a
  · exact pow_apply_coe χ n ha.unit
  · rw [map_nonunit (χ ^ n) ha, map_nonunit χ ha, zero_pow hn]

name: equivToUnitHom_mul_apply
statement:
lemma equivToUnitHom_mul_apply (χ₁ χ₂ : MulChar R R') (a : Rˣ) :
    equivToUnitHom (χ₁ * χ₂) a = equivToUnitHom χ₁ a * equivToUnitHom χ₂ a
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun ((↑) : R'ˣ → R') using Units.val_injective
  push_cast
  simp_rw [coe_equivToUnitHom, coeToFun_mul, Pi.mul_apply]

name: eq_one_iff
statement: lemma eq_one_iff {χ : MulChar R R'} : χ = 1 ↔ ∀ a : Rˣ, χ a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MulChar.ext_iff, one_apply_coe]

name: ne_one_iff
statement: lemma ne_one_iff {χ : MulChar R R'} : χ ≠ 1 ↔ ∃ a : Rˣ, χ a ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Ne, eq_one_iff, not_forall]

name: domRestrict_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem domRestrict_eq_one_iff {S : Type*} [SetLike S R] [SubmonoidClass S R] {T : S}
    {χ : MulChar R R'} : χ.domRestrict T = 1 ↔ ∀ x : Tˣ, χ x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [eq_one_iff]

name: IsQuadratic.eq_of_eq_coe
proof:
:=
  Int.cast_injOn_of_ringChar_ne_two hR'' (hχ a) (hχ' a') h

name: ringHomComp_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ringHomComp_one (f : R' →+* R'') : (1 : MulChar R R').ringHomComp f = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [MulChar.ringHomComp_apply, MulChar.one_apply_coe, map_one]

name: ringHomComp_inv
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_inv {R : Type*} [CommMonoidWithZero R] (χ : MulChar R R') (f : R' →+* R'') :
    (χ.ringHomComp f)⁻¹ = χ⁻¹.ringHomComp f
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [inv_apply, Ring.inverse_unit, ringHomComp_apply]

name: ringHomComp_mul
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_mul (χ φ : MulChar R R') (f : R' →+* R'') :
    (χ * φ).ringHomComp f = χ.ringHomComp f * φ.ringHomComp f
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  simp only [ringHomComp_apply, coeToFun_mul, Pi.mul_apply, map_mul]

name: ringHomComp_pow
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_pow (χ : MulChar R R') (f : R' →+* R'') (n : ℕ) :
    χ.ringHomComp f ^ n = (χ ^ n).ringHomComp f
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, ringHomComp_one]
  | succ n ih => simp only [pow_succ, ih, ringHomComp_mul]

name: ringHomComp_zpow
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_zpow (χ : MulChar R R') (f : R' →+* R'') (n : ℤ) :
    χ.ringHomComp f ^ n = (χ ^ n).ringHomComp f
proof:
:=
  ((ringHomCompHom f).map_zpow χ n).symm

name: zpow_apply_coe
statement:
theorem zpow_apply_coe {R : Type*} [CommGroupWithZero R] {R' : Type*} [CommRing R']
    (χ : MulChar R R') (n : ℤ) (a : Rˣ) : (χ ^ n) a = χ (a ^ n : Rˣ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl | rfl⟩ := Int.eq_nat_or_neg n
  · simp [pow_apply_coe]
  · simp [pow_apply_coe, inv_apply', ← inv_pow]

name: injective_ringHomComp
statement:
lemma injective_ringHomComp {f : R' →+* R''} (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (ringHomComp (R := R) · f)
proof:
:= by
  simpa
    only [Function.Injective, MulChar.ext_iff, ringHomComp, coe_mk, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]
    using fun χ χ' h a ↦ hf (h a)

name: ringHomComp_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_eq_one_iff {f : R' →+* R''} (hf : Function.Injective f) {χ : MulChar R R'} :
    χ.ringHomComp f = 1 ↔ χ = 1
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (show (1 : MulChar R R').ringHomComp f = 1 by simp)]
  exact (injective_ringHomComp hf).eq_iff

name: ringHomComp_ne_one_iff
statement:
lemma ringHomComp_ne_one_iff {f : R' →+* R''} (hf : Function.Injective f) {χ : MulChar R R'} :
    χ.ringHomComp f ≠ 1 ↔ χ ≠ 1
proof:
:=
  (ringHomComp_eq_one_iff hf).not

name: IsQuadratic.comp
statement:
theorem IsQuadratic.comp {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) (f : R' →+* R'') :
    (χ.ringHomComp f).IsQuadratic
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rcases hχ a with (ha | ha | ha) <;> simp [ha]

name: IsQuadratic.inv
statement: theorem IsQuadratic.inv {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) : χ⁻¹ = χ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [inv_apply_eq_inv]
  rcases hχ x with (h₀ | h₁ | h₂)
  · rw [h₀, Ring.inverse_zero]
  · rw [h₁, Ring.inverse_one]
  · 
    have : (-1 : R') = (-1 : R'ˣ) := by norm_cast; simp
    rw [h₂, this, Ring.inverse_unit (-1 : R'ˣ), inv_neg, inv_one]

name: IsQuadratic.sq_eq_one
statement: theorem IsQuadratic.sq_eq_one {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) : χ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_mul_cancel χ, pow_two, hχ.inv]

name: IsQuadratic.pow_char
statement:
theorem IsQuadratic.pow_char {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    [CharP R' p] : χ ^ p = χ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [pow_apply_coe]
  rcases hχ x with (hx | hx | hx) <;> rw [hx]
  · rw [zero_pow (@Fact.out p.Prime).ne_zero]
  · rw [one_pow]
  · exact neg_one_pow_char R' p

name: IsQuadratic.pow_even
statement:
theorem IsQuadratic.pow_even {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) {n : ℕ} (hn : Even n) :
    χ ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := even_iff_two_dvd.mp hn
  rw [pow_mul, hχ.sq_eq_one, one_pow]

name: IsQuadratic.pow_odd
statement:
theorem IsQuadratic.pow_odd {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ.IsQuadratic) {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) :
    χ ^ n = χ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hn
  rw [pow_add, pow_one, hχ.pow_even (even_two_mul _), one_mul]

name: isQuadratic_iff_sq_eq_one
statement:
lemma isQuadratic_iff_sq_eq_one {M R : Type*} [CommMonoid M] [CommRing R] [NoZeroDivisors R]
    [Nontrivial R] {χ : MulChar M R} :
    IsQuadratic χ ↔ χ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ext (fun x ↦ ?_), fun h x ↦ ?_⟩
  · rw [one_apply_coe, χ.pow_apply_coe]
    rcases h x with H | H | H
    · exact (not_isUnit_zero <| H ▸ IsUnit.map χ <| x.isUnit).elim
    · simp only [H, one_pow]
    · simp only [H, even_two, Even.neg_pow, one_pow]
  · by_cases hx : IsUnit x
    · refine .inr <| sq_eq_one_iff.mp ?_
      rw [← χ.pow_apply' two_ne_zero, h, MulChar.one_apply hx]
    · exact .inl <| map_nonunit χ hx

name: pow_card_eq_one
statement: protected lemma pow_card_eq_one [Fintype Mˣ] (χ : MulChar M R) : χ ^ (Fintype.card Mˣ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  rw [pow_apply_coe, ← map_pow, one_apply_coe, ← Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, pow_card_eq_one,
    Units.val_eq_one.mpr rfl, map_one]

name: orderOf_pos
statement: lemma orderOf_pos [Finite Mˣ] (χ : MulChar M R) : 0 < orderOf χ
proof:
:= by
  cases nonempty_fintype Mˣ
  apply IsOfFinOrder.orderOf_pos
  exact isOfFinOrder_iff_pow_eq_one.2 ⟨_, Fintype.card_pos, χ.pow_card_eq_one⟩

name: sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one
statement: theorem sum_eq_zero_of_ne_one [IsDomain R'] {χ : MulChar R R'} (hχ : χ ≠ 1) : ∑ a, χ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases ne_one_iff.mp hχ with ⟨b, hb⟩
  refine eq_zero_of_mul_eq_self_left hb ?_
  simpa only [Finset.mul_sum, ← map_mul] using b.mulLeft_bijective.sum_comp _

name: sum_one_eq_card_units
statement:
theorem sum_one_eq_card_units [DecidableEq R] :
    (∑ a, (1 : MulChar R R') a) = Fintype.card Rˣ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a, (1 : MulChar R R') a) = ∑ a : R, if IsUnit a then 1 else 0 :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset R).filter IsUnit).card := Finset.sum_boole _ _
    _ = (Finset.univ.map ⟨((↑) : Rˣ → R), Units.val_injective⟩).card := ?_
    _ = Fintype.card Rˣ := congr_arg _ (Finset.card_map _)
  · split_ifs with h
    · exact one_apply_coe h.unit
    · exact map_nonunit _ h
  · congr
    ext a
    simp [IsUnit]

name: val_neg_one_eq_one_of_odd_order
statement:
lemma val_neg_one_eq_one_of_odd_order {χ : MulChar R R'} {n : ℕ} (hn : Odd n) (hχ : χ ^ n = 1) :
    χ (-1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hn.neg_one_pow, map_pow, ← χ.pow_apply' (Nat.ne_of_odd_add hn), hχ]
  exact MulChar.one_apply_coe (-1)

name: convs_eq_convergent
statement:
theorem convs_eq_convergent (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    (GenContFract.of ξ).convs n = ξ.convergent n
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing ξ with
  | zero => simp only [zeroth_conv_eq_h, of_h_eq_floor, convergent_zero, Rat.cast_intCast]
  | succ n ih => rw [convs_succ, ih (fract ξ)⁻¹, convergent_succ, one_div]; norm_cast

name: exists_convs_eq_rat
statement:
theorem exists_convs_eq_rat {q : ℚ}
    (h : |ξ - q| < 1 / (2 * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2)) : ∃ n, (GenContFract.of ξ).convs n = q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_rat_eq_convergent h
  exact ⟨n, hn.symm ▸ convs_eq_convergent ξ n⟩

name: exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le
statement:
theorem exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le (ξ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (n_pos : 0 < n) :
    ∃ j k : ℤ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ n ∧ |↑k * ξ - j| ≤ 1 / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℤ → ℤ := fun m => ⌊fract (ξ * m) * (n + 1)⌋
  have hn : 0 < (n : ℝ) + 1 := mod_cast Nat.succ_pos _
  have hfu := fun m : ℤ => mul_lt_of_lt_one_left hn <| fract_lt_one (ξ * ↑m)
  conv in |_| ≤ _ => rw [mul_comm, le_div_iff₀ hn, ← abs_of_pos hn, ← abs_mul]
  let D := Icc (0 : ℤ) n
  by_cases! H : ∃ m ∈ D, f m = n
  · obtain ⟨m, hm, hf⟩ := H
    have hf' : ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) ≤ fract (ξ * m) * (n + 1) := hf ▸ floor_le (fract (ξ * m) * (n + 1))
    have hm₀ : 0 < m := by
      have hf₀ : f 0 = 0 := by
        simp only [f, cast_zero, mul_zero, fract_zero, zero_mul, floor_zero]
      refine Ne.lt_of_le (fun h => n_pos.ne ?_) (mem_Icc.mp hm).1
      exact mod_cast hf₀.symm.trans (h.symm ▸ hf : f 0 = n)
    refine ⟨⌊ξ * m⌋ + 1, m, hm₀, (mem_Icc.mp hm).2, ?_⟩
    rw [cast_add, ← sub_sub, sub_mul, cast_one, one_mul, abs_le]
    refine
      ⟨le_sub_iff_add_le.mpr ?_, sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr <| le_of_lt <| (hfu m).trans <| lt_one_add _⟩
    simpa only [neg_add_cancel_comm_assoc] using! hf'
  · have hD : #(Ico (0 : ℤ) n) < #D := by rw [card_Icc, card_Ico]; exact lt_add_one n
    have hfu' : ∀ m, f m ≤ n := fun m => lt_add_one_iff.mp (floor_lt.mpr (mod_cast hfu m))
    have hwd : ∀ m : ℤ, m ∈ D → f m ∈ Ico (0 : ℤ) n := fun x hx =>
      mem_Ico.mpr
        ⟨floor_nonneg.mpr (mul_nonneg (fract_nonneg (ξ * x)) hn.le), Ne.lt_of_le (H x hx) (hfu' x)⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, x_lt_y, hxy⟩ : ∃ x ∈ D, ∃ y ∈ D, x < y ∧ f x = f y := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, x_ne_y, hxy⟩ := exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hD hwd
      rcases lt_trichotomy x y with (h | h | h)
      exacts [⟨x, hx, y, hy, h, hxy⟩, False.elim (x_ne_y h), ⟨y, hy, x, hx, h, hxy.symm⟩]
    refine
      ⟨⌊ξ * y⌋ - ⌊ξ * x⌋, y - x, sub_pos_of_lt x_lt_y,
        sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr <| le_add_of_le_of_nonneg (mem_Icc.mp hy).2 (mem_Icc.mp hx).1, ?_⟩
    convert_to! |fract (ξ * y) * (n + 1) - fract (ξ * x) * (n + 1)| ≤ 1
    · congr; push_cast; simp only [fract]; ring
    exact (abs_sub_lt_one_of_floor_eq_floor hxy.symm).le

name: exists_nat_abs_mul_sub_round_le
statement:
theorem exists_nat_abs_mul_sub_round_le (ξ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (n_pos : 0 < n) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 0 < k ∧ k ≤ n ∧ |↑k * ξ - round (↑k * ξ)| ≤ 1 / (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, k, hk₀, hk₁, h⟩ := exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le ξ n_pos
  have hk := toNat_of_nonneg hk₀.le
  rw [← hk] at hk₀ hk₁ h
  exact ⟨k.toNat, natCast_pos.mp hk₀, Nat.cast_le.mp hk₁, (round_le (↑k.toNat * ξ) j).trans h⟩

name: exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le
statement:
theorem exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le (ξ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (n_pos : 0 < n) :
    ∃ q : ℚ, |ξ - q| ≤ 1 / ((n + 1) * q.den) ∧ q.den ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, k, hk₀, hk₁, h⟩ := exists_int_int_abs_mul_sub_le ξ n_pos
  have hk₀' : (0 : ℝ) < k := Int.cast_pos.mpr hk₀
  have hden : ((j / k : ℚ).den : ℤ) ≤ k := by
    convert! le_of_dvd hk₀ (Rat.den_dvd j k)
    exact Rat.intCast_div_eq_divInt _ _
  refine ⟨j / k, ?_, Nat.cast_le.mp (hden.trans hk₁)⟩
  rw [← div_div, le_div_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr <| Rat.pos _ : (0 : ℝ) < _)]
  refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Int.cast_le.mpr hden : _ ≤ (k : ℝ)) (abs_nonneg _)).trans ?_
  rwa [← abs_of_pos hk₀', Rat.cast_div, Rat.cast_intCast, Rat.cast_intCast, ← abs_mul, sub_mul,
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hk₀'.ne', mul_comm]

name: exists_rat_abs_sub_lt_and_lt_of_irrational
statement:
theorem exists_rat_abs_sub_lt_and_lt_of_irrational {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) (q : ℚ) :
    ∃ q' : ℚ, |ξ - q'| < 1 / (q'.den : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧ |ξ - q'| < |ξ - q|
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr <| Irrational.ne_rat hξ q)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / |ξ - q|)
  have m_pos : (0 : ℝ) < m := (one_div_pos.mpr h).trans hm
  obtain ⟨q', hbd, hden⟩ := exists_rat_abs_sub_le_and_den_le ξ (Nat.cast_pos.mp m_pos)
  have den_pos : (0 : ℝ) < q'.den := Nat.cast_pos.mpr q'.pos
  have md_pos := mul_pos (add_pos m_pos zero_lt_one) den_pos
  refine
    ⟨q', lt_of_le_of_lt hbd ?_,
      lt_of_le_of_lt hbd <|
        (one_div_lt md_pos h).mpr <|
          hm.trans <|
            lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_add_one _) <|
              (le_mul_iff_one_le_right <| add_pos m_pos zero_lt_one).mpr <|
                mod_cast (q'.pos : 1 ≤ q'.den)⟩
  rw [sq, one_div_lt_one_div md_pos (mul_pos den_pos den_pos), mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ den_pos]
  exact lt_add_of_le_of_pos (Nat.cast_le.mpr hden) zero_lt_one

name: infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_of_irrational
statement:
theorem infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_of_irrational {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : Irrational ξ) :
    {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2}.Infinite
proof:
:= by
  refine Or.resolve_left (Set.finite_or_infinite _) fun h => ?_
  obtain ⟨q, _, hq⟩ :=
    exists_min_image {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2} (fun q => |ξ - q|) h
      ⟨⌊ξ⌋, by simp [abs_of_nonneg, Int.fract_lt_one]⟩
  obtain ⟨q', hmem, hbetter⟩ := exists_rat_abs_sub_lt_and_lt_of_irrational hξ q
  exact lt_irrefl _ (lt_of_le_of_lt (hq q' hmem) hbetter)

name: den_le_and_le_num_le_of_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
proof:
:= by
  have hq₀ : (0 : ℚ) < q.den := Nat.cast_pos.mpr q.pos
  replace h : |ξ * q.den - q.num| < 1 / q.den := by
    rw [← mul_lt_mul_iff_left₀ hq₀] at h
    conv_lhs at h => rw [← abs_of_pos hq₀, ← abs_mul, sub_mul, mul_den_eq_num]
    rwa [sq, div_mul, mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hq₀.ne'] at h
  constructor
  · rcases eq_or_ne ξ q with (rfl | H)
    · exact le_rfl
    · have hξ₀ : (0 : ℚ) < ξ.den := Nat.cast_pos.mpr ξ.pos
      rw [← Rat.num_div_den ξ, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_sub' hξ₀.ne', abs_div, abs_of_pos hξ₀,
        div_lt_iff₀ hξ₀, div_mul_comm, mul_one] at h
      refine Nat.cast_le.mp ((one_lt_div hq₀).mp <| lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ h).le
      norm_cast
      rw [mul_comm _ q.num]
      exact Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero_of_ne <| mt Rat.eq_iff_mul_eq_mul.mpr H)
  · obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ :=
      abs_sub_lt_iff.mp
        (h.trans_le <|
          (one_div_le zero_lt_one hq₀).mp <| (@one_div_one ℚ _).symm ▸ Nat.cast_le.mpr q.pos)
    rw [sub_lt_iff_lt_add, add_comm] at h₁ h₂
    rw [← sub_lt_iff_lt_add] at h₂
    norm_cast at h₁ h₂
    exact
      ⟨sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr (Int.ceil_le.mpr h₁.le), sub_le_iff_le_add.mp (Int.le_floor.mpr h₂.le)⟩

name: finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
statement:
theorem finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq (ξ : ℚ) :
    {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℚ → ℤ × ℕ := fun q => (q.num, q.den)
  set s := {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2}
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b hab
    simp only [f, Prod.mk_inj] at hab
    rw [← Rat.num_div_den a, ← Rat.num_div_den b, hab.1, hab.2]
  have H : f '' s ⊆ ⋃ (y : ℕ) (_ : y ∈ Ioc 0 ξ.den), Icc (⌈ξ * y⌉ - 1) (⌊ξ * y⌋ + 1) ×ˢ {y} := by
    intro xy hxy
    simp only [mem_image] at hxy
    obtain ⟨q, hq₁, hq₂⟩ := hxy
    obtain ⟨hd, hn⟩ := den_le_and_le_num_le_of_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq hq₁
    simp_rw [mem_iUnion]
    refine ⟨q.den, Set.mem_Ioc.mpr ⟨q.pos, hd⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [prod_singleton, mem_image, mem_Icc]
    exact ⟨q.num, hn, hq₂⟩
  refine (Finite.subset ?_ H).of_finite_image hinj.injOn
  exact Finite.biUnion (finite_Ioc _ _) fun x _ => Finite.prod (finite_Icc _ _) (finite_singleton _)

name: Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational
statement:
theorem Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational (ξ : ℝ) :
    {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2}.Infinite ↔ Irrational ξ
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨fun h => (irrational_iff_ne_rational ξ).mpr fun a b _ => ?_,
      Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_of_irrational⟩
  contrapose! h
  convert! Rat.finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq ((a : ℚ) / b) with q
  rw [h, (by (push_cast; rfl) : (1 : ℝ) / (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2 = (1 / (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2 : ℚ))]
  norm_cast

name: convergent_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convergent_zero (ξ : ℝ) : ξ.convergent 0 = ⌊ξ⌋
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: convergent_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convergent_succ (ξ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ξ.convergent (n + 1) = ⌊ξ⌋ + ((fract ξ)⁻¹.convergent n)⁻¹
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: convergent_of_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convergent_of_zero (n : ℕ) : convergent 0 n = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [convergent_zero, floor_zero, cast_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ih, convergent_succ, floor_zero, cast_zero, fract_zero, add_zero, inv_zero]

name: convergent_of_int
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convergent_of_int {ξ : ℤ} (n : ℕ) : convergent ξ n = ξ
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simp only [convergent_zero, floor_intCast]
  · simp only [convergent_succ, floor_intCast, fract_intCast, convergent_of_zero, add_zero,
      inv_zero]

name: aux
statement: private theorem aux₀ {v : ℤ} (hv : 0 < v) : (0 : ℝ) < v ∧ (0 : ℝ) < 2 * v - 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨cast_pos.mpr hv, by norm_cast; lia⟩

name: aux
statement: private theorem aux₁ : 0 < fract ξ
proof:
:= by
  have hv₀ : (0 : ℝ) < v := cast_pos.mpr (zero_lt_two.trans_le hv)
  obtain ⟨hv₁, hv₂⟩ := aux₀ (zero_lt_two.trans_le hv)
  obtain ⟨hcop, _, h⟩ := h
  refine fract_pos.mpr fun hf => ?_
  rw [hf] at h
  have H : (2 * v - 1 : ℝ) < 1 := by
    refine (mul_lt_iff_lt_one_right hv₀).1 ((inv_lt_inv₀ hv₀ (mul_pos hv₁ hv₂)).1 (h.trans_le' ?_))
    have h' : (⌊ξ⌋ : ℝ) - u / v = (⌊ξ⌋ * v - u) / v := by field
    rw [h', abs_div, abs_of_pos hv₀, ← one_div, div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hv₀]
    norm_cast
    rw [← zero_add (1 : ℤ), add_one_le_iff, abs_pos, sub_ne_zero]
    rintro rfl
    cases isUnit_iff.mp (isCoprime_self.mp (IsCoprime.mul_left_iff.mp hcop).2) <;> lia
  norm_cast at H
  linarith only [hv, H]

name: aux
statement: private theorem aux₂ : 0 < u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v ∧ u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v < v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcop, _, h⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hv₀, hv₀'⟩ := aux₀ (zero_lt_two.trans_le hv)
  have hv₁ : 0 < 2 * v - 1 := by linarith only [hv]
  rw [← one_div, lt_div_iff₀ (mul_pos hv₀ hv₀'), ← abs_of_pos (mul_pos hv₀ hv₀'), ← abs_mul,
    sub_mul, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hv₀.ne', abs_sub_comm, abs_lt,
    lt_sub_iff_add_lt, sub_lt_iff_lt_add, mul_assoc] at h
  have hu₀ : 0 ≤ u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v := by
    refine (mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_right hv₁).mp ?_
    rw [← sub_one_lt_iff, zero_sub]
    replace h := h.1
    rw [← lt_sub_iff_add_lt, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_mul] at h
    exact mod_cast
      h.trans_le
        ((mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ <| hv₀').mpr <|
          (sub_le_sub_iff_left (u : ℝ)).mpr ((mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hv₀).mpr (floor_le ξ)))
  have hu₁ : u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v ≤ v := by
    refine _root_.le_of_mul_le_mul_right (le_of_lt_add_one ?_) hv₁
    replace h := h.2
    rw [← sub_lt_iff_lt_add, ← mul_assoc, ← sub_mul, ← add_lt_add_iff_right (v * (2 * v - 1) : ℝ),
      add_comm (1 : ℝ)] at h
    have :=
      flip mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hv₀' <| (sub_lt_sub_iff_left (u : ℝ)).mpr <|
          flip mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hv₀ <| sub_right_lt_of_lt_add <| lt_floor_add_one ξ
    rw [sub_mul ξ, one_mul, ← sub_add, add_mul] at this
    exact mod_cast this.trans h
  have huv_cop : IsCoprime (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v) v := by
    rwa [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul, IsCoprime.add_mul_right_left_iff]
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne' hu₀ fun hf => ?_, lt_of_le_of_ne hu₁ fun hf => ?_⟩ <;>
    · rw [hf] at huv_cop
      simp only [isCoprime_zero_left, isCoprime_self, isUnit_iff] at huv_cop
      rcases huv_cop with huv_cop | huv_cop <;> linarith only [hv, huv_cop]

name: aux
statement:
private theorem aux₃ :
    |(fract ξ)⁻¹ - v / (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v)| < (((u : ℝ) - ⌊ξ⌋ * v) * (2 * (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v) - 1))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hu₀, huv⟩ := aux₂ hv h
  have hξ₀ := aux₁ hv h
  set u' := u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v with hu'
  have hu'ℝ : (u' : ℝ) = u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v := mod_cast hu'
  rw [← hu'ℝ]
  replace hu'ℝ := (eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp hu'ℝ).symm
  obtain ⟨Hu, Hu'⟩ := aux₀ hu₀
  obtain ⟨Hv, Hv'⟩ := aux₀ (zero_lt_two.trans_le hv)
  have H₁ := div_pos (div_pos Hv Hu) hξ₀
  replace h := h.2.2
  have h' : |fract ξ - u' / v| < ((v : ℝ) * (2 * v - 1))⁻¹ := by
    rwa [hu'ℝ, add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ Hv.ne', ← sub_sub, sub_right_comm] at h
  have H : (2 * u' - 1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * v - 1) * fract ξ := by
    replace h := (abs_lt.mp h).1
    have : (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) * (-((v : ℝ) * (2 * v - 1))⁻¹ + u' / v) = 2 * u' - (1 + u') / v := by
      field
    rw [hu'ℝ, add_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ Hv.ne', ← sub_sub, sub_right_comm, self_sub_floor,
      lt_sub_iff_add_lt, ← mul_lt_mul_iff_right₀ Hv', this] at h
    refine LE.le.trans ?_ h.le
    rw [sub_le_sub_iff_left, div_le_one Hv, add_comm]
    exact mod_cast huv
  calc
    |(fract ξ)⁻¹ - v / u'| = |(fract ξ - u' / v) * (v / u' / fract ξ)| := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm]; congr 1; field
    _ = |fract ξ - u' / v| * (v / u' / fract ξ) := by rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos H₁]
    _ < ((v : ℝ) * (2 * v - 1))⁻¹ * (v / u' / fract ξ) := by gcongr
    _ = (u' * ((2 * v - 1) * fract ξ))⁻¹ := by field
    _ ≤ (u' * (2 * u' - 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ := by gcongr

name: invariant
statement: private theorem invariant : ContfracLegendre.Ass (fract ξ)⁻¹ v (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun huv => ?_, mod_cast aux₃ hv h⟩
  · rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_mul, isCoprime_comm, IsCoprime.add_mul_right_left_iff]
    exact h.1
  · obtain hv₀' := (aux₀ (zero_lt_two.trans_le hv)).2
    have Hv : (v * (2 * v - 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ + (v : ℝ)⁻¹ = 2 / (2 * v - 1) := by
      simp [field]
    have Huv : (u / v : ℝ) = ⌊ξ⌋ + (v : ℝ)⁻¹ := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp huv]; simp [field]
    have h' := (abs_sub_lt_iff.mp h.2.2).1
    rw [Huv, ← sub_sub, sub_lt_iff_lt_add, self_sub_floor, Hv] at h'
    rwa [lt_sub_iff_add_lt', (by ring : (v : ℝ) + -(1 / 2) = (2 * v - 1) / 2),
      lt_inv_comm₀ (div_pos hv₀' zero_lt_two) (aux₁ hv h), inv_div]

name: exists_rat_eq_convergent'
statement:
theorem exists_rat_eq_convergent' {v : ℕ} (h : ContfracLegendre.Ass ξ u v) :
    ∃ n, (u / v : ℚ) = ξ.convergent n
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing ξ u with | h v ih => ?_
  rcases lt_trichotomy v 1 with (ht | rfl | ht)
  · replace h := h.2.2
    simp only [Nat.lt_one_iff.mp ht, Nat.cast_zero, div_zero, tsub_zero, zero_mul,
      cast_zero, inv_zero] at h
    exact False.elim (lt_irrefl _ <| (abs_nonneg ξ).trans_lt h)
  · rw [Nat.cast_one, div_one]
    obtain ⟨_, h₁, h₂⟩ := h
    rcases le_or_gt (u : ℝ) ξ with ht | ht
    · use 0
      rw [convergent_zero, Rat.intCast_inj, eq_comm, floor_eq_iff]
      convert! And.intro ht (sub_lt_iff_lt_add'.mp (abs_lt.mp h₂).2) <;> norm_num
    · replace h₁ := lt_sub_iff_add_lt'.mp (h₁ rfl)
      have hξ₁ : ⌊ξ⌋ = u - 1 := by
        rw [floor_eq_iff, cast_sub, cast_one, sub_add_cancel]
        exact ⟨(((sub_lt_sub_iff_left _).mpr one_half_lt_one).trans h₁).le, ht⟩
      rcases eq_or_ne ξ ⌊ξ⌋ with Hξ | Hξ
      · rw [Hξ, hξ₁, cast_sub, cast_one, ← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_lt_sub_iff_left] at h₁
        exact False.elim (lt_irrefl _ <| h₁.trans one_half_lt_one)
      · have hξ₂ : ⌊(fract ξ)⁻¹⌋ = 1 := by
          rw [floor_eq_iff, cast_one, le_inv_comm₀ zero_lt_one (fract_pos.mpr Hξ), inv_one,
            one_add_one_eq_two, inv_lt_comm₀ (fract_pos.mpr Hξ) zero_lt_two]
          refine ⟨(fract_lt_one ξ).le, ?_⟩
          rw [fract, hξ₁, cast_sub, cast_one, lt_sub_iff_add_lt', sub_add]
          convert! h₁ using 1
          rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
          norm_num
        use 1
        simp [convergent, hξ₁, hξ₂, cast_sub, cast_one]
  · obtain ⟨huv₀, huv₁⟩ := aux₂ (Nat.cast_le.mpr ht) h
    have Hv : (v : ℚ) ≠ 0 := (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans ht)).ne'
    have huv₁' : (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v).toNat < v := by zify; rwa [toNat_of_nonneg huv₀.le]
    have inv : ContfracLegendre.Ass (fract ξ)⁻¹ v (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * ↑v).toNat :=
      (toNat_of_nonneg huv₀.le).symm ▸ invariant (Nat.cast_le.mpr ht) h
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := ih (u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v).toNat huv₁' inv
    use n + 1
    rw [convergent_succ, ← hn,
      (mod_cast toNat_of_nonneg huv₀.le : ((u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v).toNat : ℚ) = u - ⌊ξ⌋ * v),
      cast_natCast, inv_div, sub_div, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ Hv, add_sub_cancel]

name: exists_rat_eq_convergent
statement:
theorem exists_rat_eq_convergent {q : ℚ} (h : |ξ - q| < 1 / (2 * (q.den : ℝ) ^ 2)) :
    ∃ n, q = ξ.convergent n
proof:
:= by
  refine q.num_div_den ▸ exists_rat_eq_convergent' ⟨?_, fun hd => ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime.mpr (natAbs_natCast q.den ▸ q.reduced)
  · rw [← q.den_eq_one_iff.mp (Nat.cast_eq_one.mp hd)] at h
    simpa only [Rat.den_intCast, Nat.cast_one, one_pow, mul_one] using! (abs_lt.mp h).1
  · obtain ⟨hq₀, hq₁⟩ := aux₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr q.pos)
    replace hq₁ := mul_pos hq₀ hq₁
    have hq₂ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (q.den * q.den) := mul_pos zero_lt_two (mul_pos hq₀ hq₀)
    rw [cast_natCast] at *
    rw [(by norm_cast : (q.num / q.den : ℝ) = (q.num / q.den : ℚ)), Rat.num_div_den]
    exact h.trans (by rw [← one_div, sq, one_div_lt_one_div hq₂ hq₁, ← sub_pos]; ring_nf; exact hq₀)

name: summable_riemannZetaSummand
statement:

    Summable (fun n ↦ ‖riemannZetaSummandHom (ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs) n‖)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [riemannZetaSummandHom, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk]
  convert! Real.summable_nat_rpow_inv.mpr hs with n
  rw [← ofReal_natCast,
    norm_cpow_eq_rpow_re_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) <| re_neg_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs,
    neg_re, Real.rpow_neg <| Nat.cast_nonneg n]

statement:
lemma tsum_riemannZetaSummand (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    ∑' (n : ℕ), riemannZetaSummandHom (ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs) n = riemannZeta s
proof:
:= by
  have hsum := summable_riemannZetaSummand hs
  rw [zeta_eq_tsum_one_div_nat_add_one_cpow hs, hsum.of_norm.tsum_eq_zero_add, map_zero, zero_add]
  simp only [riemannZetaSummandHom, cpow_neg, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, one_div]

name: DirichletCharacter.LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log
statement:
theorem DirichletCharacter.LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log {N : ℕ} (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N)
    {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
    exp (∑' p : Nat.Primes, -log (1 - χ p * p ^ (-s))) = L ↗χ s
proof:
:= by
  let f := dirichletSummandHom χ <| ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs
  have h n : term ↗χ s n = f n := by
    rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp only [term_zero, map_zero]
    · simp only [ne_eq, hn, not_false_eq_true, term_of_ne_zero, div_eq_mul_inv,
        dirichletSummandHom, cpow_neg, MonoidWithZeroHom.coe_mk, ZeroHom.coe_mk, f]
  simpa only [LSeries, h]
    using! exp_tsum_primes_log_eq_tsum (f := f) <| summable_dirichletSummand χ hs

    modOne_eq_one (R := ℂ) ▸
      DirichletCharacter.LSeries_eulerProduct_exp_log (1 : DirichletCharacter ℂ 1) hs using 7
