theorem IsRamified.finrank_eq_two [w.LiesOver v] (h : w.IsRamified K) :
    Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion = 2
proof:
:= by
  have H := NumberField.InfinitePlace.isRamified_iff.mp h
  rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.LiesOver.comap_eq w v] at H
  have := LiesOver.extensionEmbedding_liesOver_of_isReal w H.2
  rw [Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ringEquivRealOfIsReal H.2)
      (ringEquivComplexOfIsComplex H.1) (by ext; simp),
    Complex.finrank_real_complex]

name: IsUnramified.finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem IsUnramified.finrank_eq_one [w.LiesOver v] (h : w.IsUnramified K) :
    Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases v.isReal_or_isComplex with (hv | hv)
  · have := LiesOver.extensionEmbedding_liesOver_of_isReal w hv
    rw [Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ringEquivRealOfIsReal hv) (ringEquivRealOfIsReal
        (h.liesOver_isReal_over _ _ hv)) (RingHom.ext fun _ ↦ Complex.ofReal_inj.1 <| by simp),
      Module.finrank_self]
  · cases LiesOver.embedding_comp_eq_or_conjugate_embedding_comp_eq w v with
    | inl hl =>
      have : ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver w.embedding v.embedding := ⟨hl⟩
      have := liesOver_extensionEmbedding w v
      rw [Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ringEquivComplexOfIsComplex hv)
          (ringEquivComplexOfIsComplex (LiesOver.isComplex_of_isComplex_under _ hv)) (by ext; simp),
        Module.finrank_self]
    | inr hr =>
      have : ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver (conjugate w.embedding) v.embedding := ⟨hr⟩
      have := liesOver_conjugate_extensionEmbedding w v
      rw [Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (ringEquivComplexOfIsComplex hv)
        ((ringEquivComplexOfIsComplex (LiesOver.isComplex_of_isComplex_under _ hv)).trans
          (starRingAut (R := ℂ))) (by ext; simp [← conjugate_coe_eq]),
        Module.finrank_self]

name: mult_mul_finrank
statement:
theorem mult_mul_finrank [w.LiesOver v] :
    v.mult * Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion = w.mult
proof:
:= by
  have hv : v = w.comap (algebraMap K L) := Subtype.ext ‹w.LiesOver v›.under_eq.symm
  rcases w.isUnramified_or_isRamified K with h | h
  · rw [h.finrank_eq_one v, hv, h.eq, mul_one]
  · rw [h.finrank_eq_two v, hv, h.isReal.mult_eq_one, h.isComplex.mult_eq_two, one_mul]

name: inertiaDeg_of_liesOver
statement:
theorem inertiaDeg_of_liesOver [w.LiesOver v] :
    v.inertiaDeg w = (⊥ : Ideal w.Completion).inertiaDeg v.Completion
proof:
:= by
  simp only [InfinitePlace.inertiaDeg, dite_eq_left]

name: inertiaDeg_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem inertiaDeg_eq_finrank [w.LiesOver v] :
    v.inertiaDeg w = Module.finrank v.Completion w.Completion
proof:
:= by
  rw [inertiaDeg_of_liesOver, Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_of_isMaximal ⊥]
  exact Algebra.finrank_eq_of_equiv_equiv (RingEquiv.quotientBot v.Completion)
    (RingEquiv.quotientBot w.Completion) (by ext; simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra])

name: inertiaDeg_eq_one
statement: theorem inertiaDeg_eq_one (hw : w ∈ unramifiedPlacesOver L v) : v.inertiaDeg w = 1
proof:
:=
  have := (Set.mem_ofPred.1 hw).1; hw.2.finrank_eq_one v ▸ inertiaDeg_eq_finrank v w

name: inertiaDeg_eq_two
statement: theorem inertiaDeg_eq_two (hw : w ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v) : v.inertiaDeg w = 2
proof:
:=
  have := (Set.mem_ofPred.1 hw).1; hw.2.finrank_eq_two v ▸ inertiaDeg_eq_finrank v w

name: sum_inertiaDeg_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem sum_inertiaDeg_eq_finrank [NumberField K] [NumberField L] :
    ∑ w ∈ v.placesOver L, v.inertiaDeg w = Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← union_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver L v, toFinset_union,
    sum_union (Set.disjoint_toFinset.2 <| disjoint_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver L v),
    sum_congr rfl (fun _ h ↦ inertiaDeg_eq_two (by simpa using h)),
    sum_congr rfl (fun _ h ↦ inertiaDeg_eq_one (by simpa using h)), sum_const, add_comm]
  simp [← unramifedPlacesOver_ncard_add_eq_finrank L v, mul_comm, ncard_eq_toFinset_card']

name: FinitePlace.embedding_apply
statement: theorem FinitePlace.embedding_apply (x : K) : embedding v x = ↑x
proof: := rfl

name: one_lt_absNorm
statement: lemma one_lt_absNorm : 1 < absNorm v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  apply IsPrime.ne_top v.isPrime
  rw [← absNorm_eq_one_iff]
  have : 0 < absNorm v.asIdeal := by
    rw [Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero, absNorm_ne_zero_iff]
    exact Ring.HasFiniteQuotients.finiteQuotient v.ne_bot
  lia

name: one_lt_absNorm_nnreal
statement: lemma one_lt_absNorm_nnreal : 1 < (absNorm v.asIdeal : ℝ≥0)
proof: := mod_cast one_lt_absNorm v

name: two_le_absNorm_nnreal
statement: lemma two_le_absNorm_nnreal : 2 ≤ (absNorm v.asIdeal : ℝ≥0)
proof: := mod_cast one_lt_absNorm v

name: absNorm_ne_zero
statement: lemma absNorm_ne_zero : (absNorm v.asIdeal : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ne_zero_of_lt (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v)

name: adicAbv_def
statement: theorem adicAbv_def {x : K} : adicAbv K v x = toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v) (v.valuation K x)
proof: := rfl

name: isNonarchimedean_adicAbv
statement: theorem isNonarchimedean_adicAbv : IsNonarchimedean (adicAbv K v)
proof:
:=
  v.isNonarchimedean_adicAbv <| one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v

name: rankOne_hom'_def
statement:
lemma rankOne_hom'_def :
    (instRankOneAdicCompletion K v).hom' = (toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v)).comp
      (valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt Valued.v).toMonoidWithZeroHom
proof: := rfl

name: toNNReal_valued_eq_adicAbv
statement:
lemma toNNReal_valued_eq_adicAbv (x : WithVal (v.valuation K)) :
    toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v) (Valued.v x) = adicAbv K v (WithVal.equiv _ x)
proof: := rfl

name: adicAbv_add_le_max
statement:
theorem adicAbv_add_le_max (x y : K) :
    adicAbv K v (x + y) ≤ (adicAbv K v x) ⊔ (adicAbv K v y)
proof: := isNonarchimedean_adicAbv K v x y

name: adicAbv_natCast_le_one
statement: theorem adicAbv_natCast_le_one (n : ℕ) : adicAbv K v n ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (isNonarchimedean_adicAbv K v).apply_natCast_le_one (map_zero_le (adicAbv K v) 1)
  (map_one (adicAbv K v))

name: adicAbv_intCast_le_one
statement: theorem adicAbv_intCast_le_one (n : ℤ) : adicAbv K v n ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (isNonarchimedean_adicAbv K v).apply_intCast_le_one (map_zero_le (adicAbv K v) 1)
  (map_one (adicAbv K v)) (map_neg_eq_map (adicAbv K v))

name: FinitePlace.norm_def
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.norm_def (x : v.adicCompletion K) :
    ‖x‖ = toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v) (Valued.v x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [Valued.toNormedField.norm_def, Valuation.RankOne.hom, HeightOneSpectrum.rankOne_hom'_def,
    valueGroup₀_equiv_withZeroMulInt_restrict_apply_of_surjective
      (valuedAdicCompletion_surjective K v)]

name: FinitePlace.norm_embedding
statement: theorem FinitePlace.norm_embedding (x : K) : ‖embedding v x‖ = adicAbv K v x
proof:
:= by
  simp [norm_def, embedding_apply, adicAbv_def]

name: FinitePlace.norm_embedding'
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.norm_embedding' (x : K) :
    ‖embedding v x‖ = toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v) (v.valuation K x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding, adicAbv_def]

name: FinitePlace.norm_embedding_int
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.norm_embedding_int (x : R) :
    ‖embedding v (algebraMap _ K x)‖ = toNNReal (absNorm_ne_zero v) (v.intValuation x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [norm_embedding, adicAbv_def, valuation_of_algebraMap]

name: FinitePlace.norm_le_one
statement: theorem FinitePlace.norm_le_one (x : R) : ‖embedding v (algebraMap _ K x)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding]
  exact v.adicAbv_coe_le_one (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v) x

name: FinitePlace.norm_eq_one_iff_notMem
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.norm_eq_one_iff_notMem (x : R) :
    ‖embedding v (algebraMap _ K x)‖ = 1 ↔ x ∉ v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding]
  exact v.adicAbv_coe_eq_one_iff (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v) x

name: FinitePlace.norm_lt_one_iff_mem
statement:
theorem FinitePlace.norm_lt_one_iff_mem (x : R) :
    ‖embedding v (algebraMap _ K x)‖ < 1 ↔ x ∈ v.asIdeal
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding]
  exact v.adicAbv_coe_lt_one_iff (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v) x

name: FinitePlace.two_le_norm_of_one_lt_norm
statement: lemma FinitePlace.two_le_norm_of_one_lt_norm (x : v.adicCompletion K) (h : 1 < ‖x‖) : 2 ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [FinitePlace.norm_def, WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal_neg_apply (absNorm_ne_zero v) (by aesop)]
  apply (two_le_absNorm_nnreal v).trans
  conv_lhs => rw [← zpow_one (v.asIdeal.absNorm : NNReal)]
  apply zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v).le
  simpa [← Int.sub_one_lt_iff, sub_self, ← toAdd_one, Multiplicative.toAdd_lt,
    WithZero.lt_unzero_iff] using Valued.toNormedField.one_lt_norm_iff.1 h

name: HeightOneSpectrum.embedding_mul_absNorm
statement:
lemma HeightOneSpectrum.embedding_mul_absNorm {x : R} (h_x_nezero : x ≠ 0) :
    ‖embedding v (algebraMap _ K x)‖ * absNorm (v.maxPowDividing (span {x})) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [maxPowDividing, map_pow, Nat.cast_pow, norm_embedding, adicAbv_def,
    WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal_neg_apply _ ((v.valuation K).ne_zero_iff.mpr
      ((FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff R K).not.2 h_x_nezero))]
  push_cast
  rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_add₀ <| mod_cast (zero_lt_one.trans (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v)).ne']
  norm_cast
  rw [zpow_eq_one_iff_right₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg' _) (mod_cast (one_lt_absNorm_nnreal v).ne')]
  simp [valuation_of_algebraMap, intValuation_if_neg, h_x_nezero]

name: FinitePlace.isFinitePlace
statement: lemma FinitePlace.isFinitePlace [NumberField K] (v : FinitePlace K) : IsFinitePlace v.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsFinitePlace, v.prop]

name: isFinitePlace_iff
statement:
lemma isFinitePlace_iff [NumberField K] (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) :
    IsFinitePlace v ↔ ∃ w : FinitePlace K, w.val = v
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨⟨v, H⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨w, hw⟩ ↦ hw ▸ w.isFinitePlace⟩

name: mk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (x : K) : mk v x = ‖embedding v x‖
proof: := rfl

name: coe_apply
statement: lemma coe_apply (v : FinitePlace K) (x : K) : v x = v.val x
proof: := rfl

name: mk_maximalIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_maximalIdeal (w : FinitePlace K) : mk (maximalIdeal w) = w
proof: := Subtype.ext w.2.choose_spec

name: norm_embedding_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem norm_embedding_eq (w : FinitePlace K) (x : K) :
    ‖embedding (maximalIdeal w) x‖ = w x
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← mk_maximalIdeal w, mk_apply]

name: pos_iff
statement: theorem pos_iff {w : FinitePlace K} {x : K} : 0 < w x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof: := w.1.pos_iff

name: mk_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_iff {v₁ v₂ : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)} : mk v₁ = mk v₂ ↔ v₁ = v₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun a ↦ by rw [a]⟩
  contrapose!
  intro h
  rw [DFunLike.ne_iff]
  have ⟨x, hx1, hx2⟩ : ∃ x : 𝓞 K, x ∈ v₁.asIdeal ∧ x ∉ v₂.asIdeal := by
    by_contra! H
    exact h <| HeightOneSpectrum.ext_iff.mpr <| IsMaximal.eq_of_le (isMaximal v₁) IsPrime.ne_top' H
  use x
  simp only [mk_apply]
  rw [← norm_lt_one_iff_mem K] at hx1
  rw [← norm_eq_one_iff_notMem K] at hx2
  linarith

name: maximalIdeal_mk
statement: theorem maximalIdeal_mk (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) : maximalIdeal (mk v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_eq_iff, mk_maximalIdeal]

name: maximalIdeal_injective
statement: lemma maximalIdeal_injective : (fun w : FinitePlace K ↦ maximalIdeal w).Injective
proof:
:=
  equivHeightOneSpectrum.injective

name: maximalIdeal_inj
statement: lemma maximalIdeal_inj (w₁ w₂ : FinitePlace K) : maximalIdeal w₁ = maximalIdeal w₂ ↔ w₁ = w₂
proof:
:=
  equivHeightOneSpectrum.injective.eq_iff

name: hasFiniteMulSupport_int
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem hasFiniteMulSupport_int {x : 𝓞 K} (h_x_nezero : x ≠ 0) :
    (fun w : FinitePlace K ↦ w x).HasFiniteMulSupport
proof:
:= by
  have (w : FinitePlace K) : w x ≠ 1 ↔ w x < 1 :=
    ne_iff_lt_iff_le.mpr <| norm_embedding_eq w x ▸ norm_le_one K w.maximalIdeal x
  simp_rw [Function.HasFiniteMulSupport, Function.mulSupport, this, ← norm_embedding_eq,
    norm_lt_one_iff_mem, ← Ideal.dvd_span_singleton]
  have h : {v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K) | v.asIdeal ∣ span {x}}.Finite := by
    apply Ideal.finite_factors
    simp only [Submodule.zero_eq_bot, ne_eq, span_singleton_eq_bot, h_x_nezero, not_false_eq_true]
  have h_inj : Set.InjOn FinitePlace.maximalIdeal {w | w.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ∣ span {x}} :=
    Function.Injective.injOn maximalIdeal_injective
  refine (h.subset ?_).of_finite_image h_inj
  simp only [dvd_span_singleton, Set.image_subset_iff, Set.preimage_ofPred_eq, subset_refl]

name: hasFiniteMulSupport
statement:
@[fun_prop]
theorem hasFiniteMulSupport {x : K} (h_x_nezero : x ≠ 0) :
    (fun w : FinitePlace K ↦ w x).HasFiniteMulSupport
proof:
:= by
  rcases IsFractionRing.div_surjective (𝓞 K) x with ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩
  simp_all only [ne_eq, div_eq_zero_iff, FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_eq_zero_iff, not_or, map_div₀]
  obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := h_x_nezero
  simp_rw [← RingOfIntegers.coe_eq_algebraMap]
  fun_prop

name: hasFiniteMulSupport_fun_pow_multiplicity
statement:
lemma hasFiniteMulSupport_fun_pow_multiplicity {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] {I : Ideal (𝓞 K)}
    (hI : I ≠ ⊥) (f : Ideal (𝓞 K) → M) :
    (fun v : FinitePlace K ↦
      f v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ^ multiplicity v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal I).HasFiniteMulSupport
proof:
:=
  UniqueFactorizationMonoid.hasFiniteMulSupport_fun_pow_multiplicity _
    (asIdeal_injective.comp maximalIdeal_injective) (fun v ↦ v.maximalIdeal.irreducible) hI

name: add_le
statement:
protected
lemma add_le (v : FinitePlace K) (x y : K) :
    v (x + y) ≤ max (v x) (v y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := v.prop
  have H x : v x = NumberField.HeightOneSpectrum.adicAbv K w x := by
    rw [show v x = v.val x from rfl]
    grind only [place_apply, norm_embedding]
  simpa only [H] using adicAbv_add_le_max K w x y

name: equivHeightOneSpectrum_symm_apply
statement:
lemma equivHeightOneSpectrum_symm_apply (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (x : K) :
    (equivHeightOneSpectrum.symm v) x = ‖embedding v x‖
proof: := rfl

name: equivHeightOneSpectrum_symm_apply_algebraMap
statement:
lemma equivHeightOneSpectrum_symm_apply_algebraMap
    (v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 K)) (w : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L)) [w.1.LiesOver v.1] (x : K) :
    FinitePlace.equivHeightOneSpectrum.symm w (algebraMap K L x) =
      FinitePlace.equivHeightOneSpectrum.symm v x ^
        (w.1.ramificationIdx (𝓞 K) * w.1.inertiaDeg (𝓞 K))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · rw [hx, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero, zero_pow]
    exact (mul_pos (w.asIdeal.ramificationIdx_pos (𝓞 K)) (w.asIdeal.inertiaDeg_pos (𝓞 K))).ne'
  simp_rw [NumberField.FinitePlace.equivHeightOneSpectrum_symm_apply,
    FinitePlace.norm_embedding, HeightOneSpectrum.adicAbv_def]
  rw [← IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_liesOver L v, map_pow,
    Ideal.ramificationIdx'_eq_ramificationIdx v.1 w.1 v.ne_bot,
    WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal_neg_apply _ (by simpa), WithZeroMulInt.toNNReal_neg_apply _ (by simpa),
    ← Ideal.absNorm_pow_inertiaDeg v.1 w.1]
  simp only [Nat.cast_pow, NNReal.coe_zpow, ← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul]
  grind

name: finprod_finitePlace_pow_multiplicity
statement:
lemma finprod_finitePlace_pow_multiplicity {I : Ideal (𝓞 K)} (hI : I ≠ ⊥) :
    ∏ᶠ v : FinitePlace K, v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal ^ multiplicity v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal I = I
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← finprod_heightOneSpectrum_pow_multiplicity hI]
  simp only [← finprod_comp_equiv (equivHeightOneSpectrum (K := K)), equivHeightOneSpectrum_apply]

name: apply_mul_absNorm_pow_eq_one
statement:
lemma apply_mul_absNorm_pow_eq_one (v : FinitePlace K) {x : 𝓞 K} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    v x * v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal.absNorm ^ multiplicity v.maximalIdeal.asIdeal (span {x}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnz : span {x} ≠ ⊥ := mt Submodule.span_singleton_eq_bot.mp hx
  rw [← norm_embedding_eq v x, ← Nat.cast_pow, ← map_pow, ← maxPowDividing_eq_pow_multiplicity hnz]
  exact HeightOneSpectrum.embedding_mul_absNorm K v.maximalIdeal hx

name: InfinitePlace.isInfinitePlace
statement: lemma InfinitePlace.isInfinitePlace (v : InfinitePlace K) : IsInfinitePlace v.val
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsInfinitePlace, v.prop]

name: isInfinitePlace_iff
statement:
lemma isInfinitePlace_iff (v : AbsoluteValue K ℝ) :
    IsInfinitePlace v ↔ ∃ w : InfinitePlace K, w.val = v
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ ⟨⟨v, H⟩, rfl⟩, fun ⟨w, hw⟩ ↦ hw ▸ w.isInfinitePlace⟩

name: coe_apply
statement: lemma coe_apply (v : InfinitePlace K) (x : K) : v x = v.1 x
proof: := rfl

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma ext (v₁ v₂ : InfinitePlace K) (h : ∀ k, v₁ k = v₂ k) : v₁ = v₂
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext <| AbsoluteValue.ext h

name: apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem apply (φ : K →+* ℂ) (x : K) : (mk φ) x = ‖φ x‖
proof: := rfl

name: mk_embedding
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_embedding (w : InfinitePlace K) : mk (embedding w) = w
proof: := Subtype.ext w.2.choose_spec

name: mk_conjugate_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_conjugate_eq (φ : K →+* ℂ) : mk (ComplexEmbedding.conjugate φ) = mk φ
proof:
:= by
  refine DFunLike.ext _ _ (fun x => ?_)
  rw [apply, apply, ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq, Complex.norm_conj]

name: norm_embedding_eq
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_eq (w : InfinitePlace K) (x : K) :
    ‖(embedding w) x‖ = w x
proof:
:= by
  nth_rewrite 2 [← mk_embedding w]
  rfl

name: embedding_injective
statement: theorem embedding_injective : (embedding (K := K)).Injective
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ by simpa using congr_arg mk h

name: embedding_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embedding_inj {v₁ v₂ : InfinitePlace K} : v₁.embedding = v₂.embedding ↔ v₁ = v₂
proof:
:=
  (embedding_injective _).eq_iff

name: conjugate_embedding_injective
statement:
theorem conjugate_embedding_injective :
    (fun (v : InfinitePlace K) ↦ ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v.embedding).Injective
proof:
:=
  star_injective.comp <| embedding_injective K

name: eq_of_embedding_eq_conjugate
statement:
theorem eq_of_embedding_eq_conjugate {v₁ v₂ : InfinitePlace K}
    (h : v₁.embedding = ComplexEmbedding.conjugate v₂.embedding) : v₁ = v₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_embedding v₁, h, mk_conjugate_eq, mk_embedding]

name: eq_iff_eq
statement: theorem eq_iff_eq (x : K) (r : ℝ) : (∀ w : InfinitePlace K, w x = r) ↔ ∀ φ : K →+* ℂ, ‖φ x‖ = r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hw φ => hw (mk φ), by rintro hφ ⟨w, ⟨φ, rfl⟩⟩; exact hφ φ⟩

name: le_iff_le
statement: theorem le_iff_le (x : K) (r : ℝ) : (∀ w : InfinitePlace K, w x ≤ r) ↔ ∀ φ : K →+* ℂ, ‖φ x‖ ≤ r
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hw φ => hw (mk φ), by rintro hφ ⟨w, ⟨φ, rfl⟩⟩; exact hφ φ⟩

name: pos_iff
statement: theorem pos_iff {w : InfinitePlace K} {x : K} : 0 < w x ↔ x ≠ 0
proof: := AbsoluteValue.pos_iff w.1

name: mk_eq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mk_eq_iff {φ ψ : K →+* ℂ} : mk φ = mk ψ ↔ φ = ψ ∨ ComplexEmbedding.conjugate φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    
    intro h₀
    obtain ⟨j, hiφ⟩ := (φ.injective).hasLeftInverse
    let ι := RingEquiv.ofLeftInverse hiφ
    have hlip : LipschitzWith 1 (RingHom.comp ψ ι.symm.toRingHom) := by
      change LipschitzWith 1 (ψ ∘ ι.symm)
      apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm, Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply,
        ← map_sub, ← map_sub]
      apply le_of_eq
      suffices ‖φ (ι.symm (x - y))‖ = ‖ψ (ι.symm (x - y))‖ by
        rw [← this, ← RingEquiv.ofLeftInverse_apply hiφ _, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply ι _,
          dist_eq_norm]
        rfl
      exact congrFun (congrArg (↑) h₀) _
    cases
      Complex.uniformContinuous_ringHom_eq_id_or_conj φ.fieldRange hlip.uniformContinuous with
    | inl h =>
        left; ext1 x
        conv_rhs => rw [← hiφ x]
        exact (congrFun h (ι x)).symm
    | inr h =>
        right; ext1 x
        conv_rhs => rw [← hiφ x]
        exact (congrFun h (ι x)).symm
  · rintro (⟨h⟩ | ⟨h⟩)
    · exact congr_arg mk h
    · rw [← mk_conjugate_eq]
      exact congr_arg mk h

name: embedding_mk_eq
statement:
theorem embedding_mk_eq (φ : K →+* ℂ) :
    embedding (mk φ) = φ ∨ embedding (mk φ) = ComplexEmbedding.conjugate φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [@eq_comm _ _ φ, @eq_comm _ _ (ComplexEmbedding.conjugate φ), ← mk_eq_iff, mk_embedding]

name: embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal {φ : K →+* ℂ} (h : ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ) :
    embedding (mk φ) = φ
proof:
:= by
  have := embedding_mk_eq φ
  rwa [ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mp h, or_self] at this

name: isReal_iff
statement:
theorem isReal_iff {w : InfinitePlace K} :
    IsReal w ↔ ComplexEmbedding.IsReal (embedding w)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨embedding w, h, mk_embedding w⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨φ, ⟨hφ, rfl⟩⟩
  rwa [embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal hφ]

name: isComplex_iff
statement:
theorem isComplex_iff {w : InfinitePlace K} :
    IsComplex w ↔ ¬ComplexEmbedding.IsReal (embedding w)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun h => ⟨embedding w, h, mk_embedding w⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨φ, ⟨hφ, rfl⟩⟩
  contrapose hφ
  cases mk_eq_iff.mp (mk_embedding (mk φ)) with
  | inl h => rwa [h] at hφ
  | inr h => rwa [← ComplexEmbedding.isReal_conjugate_iff, h] at hφ

name: conjugate_embedding_eq_of_isReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_embedding_eq_of_isReal {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : IsReal w) :
    ComplexEmbedding.conjugate (embedding w) = embedding w
proof:
:=
  ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mpr (isReal_iff.mp h)

name: not_isReal_iff_isComplex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_isReal_iff_isComplex {w : InfinitePlace K} : ¬IsReal w ↔ IsComplex w
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplex_iff, isReal_iff]

name: not_isComplex_iff_isReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_isComplex_iff_isReal {w : InfinitePlace K} : ¬IsComplex w ↔ IsReal w
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplex_iff, isReal_iff, not_not]

name: isReal_or_isComplex
statement: theorem isReal_or_isComplex (w : InfinitePlace K) : IsReal w ∨ IsComplex w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_isReal_iff_isComplex]; exact em _

name: ne_of_isReal_isComplex
statement:
theorem ne_of_isReal_isComplex {w w' : InfinitePlace K} (h : IsReal w) (h' : IsComplex w') :
    w ≠ w'
proof: := fun h_eq ↦ not_isReal_iff_isComplex.mpr h' (h_eq ▸ h)

name: disjoint_isReal_isComplex
statement:
theorem disjoint_isReal_isComplex :
    Disjoint {(w : InfinitePlace K) | IsReal w} {(w : InfinitePlace K) | IsComplex w}
proof:
:=
  Set.disjoint_iff.2 <| fun _ hw ↦ not_isReal_iff_isComplex.2 hw.2 hw.1

name: embedding_of_isReal_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embedding_of_isReal_apply {w : InfinitePlace K} (hw : IsReal w) (x : K) :
    ((embedding_of_isReal hw) x : ℂ) = (embedding w) x
proof:
:=
  ComplexEmbedding.IsReal.coe_embedding_apply (isReal_iff.mp hw) x

name: norm_embedding_of_isReal
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_of_isReal {w : InfinitePlace K} (hw : IsReal w) (x : K) :
    ‖embedding_of_isReal hw x‖ = w x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_embedding_eq, ← embedding_of_isReal_apply hw, Complex.norm_real]

name: isReal_of_mk_isReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isReal_of_mk_isReal {φ : K →+* ℂ} (h : IsReal (mk φ)) :
    ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ
proof:
:= by
  contrapose h
  rw [not_isReal_iff_isComplex]
  exact ⟨φ, h, rfl⟩

name: isReal_mk_iff
statement:
lemma isReal_mk_iff {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    IsReal (mk φ) ↔ ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨isReal_of_mk_isReal, fun H ↦ ⟨_, H, rfl⟩⟩

name: isComplex_mk_iff
statement:
lemma isComplex_mk_iff {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    IsComplex (mk φ) ↔ ¬ ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  not_isReal_iff_isComplex.symm.trans isReal_mk_iff.not

name: not_isReal_of_mk_isComplex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_isReal_of_mk_isComplex {φ : K →+* ℂ} (h : IsComplex (mk φ)) :
    ¬ ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ
proof: := by rwa [← isComplex_mk_iff]

name: IsReal.mult_eq_one
statement: theorem IsReal.mult_eq_one {w : InfinitePlace K} (hw : IsReal w) : mult w = 1
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_left hw

name: IsComplex.mult_eq_two
statement: theorem IsComplex.mult_eq_two {w : InfinitePlace K} (hw : IsComplex w) : mult w = 2
proof:
:=
  ite_eq_right (not_isReal_iff_isComplex.mpr hw)

name: mult_isReal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mult_isReal (w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsReal w}) :
    mult w.1 = 1
proof:
:=
  w.2.mult_eq_one

name: mult_isComplex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mult_isComplex (w : {w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w}) :
    mult w.1 = 2
proof:
:=
  w.2.mult_eq_two

name: mult_pos
statement: theorem mult_pos {w : InfinitePlace K} : 0 < mult w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mult]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: mult_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mult_ne_zero {w : InfinitePlace K} : mult w ≠ 0
proof: := ne_of_gt mult_pos

name: mult_coe_ne_zero
statement: theorem mult_coe_ne_zero {w : InfinitePlace K} : (mult w : ℝ) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr mult_ne_zero

name: one_le_mult
statement: theorem one_le_mult {w : InfinitePlace K} : (1 : ℝ) ≤ mult w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_le]
  exact mult_pos

name: card_filter_mk_eq
statement: theorem card_filter_mk_eq [NumberField K] (w : InfinitePlace K) : #{φ | mk φ = w} = mult w
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs =>
    congr; congr; ext
    rw [← mk_embedding w, mk_eq_iff, ComplexEmbedding.conjugate, star_involutive.eq_iff]
  simp_rw [Finset.filter_or, Finset.filter_eq' _ (embedding w),
    Finset.filter_eq' _ (ComplexEmbedding.conjugate (embedding w)),
    Finset.mem_univ, ite_true, mult]
  split_ifs with hw
  · rw [ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mp (isReal_iff.mp hw), Finset.union_idempotent,
      Finset.card_singleton]
  · refine Finset.card_pair ?_
    rwa [Ne, eq_comm, ← ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff, ← isReal_iff]

name: prod_eq_prod_mul_prod
statement:
@[to_additive]
theorem prod_eq_prod_mul_prod {α : Type*} [CommMonoid α] [NumberField K] (f : InfinitePlace K → α) :
    ∏ w, f w = (∏ w : {w // IsReal w}, f w.1) * (∏ w : {w // IsComplex w}, f w.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Equiv.prod_comp (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun _ ↦ not_isReal_iff_isComplex))]
  simp [Fintype.prod_subtype_mul_prod_subtype]

name: sum_mult_eq
statement:
theorem sum_mult_eq [NumberField K] :
    ∑ w : InfinitePlace K, mult w = Module.finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Embeddings.card K ℂ, Fintype.card, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, ← Finset.univ.sum_fiberwise
    (fun φ => InfinitePlace.mk φ)]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl
    (fun _ _ => by rw [Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, card_filter_mk_eq])

name: mkReal_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkReal_coe (φ : { φ : K →+* ℂ // ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ }) :
    (mkReal φ : InfinitePlace K) = mk (φ : K →+* ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: mkComplex_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkComplex_coe (φ : { φ : K →+* ℂ // ¬ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ }) :
    (mkComplex φ : InfinitePlace K) = mk (φ : K →+* ℂ)
proof: := rfl

name: prod_eq_abs_norm
statement:
theorem prod_eq_abs_norm (x : K) :
    ∏ w : InfinitePlace K, w x ^ mult w = abs (Algebra.norm ℚ x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  convert! (congr_arg (‖·‖) (Algebra.norm_eq_prod_embeddings ℚ ℂ x)).symm
  · rw [norm_prod, ← Fintype.prod_equiv (RingHom.equivRatAlgHom K ℂ) (fun f => ‖f x‖)
      (fun φ => ‖φ x‖) fun _ => by simp [RingHom.equivRatAlgHom_apply]]
    rw [← Finset.prod_fiberwise Finset.univ mk (fun φ => ‖φ x‖)]
    have (w : InfinitePlace K) (φ) (hφ : φ ∈ ({φ | mk φ = w} : Finset _)) :
        ‖φ x‖ = w x := by rw [← (Finset.mem_filter.mp hφ).2, apply]
    simp_rw [Finset.prod_congr rfl (this _), Finset.prod_const, card_filter_mk_eq]
  · rw [eq_ratCast, Rat.cast_abs, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← Complex.norm_real, Complex.ofReal_ratCast]

name: one_le_of_lt_one
statement:
theorem one_le_of_lt_one {w : InfinitePlace K} {a : (𝓞 K)} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ ⦃z⦄, z ≠ w → z a < 1) : 1 ≤ w a
proof:
:= by
  suffices (1 : ℝ) ≤ |Algebra.norm ℚ (a : K)| by
    contrapose! this
    rw [← InfinitePlace.prod_eq_abs_norm, ← Finset.prod_const_one]
    refine Finset.prod_lt_prod_of_nonempty₀ (fun _ _ ↦ ?_) (fun z _ ↦ ?_) Finset.univ_nonempty
    · exact pow_pos (pos_iff.mpr ((Subalgebra.coe_eq_zero _).not.mpr ha)) _
    · refine pow_lt_one₀ (apply_nonneg _ _) ?_ (by rw [mult]; split_ifs <;> norm_num)
      by_cases hz : z = w
      · rwa [hz]
      · exact h hz
  rw [← Algebra.coe_norm_int, ← Int.cast_one, ← Int.cast_abs, Rat.cast_intCast, Int.cast_le]
  exact Int.one_le_abs (Algebra.norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr ha)

name: _root_.NumberField.is_primitive_element_of_infinitePlace_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [Field.primitive_element_iff_algHom_eq_of_eval ℚ ℂ ?_ _ w.embedding.toRatAlgHom]
  · intro ψ hψ
    have h : 1 ≤ w x := one_le_of_lt_one h₁ h₂
    have main : w = InfinitePlace.mk ψ.toRingHom := by
      simp only [RingHom.toRatAlgHom_apply] at hψ
      rw [← norm_embedding_eq, hψ] at h
      contrapose! h
      exact h₂ h.symm
    rw [(mk_embedding w).symm, mk_eq_iff] at main
    cases h₃ with
    | inl hw =>
      rw [conjugate_embedding_eq_of_isReal hw, or_self] at main
      exact congr_arg RingHom.toRatAlgHom main
    | inr hw =>
      refine congr_arg RingHom.toRatAlgHom (main.resolve_right fun h' ↦ hw.not_ge ?_)
      have : (embedding w x).im = 0 := by
        rw [← Complex.conj_eq_iff_im]
        have := RingHom.congr_fun h' x
        simp only [ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
          RingHom.coe_coe] at this
        rw [this]
        exact hψ.symm
      rwa [← norm_embedding_eq, ← Complex.re_add_im (embedding w x), this, Complex.ofReal_zero,
        zero_mul, add_zero, Complex.norm_real] at h
  · exact fun x ↦ IsAlgClosed.splits _

name: _root_.NumberField.adjoin_eq_top_of_infinitePlace_lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_toSubalgebra_of_isAlgebraic (IsAlgebraic.of_finite ℚ _)]
  exact congr_arg IntermediateField.toSubalgebra <|
    NumberField.is_primitive_element_of_infinitePlace_lt h₁ h₂ h₃

name: card_real_embeddings
statement:
theorem card_real_embeddings :
    card { φ : K →+* ℂ // ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ } = nrRealPlaces K
proof: := Fintype.card_congr mkReal

name: card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces
statement:
theorem card_eq_nrRealPlaces_add_nrComplexPlaces :
    Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K) = nrRealPlaces K + nrComplexPlaces K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  convert!
    Fintype.card_subtype_or_disjoint (IsReal (K := K)) (IsComplex (K := K))
      (disjoint_isReal_isComplex K) using 1
  exact (Fintype.card_of_subtype _ (fun w ↦ ⟨fun _ ↦ isReal_or_isComplex w, fun _ ↦ by simp⟩)).symm

name: card_complex_embeddings
statement:
theorem card_complex_embeddings :
    card { φ : K →+* ℂ // ¬ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ } = 2 * nrComplexPlaces K
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ w : { w : InfinitePlace K // IsComplex w },
     #{φ : {φ //¬ ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ} | mkComplex φ = w} = 2 by
    rw [Fintype.card, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones, ← Finset.sum_fiberwise _ (fun φ => mkComplex φ)]
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_const, this, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Fintype.card, Finset.card_eq_sum_ones,
      Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rintro ⟨w, hw⟩
  convert! card_filter_mk_eq w
  · rw [← Fintype.card_subtype, ← Fintype.card_subtype]
    refine Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective ?_ ⟨fun _ _ h => ?_, fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ => ?_⟩)
    · exact fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ => ⟨φ.val, by rwa [Subtype.ext_iff] at hφ⟩
    · rwa [Subtype.mk_eq_mk, ← Subtype.ext_iff, ← Subtype.ext_iff] at h
    · refine ⟨⟨⟨φ, not_isReal_of_mk_isComplex (hφ.symm ▸ hw)⟩, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
      rwa [Subtype.ext_iff, mkComplex_coe]
  · simp_rw [mult, not_isReal_iff_isComplex.mpr hw, ite_false]

name: card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank
statement:
theorem card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank :
    nrRealPlaces K + 2 * nrComplexPlaces K = finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← card_real_embeddings, ← card_complex_embeddings, Fintype.card_subtype_compl,
    ← Embeddings.card K ℂ, Nat.add_sub_of_le]
  exact Fintype.card_subtype_le _

name: ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_sign
statement:
theorem ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_sign :
    (ComplexEmbedding.involutive_conjugate K).toPerm.sign = (-1) ^ nrComplexPlaces K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.Perm.sign_of_pow_two_eq_one, Embeddings.card, ← card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank,
    ← card_real_embeddings, Fintype.card, Fintype.card, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ zero_lt_two]
  exact Equiv.ext (ComplexEmbedding.involutive_conjugate K).toPerm_involutive

name: nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_of_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_of_finrank_eq_one (h : finrank ℚ K = 1) :
    nrComplexPlaces K = 0
proof: := by linarith [card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K]

name: nrRealPlaces_eq_one_of_finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem nrRealPlaces_eq_one_of_finrank_eq_one (h : finrank ℚ K = 1) :
    nrRealPlaces K = 1
proof:
:= by
  have := card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank K
  rwa [nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_of_finrank_eq_one h, h, mul_zero, add_zero] at this

name: nrRealPlaces_pos_of_odd_finrank
statement:
theorem nrRealPlaces_pos_of_odd_finrank (h : Odd (finrank ℚ K)) :
    0 < nrRealPlaces K
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero ?_
  by_contra hc
  refine (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.mpr ?_) h
  rw [← card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank, hc, zero_add]
  exact even_two_mul (nrComplexPlaces K)

name: nrRealPlaces_eq_zero_of_two_lt
statement:
theorem nrRealPlaces_eq_zero_of_two_lt (hk : 2 < k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ k) :
    NumberField.InfinitePlace.nrRealPlaces K = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (@Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff _ (_)).2 ⟨fun ⟨w, hwreal⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
  rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.isReal_iff] at hwreal
  let f := w.embedding
  have hζ' : IsPrimitiveRoot (f ζ) k := hζ.map_of_injective f.injective
  have him : (f ζ).im = 0 := by
    rw [← Complex.conj_eq_iff_im, ← NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.conjugate_coe_eq]
    congr
  have hre : (f ζ).re = 1 ∨ (f ζ).re = -1 := by
    rw [← Complex.abs_re_eq_norm] at him
    have := Complex.norm_eq_one_of_pow_eq_one hζ'.pow_eq_one (by lia)
    rwa [← him, ← abs_one, abs_eq_abs] at this
  cases hre with
  | inl hone =>
    exact hζ'.ne_one (by lia) <| Complex.ext (by simp [hone]) (by simp [him])
  | inr hnegone =>
    replace hζ' := hζ'.eq_orderOf
    simp only [show f ζ = -1 from Complex.ext (by simp [hnegone]) (by simp [him]),
      orderOf_neg_one, ringChar.eq_zero] at hζ'
    lia

name: infinitePlace_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma infinitePlace_apply (v : InfinitePlace ℚ) (x : ℚ) : v x = |x|
proof:
:= by
  rw [NumberField.InfinitePlace.coe_apply]
  obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := v
  simp

name: isReal_infinitePlace
statement: lemma isReal_infinitePlace : InfinitePlace.IsReal (infinitePlace)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Rat.castHom ℂ, by ext; simp, rfl⟩

name: map_ratCast
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_ratCast (v : InfinitePlace K) (x : ℚ) : v x = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨_, _⟩
  aesop (add simp [coe_apply])

name: map_natCast
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_natCast (v : InfinitePlace K) (n : ℕ) : v n = n
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨_, _⟩
  aesop (add simp [coe_apply])

name: map_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem map_intCast (v : InfinitePlace K) (z : ℤ) : v z = ‖z‖
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with ⟨_, _⟩
  aesop (add simp [coe_apply])

name: eq_one_of_rpow_eq
statement: theorem eq_one_of_rpow_eq {t : ℝ} (h : (w ·) ^ t = v) : t = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_gt (1 : ℕ)
  exact ((n : ℝ).rpow_right_inj (by grind [Nat.cast_pos]) (by aesop)).1 <|
    by simpa using funext_iff.1 h n

name: eq_iff_isEquiv
statement: theorem eq_iff_isEquiv : w = v ↔ w.1.IsEquiv v.1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ .rfl, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨t, _, h⟩ := w.1.isEquiv_iff_exists_rpow_eq.1 h
  exact ext _ _ fun k ↦ by simpa [eq_one_of_rpow_eq h, ext, coe_apply] using funext_iff.1 h k

name: isNontrivial
statement: theorem isNontrivial : v.1.IsNontrivial
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_gt (1 : ℕ)
  exact ⟨n, v.pos_iff.1 <| zero_lt_one.trans (by simpa), by simp [← coe_apply]; grind⟩

name: denseRange_algebraMap_pi
statement:
theorem denseRange_algebraMap_pi [NumberField K] :
    DenseRange <| algebraMap K ((v : InfinitePlace K) → WithAbs v.1)
proof:
:=
  AbsoluteValue.denseRange_algebraMap_pi (fun v ↦ v.isNontrivial)
    fun _ _ h ↦ (eq_iff_isEquiv (K := K)).not.mp h

name: card
statement: theorem card : Fintype.card (K →+* A) = finrank ℚ K
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.ofEquiv_card (RingHom.equivRatAlgHom K A).symm, AlgHom.card]

name: range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly
statement:
theorem range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly :
    (range fun φ : K →+* A => φ x) = (minpoly ℚ x).rootSet A
proof:
:= by
  convert! (NumberField.isAlgebraic K).range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly A x using 1
  ext a
  exact ⟨fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ => ⟨φ.toRatAlgHom, hφ⟩, fun ⟨φ, hφ⟩ => ⟨φ.toRingHom, hφ⟩⟩

name: coeff_bdd_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem coeff_bdd_of_norm_le {B : ℝ} {x : K} (h : ∀ φ : K →+* A, ‖φ x‖ ≤ B) (i : ℕ) :
    ‖(minpoly ℚ x).coeff i‖ ≤ max B 1 ^ finrank ℚ K * (finrank ℚ K).choose (finrank ℚ K / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := Algebra.IsSeparable.isIntegral ℚ x
  rw [← norm_algebraMap' A, ← coeff_map (algebraMap ℚ A)]
  refine coeff_bdd_of_roots_le _ (minpoly.monic hx)
      (IsAlgClosed.splits _) (minpoly.natDegree_le x) (fun z hz => ?_) i
  classical
  rw [← Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hz
  obtain ⟨φ, rfl⟩ := (range_eval_eq_rootSet_minpoly K A x).symm.subset hz
  exact h φ

name: finite_of_norm_le
statement: theorem finite_of_norm_le (B : ℝ) : {x : K | IsIntegral ℤ x ∧ ∀ φ : K →+* A, ‖φ x‖ ≤ B}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C := Nat.ceil (max B 1 ^ finrank ℚ K * (finrank ℚ K).choose (finrank ℚ K / 2))
  have := bUnion_roots_finite (algebraMap ℤ K) (finrank ℚ K) (finite_Icc (-C : ℤ) C)
  refine this.subset fun x hx => ?_; simp_rw [mem_iUnion]
  have h_map_ℚ_minpoly := minpoly.isIntegrallyClosed_eq_field_fractions' ℚ hx.1
  refine ⟨_, ⟨?_, fun i => ?_⟩, mem_rootSet.2 ⟨minpoly.ne_zero hx.1, minpoly.aeval ℤ x⟩⟩
  · rw [← (minpoly.monic hx.1).natDegree_map (algebraMap ℤ ℚ), ← h_map_ℚ_minpoly]
    exact minpoly.natDegree_le x
  rw [mem_Icc, ← abs_le, ← @Int.cast_le ℝ]
  refine (Eq.trans_le ?_ <| coeff_bdd_of_norm_le hx.2 i).trans (Nat.le_ceil _)
  rw [h_map_ℚ_minpoly, coeff_map, eq_intCast, Int.norm_cast_rat, Int.norm_eq_abs, Int.cast_abs]

name: pow_eq_one_of_norm_le_one
statement:
theorem pow_eq_one_of_norm_le_one {x : K} (hx₀ : x ≠ 0) (hxi : IsIntegral ℤ x)
    (hx : ∀ φ : K →+* A, ‖φ x‖ ≤ 1) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n), x ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, -, b, -, habne, h⟩ :=
    Set.Infinite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_mapsTo (f := (x ^ · : ℕ → K)) Set.infinite_univ
      (fun a _ => mem_ofPred.mpr <|
        ⟨hxi.pow a, fun φ => by simp [pow_le_one₀ (norm_nonneg (φ x)) <| hx φ]⟩)
      (finite_of_norm_le K A (1 : ℝ))
  wlog hlt : b < a
  · exact this K A hx₀ hxi hx b a habne.symm h.symm (habne.lt_or_gt.resolve_right hlt)
  refine ⟨a - b, tsub_pos_of_lt hlt, ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_cancel hlt.le, pow_add, mul_left_eq_self₀] at h
  refine h.resolve_right fun hp ↦ hx₀ (eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hp)

name: pow_eq_one_of_norm_eq_one
statement:
theorem pow_eq_one_of_norm_eq_one {x : K} (hxi : IsIntegral ℤ x) (hx : ∀ φ : K →+* A, ‖φ x‖ = 1) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (_ : 0 < n), x ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply pow_eq_one_of_norm_le_one K A _ hxi fun φ ↦ le_of_eq <| hx φ
  intro rfl
  simp_rw [map_zero, norm_zero, zero_ne_one] at hx
  exact hx (IsAlgClosed.lift (R := ℚ)).toRingHom

name: NumberField.place_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem NumberField.place_apply (x : K) : (NumberField.place φ) x = norm (φ x)
proof: := rfl

name: lift_comp_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_comp_algebraMap [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] (φ : k →+* ℂ) :
    (lift K φ).comp (algebraMap k K) = φ
proof:
:= by
  unfold lift
  let := φ.toAlgebra
  rw [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap_of_tower, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra']

name: lift_algebraMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_algebraMap_apply [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] (φ : k →+* ℂ) (x : k) :
    lift K φ (algebraMap k K x) = φ x
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (lift_comp_algebraMap K φ) x

name: conjugate_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_comp (φ : K →+* ℂ) (σ : k →+* K) :
    (conjugate φ).comp σ = conjugate (φ.comp σ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: involutive_conjugate
statement:
theorem involutive_conjugate :
    Function.Involutive (conjugate : (K →+* ℂ) → (K →+* ℂ))
proof:
:= by
  intro; simp

name: conjugate_coe_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem conjugate_coe_eq (φ : K →+* ℂ) (x : K) : (conjugate φ) x = conj (φ x)
proof: := rfl

name: place_conjugate
statement: theorem place_conjugate (φ : K →+* ℂ) : place (conjugate φ) = place φ
proof:
:= by
  ext; simp only [place_apply, norm_conj, conjugate_coe_eq]

name: isReal_iff
statement: theorem isReal_iff {φ : K →+* ℂ} : IsReal φ ↔ conjugate φ = φ
proof: := isSelfAdjoint_iff

name: isReal_conjugate_iff
statement: theorem isReal_conjugate_iff {φ : K →+* ℂ} : IsReal (conjugate φ) ↔ IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  IsSelfAdjoint.star_iff

name: IsReal.coe_embedding_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsReal.coe_embedding_apply {φ : K →+* ℂ} (hφ : IsReal φ) (x : K) :
    (hφ.embedding x : ℂ) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · rfl
  · rw [ofReal_im, eq_comm, ← Complex.conj_eq_iff_im]
    exact RingHom.congr_fun hφ x

name: IsReal.comp
statement:
lemma IsReal.comp (f : k →+* K) {φ : K →+* ℂ} (hφ : IsReal φ) :
    IsReal (φ.comp f)
proof: := by ext1 x; simpa using RingHom.congr_fun hφ (f x)

name: isReal_comp_iff
statement:
lemma isReal_comp_iff {f : k ≃+* K} {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    IsReal (φ.comp (f : k →+* K)) ↔ IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H ↦ by convert! H.comp f.symm.toRingHom; ext1; simp, IsReal.comp _⟩

name: exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
lemma exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq [Algebra k K] [IsGalois k K] (φ ψ : K →+* ℂ)
    (h : φ.comp (algebraMap k K) = ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(K/k), φ.comp σ.symm = ψ
proof:
:= by
  let := (φ.comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
  let := φ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k K ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let ψ' : K →ₐ[k] ℂ := { ψ with commutes' := fun r ↦ (RingHom.congr_fun h r).symm }
  use (AlgHom.restrictNormal' ψ' K).symm
  ext1 x
  exact AlgHom.restrictNormal_commutes ψ' K x

name: IsConj.eq
statement: lemma IsConj.eq (h : IsConj φ σ) (x) : φ (σ x) = star (φ x)
proof: := RingHom.congr_fun h.symm x

name: IsConj.ext
statement: lemma IsConj.ext {σ₁ σ₂ : Gal(K/k)} (h₁ : IsConj φ σ₁) (h₂ : IsConj φ σ₂) : σ₁ = σ₂
proof:
:=
  AlgEquiv.ext fun x ↦ φ.injective ((h₁.eq x).trans (h₂.eq x).symm)

name: IsConj.ext_iff
statement: lemma IsConj.ext_iff {σ₁ σ₂ : Gal(K/k)} (h₁ : IsConj φ σ₁) : σ₁ = σ₂ ↔ IsConj φ σ₂
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e ↦ e ▸ h₁, h₁.ext⟩

name: IsConj.isReal_comp
statement: lemma IsConj.isReal_comp (h : IsConj φ σ) : IsReal (φ.comp (algebraMap k K))
proof:
:= by
  ext1 x
  simp only [conjugate_coe_eq, RingHom.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, ← h.eq,
    starRingEnd_apply, AlgEquiv.commutes]

name: isConj_one_iff
statement: lemma isConj_one_iff : IsConj φ (1 : Gal(K/k)) ↔ IsReal φ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: isConj_ne_one_iff
statement:
lemma isConj_ne_one_iff (hσ : IsConj φ σ) :
    σ ≠ 1 ↔ ¬ IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  not_iff_not.mpr ⟨fun h ↦ isConj_one_iff.mp (h ▸ hσ),
    fun h ↦ (IsConj.ext_iff hσ).mpr h.isConjGal_one⟩

name: IsConj.symm
statement:
lemma IsConj.symm (hσ : IsConj φ σ) :
    IsConj φ σ.symm
proof: := RingHom.ext fun x ↦ by simpa using congr_arg star (hσ.eq (σ.symm x))

name: isConj_symm
statement: lemma isConj_symm : IsConj φ σ.symm ↔ IsConj φ σ
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsConj.symm, IsConj.symm⟩

name: isConj_apply_apply
statement:
lemma isConj_apply_apply (hσ : IsConj φ σ) (x : K) :
    σ (σ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [← φ.injective.eq_iff, hσ.eq]

name: IsConj.comp
statement:
theorem IsConj.comp (hσ : IsConj φ σ) (ν : Gal(K/k)) :
    IsConj (φ.comp ν) (ν⁻¹ * σ * ν)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa [← AlgEquiv.mul_apply, ← mul_assoc] using! RingHom.congr_fun hσ _

name: orderOf_isConj_two_of_ne_one
statement:
lemma orderOf_isConj_two_of_ne_one (hσ : IsConj φ σ) (hσ' : σ ≠ 1) :
    orderOf σ = 2
proof:
:=
  orderOf_eq_prime_iff.mpr ⟨by ext; simpa using isConj_apply_apply hσ _, hσ'⟩

name: LiesOver.over_apply
statement:
theorem LiesOver.over_apply (φ : L →+* ℂ) (ψ : K →+* ℂ) [ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver φ ψ] {x : K} :
    φ (algebraMap K L x) = ψ x
proof: := RingHom.ext_iff.1 (LiesOver.over φ ψ) _

name: liesOver_iff
statement:
theorem liesOver_iff {φ : L →+* ℂ} {ψ : K →+* ℂ} :
    ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver φ ψ ↔ φ.comp (algebraMap K L) = ψ
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ LiesOver.over φ ψ, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩

name: comp_eq
statement: theorem comp_eq : φ.1.comp (algebraMap K L) = ψ
proof: := φ.2.over

name: conjugate_comp_ne
statement: theorem conjugate_comp_ne (h : ¬IsReal ψ) : (conjugate φ).comp (algebraMap K L) ≠ ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp_all [ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff, comp_eq]

name: not_isReal_of_not_isReal
statement: theorem not_isReal_of_not_isReal (h : ¬IsReal ψ) : ¬IsReal φ.1
proof:
:=
  mt (IsReal.comp _) (comp_eq φ ▸ h)

name: IsUnmixed.isReal_iff_isReal
statement:
theorem IsUnmixed.isReal_iff_isReal {φ : L →+* ℂ} (h : IsUnmixed K φ) :
    IsReal (φ.comp (algebraMap K L)) ↔ IsReal φ
proof:
:= by
  aesop (add simp [IsReal.comp])

name: disjoint_unmixedEmbeddingsOver_mixedEmbeddingsOver
statement:
theorem disjoint_unmixedEmbeddingsOver_mixedEmbeddingsOver :
    Disjoint (unmixedEmbeddingsOver L ψ) (mixedEmbeddingsOver L ψ)
proof:
:= by
  grind [mixedEmbeddingsOver, unmixedEmbeddingsOver]

name: union_unmixedEmbeddingsOver_mixedEmbeddingsOver
proof:
:= by
  grind [unmixedEmbeddingsOver, mixedEmbeddingsOver, ← Set.ofPred_or]

name: comap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comap_mk (φ : K →+* ℂ) (f : k →+* K) : (mk φ).comap f = mk (φ.comp f)
proof: := rfl

name: comap_id
statement: lemma comap_id (w : InfinitePlace K) : w.comap (RingHom.id K) = w
proof: := rfl

name: comap_comp
statement:
lemma comap_comp (w : InfinitePlace K) (f : F →+* K) (g : k →+* F) :
    w.comap (f.comp g) = (w.comap f).comap g
proof: := rfl

name: comap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comap_apply (w : InfinitePlace K) (f : k →+* K) (x : k) :
    w.comap f x = w (f x)
proof: := rfl

name: comp_of_comap_eq
statement:
lemma comp_of_comap_eq {v : InfinitePlace k} {w : InfinitePlace K} {f : k →+* K}
    (h : w.comap f = v) (x : k) : w (f x) = v x
proof:
:= by
  simp [← h]

name: coe_mk_comp
statement:
lemma coe_mk_comp {ψ : K →+* ℂ} {f : k →+* K}
    (h : Function.Injective f) : (mk (ψ.comp f)).1 = (mk ψ).1.comp h
proof: := rfl

name: comap_mk_lift
statement:
lemma comap_mk_lift [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] (φ : k →+* ℂ) :
    (mk (ComplexEmbedding.lift K φ)).comap (algebraMap k K) = mk φ
proof: := by simp

name: IsReal.comap
statement:
lemma IsReal.comap (f : k →+* K) {w : InfinitePlace K} (hφ : IsReal w) :
    IsReal (w.comap f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_embedding w, comap_mk, isReal_mk_iff]
  rw [← mk_embedding w, isReal_mk_iff] at hφ
  exact hφ.comp f

name: IsComplex.of_comap
statement:
lemma IsComplex.of_comap (f : k →+* K) {w : InfinitePlace K} (hf : IsComplex (w.comap f)) :
    IsComplex w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_isReal_iff_isComplex] at hf ⊢
  exact (IsReal.comap f).mt hf

name: isReal_comap_iff
statement:
lemma isReal_comap_iff (f : k ≃+* K) {w : InfinitePlace K} :
    IsReal (w.comap (f : k →+* K)) ↔ IsReal w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_embedding w, comap_mk, isReal_mk_iff, isReal_mk_iff, ComplexEmbedding.isReal_comp_iff]

name: comap_surjective
statement:
lemma comap_surjective [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K] :
    Function.Surjective (comap · (algebraMap k K))
proof:
:= fun w ↦
  ⟨(mk (ComplexEmbedding.lift K  w.embedding)), by simp⟩

name: comap_embedding_of_isReal
statement:
theorem comap_embedding_of_isReal (f : k →+* K) {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : (w.comap f).IsReal) :
    (w.comap f).embedding = w.embedding.comp f
proof:
:= by
   rw [← mk_embedding w, comap_mk, mk_embedding, embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal
    (by rwa [← isReal_mk_iff, ← comap_mk, mk_embedding])]

name: mult_comap_le
statement: lemma mult_comap_le (f : k →+* K) (w : InfinitePlace K) : mult (w.comap f) ≤ mult w
proof:
:= by
  rw [mult, mult]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂
  pick_goal 3
  · exact (h₁ (h₂.comap _)).elim
  all_goals decide

name: card_mono
statement:
lemma card_mono [NumberField k] [NumberField K] :
    card (InfinitePlace k) ≤ card (InfinitePlace K)
proof:
:=
  have := Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite ℚ k K
  Fintype.card_le_of_surjective _ comap_surjective

name: smul_eq_comap
statement: lemma smul_eq_comap : σ • w = w.comap σ.symm
proof: := rfl

name: smul_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma smul_apply (x) : (σ • w) x = w (σ.symm x)
proof: := rfl

name: smul_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma smul_mk (φ : K →+* ℂ) : σ • mk φ = mk (φ.comp σ.symm)
proof: := rfl

name: comap_smul
statement: lemma comap_smul {f : F →+* K} : (σ • w).comap f = w.comap (RingHom.comp σ.symm f)
proof: := rfl

name: isReal_smul_iff
statement: lemma isReal_smul_iff : IsReal (σ • w) ↔ IsReal w
proof: := isReal_comap_iff (f := σ.symm.toRingEquiv)

name: isComplex_smul_iff
statement: lemma isComplex_smul_iff : IsComplex (σ • w) ↔ IsComplex w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_isReal_iff_isComplex, ← not_isReal_iff_isComplex, isReal_smul_iff]

name: ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
statement:
lemma ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq [IsGalois k K] (φ ψ : K →+* ℂ)
    (h : φ.comp (algebraMap k K) = ψ.comp (algebraMap k K)) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(K/k), φ.comp σ.symm = ψ
proof:
:=
  NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq φ ψ h

name: exists_smul_eq_of_comap_eq
statement:
lemma exists_smul_eq_of_comap_eq [IsGalois k K] {w w' : InfinitePlace K}
    (h : w.comap (algebraMap k K) = w'.comap (algebraMap k K)) : ∃ σ : Gal(K/k), σ • w = w'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_embedding w, ← mk_embedding w', comap_mk, comap_mk, mk_eq_iff] at h
  cases h with
  | inl h =>
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq w.embedding w'.embedding h
    use σ
    rw [← mk_embedding w, ← mk_embedding w', smul_mk, hσ]
  | inr h =>
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ComplexEmbedding.exists_comp_symm_eq_of_comp_eq
      ((starRingEnd ℂ).comp (embedding w)) w'.embedding h
    use σ
    rw [← mk_embedding w, ← mk_embedding w', smul_mk, mk_eq_iff]
    exact Or.inr hσ

name: mem_orbit_iff
statement:
lemma mem_orbit_iff [IsGalois k K] {w w' : InfinitePlace K} :
    w' ∈ MulAction.orbit Gal(K/k) w ↔ w.comap (algebraMap k K) = w'.comap (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, exists_smul_eq_of_comap_eq⟩
  rintro ⟨σ, rfl : σ • w = w'⟩
  rw [← mk_embedding w, comap_mk, smul_mk, comap_mk]
  congr 1; ext1; simp

name: orbitRelEquiv_apply_mk''
statement:
lemma orbitRelEquiv_apply_mk'' [IsGalois k K] (w : InfinitePlace K) :
    orbitRelEquiv (Quotient.mk'' w) = comap w (algebraMap k K)
proof: := rfl

name: isUnramified_or_isRamified
statement: lemma isUnramified_or_isRamified : w.IsUnramified k ∨ w.IsRamified k
proof:
:=
  or_not

name: isUnramified_self
statement: lemma isUnramified_self : IsUnramified K w
proof: := rfl

name: IsUnramified.eq
statement: lemma IsUnramified.eq (h : IsUnramified k w) : mult (w.comap (algebraMap k K)) = mult w

name: isUnramified_iff_mult_le
statement:
lemma isUnramified_iff_mult_le :
    IsUnramified k w ↔ mult w ≤ mult (w.comap (algebraMap k K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsUnramified, le_antisymm_iff, and_iff_right]
  exact mult_comap_le _ _

name: IsUnramified.comap_algHom
statement:
lemma IsUnramified.comap_algHom {w : InfinitePlace F} (h : IsUnramified k w) (f : K →ₐ[k] F) :
    IsUnramified k (w.comap (f : K →+* F))
proof:
:= by
  rw [InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff_mult_le, ← InfinitePlace.comap_comp, f.comp_algebraMap, h.eq]
  exact InfinitePlace.mult_comap_le _ _

name: IsUnramified.of_restrictScalars
statement:
lemma IsUnramified.of_restrictScalars {w : InfinitePlace F} (h : IsUnramified k w) :
    IsUnramified K w
proof:
:= by
  rw [InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff_mult_le, ← h.eq, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k K F,
    InfinitePlace.comap_comp]
  exact InfinitePlace.mult_comap_le _ _

name: IsUnramified.comap
statement:
lemma IsUnramified.comap {w : InfinitePlace F} (h : IsUnramified k w) :
    IsUnramified k (w.comap (algebraMap K F))
proof:
:=
  h.comap_algHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K F)

name: not_isUnramified_iff
statement:
lemma not_isUnramified_iff :
    ¬ IsUnramified k w ↔ IsComplex w ∧ IsReal (w.comap (algebraMap k K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsUnramified, mult, mult, ← not_isReal_iff_isComplex]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂ h₂ <;>
    simp only [not_true_eq_false, false_iff, and_self, forall_true_left, IsEmpty.forall_iff,
      not_and, OfNat.one_ne_ofNat, not_false_eq_true, true_iff, OfNat.ofNat_ne_one, h₁, h₂]
  exact h₁ (h₂.comap _)

name: isUnramified_iff
statement:
lemma isUnramified_iff :
    IsUnramified k w ↔ IsReal w ∨ IsComplex (w.comap (algebraMap k K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_iff_not, not_isUnramified_iff, not_or,
    not_isReal_iff_isComplex, not_isComplex_iff_isReal]

name: isRamified_iff
statement: theorem isRamified_iff : w.IsRamified k ↔ w.IsComplex ∧ (w.comap (algebraMap k K)).IsReal
proof:
:=
  not_isUnramified_iff

name: IsRamified.isComplex
statement: theorem IsRamified.isComplex (h : w.IsRamified k) : w.IsComplex
proof: := (isRamified_iff.1 h).1

name: IsRamified.isReal
statement: theorem IsRamified.isReal (h : w.IsRamified k) : (w.comap (algebraMap k K)).IsReal
proof:
:=
  (isRamified_iff.1 h).2

name: IsRamified.ne_conjugate
statement:
theorem IsRamified.ne_conjugate {w₁ w₂ : InfinitePlace K} (h : w₂.IsRamified k) :
    w₁.embedding ≠ ComplexEmbedding.conjugate w₂.embedding
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h_eq : w₁ = w₂
  · rw [isRamified_iff, isComplex_iff] at h
    exact Ne.symm (h_eq ▸ h.1)
  · contrapose h_eq
    rw [← mk_embedding w₁, h_eq, mk_conjugate_eq, mk_embedding]

name: IsRamified.comap_embedding
statement:
lemma IsRamified.comap_embedding {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsRamified k) :
    (w.comap (algebraMap k K)).embedding = w.embedding.comp (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_embedding_of_isReal _ (isRamified_iff.1 h).2]

name: IsRamified.comap_embedding_conjugate
statement:
lemma IsRamified.comap_embedding_conjugate {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsRamified k) :
    (w.comap (algebraMap k K)).embedding = (conjugate w.embedding).comp (algebraMap k K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.1 <| isReal_iff.1 ((isRamified_iff.1 h).2)]
  simp [conjugate_comp, comap_embedding_of_isReal _ ((isRamified_iff.1 h).2)]

name: IsRamified.isMixed_embedding
statement:
lemma IsRamified.isMixed_embedding {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsRamified k) :
    IsMixed k w.embedding
proof:
:=
  ⟨comap_embedding_of_isReal _ h.isReal ▸ isReal_iff.1 h.isReal, isComplex_iff.1 h.isComplex⟩

name: IsRamified.isMixed_conjugate_embedding
statement:
lemma IsRamified.isMixed_conjugate_embedding {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsRamified k) :
    IsMixed k (conjugate w.embedding)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.comap_embedding_conjugate ▸ isReal_iff.1 h.isReal,
    by simpa using isComplex_iff.1 <| h.isComplex⟩

name: isRamified_mk_iff_isMixed
statement:
theorem isRamified_mk_iff_isMixed {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    (mk φ).IsRamified k ↔ IsMixed k φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases embedding_mk_eq φ with (hl | hr)
    · exact hl ▸ h.isMixed_embedding
    · rw [← star_star φ]; simpa [← congrArg conjugate hr] using h.isMixed_conjugate_embedding
  · rw [isRamified_iff, isComplex_iff, comap_mk, isReal_iff, embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal h.1]
    exact ⟨by rcases embedding_mk_eq φ with (_ | _) <;> aesop, h.1⟩

name: IsUnramified.isUnmixed
statement:
lemma IsUnramified.isUnmixed {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsUnramified k) :
    IsUnmixed k w.embedding
proof:
:= by
  intro hw
  rw [← isReal_mk_iff, ← comap_mk, mk_embedding] at hw
  exact isReal_iff.1 <| (isUnramified_iff.1 h).resolve_right (not_isComplex_iff_isReal.2 hw)

name: IsUnramified.isUnmixed_conjugate
statement:
lemma IsUnramified.isUnmixed_conjugate {w : InfinitePlace K} (h : w.IsUnramified k) :
    IsUnmixed k (conjugate w.embedding)
proof:
:= by
  intro hw
  simp_rw [conjugate_comp, IsSelfAdjoint.star_iff, ← isReal_mk_iff, ← comap_mk, mk_embedding] at hw
  simpa using isReal_iff.1 <| (isUnramified_iff.1 h).resolve_right (not_isComplex_iff_isReal.2 hw)

name: isUnramified_mk_iff_isUnmixed
statement:
theorem isUnramified_mk_iff_isUnmixed {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    (mk φ).IsUnramified k ↔ IsUnmixed k φ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  · rcases embedding_mk_eq φ with (hl | hr)
    · exact hl ▸ h.isUnmixed
    · rw [← star_star φ]; simpa [← congrArg conjugate hr] using h.isUnmixed_conjugate
  · rw [isUnramified_iff, isReal_iff]
    by_cases hv : ComplexEmbedding.IsReal (φ.comp (algebraMap k K))
    · exact .inl <| by simp [embedding_mk_eq_of_isReal, h hv]
    · exact .inr <| by simpa using (isReal_mk_iff.not.2 hv)

name: IsReal.isUnramified
statement: lemma IsReal.isUnramified (h : IsReal w) : IsUnramified k w
proof: := isUnramified_iff.mpr (Or.inl h)

name: _root_.NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsConj.isUnramified_mk_iff
statement:
lemma _root_.NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsConj.isUnramified_mk_iff
    {φ : K →+* ℂ} (h : ComplexEmbedding.IsConj φ σ) :
    IsUnramified k (mk φ) ↔ σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.ext_iff, ComplexEmbedding.isConj_one_iff, ← not_iff_not, not_isUnramified_iff,
    ← not_isReal_iff_isComplex, comap_mk, isReal_mk_iff, isReal_mk_iff, eq_true h.isReal_comp,
    and_true]

name: isUnramified_mk_iff_forall_isConj
statement:
lemma isUnramified_mk_iff_forall_isConj [IsGalois k K] {φ : K →+* ℂ} :
    IsUnramified k (mk φ) ↔ ∀ σ : Gal(K/k), ComplexEmbedding.IsConj φ σ → σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H σ hσ ↦ hσ.isUnramified_mk_iff.mp H,
    fun H ↦ ?_⟩
  by_contra hφ
  rw [not_isUnramified_iff] at hφ
  rw [comap_mk, isReal_mk_iff, ← not_isReal_iff_isComplex, isReal_mk_iff,
    ← ComplexEmbedding.isConj_one_iff (k := k)] at hφ
  let := (φ.comp (algebraMap k K)).toAlgebra
  let := φ.toAlgebra
  have : IsScalarTower k K ℂ := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  let φ' : K →ₐ[k] ℂ := { star φ with
    commutes' := fun r ↦ by simpa using! RingHom.congr_fun hφ.2 r }
  have : ComplexEmbedding.IsConj φ (AlgHom.restrictNormal' φ' K) :=
    (RingHom.ext <| AlgHom.restrictNormal_commutes φ' K).symm
  exact hφ.1 (H _ this ▸ this)

name: mem_stabilizer_mk_iff
statement:
lemma mem_stabilizer_mk_iff (φ : K →+* ℂ) (σ : Gal(K/k)) :
    σ ∈ Stab (mk φ) ↔ σ = 1 ∨ ComplexEmbedding.IsConj φ σ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, smul_mk, mk_eq_iff]
  rw [← ComplexEmbedding.isConj_symm, ComplexEmbedding.conjugate, star_eq_iff_star_eq]
  refine or_congr ⟨fun H ↦ ?_, fun H ↦ H ▸ rfl⟩ Iff.rfl
  exact congr_arg AlgEquiv.symm
    (AlgEquiv.ext (g := AlgEquiv.refl) fun x ↦ φ.injective (RingHom.congr_fun H x))

name: IsUnramified.stabilizer_eq_bot
statement: lemma IsUnramified.stabilizer_eq_bot (h : IsUnramified k w) : Stab w = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_bot_iff, ← mk_embedding w, SetLike.le_def]
  simp only [mem_stabilizer_mk_iff, Subgroup.mem_bot, forall_eq_or_imp, true_and]
  exact fun σ hσ ↦ hσ.isUnramified_mk_iff.mp ((mk_embedding w).symm ▸ h)

name: _root_.NumberField.ComplexEmbedding.IsConj.coe_stabilizer_mk
proof:
:= by
  ext
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_stabilizer_mk_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
    ← h.ext_iff, eq_comm (a := σ)]

name: nat_card_stabilizer_eq_one_or_two
statement:
lemma nat_card_stabilizer_eq_one_or_two :
    Nat.card (Stab w) = 1 ∨ Nat.card (Stab w) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← SetLike.coe_sort_coe, ← mk_embedding w]
  by_cases! h : ∃ σ, ComplexEmbedding.IsConj (k := k) (embedding w) σ
  · obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := h
    rw [hσ.coe_stabilizer_mk]
    simp
  · left
    trans Nat.card ({1} : Set Gal(K/k))
    · congr with x
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_stabilizer_mk_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, or_iff_left_iff_imp,
        h x, IsEmpty.forall_iff]
    · simp

name: isUnramified_iff_stabilizer_eq_bot
statement: lemma isUnramified_iff_stabilizer_eq_bot [IsGalois k K] : IsUnramified k w ↔ Stab w = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_embedding w, isUnramified_mk_iff_forall_isConj]
  simp only [eq_bot_iff, SetLike.le_def, mem_stabilizer_mk_iff,
    Subgroup.mem_bot, forall_eq_or_imp, true_and]

name: isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_one
statement:
lemma isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_one [IsGalois k K] :
    IsUnramified k w ↔ Nat.card (Stab w) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnramified_iff_stabilizer_eq_bot, Subgroup.card_eq_one]

name: not_isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two
statement:
lemma not_isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two [IsGalois k K] :
    ¬ IsUnramified k w ↔ Nat.card (Stab w) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_one]
  obtain (e | e) := nat_card_stabilizer_eq_one_or_two k w <;> rw [e] <;> decide

name: isRamified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two
statement:
lemma isRamified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two [IsGalois k K] :
    IsRamified k w ↔ Nat.card (Stab w) = 2
proof:
:=
  not_isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two

name: exists_isConj_of_isRamified
statement:
lemma exists_isConj_of_isRamified [IsGalois k K] {φ : K →+* ℂ} (h : IsRamified k (mk φ)) :
    ∃ σ : Gal(K/k), ComplexEmbedding.IsConj φ σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [isRamified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two, Nat.card_eq_two_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩, h₁, -⟩ := h
  rw [mem_stabilizer_mk_iff] at hx hy
  grind

name: card_stabilizer
statement:
lemma card_stabilizer [IsGalois k K] :
    Nat.card (Stab w) = if IsUnramified k w then 1 else 2
proof:
:= by
  split
  · rwa [← isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_one]
  · rwa [← not_isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two]

name: even_nat_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified
statement:
lemma even_nat_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified [IsGalois k K] (hw : ¬ IsUnramified k w) :
    Even (Nat.card Gal(K/k))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases H : Finite Gal(K/k)
  · cases nonempty_fintype Gal(K/k)
    rw [even_iff_two_dvd, ← not_isUnramified_iff_card_stabilizer_eq_two.mp hw]
    exact Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card (Stab w)
  · convert! Even.zero
    by_contra e
    exact H (Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero e)

name: even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified
statement:
lemma even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified [IsGalois k K] (hw : ¬ IsUnramified k w) :
    Even (Nat.card Gal(K/k))
proof:
:=
  even_nat_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified hw

name: even_finrank_of_not_isUnramified
statement:
lemma even_finrank_of_not_isUnramified [IsGalois k K]
    (hw : ¬ IsUnramified k w) : Even (finrank k K)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases FiniteDimensional k K
  · exact IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank k K ▸ even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified hw
  · exact finrank_of_not_finite ‹_› ▸ Even.zero

name: isUnramified_smul_iff
statement:
lemma isUnramified_smul_iff :
    IsUnramified k (σ • w) ↔ IsUnramified k w
proof:
:= by
  rw [isUnramified_iff, isUnramified_iff, isReal_smul_iff, comap_smul,
    ← AlgEquiv.toAlgHom_toRingHom, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap]

name: isUnramifiedIn_comap
statement:
lemma isUnramifiedIn_comap [IsGalois k K] {w : InfinitePlace K} :
    (w.comap (algebraMap k K)).IsUnramifiedIn K ↔ w.IsUnramified k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H ↦ H _ rfl, fun H v hv ↦ ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ := exists_smul_eq_of_comap_eq hv
  rwa [isUnramified_smul_iff] at H

name: even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramifiedIn
statement:
lemma even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramifiedIn [IsGalois k K]
    {w : InfinitePlace k} (hw : ¬ w.IsUnramifiedIn K) :
    Even (Nat.card Gal(K/k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := comap_surjective (K := K) w
  rw [isUnramifiedIn_comap] at hw
  exact even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified hw

name: even_finrank_of_not_isUnramifiedIn
statement:
lemma even_finrank_of_not_isUnramifiedIn
    [IsGalois k K] {w : InfinitePlace k} (hw : ¬ w.IsUnramifiedIn K) :
    Even (finrank k K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := comap_surjective (K := K) w
  rw [isUnramifiedIn_comap] at hw
  exact even_finrank_of_not_isUnramified hw

name: card_isUnramified
statement:
lemma card_isUnramified [NumberField k] [IsGalois k K] :
    #{w : InfinitePlace K | w.IsUnramified k} =
      #{w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K} * finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank,
    Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := (comap · (algebraMap k K)))
    (t := {w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K}), ← smul_eq_mul, ← sum_const]
  · refine sum_congr rfl (fun w hw ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := comap_surjective (K := K) w
    rw [mem_filter_univ] at hw
    trans #(MulAction.orbit Gal(K/k) w).toFinset
    · congr; ext w'
      rw [mem_filter, mem_filter_univ, Set.mem_toFinset, mem_orbit_iff, @eq_comm _ (comap w' _),
        and_iff_right_iff_imp]
      intro e; rwa [← isUnramifiedIn_comap, ← e]
    · rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
        ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group _ w,
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab w), card_stabilizer, ite_eq_left,
        mul_one, Set.toFinset_card]
      rwa [← isUnramifiedIn_comap]
  · simp [Set.MapsTo, isUnramifiedIn_comap]

name: card_isUnramified_compl
statement:
lemma card_isUnramified_compl [NumberField k] [IsGalois k K] :
    #({w : InfinitePlace K | w.IsUnramified k} : Finset _)ᶜ =
      #({w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K} : Finset _)ᶜ * (finrank k K / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank,
    Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := (comap · (algebraMap k K)))
    (t := ({w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K} : Finset _)ᶜ), ← smul_eq_mul, ← sum_const]
  · refine sum_congr rfl (fun w hw ↦ ?_)
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := comap_surjective (K := K) w
    rw [compl_filter, mem_filter_univ] at hw
    trans Finset.card (MulAction.orbit Gal(K/k) w).toFinset
    · congr; ext w'
      rw [mem_filter, compl_filter, mem_filter_univ, @eq_comm _ (comap w' _), Set.mem_toFinset,
        mem_orbit_iff, and_iff_right_iff_imp]
      intro e; rwa [← isUnramifiedIn_comap, ← e]
    · rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
        ← MulAction.card_orbit_mul_card_stabilizer_eq_card_group _ w,
        ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card (α := Stab w), InfinitePlace.card_stabilizer, ite_eq_right,
        Nat.mul_div_cancel _ zero_lt_two, Set.toFinset_card]
      rwa [← isUnramifiedIn_comap]
  · simp [Set.MapsTo, isUnramifiedIn_comap]

name: card_eq_card_isUnramifiedIn
statement:
lemma card_eq_card_isUnramifiedIn [NumberField k] [IsGalois k K] :
    Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K) =
      #{w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K} * finrank k K +
      #({w : InfinitePlace k | w.IsUnramifiedIn K} : Finset _)ᶜ * (finrank k K / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_isUnramified, ← card_isUnramified_compl, Finset.card_add_card_compl]

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.trans
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.trans
    [h₁ : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K] [h₂ : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces K F] :
    IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k F where
  isUnramified w
proof:
:=
    Eq.trans (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k K F ▸ h₁.1 (w.comap (algebraMap _ _))) (h₂.1 w)

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.top
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.top [h : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k F] :
    IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces K F where
  isUnramified w
proof: := (h.1 w).of_restrictScalars K

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.bot
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.bot [h₁ : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k F]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K F] :
    IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K where
  isUnramified w
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := InfinitePlace.comap_surjective (K := F) w
    exact (h₁.1 w).comap K

name: NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramified
statement:
lemma NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramified [IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K]
    (w : InfinitePlace K) : IsUnramified k w
proof: := IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.isUnramified w

name: NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramifiedIn
statement:
lemma NumberField.InfinitePlace.isUnramifiedIn [IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K]
    (w : InfinitePlace k) : IsUnramifiedIn K w
proof: := fun v _ ↦ v.isUnramified k

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces_of_odd_card_aut
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces_of_odd_card_aut [IsGalois k K]
    (h : Odd (Nat.card Gal(K/k))) : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ not_not.mp (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 h ∘ InfinitePlace.even_card_aut_of_not_isUnramified)⟩

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces_of_odd_finrank
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces_of_odd_finrank [IsGalois k K]
    (h : Odd (Module.finrank k K)) : IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ not_not.mp (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 h ∘ InfinitePlace.even_finrank_of_not_isUnramified)⟩

name: IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.card_infinitePlace
statement:
lemma IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces.card_infinitePlace [NumberField k] [NumberField K]
    [IsGalois k K] [IsUnramifiedAtInfinitePlaces k K] :
    Fintype.card (InfinitePlace K) = Fintype.card (InfinitePlace k) * finrank k K
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [InfinitePlace.card_eq_card_isUnramifiedIn (k := k) (K := K), Finset.filter_true_of_mem,
    Finset.card_univ, Finset.card_eq_zero.mpr, zero_mul, add_zero]
  · exact Finset.compl_univ
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, forall_true_left]
  exact InfinitePlace.isUnramifiedIn K

name: comap_eq
statement: theorem comap_eq : w.comap (algebraMap K L) = v
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simpa only [coe_apply] using! AbsoluteValue.ext_iff.1 (LiesOver.under_eq w.1 v.1) _

name: mk_embedding_comp
statement: theorem mk_embedding_comp : InfinitePlace.mk (w.embedding.comp (algebraMap K L)) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comap_mk, w.mk_embedding, comap_eq w v]

name: embedding_comp_eq_or_conjugate_embedding_comp_eq
statement:
theorem embedding_comp_eq_or_conjugate_embedding_comp_eq :
    w.embedding.comp (algebraMap K L) = v.embedding ∨
      (conjugate w.embedding).comp (algebraMap K L) = v.embedding
proof:
:= by
  cases embedding_mk_eq (w.embedding.comp (algebraMap K L)) with
  | inl hl => exact .inl (hl ▸ congrArg embedding (mk_embedding_comp w v))
  | inr hr => simpa using .inr (hr ▸ congrArg embedding (mk_embedding_comp w v))

name: isComplex_of_isComplex_under
statement: theorem isComplex_of_isComplex_under (hv : v.IsComplex) : w.IsComplex
proof:
:= by
  rw [isComplex_iff, ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff, RingHom.ext_iff, not_forall] at hv ⊢
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hv
  use algebraMap K L x
  rw [← comap_eq w v, ← mk_embedding w, comap_mk] at hx
  rcases embedding_mk_eq (w.embedding.comp (algebraMap K L)) with (_ | _) <;> aesop

name: isReal_of_isReal_over
statement: theorem isReal_of_isReal_over (hw : w.IsReal) : v.IsReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_isComplex_iff_isReal] at hw ⊢
  exact mt (isComplex_of_isComplex_under w) hw

name: IsRamified.liesOver_isReal_under
statement:
theorem IsRamified.liesOver_isReal_under (hw : w.IsRamified K) :
    v.IsReal
proof: := LiesOver.comap_eq w v ▸ (isRamified_iff.1 hw).2

name: IsUnramified.liesOver_isReal_over
statement: theorem IsUnramified.liesOver_isReal_over (hw : w.IsUnramified K) (hv : v.IsReal) : w.IsReal
proof:
:=
  (InfinitePlace.isUnramified_iff.1 hw).resolve_right
    (by simpa [LiesOver.comap_eq w v] using not_isComplex_iff_isReal.2 hv)

name: mk_mem_unramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem mk_mem_unramifiedPlacesOver {φ : L →+* ℂ} (h : φ ∈ unmixedEmbeddingsOver L (v.embedding)) :
    mk φ ∈ unramifiedPlacesOver L v
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨have := h.1; mk_embedding v ▸ LiesOver.under_eq (mk φ).1 (mk v.embedding).1⟩,
    h.2.mk_isUnramified⟩

name: liesOver_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem liesOver_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver (hw : w ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v) :
    ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver w.embedding v.embedding where
  over
proof: := have := hw.1; hw.2.comap_embedding ▸ congrArg embedding (LiesOver.comap_eq w v)

name: liesOver_conjugate_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem liesOver_conjugate_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver
    (hw : w ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v) :
    ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver (conjugate w.embedding) v.embedding where
  over
proof: := have := hw.1; hw.2.comap_embedding_conjugate ▸ congrArg embedding (LiesOver.comap_eq w v)

name: mk_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem mk_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver {φ : L →+* ℂ} (h : φ ∈ mixedEmbeddingsOver L (v.embedding)) :
    mk φ ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨have := h.1; mk_embedding v ▸ LiesOver.under_eq (mk φ).1 (mk v.embedding).1⟩, h.2.mk_isRamified⟩

name: embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver
statement:
theorem embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver (hw : w ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v) :
    w.embedding ∈ mixedEmbeddingsOver L (v.embedding)
proof:
:=
  ⟨liesOver_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver hw, hw.2.isMixed_embedding⟩

name: conjugate_embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver
statement:
theorem conjugate_embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver (hw : w ∈ ramifiedPlacesOver L v) :
    conjugate w.embedding ∈ mixedEmbeddingsOver L (v.embedding)
proof:
:=
  ⟨liesOver_conjugate_embedding_of_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver hw, hw.2.isMixed_conjugate_embedding⟩

name: disjoint_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem disjoint_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver :
    Disjoint (ramifiedPlacesOver L v) (unramifiedPlacesOver L v)
proof:
:= by
  grind [ramifiedPlacesOver, unramifiedPlacesOver]

name: union_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver
statement:
theorem union_ramifiedPlacesOver_unramifiedPlacesOver :
    (ramifiedPlacesOver L v) ∪ (unramifiedPlacesOver L v) = placesOver L v
proof:
:= by
  rw [placesOver, ramifiedPlacesOver, unramifiedPlacesOver, ← Set.ofPred_or]
  grind

name: bijOn_sumElim_conjugate
statement:
theorem bijOn_sumElim_conjugate :
    (Set.sumEquiv.symm (ramifiedPlacesOver L v, ramifiedPlacesOver L v)).BijOn
      (Sum.elim embedding (conjugate ∘ embedding)) (mixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding)
proof:
:=
  ⟨.sumElim embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver conjugate_embedding_mem_mixedEmbeddingsOver,
    (embedding_injective L).injOn.sumElim (star_injective.comp (embedding_injective L)).injOn
      (fun _ _ _ h ↦ h.2.ne_conjugate), fun ψ h ↦ by cases embedding_mk_eq ψ with
        | inl hl => simpa using .inl ⟨mk ψ, mk_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver h, hl⟩
        | inr hr => simpa using .inr ⟨mk ψ, mk_mem_ramifiedPlacesOver h, by aesop⟩⟩

name: ramifiedPlacesOver_ncard
statement:
theorem ramifiedPlacesOver_ncard :
    2 * (ramifiedPlacesOver L v).ncard = (mixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (bijOn_sumElim_conjugate L v).ncard_eq, two_mul, Set.ncard_sumEquiv_symm_apply]

name: embeddingConjugateIte_pos
statement:
private theorem embeddingConjugateIte_pos (h : ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver w.embedding v.embedding) :
    embeddingConjugateIte v w = w.embedding
proof: := by simp [embeddingConjugateIte, h]

name: embeddingConjugateIte_neg
statement:
private theorem embeddingConjugateIte_neg (h : ¬ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver w.embedding v.embedding) :
    embeddingConjugateIte v w = conjugate w.embedding
proof: := by simp [embeddingConjugateIte, h]

name: mapsTo_embeddingConjugateIte
statement:
private theorem mapsTo_embeddingConjugateIte : (unramifiedPlacesOver L v).MapsTo
    (embeddingConjugateIte v) (unmixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding)
proof:
:= by
  rintro w ⟨_, hw⟩
  by_cases h : ComplexEmbedding.LiesOver w.embedding v.embedding
  · simpa [embeddingConjugateIte_pos h] using ⟨h, hw.isUnmixed⟩
  · simpa [embeddingConjugateIte_neg h] using
      ⟨⟨(LiesOver.embedding_comp_eq_or_conjugate_embedding_comp_eq w v).resolve_left
        (liesOver_iff.not.1 h)⟩, hw.isUnmixed_conjugate⟩

name: surjOn_embeddingConjugateIte
statement:
private theorem surjOn_embeddingConjugateIte : (unramifiedPlacesOver L v).SurjOn
    (embeddingConjugateIte v) (unmixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding)
proof:
:= by
  refine fun ψ h ↦ ⟨mk ψ, mk_mem_unramifiedPlacesOver h, ?_⟩
  rcases embedding_mk_eq ψ with (_ | hψ)
  · aesop (add simp [embeddingConjugateIte, unmixedEmbeddingsOver])
  · simpa [embeddingConjugateIte, hψ] using fun ⟨_⟩ ↦
      h.2.isReal_iff_isReal.1 <| by have := h.1.over; aesop

name: bijOn_extensionIte
statement:
private theorem bijOn_extensionIte : (unramifiedPlacesOver L v).BijOn (embeddingConjugateIte v)
    (unmixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding)
proof:
:=
  ⟨mapsTo_embeddingConjugateIte L v, ((embedding_injective _).ite (star_injective.comp
    (embedding_injective _)) (fun _ _ ↦ eq_of_embedding_eq_conjugate L)).injOn,
      surjOn_embeddingConjugateIte L v⟩

name: unramifiedPlacesOver_ncard
statement:
theorem unramifiedPlacesOver_ncard :
    (unramifiedPlacesOver L v).ncard = (unmixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding).ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [(bijOn_extensionIte L v).ncard_eq]

name: unramifedPlacesOver_ncard_add_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem unramifedPlacesOver_ncard_add_eq_finrank [NumberField K] [NumberField L] :
    (unramifiedPlacesOver L v).ncard + 2 * (ramifiedPlacesOver L v).ncard = Module.finrank K L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Algebra K ℂ := v.embedding.toAlgebra
  rw [← AlgHom.card K L ℂ, ramifiedPlacesOver_ncard, unramifiedPlacesOver_ncard,
    ← Set.ncard_union_eq (disjoint_unmixedEmbeddingsOver_mixedEmbeddingsOver L v.embedding),
    union_unmixedEmbeddingsOver_mixedEmbeddingsOver, Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
  apply (card_nbij AlgHom.toRingHom (fun σ _ ↦ by simpa using ⟨by aesop⟩)
    AlgHom.coe_ringHom_injective.injOn (fun ψ hψ ↦ ?_)).symm
  simp only [Set.Finite.toFinset_ofPred, coe_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hψ
  exact ⟨⟨ψ, fun _ ↦ by simp [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, ← hψ.over]⟩, by simp⟩

name: nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_iff [NumberField K] :
    nrComplexPlaces K = 0 ↔ IsTotallyReal K
proof:
:= by
  simp [Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff, isEmpty_subtype, isTotallyReal_iff]

name: IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal
statement:
theorem IsTotallyReal.complexEmbedding_isReal [IsTotallyReal K] (φ : K →+* ℂ) :
    ComplexEmbedding.IsReal φ
proof:
:=
  isReal_mk_iff.mp <| isReal (InfinitePlace.mk φ)

name: IsTotallyReal.mult_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsTotallyReal.mult_eq [IsTotallyReal K] (w : InfinitePlace K) : mult w = 1
proof:
:=
  mult_isReal ⟨w, isReal w⟩

name: IsTotallyReal.ofRingEquiv
statement:
theorem IsTotallyReal.ofRingEquiv [IsTotallyReal F] (f : F ≃+* K) : IsTotallyReal K where
  isReal _
proof: := (isReal_comap_iff f).mp <| IsTotallyReal.isReal _

name: IsTotallyReal.of_algebra
statement:
theorem IsTotallyReal.of_algebra [IsTotallyReal K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] :
    IsTotallyReal F where
  isReal w
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨W, rfl⟩ : ∃ W : InfinitePlace K, W.comap (algebraMap F K) = w := comap_surjective w
    exact IsReal.comap _ (IsTotallyReal.isReal W)

name: isTotallyReal_iff_ofRingEquiv
statement: theorem isTotallyReal_iff_ofRingEquiv (f : F ≃+* K) : IsTotallyReal F ↔ IsTotallyReal K
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ ↦ .ofRingEquiv f, fun _ ↦ .ofRingEquiv f.symm⟩

name: isTotallyReal_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isTotallyReal_top_iff : IsTotallyReal (⊤ : Subfield K) ↔ IsTotallyReal K
proof:
:=
  isTotallyReal_iff_ofRingEquiv Subfield.topEquiv

name: IsTotallyReal.nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsTotallyReal.nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero [NumberField K] [h : IsTotallyReal K] :
    nrComplexPlaces K = 0
proof:
:=
  nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_iff.mpr h

name: IsTotallyReal.finrank
statement:
protected theorem IsTotallyReal.finrank [NumberField K] [h : IsTotallyReal K] :
    finrank ℚ K = nrRealPlaces K
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_add_two_mul_card_eq_rank, nrComplexPlaces_eq_zero_iff.mpr h, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: mem_maximalRealSubfield_iff
statement:
theorem mem_maximalRealSubfield_iff (x : K) :
    x ∈ maximalRealSubfield K ↔ ∀ φ : K →+* ℂ, star (φ x) = φ x
proof: := .rfl

name: IsTotallyReal.le_maximalRealSubfield
statement:
theorem IsTotallyReal.le_maximalRealSubfield (E : Subfield K) [IsTotallyReal E] :
    E ≤ maximalRealSubfield K
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx φ
  rw [show φ x = (φ.comp E.subtype) ⟨x, hx⟩ by simp, RCLike.star_def, ← conjugate_coe_eq]
  refine RingHom.congr_fun ?_ _
  exact ComplexEmbedding.isReal_iff.mp <| isReal_mk_iff.mp <| isReal _

name: IsTotallyReal.maximalRealSubfield_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsTotallyReal.maximalRealSubfield_eq_top [IsTotallyReal K] :
    maximalRealSubfield K = ⊤
proof:
:=
  top_unique <| NumberField.IsTotallyReal.le_maximalRealSubfield _

name: isTotallyReal_iff_le_maximalRealSubfield
statement:
theorem isTotallyReal_iff_le_maximalRealSubfield {E : Subfield K} :
    IsTotallyReal E ↔ E ≤ maximalRealSubfield K
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h ↦ h.le_maximalRealSubfield, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  let _ : Algebra E (maximalRealSubfield K) := RingHom.toAlgebra <| Subfield.inclusion h
  have : IsScalarTower E (maximalRealSubfield K) K := IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' rfl
  have : Algebra.IsAlgebraic E (maximalRealSubfield K) :=
