name: hasDerivAt_jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_jacobiTheta₂_fst (z : ℂ) {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :
    HasDerivAt (jacobiTheta₂ · τ) (jacobiTheta₂' z τ) z
proof:
:= by
  
  
  let eval_fst_CLM : (ℂ × ℂ →L[ℂ] ℂ) →L[ℂ] ℂ :=
  { toFun := fun f ↦ f (1, 0)
    map_add' := by simp only [add_apply, forall_const]
    map_smul' := by simp }
  have step1 : HasSum (fun n ↦ (jacobiTheta₂_term_fderiv n z τ) (1, 0))
      ((jacobiTheta₂_fderiv z τ) (1, 0)) := by
    apply eval_fst_CLM.hasSum (hasSum_jacobiTheta₂_term_fderiv z hτ)
  have step2 (n : ℤ) : (jacobiTheta₂_term_fderiv n z τ) (1, 0) = jacobiTheta₂'_term n z τ := by
    simp [jacobiTheta₂_term_fderiv, jacobiTheta₂'_term, jacobiTheta₂_term, mul_comm]
  simp only [step2] at step1
  have step3 : HasDerivAt (fun x ↦ jacobiTheta₂ x τ) ((jacobiTheta₂_fderiv z τ) (1, 0)) z :=
    (((hasFDerivAt_jacobiTheta₂ z hτ).comp z (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left z τ)).hasDerivAt :)
  rwa [← step1.tsum_eq] at step3

name: continuousAt_jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma continuousAt_jacobiTheta₂' (z : ℂ) {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun p : ℂ × ℂ ↦ jacobiTheta₂' p.1 p.2) (z, τ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hτ'⟩ := exists_between hτ
  obtain ⟨S, hz⟩ := exists_gt |im z|
  let V := {u | |im u| < S} ×ˢ {v | T < im v}
  have hVo : IsOpen V := ((_root_.continuous_abs.comp continuous_im).isOpen_preimage _
    isOpen_Iio).prod (continuous_im.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_Ioi)
  refine ContinuousOn.continuousAt ?_ (hVo.mem_nhds ⟨hz, hτ'⟩)
  let u (n : ℤ) : ℝ := 2 * π * |n| * rexp (-π * (T * n ^ 2 - 2 * S * |n|))
  have hu : Summable u := by simpa only [u, mul_assoc, pow_one]
      using (summable_pow_mul_jacobiTheta₂_term_bound S hT 1).mul_left (2 * π)
  refine continuousOn_tsum (fun n ↦ ?_) hu (fun n ⟨z', τ'⟩ ⟨hz', hτ'⟩ ↦ ?_)
  · apply Continuous.continuousOn
    unfold jacobiTheta₂'_term jacobiTheta₂_term
    fun_prop
  · exact norm_jacobiTheta₂'_term_le hT (le_of_lt hz') (le_of_lt hτ') n

name: jacobiTheta
statement: lemma jacobiTheta₂_add_right (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂ z (τ + 2) = jacobiTheta₂ z τ
proof:
:= by

  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂_term, Complex.exp_add]
  suffices cexp (π * I * n ^ 2 * 2 : ℂ) = 1 by rw [mul_add, Complex.exp_add, this, mul_one]
  rw [(by push_cast; ring : (π * I * n ^ 2 * 2 : ℂ) = (n ^ 2 :) * (2 * π * I)), exp_int_mul,
    exp_two_pi_mul_I, one_zpow]

name: jacobiTheta

:= by

    exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I, mul_one]

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma jacobiTheta₂_add_left' (z τ : ℂ) :
    jacobiTheta₂ (z + τ) τ = cexp (-π * I * (τ + 2 * z)) * jacobiTheta₂ z τ
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [jacobiTheta₂, ← tsum_mul_left, ← (Equiv.addRight 1).tsum_eq]
  refine tsum_congr (fun n ↦ ?_)
  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂_term, ← Complex.exp_add, Equiv.coe_addRight, Int.cast_add]

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
@[simp]
lemma jacobiTheta₂_neg_left (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂ (-z) τ = jacobiTheta₂ z τ
proof:
:= by

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma jacobiTheta₂_conj (z τ : ℂ) :

proof:
:= by

name: jacobiTheta
statement: lemma jacobiTheta₂'_add_right (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂' z (τ + 2) = jacobiTheta₂' z τ
proof:
:= by
  refine tsum_congr (fun n ↦ ?_)
  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂'_term, jacobiTheta₂_term, Complex.exp_add]
  suffices cexp (π * I * n ^ 2 * 2 : ℂ) = 1 by rw [mul_add, Complex.exp_add, this, mul_one]
  rw [(by push_cast; ring : (π * I * n ^ 2 * 2 : ℂ) = (n ^ 2 :) * (2 * π * I)), exp_int_mul,

name: jacobiTheta
statement: lemma jacobiTheta₂'_add_left (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂' (z + 1) τ = jacobiTheta₂' z τ
proof:
:= by

  refine tsum_congr (fun n ↦ ?_)
  simp only [mul_add, Complex.exp_add, mul_one, mul_comm _ (n : ℂ), exp_int_mul_two_pi_mul_I,

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma jacobiTheta₂'_add_left' (z τ : ℂ) :
    jacobiTheta₂' (z + τ) τ =
      cexp (-π * I * (τ + 2 * z)) * (jacobiTheta₂' z τ - 2 * π * I * jacobiTheta₂ z τ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt τ.im 0 with hτ | hτ
  · simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂_undef _ hτ, jacobiTheta₂'_undef _ hτ, mul_zero, sub_zero, mul_zero]
  have (n : ℤ) : jacobiTheta₂'_term n (z + τ) τ =
      cexp (-π * I * (τ + 2 * z)) * (jacobiTheta₂'_term (n + 1) z τ -
      2 * π * I * jacobiTheta₂_term (n + 1) z τ) := by
    simp only [jacobiTheta₂'_term, jacobiTheta₂_term]
    conv_rhs => rw [← sub_mul, mul_comm, mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one,
      mul_add, mul_one, add_sub_cancel_right]
    congr 2
    ring
  rw [jacobiTheta₂', funext this, tsum_mul_left, ← (Equiv.subRight (1 : ℤ)).tsum_eq]
  simp only [jacobiTheta₂, jacobiTheta₂', Equiv.subRight_apply, sub_add_cancel,
    (hasSum_jacobiTheta₂'_term z hτ).summable.tsum_sub
    ((hasSum_jacobiTheta₂_term z hτ).summable.mul_left _), tsum_mul_left]

name: jacobiTheta

proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobiTheta₂', jacobiTheta₂', ← tsum_neg, ← (Equiv.neg ℤ).tsum_eq]
  congr 1 with n
  simp only [jacobiTheta₂'_term, jacobiTheta₂_term]
  rw [Equiv.neg_apply, ← neg_mul]
  push_cast
  ring_nf

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
lemma jacobiTheta₂'_conj (z τ : ℂ) :
    conj (jacobiTheta₂' z τ) = jacobiTheta₂' (conj z) (-conj τ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_inj, ← jacobiTheta₂'_neg_left, jacobiTheta₂', jacobiTheta₂', conj_tsum, ← tsum_neg]
  congr 1 with n
  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂'_term, jacobiTheta₂_term, map_mul, ← Complex.exp_conj, map_add, map_mul,
    ← ofReal_intCast, ← ofReal_ofNat, map_pow, conj_ofReal, conj_I]
  ring_nf

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
theorem jacobiTheta₂_functional_equation (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂ z τ =
    1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ) * jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (im τ) 0 with hτ | hτ
  · have : (-1 / τ).im ≤ 0 := by
      rw [neg_div, neg_im, one_div, inv_im, neg_nonpos]
      exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hτ) (normSq_nonneg τ)
    rw [jacobiTheta₂_undef z hτ, jacobiTheta₂_undef _ this, mul_zero]
  unfold jacobiTheta₂ jacobiTheta₂_term
  have h2 : 0 < (-I * τ).re := by
    simpa only [neg_mul, neg_re, mul_re, I_re, zero_mul, I_im, one_mul, zero_sub, neg_neg] using hτ
  calc
  _ = ∑' n : ℤ, cexp (-π * (-I * τ) * ↑n ^ 2 + 2 * π * (I * z) * ↑n) :=
    tsum_congr (fun n ↦ by ring_nf)
  _ = 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ∑' (n : ℤ), cexp (-π / (-I * τ) * (n + I * (I * z)) ^ 2) := by
    rw [tsum_exp_neg_quadratic h2]
  _ = 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (π * I * (-1 / τ) * z ^ 2) *
      ∑' (n : ℤ), cexp (2 * π * I * n * (z / τ) + π * I * n ^ 2 * (-1 / τ)) := by
    simp_rw [mul_assoc _ (cexp _), ← tsum_mul_left (a := cexp _), ← Complex.exp_add]
    congr 2 with n : 1; congr 1
    field_simp
    ring_nf
    simp_rw [I_sq, I_pow_four]
    ring_nf
  _ = _ := by
    congr 3
    ring

name: jacobiTheta
statement:
theorem jacobiTheta₂'_functional_equation (z τ : ℂ) :
    jacobiTheta₂' z τ = 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ) / τ *
      (jacobiTheta₂' (z / τ) (-1 / τ) - 2 * π * I * z * jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ))
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt (im τ) 0 with hτ | hτ
  · rw [jacobiTheta₂'_undef z hτ, jacobiTheta₂'_undef, jacobiTheta₂_undef, mul_zero,
      sub_zero, mul_zero] <;>
    rw [neg_div, neg_im, one_div, inv_im, neg_nonpos] <;>
    exact div_nonneg (neg_nonneg.mpr hτ) (normSq_nonneg τ)
  have hτ' : 0 < (-1 / τ).im := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv, neg_one_mul, neg_im, inv_im, neg_div, neg_neg]
    exact div_pos hτ (normSq_pos.mpr (fun h ↦ lt_irrefl 0 (zero_im ▸ h ▸ hτ)))
  have hj : HasDerivAt (fun w ↦ jacobiTheta₂ (w / τ) (-1 / τ))
      ((1 / τ) * jacobiTheta₂' (z / τ) (-1 / τ)) z := by
    have := hasDerivAt_jacobiTheta₂_fst (z / τ) hτ'
    simpa only [mul_comm, one_div] using! this.comp z (hasDerivAt_mul_const τ⁻¹)
  calc
  _ = deriv (jacobiTheta₂ · τ) z := (hasDerivAt_jacobiTheta₂_fst z hτ).deriv.symm
  _ = deriv (fun z ↦ 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ) * jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ)) z := by
    rw [funext (jacobiTheta₂_functional_equation · τ)]
  _ = 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        deriv (fun z ↦ cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ) * jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ)) z := by
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, deriv_const_mul_field]
  _ = 1 / (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) *
        (deriv (fun z ↦ cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ)) z * jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ)
         + cexp (-π * I * z ^ 2 / τ) * deriv (fun z ↦ jacobiTheta₂ (z / τ) (-1 / τ)) z) := by
    rw [deriv_fun_mul _ hj.differentiableAt]
    exact (((differentiableAt_pow 2).const_mul _).mul_const _).cexp
  _ = _ := by
    rw [hj.deriv]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv _ τ]
    rw [deriv_cexp (((differentiableAt_pow _).const_mul _).mul_const _), mul_comm,
      deriv_mul_const_field, deriv_const_mul_field, deriv_pow_field]
    ring_nf

name: jacobiTheta_T_sq_smul
statement: theorem jacobiTheta_T_sq_smul (τ : ℍ) : jacobiTheta (ModularGroup.T ^ 2 • τ :) = jacobiTheta τ
proof:
:= by
  suffices (ModularGroup.T ^ 2 • τ :) = (2 : ℂ) + ↑τ by simp_rw [this, jacobiTheta_two_add]
  have : ModularGroup.T ^ (2 : ℕ) = ModularGroup.T ^ (2 : ℤ) := rfl

name: jacobiTheta_S_smul
statement:
theorem jacobiTheta_S_smul (τ : ℍ) :
    jacobiTheta ↑(ModularGroup.S • τ) = (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * jacobiTheta τ
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (τ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_apply_ne im (zero_im.symm ▸ ne_of_gt τ.2)
  have h1 : (-I * τ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Ne, cpow_eq_zero_iff, not_and_or]
    exact Or.inl <| mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr I_ne_zero) h0
  simp_rw [UpperHalfPlane.modular_S_smul, jacobiTheta_eq_jacobiTheta₂, ← ofReal_zero]
  norm_cast
  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂_functional_equation 0 τ, zero_pow two_ne_zero, mul_zero, zero_div,
    Complex.exp_zero, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, mul_one_div, div_self h1, one_mul,
    inv_neg, neg_div, one_div]

name: norm_exp_mul_sq_le
statement:
theorem norm_exp_mul_sq_le {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < τ.im) (n : ℤ) :
    ‖cexp (π * I * (n : ℂ) ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ rexp (-π * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs
proof:
:= by
  let y := rexp (-π * τ.im)
  have h : y < 1 := exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_lt_zero.mpr pi_pos) hτ)
  refine (le_of_eq ?_).trans (?_ : y ^ n ^ 2 ≤ _)
  · rw [norm_exp]
    have : (π * I * n ^ 2 * τ : ℂ).re = -π * τ.im * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [(by push_cast; ring : (π * I * n ^ 2 * τ : ℂ) = (π * n ^ 2 : ℝ) * (τ * I)),
        re_ofReal_mul, mul_I_re]
      ring
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Int.eq_ofNat_of_zero_le (sq_nonneg n)
    rw [this, exp_mul, ← Int.cast_pow, rpow_intCast, hm, zpow_natCast]
  · have : n ^ 2 = (n.natAbs ^ 2 :) := by rw [Nat.cast_pow, Int.natAbs_sq]
    rw [this, zpow_natCast]
    exact pow_le_pow_of_le_one (exp_pos _).le h.le ((sq n.natAbs).symm ▸ n.natAbs.le_mul_self)

name: hasSum_nat_jacobiTheta
statement:
theorem hasSum_nat_jacobiTheta {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)) ((jacobiTheta τ - 1) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have := hasSum_jacobiTheta₂_term 0 hτ
  simp_rw [jacobiTheta₂_term, mul_zero, zero_add, ← jacobiTheta_eq_jacobiTheta₂] at this
  have := this.nat_add_neg
  rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1] at this
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_range_one, Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, Nat.cast_zero, neg_zero,
    Int.cast_zero, sq (0 : ℂ), mul_zero, zero_mul, neg_sq, ← mul_two,
    Complex.exp_zero, add_sub_assoc, (by norm_num : (1 : ℂ) - 1 * 2 = -1), ← sub_eq_add_neg,
    Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at this
  convert! this.div_const 2 using 1
  simp_rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℂ)]

name: jacobiTheta_eq_tsum_nat
statement:
theorem jacobiTheta_eq_tsum_nat {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :
    jacobiTheta τ = ↑1 + ↑2 * ∑' n : ℕ, cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasSum_nat_jacobiTheta hτ).tsum_eq, mul_div_cancel₀ _ (two_ne_zero' ℂ), ← add_sub_assoc,
    add_sub_cancel_left]

name: norm_jacobiTheta_sub_one_le
statement:
theorem norm_jacobiTheta_sub_one_le {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :
    ‖jacobiTheta τ - 1‖ ≤ 2 / (1 - rexp (-π * τ.im)) * rexp (-π * τ.im)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ‖∑' n : ℕ, cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤
      rexp (-π * τ.im) / (1 - rexp (-π * τ.im)) by
    calc
      ‖jacobiTheta τ - 1‖ = ↑2 * ‖∑' n : ℕ, cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)‖ := by
        rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mpr (jacobiTheta_eq_tsum_nat hτ), norm_mul, Complex.norm_two]
      _ ≤ 2 * (rexp (-π * τ.im) / (1 - rexp (-π * τ.im))) := by gcongr
      _ = 2 / (1 - rexp (-π * τ.im)) * rexp (-π * τ.im) := by rw [div_mul_comm, mul_comm]
  have : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)‖ ≤ rexp (-π * τ.im) ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro n
    simpa only [Int.cast_add, Int.cast_one] using! norm_exp_mul_sq_le hτ (n + 1)
  have s : HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
      rexp (-π * τ.im) ^ (n + 1)) (rexp (-π * τ.im) / (1 - rexp (-π * τ.im))) := by
    simp_rw [pow_succ', div_eq_mul_inv, hasSum_mul_left_iff (Real.exp_ne_zero _)]
    exact hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one (exp_pos (-π * τ.im)).le
      (exp_lt_one_iff.mpr <| mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos (neg_lt_zero.mpr pi_pos) hτ)
  have aux : Summable fun n : ℕ => ‖cexp (π * I * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ^ 2 * τ)‖ :=
    .of_nonneg_of_le (fun n => norm_nonneg _) this s.summable
  exact (norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm aux).trans ((aux.tsum_mono s.summable this).trans_eq s.tsum_eq)

name: isBigO_at_im_infty_jacobiTheta_sub_one
statement:
theorem isBigO_at_im_infty_jacobiTheta_sub_one :
    (fun τ => jacobiTheta τ - 1) =O[comap im atTop] fun τ => rexp (-π * τ.im)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [IsBigO, IsBigOWith, Filter.eventually_comap, Filter.eventually_atTop]
  refine ⟨2 / (1 - rexp (-(π * 1))), 1, fun y hy τ hτ =>
    (norm_jacobiTheta_sub_one_le (hτ.symm ▸ zero_lt_one.trans_le hy : 0 < im τ)).trans ?_⟩
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.abs_exp, hτ, neg_mul]
  gcongr
  simp [pi_pos]

name: differentiableAt_jacobiTheta
statement:
theorem differentiableAt_jacobiTheta {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) :

statement: theorem continuousAt_jacobiTheta {τ : ℂ} (hτ : 0 < im τ) : ContinuousAt jacobiTheta τ

name: isBigO_exp_neg_mul_of_le
statement:
lemma isBigO_exp_neg_mul_of_le {c d : ℝ} (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    (fun t ↦ exp (-d * t)) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-c * t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Eventually.isBigO
  filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
  rw [norm_of_nonneg (exp_pos _).le]
  gcongr

name: exp_lt_aux
statement: private lemma exp_lt_aux {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : rexp (-π * t) < 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [exp_lt_one_iff, neg_mul, neg_lt_zero] using mul_pos pi_pos ht

name: isBigO_one_aux
statement:
private lemma isBigO_one_aux :
    IsBigO atTop (fun t : ℝ ↦ (1 - rexp (-π * t))⁻¹) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((Tendsto.const_sub _ ?_).inv₀ (by simp)).isBigO_one ℝ (c := ((1 - 0)⁻¹ : ℝ))
  simpa only [neg_mul, tendsto_exp_comp_nhds_zero, tendsto_neg_atBot_iff]
    using! tendsto_id.const_mul_atTop pi_pos

name: f_le_g_nat
statement:
lemma f_le_g_nat (k : ℕ) {a t : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (ht : 0 < t) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖f_nat k a t n‖ ≤ g_nat k a t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_nat, norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), g_nat]
  simp only [neg_mul, add_sq]
  gcongr
  have H₁ : (n : ℝ) ≤ n ^ 2 := mod_cast Nat.le_self_pow two_ne_zero n
  have H₂ : 0 ≤ 2 * n * a := by positivity
  linear_combination H₁ + H₂

name: summable_f_nat
statement: lemma summable_f_nat (k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : Summable (f_nat k a t)
proof:
:= by
  have : Summable fun n : ℕ ↦ n ^ k * exp (-π * (n + a) ^ 2 * t) := by
    refine (((summable_pow_mul_jacobiTheta₂_term_bound (|a| * t) ht k).mul_right
      (rexp (-π * a ^ 2 * t))).comp_injective Nat.cast_injective).of_norm_bounded (fun n ↦ ?_)
    simp_rw [mul_assoc, Function.comp_apply, ← Real.exp_add, norm_mul, norm_pow, Int.cast_abs,
      Int.cast_natCast, norm_eq_abs, Nat.abs_cast, abs_exp]
    gcongr
    rw [← sub_nonneg]
    rw [show -π * (t * n ^ 2 - 2 * (|a| * (t * n))) + -π * (a ^ 2 * t) - -π * ((n + a) ^ 2 * t)
         = π * t * n * (|a| + a) * 2 by ring]
    refine mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity) ?_) two_pos.le
    rw [← neg_le_iff_add_nonneg]
    apply neg_le_abs
  apply (this.mul_left (2 ^ k)).of_norm_bounded_eventually_nat
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc, f_nat, norm_mul, norm_eq_abs, abs_exp,
    mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_right (exp_pos _), ← mul_pow, abs_pow, two_mul]
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (Nat.ceil |a|)] with n hn
  gcongr
  exact (abs_add_le ..).trans (add_le_add (Nat.abs_cast _).le (Nat.ceil_le.mp hn))

name: F_nat_zero_le
statement:
lemma F_nat_zero_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ‖F_nat 0 a t‖ ≤ rexp (-π * a ^ 2 * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t))
proof:
:= by
  refine tsum_of_norm_bounded ?_ (f_le_g_nat 0 ha ht)
  convert! (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one (exp_pos _).le <| exp_lt_aux ht).mul_left _ using 1
  ext1 n
  simp only [g_nat]
  rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_add]
  ring_nf

name: F_nat_zero_zero_sub_le
statement:
lemma F_nat_zero_zero_sub_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ‖F_nat 0 0 t - 1‖ ≤ rexp (-π * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t))
proof:
:= by
  convert! F_nat_zero_le zero_le_one ht using 2
  · rw [F_nat, (summable_f_nat 0 0 ht).tsum_eq_zero_add, f_nat, Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, pow_zero,
      one_mul, pow_two, mul_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, exp_zero, add_comm, add_sub_cancel_right]
    simp_rw [F_nat, f_nat, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_zero]
  · rw [one_pow, mul_one]

name: isBigO_atTop_F_nat_zero_sub
statement:
lemma isBigO_atTop_F_nat_zero_sub {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∃ p, 0 < p ∧
    (fun t ↦ F_nat 0 a t - (if a = 0 then 1 else 0)) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-p * t)
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [h]
    have : (fun t ↦ F_nat 0 0 t - 1) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ rexp (-π * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t)) := by
      apply Eventually.isBigO
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
      exact F_nat_zero_zero_sub_le ht
    refine ⟨_, pi_pos, this.trans ?_⟩
    simpa using! (isBigO_refl (fun t ↦ rexp (-π * t)) _).mul isBigO_one_aux
  · simp_rw [sub_zero]
    have : (fun t ↦ F_nat 0 a t) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ rexp (-π * a ^ 2 * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t)) := by
      apply Eventually.isBigO
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
      exact F_nat_zero_le ha ht
    refine ⟨π * a ^ 2, mul_pos pi_pos (sq_pos_of_ne_zero h), this.trans ?_⟩
    simpa only [neg_mul π (a ^ 2), mul_one] using! (isBigO_refl _ _).mul isBigO_one_aux

name: F_nat_one_le
statement:
lemma F_nat_one_le {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    ‖F_nat 1 a t‖ ≤ rexp (-π * (a ^ 2 + 1) * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t)) ^ 2
      + a * rexp (-π * a ^ 2 * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t))
proof:
:= by
  refine tsum_of_norm_bounded ?_ (f_le_g_nat 1 ha ht)
  unfold g_nat
  simp_rw [pow_one, add_mul]
  apply HasSum.add
  · have h0' : ‖rexp (-π * t)‖ < 1 := by
      simpa only [norm_eq_abs, abs_exp] using exp_lt_aux ht
    convert! (hasSum_coe_mul_geometric_of_norm_lt_one h0').mul_left (exp (-π * a ^ 2 * t)) using 1
    · ext1 n
      rw [mul_comm (exp _), ← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_assoc (n : ℝ), ← Real.exp_add]
      ring_nf
    · rw [mul_add, add_mul, mul_one, exp_add, mul_div_assoc]
  · convert! (hasSum_geometric_of_lt_one (exp_pos _).le <| exp_lt_aux ht).mul_left _ using 1
    ext1 n
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, mul_assoc _ (exp _), ← Real.exp_add]
    ring_nf

name: isBigO_atTop_F_nat_one
statement:
lemma isBigO_atTop_F_nat_one {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : ∃ p, 0 < p ∧
    F_nat 1 a =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-p * t)
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∃ p, 0 < p ∧ (fun t ↦ rexp (-π * (a ^ 2 + 1) * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t)) ^ 2
      + a * rexp (-π * a ^ 2 * t) / (1 - rexp (-π * t))) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-p * t) by
    let ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := this
    refine ⟨p, hp, (Eventually.isBigO ?_).trans hp'⟩
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
    exact F_nat_one_le ha ht
  have aux' : IsBigO atTop (fun t : ℝ ↦ ((1 - rexp (-π * t)) ^ 2)⁻¹) (fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) := by
    simpa only [inv_pow, one_pow] using! isBigO_one_aux.pow 2
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le ha with rfl | ha'
  · exact ⟨_, pi_pos, by simpa only [zero_pow two_ne_zero, zero_add, mul_one, zero_mul, zero_div,
      add_zero] using! (isBigO_refl _ _).mul aux'⟩
  · refine ⟨π * a ^ 2, mul_pos pi_pos <| pow_pos ha' _, IsBigO.add ?_ ?_⟩
    · conv_rhs => enter [t]; rw [← mul_one (rexp _)]
      refine (Eventually.isBigO ?_).mul aux'
      filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
      rw [norm_of_nonneg (exp_pos _).le, exp_le_exp]
      nlinarith [pi_pos]
    · simp_rw [mul_div_assoc, ← neg_mul]
      apply IsBigO.const_mul_left
      simpa only [mul_one] using! (isBigO_refl _ _).mul isBigO_one_aux

name: f_int_ofNat
statement:
lemma f_int_ofNat (k : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    f_int k a t (Int.ofNat n) = f_nat k a t n
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_int, f_nat, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]

name: f_int_negSucc
statement:
lemma f_int_negSucc (k : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    f_int k a t (Int.negSucc n) = f_nat k (1 - a) t n

name: summable_f_int
statement: lemma summable_f_int (k : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) : Summable (f_int k a t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Summable.of_norm
  suffices ∀ n, ‖f_int k a t n‖ = ‖(Int.rec (f_nat k a t) (f_nat k (1 - a) t) : ℤ → ℝ) n‖ from
    funext this ▸ (HasSum.int_rec (summable_f_nat k a ht).hasSum
      (summable_f_nat k (1 - a) ht).hasSum).summable.norm
  intro n
  rcases n with - | m
  · simp only [f_int, f_nat, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, Int.cast_natCast, norm_mul, norm_eq_abs, abs_pow,
      abs_abs]
  · simp only [f_int, f_nat, Int.cast_negSucc, norm_mul, norm_eq_abs, abs_pow, abs_abs,
      (by { push_cast; ring } : -↑(m + 1) + a = -(m + (1 - a))), abs_neg, neg_sq]

name: F_int_eq_of_mem_Icc
statement:
lemma F_int_eq_of_mem_Icc (k : ℕ) {a : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ Icc 0 1) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) :
    F_int k a t = (F_nat k a t) + (F_nat k (1 - a) t)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [F_int, F_nat, Function.Periodic.lift_coe]
  convert!
    ((summable_f_nat k a ht).hasSum.int_rec (summable_f_nat k (1 - a) ht).hasSum).tsum_eq using
    3 with n
  cases n
  · rw [f_int_ofNat _ ha.1]
  · rw [f_int_negSucc _ ha.2]

name: isBigO_atTop_F_int_zero_sub
statement:
lemma isBigO_atTop_F_int_zero_sub (a : UnitAddCircle) : ∃ p, 0 < p ∧
    (fun t ↦ F_int 0 a t - (if a = 0 then 1 else 0)) =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-p * t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := a.eq_coe_Ico
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := isBigO_atTop_F_nat_zero_sub ha.1
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := isBigO_atTop_F_nat_zero_sub (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2.le)
  simp_rw [AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico ha]
  simp_rw [eq_false_intro (by linarith [ha.2] : 1 - a ≠ 0), ite_false, sub_zero] at hq'
  refine ⟨_, lt_min hp hq, ?_⟩
  have : (fun t ↦ F_int 0 a t - (if a = 0 then 1 else 0)) =ᶠ[atTop]
      fun t ↦ (F_nat 0 a t - (if a = 0 then 1 else 0)) + F_nat 0 (1 - a) t := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
    rw [F_int_eq_of_mem_Icc 0 (Ico_subset_Icc_self ha) ht]
    ring
  refine this.isBigO.trans ((hp'.trans ?_).add (hq'.trans ?_)) <;>
  apply isBigO_exp_neg_mul_of_le
  exacts [min_le_left .., min_le_right ..]

name: isBigO_atTop_F_int_one
statement:
lemma isBigO_atTop_F_int_one (a : UnitAddCircle) : ∃ p, 0 < p ∧
    F_int 1 a =O[atTop] fun t ↦ exp (-p * t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := a.eq_coe_Ico
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := isBigO_atTop_F_nat_one ha.1
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hq'⟩ := isBigO_atTop_F_nat_one (sub_nonneg.mpr ha.2.le)
  refine ⟨_, lt_min hp hq, ?_⟩
  have : F_int 1 a =ᶠ[atTop] fun t ↦ F_nat 1 a t + F_nat 1 (1 - a) t := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with t ht
    exact F_int_eq_of_mem_Icc 1 (Ico_subset_Icc_self ha) ht
  refine this.isBigO.trans ((hp'.trans ?_).add (hq'.trans ?_)) <;>
  apply isBigO_exp_neg_mul_of_le
  exacts [min_le_left .., min_le_right ..]

name: G2_partial_sum_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_Icc_of_even_eq_range (e2Summand_even z), Finset.sum_range_succ', smul_add,
    nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_zero, e2Summand_zero_eq_two_riemannZeta_two]
  ring_nf
  simp only [e2Summand, eisSummand, add_comm, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Fin.isValue,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_one, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Int.reduceNeg, zpow_neg, mul_comm, mul_sum]
  congr with a
  have H2 := qExpansion_identity_pnat (k := 1) (by grind)
    ⟨(a + 1) * z, by simpa [show 0 < ((a + 1) : ℝ) by positivity] using z.2⟩
  simp only [add_comm, Nat.reduceAdd, one_div, mul_comm, mul_neg, even_two,
    Even.neg_pow, Nat.factorial_one, Nat.cast_one, div_one, pow_one] at H2
  simp_rw [zpow_ofNat, H2, ← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_neg, ← exp_nsmul]
  refine tsum_congr fun b ↦ ?_
  ring_nf
  grind [I_sq, exp_add]

name: aux_G2_tendsto
statement:
private lemma aux_G2_tendsto : Tendsto
    (fun N ↦ ∑ m ∈ range N, -8 * π ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℕ+, n * 𝕢 z ^ ((m + 1) * n)) atTop
    (𝓝 (-8 * π ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℕ+, σ 1 n * 𝕢 z ^ (n : ℕ)))
proof:
:= by
  have : -8 * π ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℕ+, σ 1 n * 𝕢 z ^ (n : ℕ) =
      ∑' m : ℕ, (-8 * π ^ 2 * ∑' n : ℕ+, n * 𝕢 z ^ ((m + 1) * n)) := by
    have := tsum_prod_pow_eq_tsum_sigma 1 (norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one z)
    rw [tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ (f := fun d ↦ ∑' c : ℕ+, c ^ 1 * 𝕢 z ^ (d * c : ℕ))] at this
    simp [← tsum_mul_left, ← this]
  rw [this]
  refine (Summable.mul_left _ ?_).hasSum.comp tendsto_finset_range
  rw [← summable_pnat_iff_summable_succ (f := fun b ↦ ∑' c : ℕ+, c * 𝕢 z ^ (b * c : ℕ))]
  apply (summable_prod_mul_pow 1 (norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one z)).prod.congr
  simp [← exp_nsmul]

name: E2_eq_tsum_cexp

name: hasSum_qExpansion_E2
statement:
theorem hasSum_qExpansion_E2 :
    HasSum (fun m : ℕ ↦ (if m = 0 then 1 else -24 * σ 1 m : ℂ) • 𝕢 z ^ m) (E2 z)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : Summable fun n : ℕ ↦ σ 1 (n + 1) * 𝕢 z ^ (n + 1) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (summable_sigma_mul_cexp_pow (k := 2) (one_le_two) z)

  convert! (hS.mul_left (-24)).hasSum using 1
  · ext : 1
    simp [mul_assoc]
  · rw [E2_eq_tsum_cexp, tsum_pnat_eq_tsum_succ (f := fun n ↦ σ 1 n * 𝕢 z ^ n), tsum_mul_left]
    simp

name: one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_eq
statement:
private lemma one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_eq (a b m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0 ∨ (a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0)) :
    1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + a) - 1 / (m * z + b) = (b - a) * (1 / ((m * z + a) * (m * z + b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_div_mul_sub_mul_one_div_eq_one_div_add_one_div]
  · grind [one_div, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, mul_inv_rev]
  · simpa using linear_ne_zero z (cd := ![m, a]) (by aesop)
  · simpa using linear_ne_zero z (cd := ![m, b]) (by aesop)

name: summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear
statement:
lemma summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear (a b : ℤ) :
    Summable fun m : ℤ ↦ 1 / (m * (z : ℂ) + a) - 1 / (m * z + b)
proof:
:= by
  have := Summable.mul_left (b - a : ℂ) (summable_linear_left_mul_linear_left (ne_zero z) a b)
  rw [← Finset.summable_compl_iff (s := {0})] at *
  apply this.congr (fun m ↦ ?_)
  grind [one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_eq z a b m (by grind)]

name: summable_right_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_succ
statement:
lemma summable_right_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_succ (m : ℤ) :
    Summable fun b : ℤ ↦ 1 / (m * (z : ℂ) + b) - 1 / (m * z + b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have := summable_linear_right_add_one_mul_linear_right z m m
  rw [← Finset.summable_compl_iff (s := {0, -1})] at *
  apply this.congr (fun b ↦ ?_)
  simpa [add_assoc, mul_comm] using
    (one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_eq z b (b + 1) m (by grind)).symm

name: aux_sum_Ico_S_identity
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [inv_neg, mul_neg, mul_sum, pow_two, ← zpow_two]
  rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i hi ↦ linear_left_summable (ne_zero z) i le_rfl)]
  apply sum_congr rfl fun n hn ↦ ?_
  rw [← tsum_mul_left, ← tsum_comp_neg]
  apply tsum_congr (by grind [zpow_two, ne_zero z])

name: tendsto_double_sum_S_act
statement:
lemma tendsto_double_sum_S_act :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ ↦ (∑' (n : ℤ), ∑ m ∈ Ico (-N : ℤ) N, (1 / ((n : ℂ) * z + m) ^ 2))) atTop
    (𝓝 ((z.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * G2 (S • z)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2_eq_tsum_symmetricIco, ← tsum_mul_left]
  have := ((summable_e2Summand_symmetricIco (S • z)).mul_left (z.1 ^ 2)⁻¹).hasSum
  simp only [HasSum, symmetricIco, tendsto_map'_iff, modular_S_smul, ← Nat.map_cast_int_atTop] at *
  apply this.congr (fun N ↦ ?_)
  simpa [e2Summand, eisSummand, ← mul_sum] using! aux_sum_Ico_S_identity z N

name: tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_eq_S_act
statement:
lemma tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_eq_S_act :
    ∑'[symmetricIco ℤ] n : ℤ, ∑' m : ℤ, 1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) ^ 2 =
    ((z : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * G2 (S • z)
proof:
:= by
  apply HasSum.tsum_eq
  rw [hasSum_symmetricIco_int_iff]
  apply (tendsto_double_sum_S_act z).congr (fun x ↦ ?_)
  rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum]
  exact fun i hi ↦ by simpa using! linear_left_summable (ne_zero z) i le_rfl

name: telescope_aux
proof:
:= by
  convert! sum_Ico_int_sub b (fun n ↦ 1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n)) using 2 <;>
  simp [add_assoc, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: tsum_symmetricIco_linear_sub_linear_add_one_eq_zero
statement:
lemma tsum_symmetricIco_linear_sub_linear_add_one_eq_zero (m : ℤ) :
    ∑'[symmetricIco ℤ] n : ℤ, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HasSum.tsum_eq
  simp_rw [hasSum_symmetricIco_int_iff, telescope_aux z m]
  simpa using (tendsto_zero_inv_linear_sub z m).sub (tendsto_zero_inv_linear z m)

name: aux_tsum_identity_1
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_neg_add_iff_add_eq (b := 2 / (d : ℂ)), tsum_int_eq_zero_add_tsum_pnat]
  · simp only [Int.cast_zero, zero_mul, zero_sub, one_div, zero_add, Int.cast_natCast, Int.cast_neg,
      neg_mul]
    ring_nf
    rw [← Summable.tsum_add]
    · grind
    · apply (summable_pnat_iff_summable_nat.mpr ((summable_int_iff_summable_nat_and_neg.mp
        (summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear z (-d) d)).1)).congr
      grind [Int.cast_natCast]
    · apply (summable_pnat_iff_summable_nat.mpr ((summable_int_iff_summable_nat_and_neg.mp
        (summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear z (-d) d)).2)).congr
      grind [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast, neg_mul, one_div]
  · simpa using! summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear z (-d) d

name: aux_tsum_identity_2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Summable.tsum_mul_left]
  · apply tsum_congr (by grind [sub_eq_add_neg, ← div_neg, ne_zero z])
  · have := summable_cotTerm (by simpa using z.int_div_mem_integerComplement (n := -d) (by aesop))
    simp only [cotTerm, one_div] at *
    simp only [← Nat.cast_add_one] at this
    rw [summable_nat_add_iff (f := fun n ↦ (-d / (z : ℂ) - n)⁻¹ + (-d / (z : ℂ) + n)⁻¹)] at this
    apply this.subtype

name: aux_tendsto_tsum_cexp_pnat
statement:
private lemma aux_tendsto_tsum_cexp_pnat :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ+ ↦ ∑' (n : ℕ+), cexp (2 * π * I * (-N / z)) ^ (n : ℕ)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have := tendsto_zero_geometric_tsum_pnat (norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one ⟨_, im_pnat_div_pos 1 z⟩)
  simp only [← exp_nsmul, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul] at *
  exact this.congr <| by grind

name: aux_tendsto_tsum
statement:
private lemma aux_tendsto_tsum : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ ↦ 2 / z *
    ∑' (m : ℕ+), (1 / (-(n : ℂ) / z - m) + 1 / (-n / z + m))) atTop (𝓝 (-2 * π * I / z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← PNat.tendsto_comp_val_iff]
  have H0 : (fun n : ℕ+ ↦ (2 / z * ∑' (m : ℕ+), (1 / (-(n : ℂ) / z - m) + 1 / (-n / z + m)))) =
      (fun n : ℕ+ ↦ (-2 * π * I / z) - (2 / z * (2 * π * I)) *
      (∑' m : ℕ+, cexp (2 * π * I * (-n / z)) ^ (m : ℕ)) + 2 / n) := by
    ext N
    have h2 := cot_series_rep <| coe_mem_integerComplement ⟨-N / z, im_pnat_div_pos N z⟩
    rw [pi_mul_cot_pi_q_exp, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add', one_div, inv_div, neg_mul, ← h2,
      ← tsum_zero_pnat_eq_tsum_nat
      (by simpa using norm_exp_two_pi_I_lt_one ⟨-N / z, im_pnat_div_pos N z⟩)] at *
    field [ne_zero z]
  rw [H0]
  nth_rw 2 [show -2 * π * I / z = (-2 * π * I / z) - (2 / z * (2 * π * I)) * 0 + 2 * 0 by ring]
  refine aux_tendsto_tsum_cexp_pnat z |>.const_mul _ |>.const_sub _ |>.add (.const_mul _ ?_)
  exact PNat.tendsto_comp_val_iff.mpr tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: tendsto_tsum_one_div_linear_sub_succ_eq
statement:
lemma tendsto_tsum_one_div_linear_sub_succ_eq :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ+ ↦ ∑ n ∈ Ico (-N : ℤ) N,
    ∑' m : ℤ, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1))) atTop (𝓝 (-2 * π * I / z))
proof:
:= by
  have (N : ℕ+) :
      ∑ n ∈ Ico (-N : ℤ) N, ∑' m : ℤ, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1))
      = ∑' m : ℤ, ∑ n ∈ Ico (-N : ℤ) N, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1)) := by
    rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i hi ↦ ?_)]
    apply (summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear z i (i + 1)).congr
    grind
  simp only [telescope_aux, aux_tsum_identity_1] at this
  rw [funext this, show -2 * π * I / z = 0 + -2 * π * I / z by ring]
  apply Tendsto.add
  · simpa [← PNat.tendsto_comp_val_iff] using!
      (tendsto_inv_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℂ)).const_mul (-2)
  · simpa only [aux_tsum_identity_2, ← PNat.tendsto_comp_val_iff] using! aux_tendsto_tsum z

name: tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_sub_eq
statement:
lemma tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_sub_eq :
    ∑'[symmetricIco ℤ] n : ℤ, ∑' m : ℤ, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1)) =
    -2 * π * I / z
proof:
:= by
  apply HasSum.tsum_eq
  simpa [HasSum, ← Nat.map_cast_int_atTop, ← PNat.tendsto_comp_val_iff]
    using tendsto_tsum_one_div_linear_sub_succ_eq z

name: tsum_tsum_symmetricIco_sub_eq
statement:
lemma tsum_tsum_symmetricIco_sub_eq :
    ∑' m : ℤ, ∑'[symmetricIco ℤ] n : ℤ, (1 / ((m : ℂ) * z + n) - 1 / (m * z + n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  convert! tsum_zero
  exact tsum_symmetricIco_linear_sub_linear_add_one_eq_zero z _

name: E2_mdifferentiable
statement: lemma E2_mdifferentiable : MDiff E2
proof:
:= by
  rw [UpperHalfPlane.mdifferentiable_iff]
  have hη : DifferentiableOn ℂ η _ := fun z hz ↦
    (differentiableAt_eta_of_mem_upperHalfPlaneSet hz).differentiableWithinAt
  have hlog : DifferentiableOn ℂ (logDeriv η) _ :=
    (hη.deriv isOpen_upperHalfPlaneSet).div hη (fun _ hz ↦ eta_ne_zero hz)
  refine (hlog.const_mul (π * I / 12)⁻¹).congr (fun z hz ↦ ?_)
  simp [ofComplex_apply_of_im_pos hz, logDeriv_eta_eq_E2 ⟨z, hz⟩]
  field_simp

name: G2Term_summable
statement: lemma G2Term_summable (z : ℍ) : Summable (G2Term z)
proof:
:= by
  have H : Summable fun m ↦ G2Term z m - δ m := by
    simp_rw [G2Term, add_sub_cancel_right]
    apply summable_of_isBigO_rpow_norm (a := 3) (by linarith)
    simpa [pow_three, pow_two, ← mul_assoc] using ((isBigO_linear_add_const_vec z 0 1).mul
      (isBigO_linear_add_const_vec z 0 0)).mul (isBigO_linear_add_const_vec z 0 0)
  exact H.congr_cofinite <| δ_eventually_cofinite.mp <| .of_forall <| by simp +contextual

name: G2Term_prod_summable
statement: lemma G2Term_prod_summable (z : ℍ) : Summable (fun p : ℤ × ℤ ↦ G2Term z ![p.1, p.2])
proof:
:= by
  apply (finTwoArrowEquiv _).symm.summable_iff.mpr (G2Term_summable z)

name: aux_identity
statement:
lemma aux_identity (z : ℍ) (b n : ℤ) : ((b : ℂ) * z + n + 1)⁻¹ * (((b : ℂ) * z + n) ^ 2)⁻¹ +
    (δ ![b, n]) + (((b : ℂ) * z + n)⁻¹ - ((b : ℂ) * z + n + 1)⁻¹) = (((b : ℂ) * z + n) ^ 2)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : b = 0 ∧ n = 0
  · simp [h.1, h.2]
  · simp only [not_and] at h
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · by_cases hn : n = -1
      · simp [hb, hn, δ_eq_two]
        ring
      · have hn0 : (n : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by aesop
        have hn1 : (n : ℂ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by norm_cast; grind
        simp [δ, h, hb, hn]
        grind
    · have h0 : (b : ℂ) * z + n + 1 ≠ 0 := by
        simpa [add_assoc] using linear_ne_zero (cd := ![b, n + 1]) z (by aesop)
      have h1 : (b : ℂ) * z + n ≠ 0 := linear_ne_zero (cd := ![b, n]) z (by aesop)
      simp [δ]
      grind

name: G2_eq_tsum_G2Term
statement: lemma G2_eq_tsum_G2Term (z : ℍ) : G2 z = ∑' m, ∑' n, G2Term z ![m, n]
proof:
:= by
  set t := ∑' m, ∑' n, (G2Term z ![m, n])
  rw [G2, show t = t + 0 by ring, ← tsum_tsum_symmetricIco_sub_eq z, ← Summable.tsum_add]
  · rw [← tsum_eq_of_summable_unconditional (L := symmetricIcc ℤ)]
    · congr with a
      rw [e2Summand, tsum_eq_of_summable_unconditional
        (summable_right_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_succ z a), ← Summable.tsum_add
        ((G2Term_prod_summable z).prod_factor _)
        (summable_right_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear_succ z a)]
      exact tsum_congr (fun b ↦ by simp [eisSummand, G2Term, aux_identity z a b, zpow_ofNat])
    · simpa only [tsum_symmetricIco_linear_sub_linear_add_one_eq_zero z, add_zero]
        using (G2Term_prod_summable z).prod
  · exact (G2Term_prod_summable z).prod
  · exact summable_zero.congr
      fun b ↦ by simp [← tsum_symmetricIco_linear_sub_linear_add_one_eq_zero z b]

name: G2_S_action_eq_tsum_G2Term
statement:
lemma G2_S_action_eq_tsum_G2Term (z : ℍ) : ((z : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * G2 (S • z) - -2 * π * I / z =
    ∑' n : ℤ, ∑' m : ℤ, G2Term z ![m, n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_sub_eq z, ← tsum_symmetricIco_tsum_eq_S_act z,
    ← tsum_eq_of_summable_unconditional (L := symmetricIco ℤ), ← Summable.tsum_sub]
  · apply tsum_congr (fun N ↦ ?_)
    rw [← Summable.tsum_sub]
    · apply tsum_congr (fun M ↦ ?_)
      simp only [one_div, G2Term, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, mul_inv_rev]
      nth_rw 1 [← aux_identity z M N]
      ring
    · simpa using! linear_left_summable (ne_zero z) N le_rfl
    · simpa [add_assoc] using! summable_left_one_div_linear_sub_one_div_linear z N (N + 1)
  · apply HasSum.summable (a := (z.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * G2 (S • z))
    rw [hasSum_symmetricIco_int_iff]
    apply (tendsto_double_sum_S_act z).congr (fun x ↦ ?_)
    rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum (fun i hi ↦ ?_)]
    simpa using! linear_left_summable (ne_zero z) i (k := 2) (by norm_num)
  · apply HasSum.summable (a := -2 * π * I / z)
    rw [hasSum_symmetricIco_int_iff, ← tendsto_comp_val_Ioi_atTop]
    exact tendsto_tsum_one_div_linear_sub_succ_eq z
  · have := G2Term_summable z
    rw [← ((finTwoArrowEquiv _).trans (.prodComm ..)).symm.summable_iff] at this
    exact this.prod

name: tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum
statement:
lemma tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum (z : ℍ) : ∑' (m : Fin 2 → ℤ), G2Term z m =
    ∑' m : ℤ, ∑' n : ℤ, G2Term z ![m, n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (finTwoArrowEquiv _).symm.tsum_eq]
  exact Summable.tsum_prod' (G2Term_prod_summable z) ((G2Term_prod_summable z).prod_factor)

name: tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum'
statement:
lemma tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum' (z : ℍ) : ∑' (m : Fin 2 → ℤ), G2Term z m =
    ∑' n : ℤ, ∑' m : ℤ, G2Term z ![m, n]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Summable.tsum_comm', tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum]
  · exact G2Term_prod_summable z
  · exact (G2Term_prod_summable z).prod_factor
  · have H := G2Term_summable z
    rw [← ((finTwoArrowEquiv _).trans (.prodComm ..)).symm.summable_iff] at H
    exact H.prod_factor

name: G2_S_transform
statement: lemma G2_S_transform (z : ℍ) : G2 z = ((z : ℂ) ^ 2)⁻¹ * G2 (S • z) - -2 * π * I / z
proof:
:= by
  rw [G2_S_action_eq_tsum_G2Term, G2_eq_tsum_G2Term z, ← tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum',
  tsum_G2Term_eq_tsum]

name: G2_T_transform
statement: lemma G2_T_transform : G2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] T = G2
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp_rw [SL_slash_def, modular_T_smul z]
  simp [G2_eq_tsum_cexp, T, denom_apply, ← exp_periodic.nat_mul 1 (2 * π * I * z)]
  grind

name: G2_slash_action
statement: lemma G2_slash_action (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) : G2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ = G2 - D2 γ
proof:
:= by
  have : γ ∈ Subgroup.closure {S, T} := by simp [SpecialLinearGroup.SL2Z_generators]
  induction this using Subgroup.closure_induction with
  | one => simp only [SlashAction.slash_one, D2_one, sub_zero]
  | mem g hg =>
      simp only [mem_insert_iff, mem_singleton_iff] at hg
      rcases hg with (h1 | h2)
      · ext z
        simp only [Pi.sub_apply, h1, D2_S z, SlashInvariantForm.slash_S_apply G2 2 z, mul_comm,
          G2_S_transform z, modular_S_smul]
        ring_nf
        aesop
      · simpa only [h2, D2_T, sub_zero] using G2_T_transform
  | mul g h _ _ ig ih =>
      rw [D2_mul, SlashAction.slash_mul, ig, sub_eq_add_neg, SlashAction.add_slash, ih]
      grind [SlashAction.neg_slash, SL_slash]
  | inv g _ ig =>
      have H1 : (G2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] g) ∣[(2 : ℤ)] g⁻¹ = (G2 - D2 g) ∣[(2 : ℤ)] g⁻¹ := by
        rw [ig]
      simp_rw [← SlashAction.slash_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, SlashAction.add_slash, mul_inv_cancel,
        SlashAction.slash_one, SL_slash, SlashAction.neg_slash] at H1
      nth_rw 2 [H1]
      have := D2_inv g
      simp only [SL_slash] at this
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, this, SL_slash, sub_neg_eq_add, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: E2_slash_action
statement: lemma E2_slash_action (γ : SL(2, ℤ)) : E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] γ = E2 - (1 / (2 * riemannZeta 2)) • D2 γ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [E2, SL_smul_slash, G2_slash_action γ, mul_sub]

name: E2_T_transform
statement: lemma E2_T_transform : E2 ∣[(2 : ℤ)] T = E2
proof:
:= by
  simp [E2_slash_action, D2_T]

name: E2_T_smul
statement: lemma E2_T_smul (z : ℍ) : E2 (T • z) = E2 z
proof:
:= by
  simpa [denom_apply, SL_slash_apply] using congrFun E2_T_transform z

name: E2_periodic

name: e2Summand_summable

name: e2Summand_zero_eq_two_riemannZeta_two
statement:
@[simp]
lemma e2Summand_zero_eq_two_riemannZeta_two (z : ℍ) : e2Summand 0 z = 2 * riemannZeta 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [e2Summand, eisSummand] using!
    (two_mul_riemannZeta_eq_tsum_int_inv_pow_of_even (k := 2) (by grind) (by simp)).symm

name: e2Summand_even
statement: lemma e2Summand_even (z : ℍ) : (e2Summand · z).Even
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  simp only [e2Summand, ← tsum_comp_neg (fun a ↦ eisSummand 2 ![-n, a] z)]
  apply tsum_congr (fun b ↦ ?_)
  simp only [eisSummand, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Int.reduceNeg, zpow_neg, Int.cast_neg, neg_mul, inv_inj]
  rw_mod_cast [Int.cast_neg]

name: D2_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma D2_one : D2 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [D2]

name: denom_aux
statement:
private lemma denom_aux (A B : SL(2, ℤ)) (z : ℍ) : ((A * B) 1 0) * (denom B z) =
    (A 1 0) * B.1.det + (B 1 0) * denom (A * B) z
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Matrix.two_mul_expl A.1 B.1
  simp only [Fin.isValue, coe_mul, h0.2.2.1, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_mul, ModularGroup.denom_apply,
    Matrix.det_fin_two B.1, Int.cast_sub, ← map_mul, h0.2.2.2]
  ring

name: D2_mul
statement: lemma D2_mul (A B : SL(2, ℤ)) : D2 (A * B) = (D2 A) ∣[(2 : ℤ)] B + D2 B
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp only [D2, mul_assoc, coe_mul, map_mul, ← mul_div, SL_slash_def,
    ModularGroup.sl_moeb, Int.reduceNeg, zpow_neg, Pi.add_apply, ← mul_add, mul_eq_mul_left_iff,
    I_ne_zero, or_false, ofReal_eq_zero, pi_ne_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero]
  have hd : (A.1 * B.1) 1 0 * denom (φ B) z - B 1 0 * denom (φ A * φ B) z = A 1 0 := by
    simpa [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] using denom_aux A B z
  have : denom A (num B z / denom B z) = denom A ↑(B • z) := by
    simp [specialLinearGroup_apply, denom, num]
  rw [(by intros; field_simp : ∀ {a b c d f e : ℂ} (he : e ≠ 0), a / b =
    c / d * (e ^ (2 : ℤ))⁻¹ + f / e ↔ a * e ^ 2 / b = c / d + e * f) (denom_ne_zero B z)]
  simp only [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, denom_cocycle A B z.im_ne_zero, this,
    ModularGroup.sl_moeb, ← hd]
  field_simp [denom_ne_zero A (toGL (φ B) • z)]
  ring

name: D2_inv
statement: lemma D2_inv (A) : (D2 A) ∣[(2 : ℤ)] A⁻¹ = -D2 A⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simpa [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero] using (D2_mul A A⁻¹).symm

name: D2_T
statement: lemma D2_T : D2 ModularGroup.T = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  simp [D2, ModularGroup.T]

name: D2_S
statement: lemma D2_S (z : ℍ) : D2 ModularGroup.S z = 2 * π * I / z
proof:
:= by
  simp [D2, ModularGroup.S, ModularGroup.denom_apply]

name: eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_not_dvd {n : ℕ} (h : ¬p ∣ n) : padicValNat p n = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_iff.2 <| Or.inr <| Or.inr h

name: dvd_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem dvd_of_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (h : padicValNat p n ≠ 0) : p ∣ n
proof:
:=
  not_not.mp (mt padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd h)

name: of_ne_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem of_ne_one_ne_zero {z : ℤ} :
    padicValInt p z = multiplicity (p : ℤ) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValInt, padicValNat_def]
  apply Int.multiplicity_natAbs

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zero : padicValInt p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [padicValInt]

name: one
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem one : padicValInt p 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [padicValInt]

name: of_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_nat {n : ℕ} : padicValInt p n = padicValNat p n
proof: := by simp [padicValInt]

name: self
statement: theorem self (hp : 1 < p) : padicValInt p p = 1
proof: := by simp [padicValNat.self hp]

name: eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eq_zero_iff {z : ℤ} : padicValInt p z = 0 ↔ p = 1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ z
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValInt, padicValNat.eq_zero_iff, Int.natAbs_eq_zero, ← Int.ofNat_dvd_left]

name: eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_not_dvd {z : ℤ} (h : ¬(p : ℤ) ∣ z) : padicValInt p z = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [h]

name: padicValRat_def
statement:
lemma padicValRat_def (p : ℕ) (q : ℚ) :
    padicValRat p q = padicValInt p q.num - padicValNat p q.den
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: neg
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem neg (q : ℚ) : padicValRat p (-q) = padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  simp [padicValRat, padicValInt]

name: zero
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zero : padicValRat p 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [padicValRat]

name: one
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem one : padicValRat p 1 = 0
proof: := by simp [padicValRat]

name: of_int
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_int {z : ℤ} : padicValRat p z = padicValInt p z
proof: := by simp [padicValRat]

name: of_int_multiplicity
statement:
theorem of_int_multiplicity {z : ℤ} :
    padicValRat p (z : ℚ) = multiplicity (p : ℤ) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [of_int, padicValInt.of_ne_one_ne_zero]

name: multiplicity_sub_multiplicity
statement:
theorem multiplicity_sub_multiplicity {q : ℚ} :
    padicValRat p q = multiplicity (p : ℤ) q.num - multiplicity p q.den
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValRat, padicValInt.of_ne_one_ne_zero, padicValNat_def]

name: of_nat
statement:
@[simp]
theorem of_nat {n : ℕ} : padicValRat p n = padicValNat p n
proof: := by simp [padicValRat]

name: self
statement: theorem self (hp : 1 < p) : padicValRat p p = 1
proof: := by simp [hp]

name: zero_le_padicValRat_of_nat
statement: theorem zero_le_padicValRat_of_nat (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ padicValRat p n
proof: := by simp

name: padicValRat_of_nat
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem padicValRat_of_nat (n : ℕ) : ↑(padicValNat p n) = padicValRat p n
proof: := by simp

name: padicValNat_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem padicValNat_self [Fact p.Prime] : padicValNat p p = 1
proof:
:=
  padicValNat.self Fact.out

name: one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd
statement:
theorem one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd {n : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hn : n ≠ 0) (div : p ∣ n) :
    1 ≤ padicValNat p n
proof:
:= by
  rwa [← ENat.natCast_le_natCast, padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity hn,
    ← pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity, pow_one]

name: dvd_iff_padicValNat_ne_zero
statement:
theorem dvd_iff_padicValNat_ne_zero {p n : ℕ} [Fact p.Prime] (hn0 : n ≠ 0) :
    p ∣ n ↔ padicValNat p n ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => one_le_iff_ne_zero.mp (one_le_padicValNat_of_dvd hn0 h), fun h =>
    Classical.not_not.1 (mt padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd h)⟩

name: finite_int_prime_iff
statement: theorem finite_int_prime_iff {a : ℤ} : FiniteMultiplicity (p : ℤ) a ↔ a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Int.finiteMultiplicity_iff, hp.1.ne_one]

name: defn
statement:
protected theorem defn (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] {q : ℚ} {n d : ℤ} (hqz : q ≠ 0)
    (qdf : q = n /. d) :
    padicValRat p q = multiplicity (p : ℤ) n - multiplicity (p : ℤ) d
proof:
:= by
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := Rat.mk_denom_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hqz qdf
  let ⟨c, hc1, hc2⟩ := Rat.num_den_mk hd qdf
  rw [padicValRat.multiplicity_sub_multiplicity]
  simp only [hc1, hc2]
  rw [multiplicity_mul (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1),
    multiplicity_mul (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1)]
  · rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add]
    simp_rw [Int.natCast_multiplicity p q.den]
    ring
  · simpa [finite_int_prime_iff, hc2] using hd
  · simpa [finite_int_prime_iff, hqz, hc2] using hd

name: mul
statement:
protected theorem mul {q r : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    padicValRat p (q * r) = padicValRat p q + padicValRat p r
proof:
:= by
  have : q * r = (q.num * r.num) /. (q.den * r.den) := by
    rw [Rat.mul_eq_mkRat, Rat.mkRat_eq_divInt, Nat.cast_mul]
  have hq' : q.num /. q.den ≠ 0 := by rwa [Rat.num_divInt_den]
  have hr' : r.num /. r.den ≠ 0 := by rwa [Rat.num_divInt_den]
  have hp' : Prime (p : ℤ) := Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1
  rw [padicValRat.defn p (mul_ne_zero hq hr) this]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [← q.num_divInt_den, padicValRat.defn p hq', ← r.num_divInt_den, padicValRat.defn p hr']
  rw [multiplicity_mul hp', multiplicity_mul hp', Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_add]
  · ring
  · simp [finite_int_prime_iff]
  · simp [finite_int_prime_iff, hq, hr]

name: pow
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem pow (q : ℚ) {k : ℕ} :
    padicValRat p (q ^ k) = k * padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hq := eq_or_ne q 0
  · cases k <;> simp
  induction k <;>
    simp [*, padicValRat.mul hq (pow_ne_zero _ hq), _root_.pow_succ', add_mul, add_comm]

name: inv
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem inv (q : ℚ) : padicValRat p q⁻¹ = -padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · simp [hq]
  · rw [eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero, ← padicValRat.mul (inv_ne_zero hq) hq, inv_mul_cancel₀ hq,
      padicValRat.one]

name: zpow
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem zpow (q : ℚ) {k : ℤ} :
    padicValRat p (q ^ k) = k * padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Int.negInduction <;> simp

name: div
statement:
protected theorem div {q r : ℚ} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    padicValRat p (q / r) = padicValRat p q - padicValRat p r
proof:
:= by
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, padicValRat.mul hq (inv_ne_zero hr), padicValRat.inv r, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: padicValRat_le_padicValRat_iff
statement:
theorem padicValRat_le_padicValRat_iff {n₁ n₂ d₁ d₂ : ℤ} (hn₁ : n₁ ≠ 0) (hn₂ : n₂ ≠ 0)
    (hd₁ : d₁ ≠ 0) (hd₂ : d₂ ≠ 0) :
    padicValRat p (n₁ /. d₁) ≤ padicValRat p (n₂ /. d₂) ↔
      ∀ n : ℕ, (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ n₁ * d₂ → (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ n₂ * d₁
proof:
:= by
  have hf1 : FiniteMultiplicity (p : ℤ) (n₁ * d₂) := finite_int_prime_iff.2 (mul_ne_zero hn₁ hd₂)
  have hf2 : FiniteMultiplicity (p : ℤ) (n₂ * d₁) := finite_int_prime_iff.2 (mul_ne_zero hn₂ hd₁)
  conv =>
    lhs
    rw [padicValRat.defn p (Rat.divInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn₁ hd₁) rfl,
      padicValRat.defn p (Rat.divInt_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hn₂ hd₂) rfl, sub_le_iff_le_add', ←
      add_sub_assoc, le_sub_iff_add_le]
    norm_cast
    rw [← multiplicity_mul (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1) hf1, add_comm,
        ← multiplicity_mul (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1) hf2,
        hf1.multiplicity_le_multiplicity_iff hf2]

name: le_padicValRat_add_of_le
statement:
theorem le_padicValRat_add_of_le {q r : ℚ} (hqr : q + r ≠ 0)
    (h : padicValRat p q ≤ padicValRat p r) : padicValRat p q ≤ padicValRat p (q + r)
proof:
:=
  if hq : q = 0 then by simpa [hq] using h
  else
    if hr : r = 0 then by simp [hr]
    else by
      have hqn : q.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.2 hq
      have hqd : (q.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := mod_cast Rat.den_nz _
      have hrn : r.num ≠ 0 := Rat.num_ne_zero.2 hr
      have hrd : (r.den : ℤ) ≠ 0 := mod_cast Rat.den_nz _
      have hqreq : q + r = (q.num * r.den + q.den * r.num) /. (q.den * r.den) := Rat.add_num_den _ _
      have hqrd : q.num * r.den + q.den * r.num ≠ 0 := Rat.mk_num_ne_zero_of_ne_zero hqr hqreq
      conv_lhs => rw [← q.num_divInt_den]
      rw [hqreq, padicValRat_le_padicValRat_iff hqn hqrd hqd (mul_ne_zero hqd hrd), ←
        emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff, mul_left_comm,
        emultiplicity_mul (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1), add_mul]
      rw [← q.num_divInt_den, ← r.num_divInt_den, padicValRat_le_padicValRat_iff hqn hrn hqd hrd, ←
        emultiplicity_le_emultiplicity_iff] at h
      calc
        _ ≤ min (emultiplicity ↑p (q.num * r.den * q.den))
                (emultiplicity ↑p (q.den * r.num * q.den)) :=
          le_min
            (by rw [emultiplicity_mul (a := _ * _) (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1), add_comm])
            (by grw [mul_assoc, emultiplicity_mul (b := _ * _) (Nat.prime_iff_prime_int.1 hp.1), h])
        _ ≤ _ := min_le_emultiplicity_add

name: min_le_padicValRat_add
statement:
theorem min_le_padicValRat_add {q r : ℚ} (hqr : q + r ≠ 0) :
    min (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r) ≤ padicValRat p (q + r)
proof:
:=
  (le_total (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r)).elim
  (fun h => by rw [min_eq_left h]; exact le_padicValRat_add_of_le hqr h)
  (fun h => by rw [min_eq_right h, add_comm]; exact le_padicValRat_add_of_le (by rwa [add_comm]) h)

name: add_eq_min
statement:
lemma add_eq_min {q r : ℚ} (hqr : q + r ≠ 0) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hval : padicValRat p q ≠ padicValRat p r) :
    padicValRat p (q + r) = min (padicValRat p q) (padicValRat p r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := min_le_padicValRat_add (p := p) hqr
  have h2 := min_le_padicValRat_add (p := p) (ne_of_eq_of_ne (add_neg_cancel_right q r) hq)
  have h3 := min_le_padicValRat_add (p := p) (ne_of_eq_of_ne (add_neg_cancel_right r q) hr)
  rw [add_neg_cancel_right, padicValRat.neg] at h2 h3
  rw [add_comm] at h3
  omega

name: add_eq_of_lt
statement:
lemma add_eq_of_lt {q r : ℚ} (hqr : q + r ≠ 0)
    (hq : q ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hval : padicValRat p q < padicValRat p r) :
    padicValRat p (q + r) = padicValRat p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_eq_min hqr hq hr (ne_of_lt hval), min_eq_left (le_of_lt hval)]

name: lt_add_of_lt
statement:
lemma lt_add_of_lt {q r₁ r₂ : ℚ} (hqr : r₁ + r₂ ≠ 0)
    (hval₁ : padicValRat p q < padicValRat p r₁) (hval₂ : padicValRat p q < padicValRat p r₂) :
    padicValRat p q < padicValRat p (r₁ + r₂)
proof:
:=
  lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_min hval₁ hval₂) (padicValRat.min_le_padicValRat_add hqr)

name: self_pow_inv
statement: lemma self_pow_inv (r : ℕ) : padicValRat p ((p : ℚ) ^ r)⁻¹ = -r
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValRat.inv, neg_inj, padicValRat.pow p, padicValRat.self hp.elim.one_lt, mul_one]

name: sum_pos_of_pos
statement:
theorem sum_pos_of_pos {n : ℕ} {F : ℕ → ℚ} (hF : ∀ i, i < n → 0 < padicValRat p (F i))
    (hn0 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i ≠ 0) : 0 < padicValRat p (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, F i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact False.elim (hn0 rfl)
  | succ d hd =>
    rw [Finset.sum_range_succ] at hn0 ⊢
    by_cases h : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range d, F x = 0
    · rw [h, zero_add]
      exact hF d (lt_add_one _)
    · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (min_le_padicValRat_add hn0)
      refine lt_min (hd (fun i hi => ?_) h) (hF d (lt_add_one _))
      exact hF _ (lt_trans hi (lt_add_one _))

name: lt_sum_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  induction hS using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton k =>
    rw [Finset.sum_singleton]
    exact hF k (by simp)
  | cons s S' Hnot Hne Hind =>
    rw [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.sum_insert Hnot]
    exact padicValRat.lt_add_of_lt
      (ne_of_gt (add_pos (hn1 s) (Finset.sum_pos (fun i _ => hn1 i) Hne)))
      (hF _ (by simp [Finset.mem_insert, true_or]))
      (Hind (fun i hi => hF _ (by rw [Finset.cons_eq_insert, Finset.mem_insert]; exact Or.inr hi)))

name: num_or_den_zero_padicVal
statement:
theorem num_or_den_zero_padicVal (a : ℚ) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) :
    padicValInt p a.num = 0 ∨ padicValNat p a.den = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := a.reduced
  contrapose! h
  apply not_coprime_of_dvd_of_dvd hp.one_lt <;>
    grind [padicValNat.dvd_of_ne_zero h.1, padicValNat.dvd_of_ne_zero h.2]

name: num_den_even_padicVal_of_even_padicVal
statement:
theorem num_den_even_padicVal_of_even_padicVal {a : ℚ} {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (h : Even (padicValRat p a)) : Even (padicValInt p a.num) ∧ Even (padicValNat p a.den)
proof:
:= by
  rcases num_or_den_zero_padicVal a hp with (h0 | h0) <;>
    simpa [h0, padicValRat_def] using h

name: isSquare_iff_even_factorization
statement:
theorem isSquare_iff_even_factorization {a : ℚ} :
    IsSquare a ↔ 0 ≤ a ∧ ∀ (p : ℕ), p.Prime → Even (padicValRat p a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine fun ⟨r, hr⟩ ↦ ⟨by simpa [hr] using mul_self_nonneg r, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
    have : Fact (p.Prime) := ⟨hp⟩
    rw [hr]
    by_cases hr0 : r = 0
    · simp [hr0]
    simp [padicValRat.mul hr0 hr0]
  · intro ⟨hR, hf⟩
    rw [isSquare_iff]
    constructor
    · refine Int.isSquare_iff_nonneg_even_factorization.mpr ⟨num_nonneg.mpr hR, fun p hp ↦ ?_⟩
      have num_even := (num_den_even_padicVal_of_even_padicVal hp (hf p hp)).1
      simpa [Nat.factorization_def _ hp, padicValInt] using num_even
    · refine Nat.isSquare_iff_even_factorization.mpr (fun p hp ↦ ?_)
      have den_even := (num_den_even_padicVal_of_even_padicVal hp (hf p hp)).2
      rwa [Nat.factorization_def _ hp]

name: mul
statement: protected theorem mul : a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → padicValNat p (a * b) = padicValNat p a + padicValNat p b
proof:
:=
  mod_cast padicValRat.mul (p := p) (q := a) (r := b)

name: div_of_dvd
statement:
protected theorem div_of_dvd (h : b ∣ a) :
    padicValNat p (a / b) = padicValNat p a - padicValNat p b
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · simp
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨hb, hk⟩ := mul_ne_zero_iff.mp ha
  rw [mul_comm, k.mul_div_cancel hb.bot_lt, padicValNat.mul hk hb, Nat.add_sub_cancel]

name: div
statement: protected theorem div (dvd : p ∣ b) : padicValNat p (b / p) = padicValNat p b - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.div_of_dvd dvd, padicValNat_self]

name: pow
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem pow (a n : ℕ) : padicValNat p (a ^ n) = n * padicValNat p a
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [← @Nat.cast_inj ℤ, push_cast] using padicValRat.pow a

name: prime_pow
statement: protected theorem prime_pow (n : ℕ) : padicValNat p (p ^ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.pow p, padicValNat_self, mul_one]

name: div_pow
statement: protected theorem div_pow (dvd : p ^ a ∣ b) : padicValNat p (b / p ^ a) = padicValNat p b - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.div_of_dvd dvd, padicValNat.prime_pow]

name: div'
statement:
protected theorem div' {m : ℕ} (cpm : Coprime p m) {b : ℕ} (dvd : m ∣ b) :
    padicValNat p (b / m) = padicValNat p b
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.div_of_dvd dvd, eq_zero_of_not_dvd (hp.out.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mp cpm),
    Nat.sub_zero]

name: dvd_of_one_le_padicValNat
statement: theorem dvd_of_one_le_padicValNat {n : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ padicValNat p n) : p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  rw [padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd h] at hp
  exact lt_irrefl 0 (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)

name: padicValNat_dvd_iff_le_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem padicValNat_dvd_iff_le_of_ne_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 1) {a n : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    p ^ n ∣ a ↔ n ≤ padicValNat p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity, ← padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one hp ha, Nat.cast_le]

name: padicValNat_dvd_iff_le
statement:
theorem padicValNat_dvd_iff_le [hp : Fact p.Prime] {a n : ℕ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    p ^ n ∣ a ↔ n ≤ padicValNat p a
proof:
:=
  padicValNat_dvd_iff_le_of_ne_one hp.out.ne_one ha

name: padicValNat_dvd_iff_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem padicValNat_dvd_iff_of_ne_one {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 1) (n a : ℕ) :
    p ^ n ∣ a ↔ a = 0 ∨ n ≤ padicValNat p a
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha)
  · exact iff_of_true (dvd_zero _) (Or.inl rfl)
  · rw [padicValNat_dvd_iff_le_of_ne_one hp ha, or_iff_right ha]

name: padicValNat_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem padicValNat_dvd_iff (n : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (a : ℕ) :
    p ^ n ∣ a ↔ a = 0 ∨ n ≤ padicValNat p a
proof:
:=
  padicValNat_dvd_iff_of_ne_one hp.out.ne_one n a

name: pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd
statement:
theorem pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd {n : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    ¬p ^ (padicValNat p n + 1) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat_dvd_iff_le hn, not_le]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

name: padicValNat_primes
statement:
theorem padicValNat_primes {q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime] (ne : p ≠ q) :
    padicValNat p q = 0

name: padicValNat_prime_prime_pow
statement:
theorem padicValNat_prime_prime_pow {q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime]
    (n : ℕ) (ne : p ≠ q) : padicValNat p (q ^ n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.pow _, padicValNat_primes ne, mul_zero]

name: padicValNat_mul_pow_left
statement:
theorem padicValNat_mul_pow_left {q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime]
    (n m : ℕ) (ne : p ≠ q) : padicValNat p (p ^ n * q ^ m) = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat.mul (NeZero.ne' (p ^ n)).symm (NeZero.ne' (q ^ m)).symm,
    padicValNat.prime_pow, padicValNat_prime_prime_pow m ne, add_zero]

name: padicValNat_mul_pow_right
statement:
theorem padicValNat_mul_pow_right {q : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] [hq : Fact q.Prime]
    (n m : ℕ) (ne : q ≠ p) : padicValNat q (p ^ n * q ^ m) = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm (p ^ n) (q ^ m)]
  exact padicValNat_mul_pow_left m n ne

name: padicValNat_le_nat_log
statement: lemma padicValNat_le_nat_log (n : ℕ) : padicValNat p n ≤ Nat.log p n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · simp
  rcases p with _ | _ | p
  · simp
  · simp
  exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le p.one_lt_succ_succ (le_of_dvd n.succ_pos pow_padicValNat_dvd)

name: padicValNat_add_le_self
statement:
lemma padicValNat_add_le_self {a : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (ha : p < a) :
    padicValNat p a + p ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases dvd : p ∣ a
  · rcases dvd with ⟨k, hk⟩
    have : padicValNat p k < k := by calc
      _ ≤ log p k := padicValNat_le_nat_log k
      _ < _ := log_lt_self p (by lia)
    rw [hk, padicValNat.mul (by lia) (by lia), padicValNat_self]
    calc
      _ ≤ p + k := by lia
      _ ≤ _ := Nat.add_le_mul hp.out.two_le (by lia)
  · rw [padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd dvd]
    lia

name: nat_log_eq_padicValNat_iff
statement:
lemma nat_log_eq_padicValNat_iff {n : ℕ} [hp : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    Nat.log p n = padicValNat p n ↔ n < p ^ (padicValNat p n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.log_eq_iff (Or.inr ⟨(Nat.Prime.one_lt' p).out, by lia⟩), and_iff_right_iff_imp]
  exact fun _ => Nat.le_of_dvd (Nat.pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn) pow_padicValNat_dvd

name: Nat.log_ne_padicValNat_succ
statement: lemma Nat.log_ne_padicValNat_succ {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : log 2 n ≠ padicValNat 2 (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ne, log_eq_iff (by simp [hn])]
  rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
  rw [← Nat.lt_add_one_iff, ← mul_one (2 ^ _)] at h1
  rw [← add_one_le_iff, Nat.pow_succ] at h2
  refine not_dvd_of_lt_of_lt_mul_succ h1 (lt_of_le_of_ne' h2 ?_) pow_padicValNat_dvd
  
  exact pow_succ_padicValNat_not_dvd (p := 2) n.succ_ne_zero ∘ dvd_of_eq

name: Nat.max_log_padicValNat_succ_eq_log_succ
statement:
lemma Nat.max_log_padicValNat_succ_eq_log_succ (n : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    max (log p n) (padicValNat p (n + 1)) = log p (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (max_le (le_log_of_pow_le hp.out.one_lt (pow_log_le_add_one p n))
    (padicValNat_le_nat_log (n + 1)))
  rw [le_max_iff, or_iff_not_imp_left, not_le]
  intro h
  replace h := le_antisymm (add_one_le_iff.mpr (lt_pow_of_log_lt hp.out.one_lt h))
    (pow_log_le_self p n.succ_ne_zero)
  rw [h, padicValNat.prime_pow, ← h]

name: range_pow_padicValNat_subset_divisors
statement:
theorem range_pow_padicValNat_subset_divisors {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.range (padicValNat p n + 1)).image (p ^ ·) ⊆ n.divisors
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at ht
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := ht
  rw [Nat.mem_divisors]
  exact ⟨(pow_dvd_pow p <| by lia).trans pow_padicValNat_dvd, hn⟩

name: range_pow_padicValNat_subset_divisors'
statement:
theorem range_pow_padicValNat_subset_divisors' {n : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    ((Finset.range (padicValNat p n)).image fun t => p ^ (t + 1)) ⊆ n.divisors.erase 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with (rfl | hn)
  · simp
  intro t ht
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range] at ht
  obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := ht
  rw [Finset.mem_erase, Nat.mem_divisors]
  refine ⟨?_, (pow_dvd_pow p <| succ_le_iff.2 hk).trans pow_padicValNat_dvd, hn⟩
  exact (Nat.one_lt_pow k.succ_ne_zero hp.out.one_lt).ne'

name: padicValNat_factorial_mul
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_mul (n : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    padicValNat p (p * n)! = padicValNat p n ! + n
proof:
:= by
  apply Nat.cast_injective (R := ℕ∞)
  rw [padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity <| factorial_ne_zero (p * n), Nat.cast_add,
      padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity <| factorial_ne_zero n]
  exact Prime.emultiplicity_factorial_mul hp.out

name: padicValNat_eq_zero_of_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem padicValNat_eq_zero_of_mem_Ioo {m k : ℕ}
    (hm : m ∈ Set.Ioo (p * k) (p * (k + 1))) : padicValNat p m = 0
proof:
:=
  padicValNat.eq_zero_of_not_dvd <| not_dvd_of_lt_of_lt_mul_succ hm.1 hm.2

name: padicValNat_factorial_mul_add
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_mul_add {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] (h : n < p) :
    padicValNat p (p * m + n)! = padicValNat p (p * m)!
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [add_zero]
  | succ n hn =>
    rw [add_succ, factorial_succ,
      padicValNat.mul (succ_ne_zero (p * m + n)) <| factorial_ne_zero (p * m + _),
      hn <| lt_of_succ_lt h, ← add_succ,
      padicValNat_eq_zero_of_mem_Ioo ⟨(Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right <| succ_pos n),
        (Nat.mul_add _ _ _▸ Nat.mul_one _ ▸ ((add_lt_add_iff_left (p * m)).mpr h))⟩,
      zero_add]

name: padicValNat_mul_div_factorial
statement:
@[simp] theorem padicValNat_mul_div_factorial (n : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    padicValNat p (p * (n / p))! = padicValNat p n !
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← div_add_mod n p]
  exact (padicValNat_factorial_mul_add (n / p) <| mod_lt n hp.out.pos).symm

name: padicValNat_factorial
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial {n b : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hnb : log p n < b) :
    padicValNat p (n !) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b, n / p ^ i
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast ((padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity (p := p) <| factorial_ne_zero _) ▸
      Prime.emultiplicity_factorial hp.out hnb)

name: sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial [hp : Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) :
    (p - 1) * padicValNat p (n !) = n - (p.digits n).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValNat_factorial <| lt_succ_of_lt <| lt_add_one (log p n)]
  nth_rw 2 [← zero_add 1]
  rw [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← Finset.sum_Ico_add' _ 0 _ 1,
    Ico_zero_eq_range, ← sub_one_mul_sum_log_div_pow_eq_sub_sum_digits, Nat.succ_eq_add_one]

name: sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero [hp : Fact p.Prime] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (p - 1) * padicValNat p n.factorial < n
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial n]
  refine Nat.sub_lt_self ?_ (digit_sum_le p n)
  have hnil : p.digits n ≠ [] := Nat.digits_ne_nil_iff_ne_zero.mpr hn
  exact List.sum_pos_iff_exists_pos_nat.mpr
    ⟨_, List.getLast_mem hnil, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (Nat.getLast_digit_ne_zero p hn)⟩

name: padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero [hp : Fact p.Prime] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p n.factorial < n
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt _ (sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero p hn)
  conv_lhs => rw [← one_mul (padicValNat p n !)]
  gcongr
  exact le_sub_one_of_lt (Nat.Prime.one_lt hp.elim)

name: padicValNat_factorial_le
statement: theorem padicValNat_factorial_le [hp : Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) : padicValNat p n.factorial ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  · exact le_of_lt (padicValNat_factorial_lt_of_ne_zero p hn)

name: padicValNat_choose
statement:
theorem padicValNat_choose {n k b : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hkn : k ≤ n) (hnb : log p n < b) :
    padicValNat p (choose n k) = #{i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + (n - k) % p ^ i}
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity (p := p) <| (choose_ne_zero hkn)) ▸
    Prime.emultiplicity_choose hp.out hkn hnb

name: padicValNat_choose'
statement:
theorem padicValNat_choose' {n k b : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (hnb : log p (n + k) < b) :
    padicValNat p (choose (n + k) k) = #{i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b | p ^ i ≤ k % p ^ i + n % p ^ i}
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast (padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity (p := p) <| choose_ne_zero <|
    Nat.le_add_left k n) ▸ Prime.emultiplicity_choose' hp.out hnb

name: sub_one_mul_padicValNat_choose_eq_sub_sum_digits'
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_padicValNat_choose_eq_sub_sum_digits' {k n : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] :
    (p - 1) * padicValNat p (choose (n + k) k) =
    (p.digits k).sum + (p.digits n).sum - (p.digits (n + k)).sum
proof:
:= by
  have h : k ≤ n + k := by exact Nat.le_add_left k n
  simp only [Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial h]
  rw [padicValNat.div_of_dvd <| factorial_mul_factorial_dvd_factorial h, Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib,
      padicValNat.mul (factorial_ne_zero _) (factorial_ne_zero _), Nat.mul_add]
  simp only [sub_one_mul_padicValNat_factorial]
  rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm <| digit_sum_le p k, Nat.add_sub_cancel n k, ← Nat.add_sub_assoc <|
      digit_sum_le p n, Nat.sub_sub (k + n), ← Nat.sub_right_comm, Nat.sub_sub, sub_add_eq,
      add_comm, tsub_tsub_assoc (Nat.le_refl (k + n)) <| (add_comm k n) ▸ (Nat.add_le_add
      (digit_sum_le p n) (digit_sum_le p k)), Nat.sub_self (k + n), zero_add, add_comm]

name: sub_one_mul_padicValNat_choose_eq_sub_sum_digits
statement:
theorem sub_one_mul_padicValNat_choose_eq_sub_sum_digits {k n : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (h : k ≤ n) : (p - 1) * padicValNat p (choose n k) =
    (p.digits k).sum + (p.digits (n - k)).sum - (p.digits n).sum
proof:
:= by
  convert! @sub_one_mul_padicValNat_choose_eq_sub_sum_digits' _ _ _ ‹_›
  all_goals lia

name: padicValInt_dvd_iff_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem padicValInt_dvd_iff_of_ne_one (hp : p ≠ 1) (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ a ↔ a = 0 ∨ n ≤ padicValInt p a
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValInt, ← Int.natAbs_eq_zero, ← padicValNat_dvd_iff_of_ne_one hp, ← Int.natCast_dvd,
    Int.natCast_pow]

name: padicValInt_dvd_iff
statement:
theorem padicValInt_dvd_iff [hp : Fact p.Prime] (n : ℕ) (a : ℤ) :
    (p : ℤ) ^ n ∣ a ↔ a = 0 ∨ n ≤ padicValInt p a
proof:
:=
  padicValInt_dvd_iff_of_ne_one hp.out.ne_one n a

name: padicValInt_dvd
statement: theorem padicValInt_dvd (a : ℤ) : (p : ℤ) ^ padicValInt p a ∣ a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = 1
  · rw [hp, Nat.cast_one, one_pow]; exact one_dvd _
  rw [padicValInt_dvd_iff_of_ne_one hp]
  exact Or.inr le_rfl

name: padicValInt_self
statement: theorem padicValInt_self [hp : Fact p.Prime] : padicValInt p p = 1
proof:
:=
  padicValInt.self hp.out.one_lt

name: padicValInt.mul
statement:
theorem padicValInt.mul [hp : Fact p.Prime] {a b : ℤ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    padicValInt p (a * b) = padicValInt p a + padicValInt p b
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [padicValInt]
  rw [Int.natAbs_mul, padicValNat.mul] <;> rwa [Int.natAbs_ne_zero]

name: padicValInt_mul_eq_succ
statement:
theorem padicValInt_mul_eq_succ [hp : Fact p.Prime] (a : ℤ) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    padicValInt p (a * p) = padicValInt p a + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [padicValInt.mul ha (Int.natCast_ne_zero.mpr hp.out.ne_zero)]
  simp only [padicValInt.of_nat, padicValNat_self]

name: padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one (hp : p ≠ 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p n = emultiplicity p n
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_comm, emultiplicity_eq_coe, pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat hp hn,
    pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat hp hn]
  simp

name: Nat.toNat_emultiplicity
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Nat.toNat_emultiplicity (p n : ℕ) : (emultiplicity p n).toNat = padicValNat p n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne p 1 with rfl | hp
  · simp
  · rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn
    · simp
    · simp [← padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one, *]

name: padicValNat_def
statement: theorem padicValNat_def {n : ℕ} : padicValNat p n = multiplicity p n
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · simp [hn]
  by_cases hp : p = 1
  · simp [hp]
  exact (multiplicity_eq_of_emultiplicity_eq_some
    (padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one hp hn).symm).symm

name: padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity
statement:
theorem padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity [hp : Fact p.Prime] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    padicValNat p n = emultiplicity p n
proof:
:=
  padicValNat_eq_emultiplicity_of_ne_one hp.out.ne_one hn

name: zero
statement:
@[deprecated padicValNat_zero_right (since := "2026-03-15")]
protected theorem zero : padicValNat p 0 = 0
proof: := padicValNat_zero_right p

name: one
statement:
@[deprecated padicValNat_one_right (since := "2026-03-15")]
protected theorem one : padicValNat p 1 = 0

name: eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} : padicValNat p n = 0 ↔ p = 1 ∨ n = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne n 0 with rfl | hn₀; · simp
  rcases eq_or_ne p 1 with rfl | hp₁; · simp
  simpa [*] using pow_dvd_iff_le_padicValNat (k := 1) hp₁ hn₀ |>.symm |>.not

name: le_emultiplicity_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList
statement:
theorem le_emultiplicity_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList {a b : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (ha : a.Prime)
    (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ↑n ≤ emultiplicity a b ↔ replicate n a <+~ b.primeFactorsList
proof:
:=
  (replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList_iff ha hb).trans
    pow_dvd_iff_le_emultiplicity |>.symm

name: le_padicValNat_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList
statement:
theorem le_padicValNat_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList {a b : ℕ} {n : ℕ} (ha : a.Prime)
    (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    n ≤ padicValNat a b ↔ replicate n a <+~ b.primeFactorsList
proof:
:= by
  rw [← le_emultiplicity_iff_replicate_subperm_primeFactorsList ha hb,
    Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff.2 ⟨ha.ne_one, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb⟩
      |>.emultiplicity_eq_multiplicity, ← padicValNat_def,
    ENat.natCast_le_natCast]

name: mul_padicValNat_le
statement: theorem mul_padicValNat_le {p n : ℕ} : p * padicValNat p n ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p 1
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hn := eq_or_ne n 0
  · simp
  grw [Nat.mul_le_pow hp, Nat.le_of_dvd hn.bot_lt pow_padicValNat_dvd]

name: prodMk_prod_apply

lemma prodMk_prod_apply (f : C(X, R)) (g : C(Y, R)) :
    prodMk μ ν ((f.comp .fst) * (g.comp .snd)) = μ f * ν g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← smul_eq_mul, prodMk_apply, ← map_smul]
  congr 1 with y
  simp_rw [contractFst_apply, ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (μ f) (g y),
    ← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul]

  simp_rw [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (g y) (f x)]
  rfl

name: prodMk'_flip
statement:
lemma prodMk'_flip (f : C(X × Y, R)) :
    (μ.prodMk' ν) f = (ν.prodMk μ) (f.comp ContinuousMap.prodSwap)
proof: := (rfl)

name: prodMk'_prod_apply
statement:
lemma prodMk'_prod_apply (f : C(X, R)) (g : C(Y, R)) :
    prodMk' μ ν ((f.comp .fst) * (g.comp .snd)) = μ f * ν g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prodMk'_apply, mul_comm (μ f) (ν g), ← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul]
  congr 1 with x
  simp_rw [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm (ν g) (f x), contractSnd_apply,
    ← smul_eq_mul, ← map_smul]
  rfl

name: prodMk_eq_prodMk'
statement: lemma prodMk_eq_prodMk' : prodMk μ ν = prodMk' μ ν
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.coe_injective
  apply denseRange_tensorHom.equalizer (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (funext fun h ↦ ?_)
  induction h with
  | add => grind
  | tmul f g => simp [prodMul_def, prodMk_prod_apply μ, prodMk'_prod_apply μ]

name: AbstractMeasure.ext_mahler
statement:
lemma AbstractMeasure.ext_mahler {μ : D(ℤ_[p], R)}
    (hμ : ∀ n, μ ((mahler n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) • 1) = 0) : μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := toCLMEquiv.symm.surjective μ
  simpa using PadicInt.ext_mahler (by simpa using hμ)

name: coeff_amiceTransform
statement:
lemma coeff_amiceTransform (μ : D(ℤ_[p], R)) (n : ℕ) :
    μ.amiceTransform.coeff n = μ ((mahler n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) • (1 : C(ℤ_[p], R)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [amiceTransform]

name: injective_amiceTransform
statement: lemma injective_amiceTransform : Function.Injective (amiceTransform : D(ℤ_[p], R) → _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
  intro μ hμ
  apply ext_mahler
  simp_all [PowerSeries.ext_iff, coeff_amiceTransform]

name: invTransformSummable
statement:
private lemma invTransformSummable (F : ℤ_[p]⟦X⟧) (f : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) :
    Summable fun i ↦ PadicInt.mahlerEquiv ℤ_[p] f i * F.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  apply NonarchimedeanAddGroup.summable_of_tendsto_cofinite_zero
  rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero, ← Filter.cocompact_eq_cofinite]
  simp only [norm_mul, mul_comm _ ‖F.coeff _‖]
  apply bdd_le_mul_tendsto_zero'
  · filter_upwards with i
    simpa using PadicInt.norm_le_one _
  · rw [← tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
    exact ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.zero_at_infty' _

name: invTransform_apply
statement:
lemma invTransform_apply (F : ℤ_[p]⟦X⟧) (f : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) :
    invTransform F f = ∑' i, PadicInt.mahlerEquiv ℤ_[p] f i * F.coeff i
proof:
:= by
  simp [invTransform, invTransformₗ]

name: amiceTransform_invTransform
statement:
lemma amiceTransform_invTransform (F : ℤ_[p]⟦X⟧) :
    amiceTransform (invTransform F) = F
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  have (i : ℕ) : (fwdDiff 1)^[i] (fun x : ℤ_[p] ↦ mahler n x) 0 = if i = n then 1 else 0 := by
    simp [← fwdDiff_iter_choose_zero n i, fwdDiff_iter_eq_sum_shift, mahler_natCast_eq]
  simp [coeff_amiceTransform, invTransform_apply, PadicInt.mahlerEquiv_apply, this]

name: amiceTransformEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma amiceTransformEquiv_apply (μ : D(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) :
    μ.amiceTransformEquiv = μ.amiceTransform
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: coeff_amiceTransformEquiv
statement:
lemma coeff_amiceTransformEquiv (μ : D(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p])) (n : ℕ) :
    μ.amiceTransformEquiv.coeff n = μ (mahler n : C(ℤ_[p], ℤ_[p]))
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff_amiceTransform]
